records.catalog_description: Individual performance goals with owner, period, metric, weight, and status, aligned to organizational objectives and reviewed within performance cycles.

records.description: Bench plan for a critical position: identified successors, readiness ratings (ready_now, 1-2_years, 3+_years), development plans, risk-of-loss assessment.
records.catalog_description: Bench plans for critical positions, listing identified successors, readiness ratings, development plans, and risk of loss.

records.description: Group session where managers normalize ratings across populations to remove rater bias and fit forced-distribution constraints. Produces calibrated performance_reviews outcomes.
records.catalog_description: Calibration sessions where managers normalize performance ratings across groups to reduce bias and meet distribution constraints.

records.description: Performance × Potential 3x3 grid placement per worker per cycle. Drives succession_plans, high-potential identification, and differentiated investment.
records.catalog_description: Placements of a worker on a performance-by-potential nine-box grid per cycle, feeding succession planning and high-potential identification.

records.description: Worker-declared career interest: target roles, mobility preferences (geographic, functional), aspired timeline. Drives internal-mobility matching.
records.catalog_description: Worker-declared career interests, including target roles, mobility preferences, and timeline, used to drive internal-mobility matching.

records.description: Continuous-feedback artifact: kudos, 1-on-1 notes, requested feedback, peer comments. Independent of formal cycle structure; aggregated into performance_reviews summaries.
records.catalog_description: Continuous feedback such as kudos, one-on-one notes, requested feedback, and peer comments, independent of formal review cycles.

records.description: Listening cadence definition: annual engagement, pulse, lifecycle (onboarding, 30/60/90-day, exit), 360-feedback. Carries audience, question set, frequency, anonymity floor.
records.catalog_description: Survey program definitions for engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 feedback, with audience, question set, frequency, and anonymity floor.

records.description: Individual employee response to a survey_campaign instance. Aggregated under anonymity thresholds to engagement_drivers; never exposed at individual level to managers below floor.
records.catalog_description: Individual employee responses to a survey, aggregated under anonymity thresholds and never exposed individually to managers.

records.description: Calculated driver score (e.g. Strategy, Growth, Recognition, Wellbeing, Leadership) at a team/department/segment grain. The action layer of engagement listening.
records.catalog_description: Calculated driver scores, such as growth, recognition, and leadership, at a team, department, or segment level.
records.notes: Config-shaped framework definitions; no workflow. Edited by program admin; record_status is the only state worth tracking.

records.description: Team or manager action commitment in response to engagement_drivers result. Tracked to closure; recurring failure to act is itself an engagement signal.
records.catalog_description: Team or manager commitments to act on engagement survey results, tracked through to closure.

records.description: Bank of survey items rotated through pulse cadence with research-backed driver mapping, anti-fatigue rotation, and benchmarking.
records.catalog_description: Survey items rotated through pulse-survey cadences, with driver mapping, anti-fatigue rotation, and benchmarking.
records.notes: Config-shaped library entries; published vs draft is the only state worth tracking and is captured by record_status.

records.description: Non-employee resource: 1099 contractor, agency staff, statement-of-work consultant, intern. Carries supplier, role, rate, end date, classification basis. Distinct from employees by lifecycle, payment path, and benefits eligibility.
records.catalog_description: Non-employee resources such as contractors, agency staff, consultants, and interns, with supplier, role, rate, and end date.

records.description: Staff-augmentation or statement-of-work requisition: scope, role, rate range, duration, location, hiring manager, supplier-tier rules. Drives supplier distribution and candidate submission.
records.catalog_description: Preventive maintenance work orders covering scope, schedule, assignee, and execution status for planned upkeep.

records.description: Agency or managed-service provider relationship with tiered preference, performance scorecard, master service agreement, and certified-recruiter roster.
records.catalog_description: Staffing agency and managed-service relationships, with preference tier, performance scorecard, service agreement, and recruiter roster.

records.description: Pre-agreed bill rate by role, geography, and supplier tier. Drives consistent work_order pricing and AP-side three-way match.
records.catalog_description: Pre-agreed bill rates by role, geography, and supplier tier, driving consistent work-order pricing and accounts-payable matching.

records.description: Hours-worked timesheet from a contingent_worker against a work_order: approved hours, expenses, project codes. Feeds contingent_invoices for supplier billing.
records.catalog_description: Timesheets from contingent workers against a work order, with approved hours, expenses, and project codes.

records.description: Supplier-issued invoice for contingent labor, computed from contingent_timesheets × rate_cards. Routed through AP-AUTO for three-way match and payment.
records.catalog_description: Supplier invoices for contingent labor, computed from approved timesheets and rate cards, then routed for matching and payment.

records.description: Employee inquiry or service request routed to HR Operations (pay question, benefits change, policy clarification, leave request, complaint). The HRSD analog of ITSM service_requests, scoped to HR-owned workflows.
records.catalog_description: Employee inquiries and service requests routed to HR operations, such as pay questions, benefits changes, leave requests, and complaints.
records.notes: Contains sensitive employee data (ER complaints, medical leave, comp questions). Cases can reopen after closure.

records.description: Taxonomy of HR ask types (Pay, Benefits, Leave, Policy, Time, Compensation, Performance, Employee Relations, Compliance). Drives routing, SLA, knowledge-article lookup, and trend analytics.
records.catalog_description: Taxonomy of HR request types such as pay, benefits, leave, and policy, driving routing, SLAs, knowledge lookup, and trend analytics.
records.notes: Config-shaped; no workflow. Authored once by HRSD admin, edited inline; no per-state permissions needed. B12 exempt.

records.description: Individual posting to the general ledger: header (date, source, period) plus balanced debit / credit lines tagged with GL account, cost center, dimension members. The atomic accounting unit.
records.catalog_description: Individual postings to the general ledger: a header plus balanced debit and credit lines tagged with account, cost center, and dimensions.

records.description: Account in the chart of accounts: code, name, type (asset/liability/equity/revenue/expense), normal balance, statutory mapping. The schema of the books.
records.catalog_description: Accounts in the chart of accounts, with code, name, type, normal balance, and statutory mapping.

records.description: Organizational unit for cost allocation: name, code, manager, hierarchy, currency. Drives variance reporting and project / departmental P&L. A near-universal foreign key in finance and payroll.
records.catalog_description: Organizational units for cost allocation, with code, manager, hierarchy, and currency, driving variance and departmental reporting.

records.description: Statutory company: legal name, registration, jurisdiction, currency, fiscal calendar. Books are kept per legal entity; consolidation rolls them up.
records.catalog_description: Statutory companies, with legal name, registration, jurisdiction, currency, and fiscal calendar. Books are kept per entity and consolidated upward.

records.description: Time bucket within a fiscal year: status (open / soft_close / closed / locked), period dates, calendar/fiscal alignment. Drives period-end close orchestration.
records.catalog_description: Time buckets within a fiscal year, with open, soft-close, closed, or locked status that drives period-end close.

records.description: Owned cash or operating account at a bank: institution, account number, IBAN/routing, currency, intended use (operating, payroll, AP, trust). Drives cash management and payment runs.
records.catalog_description: Owned cash or operating accounts at a bank, with institution, account number, currency, and intended use, driving cash management and payment runs.

records.description: Posting to a bank_account: incoming receipt, outgoing payment, transfer, fee. Drives reconciliation against journal_entries and bank statements.
records.catalog_description: Postings to a bank account such as receipts, payments, transfers, and fees, used to reconcile against journal entries and bank statements.

records.description: Capitalized property/plant/equipment record: acquisition date, cost basis, useful life, depreciation method, location, status. Distinct from operational hardware_assets (CMDB/HAM).
records.catalog_description: Capitalized property, plant, and equipment records, with acquisition date, cost basis, useful life, depreciation method, and location.

records.description: Per-fixed_asset per-book depreciation calculation timeline: period-by-period depreciation expense and accumulated depreciation. Drives the monthly depreciation journal_entries.
records.catalog_description: Per-asset, per-book depreciation timelines giving period-by-period expense and accumulated depreciation, driving the monthly depreciation entries.

records.description: Transaction between two legal_entities of the same group: intercompany invoice, transfer, allocation. Drives elimination entries at consolidation.
records.catalog_description: Transactions between two legal entities of the same group, such as intercompany invoices, transfers, and allocations, driving consolidation eliminations.

records.description: Three-way-match outcome record: invoice, purchase_order, goods_receipt with line-level match status (matched / quantity_variance / price_variance / no_po / exception). Drives auto-post or exception-queue routing.
records.catalog_description: Three-way-match outcomes linking invoice, purchase order, and goods receipt, with line-level match status that drives posting or exception handling.

records.description: Scheduled batch of supplier payments grouped by bank_account, currency, payment method (ACH, wire, check, SEPA). Drives the AP payment cycle.
records.catalog_description: Scheduled batches of supplier payments grouped by bank account, currency, and method, driving the accounts-payable payment cycle.

records.description: Vendor master record: legal name, tax id, addresses, payment terms, contacts, currency, statuses, risk profile. The supplier-side analog to the customer master.
records.catalog_description: Vendor master records, holding legal name, tax id, addresses, payment terms, contacts, currency, status, and risk profile.
records.naming_authority_rationale: Supplier is the unambiguous canonical term across business software. Multi-master is a metadata reality (SUP-LIFE lifecycle + MDM master record); staffing_suppliers is an HCM-side niche sibling that justifies its own prefix without dispossessing the bare term.

records.description: Onboarding workflow instance for a new supplier: invitation, registration form, document collection (W-9, banking, insurance, compliance attestations), approval chain.
records.catalog_description: Onboarding workflows for new suppliers, covering invitation, registration, document collection, and approval chain.

records.description: Risk and compliance profile for an active supplier: sanctions screening, financial-health rating, ESG scoring, ISO/SOC certifications, cyber-risk assessment. Periodically reassessed.
records.catalog_description: Risk and compliance profiles for active suppliers, including sanctions screening, financial health, ESG scoring, and certifications.

records.description: KPI-weighted performance rating of a supplier over a period: on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, savings delivered. Drives tier preference in sourcing decisions.
records.catalog_description: Weighted performance ratings of suppliers over a period, scoring on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and savings delivered.

records.description: Employee-submitted bundle of expense_lines for a trip, project, or period. Carries submission status, approval chain, reimbursement / payroll-payback routing.
records.catalog_description: Employee-submitted bundles of expense lines for a trip, project, or period, with submission status, approval chain, and reimbursement routing.

records.description: Individual line on an expense_report: date, merchant, category, amount, tax, billable flag, receipt reference. The atomic expense unit feeding GL coding.
records.catalog_description: Individual lines on an expense report: date, merchant, category, amount, tax, billable flag, and receipt. The atomic expense unit.

records.description: Issued corporate card record: issuer, last four, cardholder, account, status, controls (per-transaction limits, MCC blocks). Feeds the card_transactions stream.
records.catalog_description: Issued corporate cards, with issuer, last four, cardholder, status, and spending controls, feeding the card transaction stream.

records.description: Authorization / settlement record from a corporate_card feed: merchant, MCC, amount, FX, posting date. Matched to expense_lines for full audit trail.
records.catalog_description: Authorization and settlement records from a corporate card feed, with merchant, category, amount, and posting date, matched to expense lines.

records.description: Configurable rule: per-diem caps, category limits, mandatory receipts, mileage rates, FX rounding. Applied at expense_line entry to flag violations.
records.catalog_description: Configurable expense rules, such as per-diem caps, category limits, receipt requirements, and mileage rates, applied to flag violations.

records.description: Imported itinerary from a travel-booking partner: air, hotel, ground. Pre-trip approval and post-trip expense reconciliation.
records.catalog_description: Imported travel itineraries (air, hotel, ground) with pre-trip approval and post-trip expense reconciliation.

records.description: Client-facing engagement: scope, contract, start/end, billing type (T&M / fixed_fee / milestone / retainer), revenue recognition method, project manager, billing entity.
records.catalog_description: Client-facing engagements with scope, contract, dates, billing type, revenue-recognition method, and assigned project manager.
records.notes: Pattern flags considered (2026-05-26 audit): no personal content (engagement-level metadata only), no submit-lock (project plan stays editable through closeout), no single-approver (project manager governs without a sole-approver gate).

records.description: Decomposed unit of work inside a project: scope, dependencies, estimated hours, status. Drives time entry tagging and Earned Value calculation.
records.catalog_description: Decomposed units of work within a project, with scope, dependencies, estimated hours, and status, used for time tracking and earned-value calculation.
records.notes: Pattern flags considered (2026-05-26 audit): no personal content, no submit-lock (status updates editable in flight), no single-approver (task completion does not require a sole approver).

records.description: Worker-to-project allocation with role, bill rate, cost rate, planned hours, period. Drives utilization and resource-availability reporting.
records.catalog_description: Allocations of a worker to a project, with role, bill rate, cost rate, planned hours, and period, driving utilization and availability reporting.
records.notes: Pattern flags considered (2026-05-26 audit): no personal content (refs employee identity via FK), no submit-lock (allocation editable until release), no single-approver (resource-mgr approves but is not a sole authority).

records.description: Discrete billing trigger inside a project: milestone definition, amount, trigger condition, status. Drives revenue recognition and customer invoicing on fixed-fee engagements.
records.catalog_description: Discrete billing triggers within a project, with amount, trigger condition, and status, driving revenue recognition and invoicing on fixed-fee work.
records.notes: Pattern flags considered (2026-05-26 audit): no personal content, no submit-lock (milestone description stays editable until reached), no single-approver (customer signoff is workflow-level, captured by the reached state).

records.description: User-built application on the low-code platform: name, owner, deployment, permissions, status. The unit of LCAP delivery.
records.catalog_description: User-built applications on the low-code platform, with name, owner, deployment, permissions, and status.

records.description: Custom domain object defined within an LCAP app: schema, fields, references, validation rules, security model. The data layer of the LCAP delivery.
records.catalog_description: Custom domain objects defined within a low-code app, including schema, fields, references, validation rules, and security model.

records.description: Business process definition inside an LCAP app: states, transitions, role-based steps, integrations, escalations. The behavior layer of the LCAP delivery.
records.catalog_description: Business process definitions inside a low-code app: states, transitions, role-based steps, integrations, and escalations.

records.description: The installed RMM agent on an endpoint or server: its version, last check-in time, health, configuration state, and telemetry-channel status. Distinct from configuration_items (CMDB's relationship/abstraction model) and hardware_assets (HAM's financial/lifecycle model) — rmm_agents is the operational liveness view used by RMM tools.
records.catalog_description: Installed monitoring-and-management agents on endpoints and servers, with version, last check-in, health, configuration state, and telemetry status.

records.description: A scheduled or ad-hoc deployment of OS or third-party patches to a defined set of endpoints, with per-endpoint approval, execution status, success/failure, and rollback state. Tied to maintenance windows and approval workflows.
records.catalog_description: Scheduled or ad-hoc deployments of OS and software patches to a set of endpoints, with per-endpoint approval, execution status, and rollback state.

records.description: A reusable script (PowerShell, Bash, batch, Python) in the RMM tool's script library for remote execution against managed endpoints, with version history, parameter schema, scheduled runs, and per-target execution outcome.
records.catalog_description: Reusable remote-execution scripts in a management tool's library, with version history, parameter schema, scheduled runs, and per-target outcomes.

records.description: Registered table or view in the platform catalog, materialized over open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi) on object storage or as native warehouse tables. Carries catalog/schema/name, ownership, tags, classification, format metadata, and a pointer to the underlying physical layout. The unit of data on which lineage, governance, BI queries, and ML training all sit.
records.catalog_description: Registered tables and views in the platform catalog over open table formats, with ownership, tags, classification, and a pointer to the physical layout. The unit lineage, governance, BI, and ML all sit on.

records.description: Pipeline definition and its run history: ELT/ETL jobs, streaming pipelines, dbt-style transformation models, and managed ingestion connectors. Includes scheduling, dependency graph, lineage edges to source and target tables, and run-level observability (status, duration, rows processed).
records.catalog_description: Data pipeline definitions and their run history, covering ingestion and transformation jobs, scheduling, dependencies, and run-level observability.

records.description: Registered machine-learning model with versions, training-data lineage, evaluation metrics, deployment endpoints, and approval state. Backed by the platform's model registry. Distinct from PA's predictive_models, which is the HR-specific attrition-modeling concept consumed inside People Analytics workflows.
records.catalog_description: Registered machine-learning models with versions, training-data lineage, evaluation metrics, deployment endpoints, and approval state.

records.description: Versioned feature-store entry: feature definitions, materialization logic, online/offline serving configuration, freshness SLA, and lineage to source tables. The intermediate artifact between raw data and trained models.
records.catalog_description: Versioned feature-store entries with feature definitions, serving configuration, freshness targets, and lineage to source tables.

records.description: Metric or dimension definition in the platform's semantic layer: metric views, semantic models, ontology measures, governed metrics. The reusable, governed measure consumed by BI tools and AI agents alike.
records.catalog_description: Reusable metric and dimension definitions in the semantic layer, governed for consistent use across BI tools and AI agents.

records.description: Registered LLM agent or generative-AI workflow: prompt templates, tool bindings, retrieval indexes (RAG), evaluation harness, deployed endpoints, audit log, and cost/safety policy. Lives in the platform's AI tier.
records.catalog_description: Registered LLM agents and generative-AI workflows, with prompt templates, tool bindings, retrieval indexes, evaluation harness, and deployed endpoints.

records.description: Published, governed data product with an explicit contract: schema, SLA, owner, access policy, intended consumers, quality expectations, and versioning. Backed by one or more lakehouse_tables, pipeline outputs, or semantic_metrics. The unit of data exchange between producer teams and consumer teams under a data-mesh / governed-marketplace model.
records.catalog_description: Published, governed data products with an explicit contract: schema, SLA, owner, access policy, intended consumers, and quality expectations.

records.description: Billable service ticket against an MSP service contract: customer tenant, contract reference, time-tracked work logs, billable/non-billable category, SLA timer, dispatch state. Distinct from ITSM-mastered incidents (internal-IT-flavored) — same shape, different buyer and lifecycle.
records.catalog_description: Billable service tickets against a managed service provider's contract, with time-tracked work, billable category, SLA timer, and dispatch state.

records.description: Multi-flavor service contract between an MSP and an end-customer: block-hour, retainer, value-based, per-device, or managed-services. Tracks consumption, renewal dates, SLA terms, and per-contract billing rules.
records.catalog_description: Service contracts between a managed service provider and an end-customer, covering block-hour, retainer, per-device, or managed-service models, consumption, renewal, and SLA terms.

records.description: Per-ticket / per-contract / per-customer technician time entry, with category tagging, billable/non-billable classification, approval state, and downstream feed into payroll and billing.
records.catalog_description: Technician time entries per ticket, contract, or customer, with category tagging, billable classification, approval, and feeds to payroll and billing.

records.description: Invoice generated by the MSP to its end-customer: recurring service-subscription line items + out-of-contract billable work + tax. Distinct from customer_invoices (SUB-MGMT, software-vendor-issued) and invoices (S2P, AP-side).
records.catalog_description: Invoices issued by a managed service provider to its end-customer, combining recurring subscription lines, out-of-contract billable work, and tax.

records.description: An MSP's end-customer organization: site/location hierarchy, contact directory, contract portfolio, and asset estate. The MSP's view of its client roster; distinct from customers (which represent product-company customers in CRM/CSM context).
records.catalog_description: End-customer organizations of a managed service provider, with site hierarchy, contacts, contract portfolio, and asset estate.

records.description: Established remote-control session: technician identity, target endpoint, session type (attended/unattended), start/end timestamps, transferred files, elevation events, and link to recording artifact. The unit of work in remote-access tools.
records.catalog_description: Remote-control sessions, with technician, target endpoint, attended or unattended type, timestamps, transferred files, and recording link.

records.description: Video and audit-log artifact captured from a remote session: storage location, retention policy, redaction state, and downstream compliance evidence. Distinct artifact lifecycle from the parent remote_sessions record.
records.catalog_description: Video and audit-log artifacts captured from a remote session, with storage location, retention, redaction state, and compliance use.

records.description: Pre-spend approval request raised by an employee before a purchase, for a virtual card, raised card limit, vendor bill, or reimbursement budget. Modern spend-management platforms anchor on this proactive request workflow as the entry point before any transaction occurs. Lifecycle: draft -> submitted -> approved/declined -> spent (linked to one or more card_transactions / payment_runs).
records.catalog_description: Approval requests raised before a purchase, for a virtual card, raised limit, vendor bill, or reimbursement budget, from draft to spent.

records.description: User-defined container for a no-code-database deployment: a self-contained namespace for tables, views, automations, and access.
records.catalog_description: User-defined containers for a no-code deployment: a self-contained namespace for tables, views, automations, and access.

records.description: User-defined schema inside a no-code base — tables, fields with types, linked-record relationships, formulas, and views. The 'meta' the platform actually masters; the records themselves are user-owned data the platform stores without owning their semantics.
records.catalog_description: User-defined schema inside a no-code base: tables, fields with types, linked-record relationships, formulas, and views.

records.description: Atomic primitive in a work-management platform: task / item / card with owner, due date, status, priority, dependencies, subtasks, attachments, and comments. Same shape regardless of platform-specific terminology (task, item, row, card).
records.catalog_description: Atomic tasks, items, or cards in a work-management tool, with owner, due date, status, priority, dependencies, subtasks, attachments, and comments.

records.description: Container of work_items, regardless of platform-specific terminology (project, board, sheet, space/list). Has timeline, status, owner, members, dashboards, and embedded views.
records.catalog_description: Containers of work items (project, board, sheet, or space), with timeline, status, owner, members, dashboards, and embedded views.

records.description: Hierarchical objective with measurable key results, weighted progress rollup from child objectives or linked work_items, owner accountability, and cadence (quarterly/annual). Mastered by three distinct domains: WORK-MGMT (team-level execution OKRs), SPM (strategic portfolio OKRs), TALENT-MGMT (individual performance-management OKRs). Same primitive, three different lifecycles and review processes — canonical Signal-1 multi-master.
records.catalog_description: Goals with measurable key results, owner accountability, and weighted progress rollup, organized in a hierarchy and reviewed on a quarterly or annual cadence.

records.description: Trigger-action rule defined per board/project: status change, due date, assignment, form submission as triggers; multi-step actions with conditions, time delays, and external integrations. The user-authored behavior layer on top of the data primitives.
records.catalog_description: Trigger-action rules defined per board or project, with triggers like status change or assignment driving multi-step conditional actions.

records.description: A modeled artifact representing a business process (BPMN 2.0, EPC, or proprietary diagram), with version graph, lifecycle state, and metadata (owner, scope, framework lineage). Distinct from a process instance (runtime execution); this is the design-time definition.
records.catalog_description: Design-time definitions of business processes as diagrams, with version history, lifecycle state, and ownership, distinct from runtime executions.

records.description: Hierarchical map of an organization's business capabilities (typically L1/L2/L3), with maturity/investment/strategic-fit heatmaps and linkage to applications, processes, value streams, and owners.
records.catalog_description: Hierarchical maps of an organization's business capabilities, with maturity and investment ratings and links to applications, processes, and owners.

records.description: End-to-end value flow from customer demand to customer-realized value, with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, waste categorization, and SIPOC/customer-journey overlays.
records.catalog_description: End-to-end flows from customer demand to realized value, with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, and waste categorization.

records.description: A single execution of a process simulation scenario (Monte Carlo or discrete-event) against a business_process_model, with inputs (resource pools, cost/time variables), outputs (throughput, bottleneck nodes), and run metadata.
records.catalog_description: Executions of a process simulation scenario against a process model, with input variables, outputs such as throughput and bottlenecks, and run metadata.

records.description: An e-signature transaction wrapping one or more signature requests against a contract or document. Lifecycle: created → sent → in_progress → completed (or declined / voided / expired). Distinct from CLM's signature_records (the legal-side authoritative record of signed agreements); ESIGN's envelopes capture the e-sign-platform lifecycle while CLM consumes the completed result.
records.catalog_description: E-signature transactions wrapping one or more signature requests against a document, tracked from created through completed, declined, or voided.
records.naming_authority_rationale: E-signature platforms own 'envelopes' as the canonical signature-package concept (DocuSign convention adopted industry-wide).

records.description: Canonical, certified definition of a business metric: numerator, denominator, filters, dimensions, time grain, ownership, certification status, and lineage to physical sources. The atom that the metrics-layer market exists to centralize and govern.
records.catalog_description: Canonical, certified definitions of a business metric: numerator, denominator, filters, dimensions, time grain, ownership, and lineage to sources.

records.description: Logical entity/dimension/hierarchy model decoupled from physical tables. Defines conformed dimensions across fact tables, hierarchies, slowly-changing-dimension behavior, and graph-style relationships. The semantic structure metrics resolve against.
records.catalog_description: Logical entity, dimension, and hierarchy models decoupled from physical tables, defining conformed dimensions, hierarchies, and slowly-changing behavior.

records.description: Formal model of concepts (OWL classes / RDF schemas / labeled-property-graph schemas), properties, relationships, hierarchies, and axioms. Includes namespaces, prefixes, imports, and constraint shapes (SHACL/SHEX). The 'schema' tier of a knowledge graph.
records.catalog_description: Formal models of concepts, properties, relationships, and rules that define the schema tier of a knowledge graph, including namespaces and constraint shapes.
records.naming_authority_rationale: Data catalog/governance owns 'ontologies' as the canonical controlled-vocabulary concept.

records.description: Typed instances of ontology classes — RDF named individuals or LPG nodes — with assertions, relationships, embeddings, and provenance. The 'data' tier of a knowledge graph that AI agents query and operational apps write back to.
records.catalog_description: Typed instances of ontology classes (graph nodes or RDF individuals) with assertions, relationships, embeddings, and provenance, queried by AI agents and apps.

records.description: A contact-center interaction record (voice call, chat session, video session, callback). Captures session metadata: duration, channel, agent, customer, resolution status. Distinct from CSM's customer_cases (the support case is the business artifact; the support_session is the engagement event that may or may not result in a case).
records.catalog_description: Contact-center interactions (call, chat, video, callback), capturing duration, channel, agent, customer, and resolution status.

records.description: A normalized contact-center customer-identity record reconciling phone numbers, email addresses, and known customer_ids across channels. Helps the agent see context regardless of which channel the customer used.
records.catalog_description: Unified contact-center customer identities reconciling phone numbers, emails, and customer IDs across channels.

records.description: Real-time and historical metrics per queue: wait time, abandonment rate, service level, average handle time. Drives staffing decisions and SLA monitoring.
records.catalog_description: Real-time and historical metrics per contact queue, such as wait time, abandonment rate, service level, and average handle time.

records.description: A turn-by-turn record of a bot or AI-assistant conversation: utterances, intents identified, confidence scores, slot fillings, escalation events. Source-of-truth for AI training, audit, and root-cause analysis.
records.catalog_description: Turn-by-turn records of bot or AI-assistant conversations, with utterances, intents, confidence scores, and escalation events.

records.description: An NLU output record: detected intent classification, confidence, originating utterance, downstream action taken. Decoupled from conversation_transcripts so intent analytics can roll up independently of transcript retention policy.
records.catalog_description: Language-understanding outputs, recording the detected intent, confidence, originating utterance, and downstream action taken.

records.description: A scheduled or completed on-site visit by a field technician. Captures arrival, departure, work performed, parts used, customer signature, outcome. Distinct from work_orders (the demand-side artifact); a single work_order may produce multiple field_visits if the work spans days or requires re-dispatch.
records.catalog_description: Scheduled or completed on-site visits by a field technician, capturing arrival, work performed, parts used, customer signature, and outcome.

records.description: An assignment of a work_order to a specific technician at a specific time. Captures dispatch decisions, route optimization output, dispatcher overrides. Audit trail for what was assigned to whom and why.
records.catalog_description: Assignments of a work order to a specific technician at a specific time, capturing dispatch decisions, route output, and dispatcher overrides.

records.description: A customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures tier, accrued points balance, enrollment date, opt-in status. Distinct from the broader customers entity (CDP/CRM-mastered): a loyalty member is the program-side identity which may or may not match a CRM customer one-to-one (households, joint accounts, anonymous tier members in pre-identification flows).
records.catalog_description: Customers enrolled in the loyalty program, with tier, accrued points balance, enrollment date, and opt-in status.

records.description: A point-earning or point-spending event for a loyalty_member: purchase points, bonus-promo points, redemption, expiry, adjustment. The atomic accounting record for the loyalty program.
records.catalog_description: Point-earning and point-spending events for loyalty members: purchases, bonuses, redemptions, expiries, and adjustments.

records.description: A tier definition in the loyalty program (Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum or equivalent). Captures qualifying thresholds, benefits, retention rules. The reference catalog every loyalty_member is assigned to.
records.catalog_description: Tier definitions in the loyalty program, with qualifying thresholds, benefits, and retention rules that members are assigned to.

records.description: Individual business application in the enterprise portfolio (custom-built, on-prem, SaaS, hybrid) with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, vendor/platform, strategic value. Distinct from ATS `applications` (job-submission). APM's flagship entity.
records.catalog_description: Business applications in the enterprise portfolio, with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, hosting model, and strategic value.

records.description: Aggregated cost per enterprise application: license fees, infrastructure, support, personnel, cloud usage. Refresh monthly/quarterly; feeds FINOPS.
records.catalog_description: Aggregated total cost of ownership per enterprise application: license fees, infrastructure, support, personnel, and cloud usage.
records.notes: Config-shape master: time-series cost snapshots, no per-state permissions needed. Authored quarterly by the rationalization module; superseded by next period's snapshot. Lifecycle states intentionally omitted per Rule #12 exemption.

records.description: Vendor platform / tech stack with version, EOL, upgrade status, org-wide instance count. Distinct from `vendors` (legal entity) and `solutions` (product).
records.catalog_description: Vendor platforms and tech stacks, with version, end-of-life date, upgrade status, and org-wide instance count.

records.description: Evaluation of an application's tech-stack alignment with enterprise standards and vendor roadmap; score + gap analysis + remediation roadmap.
records.catalog_description: Evaluations of how well an application's tech stack aligns with enterprise standards and vendor roadmaps, with score, gaps, and remediation.

records.description: Named integration point between two applications (API, ETL, message queue, file-drop, manual); carries payload type, data owner, frequency, SLA.
records.catalog_description: Named integration points between two applications (API, ETL, message queue, file-drop, manual), with payload type, data owner, frequency, and SLA.

records.description: Multi-dimensional time-series score per application: criticality, revenue attribution, adoption, strategic alignment, technical health. Quarterly refresh.
records.catalog_description: Multi-dimensional time-series scores per application: criticality, revenue attribution, adoption, strategic alignment, and technical health.
records.notes: Config-shape master: time-series multi-dimensional score snapshots, no per-state permissions needed. Authored on each value recalculation; superseded by next refresh. Lifecycle states intentionally omitted per Rule #12 exemption.

records.description: Container for strategic initiatives grouped by business unit, product line, or cost center; aggregate KPIs and investment rules.

records.description: Sequencing and blocking relationships between initiatives and roadmap items; critical path, lag time, external dependencies.

records.catalog_description: Identified threats to organizational objectives, with likelihood, impact, inherent and residual severity, and owner.

records.catalog_description: Test results verifying a control's operating effectiveness, with tester, scope, result, evidence, and remediation status.

records.catalog_description: Formal governance directives such as acceptable-use, data-protection, or anti-corruption policies, with version, scope, and owner.

records.catalog_description: Records that a user read and acknowledged a policy, with timestamp, policy version, medium, and completion evidence.

records.catalog_description: Forward-looking corrective-action proposals from audit fieldwork, with risk rating, proposed owner, target date, and expected cost or benefit.

records.description: Formal deliverable: executive summary, scope, findings + recommendations ranked by severity, management response, sign-off.
records.catalog_description: Formal audit deliverables, with executive summary, scope, findings and recommendations ranked by severity, management response, and sign-off.

records.catalog_description: Attestations that a data asset meets quality and compliance thresholds for production use, with certifier, date, and valid-until.

records.catalog_description: Governance rules controlling who can access a data asset, covering audience, permission level, conditions, approval chain, and audit trail.

records.description: Aggregated consumption signal per data_asset: accessing_team, query_count, last_access, bytes scanned. Drives popularity and stale-asset detection.
records.catalog_description: Aggregated consumption signals per data asset, such as accessing team, query count, last access, and bytes scanned.

records.catalog_description: Rules defining acceptable data state, such as cardinality bounds, regex patterns, referential integrity, and statistical thresholds.

records.description: Work item raised when a profiling or monitoring rule breaches: root-cause detail, remediation status, linked data assets, SLA.
records.catalog_description: Work items raised when a data quality rule is breached, with root-cause detail, remediation status, linked data assets, and SLA.

records.catalog_description: Summary statistics computed on a data asset during a scan, such as cardinality, null percentage, distinct count, and value distributions.

records.catalog_description: Standard dimensions used to measure data quality, such as completeness, validity, timeliness, and accuracy.

records.description: Aggregated quality score per asset/time-slice: weighted roll-up of dimension scores, trend, direction. Consumed by BI dashboards.

records.catalog_description: Distinct execution patterns found in a process event log, grouping cases that follow significantly different paths, with their frequency and cycle time.

records.description: Resource-constrained or time-trapped steps in a process: high-wait-time activities, resource queue depth, throughput loss points. Carries activity name, severity, estimated throughput impact, recommended mitigation.
records.catalog_description: Resource-constrained or time-trapped steps found in a process, with severity, estimated throughput impact, and recommended mitigation.

records.description: Declarative rule inferred from event-log patterns: conditional activity orderings, forbidden sequences, timing constraints, resource allocations, decision thresholds. Captures hidden control logic.
records.catalog_description: Business rules inferred from event-log patterns, such as activity orderings, forbidden sequences, and decision thresholds, capturing hidden control logic.

records.description: Quality-of-experience metric for a user/device/SaaS-app triplet: latency, availability %, error rate, device responsiveness (boot time, app launch, login success %). Aggregates synthetic + RUM signals. DEM flagship.
records.catalog_description: Quality-of-experience scores for a user, device, and app combination, covering latency, availability, error rate, and responsiveness.

records.description: Proactive end-to-end test against a SaaS app from a geo/network location: request/response payload, HTTP status, latency, SSL validity, geo tag, schedule reference. Network-outside-in probes (vs OBS instrumented internals).
records.catalog_description: Proactive end-to-end tests run against an app from a geographic location, capturing status, latency, SSL validity, and response payload.

records.description: Aggregate session telemetry for an end-user's device over a window: page loads, app launches, network quality samples, DNS query times, VPN toggle state, WiFi/cellular transitions. Distinct from OBS distributed_traces (app-internal) and NPMD (network-internal).
records.catalog_description: Aggregated session telemetry for an end-user device over a window, covering page loads, app launches, network quality, and connectivity transitions.

records.description: Detected degradation affecting SaaS consumption: slow boot, app crash, unresponsive login, network disconnect, proxy/firewall block, VPN drop, USB mount failure. Source agent telemetry, severity, affected user count, business-app association.
records.catalog_description: Detected degradations affecting app usage, such as slow boot, crashes, login failures, network drops, or VPN issues, with severity and affected users.

records.description: ML-derived behavioral deviation on a device: CPU spike during login, memory leak, unexpected network egress, certificate validation failure, impossible-travel pattern. Scored, triaged, feeds InfoSec dashboards.
records.catalog_description: Behavioral deviations on a device flagged by analytics, such as unexpected network egress or impossible-travel patterns, scored and triaged.

records.description: Self-service workplace hoteling: employee reservation of available desk, date/time, work mode. Core to flexible/hybrid workplace policies.
records.catalog_description: Self-service desk reservations for hybrid and hot-desking workplaces, covering the desk, date and time, and work mode.

records.description: Meeting room, event space, or collaborative area reservation by employee or team: time slot, capacity, amenities requested.
records.catalog_description: Reservations of meeting rooms, event spaces, or collaborative areas by an employee or team, with time slot, capacity, and requested amenities.

records.description: Employee request for workspace changes: desk relocation, accommodation needs, floor reassignment. Routed to facilities for approval/execution. Workplace-scoped (vs generic ITSM service_requests).
records.catalog_description: Employee requests for workspace changes such as desk relocation, accommodation needs, or floor reassignment, routed to facilities.

records.description: Analytics on actual office occupancy/usage: peak-hour patterns, underutilization zones, utilization rates. Drives real-estate optimization. Distinct from REAL-EST `occupancy_records` (operational).
records.catalog_description: Reports on actual office occupancy and usage, covering peak patterns, underutilized zones, and utilization rates to guide space optimization.

records.description: Employee survey/feedback on office experience: comfort, amenities, satisfaction. Informs workplace strategy and EX improvements.
records.catalog_description: Employee survey feedback on office experience, covering comfort, amenities, and satisfaction, informing workplace strategy.

records.description: Release-to-floor unit of work: product SKU, quantity, schedule window, build instructions reference, material requirements. Distinct from ERP demand planning; MFG-OPS owns floor execution.
records.catalog_description: Units of work released to the factory floor, specifying product, quantity, schedule window, build instructions, and material requirements.

records.description: Operator-facing step sequence for building/assembling a product variant: sequence, resource requirements, quality checkpoints, safety notes, attached media. References product + production_order.
records.catalog_description: Operator-facing step sequences for building or assembling a product variant, with resource requirements, quality checkpoints, safety notes, and attached media.

records.description: Published build plan for a line, manufacturing cell, or workcenter: time-based slots, assigned orders, sequencing, changeover windows. Product of capacity-planning optimization. Distinct from WFM `work_schedules` (labor-centric).
records.catalog_description: Published build plans for a line, cell, or workcenter, with time-based slots, assigned orders, sequencing, and changeover windows.

records.description: As-built record of a manufactured item: serial number, lot/batch, production_order reference, produced_timestamp, quality_status, embedded costs. Traceability spine for batch/genealogy queries.
records.catalog_description: As-built records of manufactured items, with serial number, lot or batch, the order that produced them, and quality status, forming the traceability backbone.

records.description: Shop-floor equipment/line stoppage: start_time, duration, reason code, impact (throughput loss), resolution. OEE input. Distinct from EAM `eam_work_orders` (maintenance-triggered).
records.catalog_description: Shop-floor equipment or line stoppages, with start time, duration, reason code, throughput impact, and resolution, feeding equipment effectiveness metrics.

records.description: Per-unit/per-batch inspection result: checklist completion, pass/fail, defect classification, produced_unit reference, inspector, timestamp. Feeds quality dashboards and hold/release decisions.
records.catalog_description: Inspection results for a produced unit or batch, recording checklist completion, pass or fail, defect classification, and inspector.

records.description: Operator-initiated issue/escalation: andon pull, quality defect escape, safety concern, equipment anomaly, material shortage. Work item for shop-floor problem-solving team. Distinct from FSM support tickets.
records.catalog_description: Operator-raised shop-floor issues such as defects, safety concerns, equipment anomalies, or material shortages, for the problem-solving team.

records.description: Borrower request to originate a loan: application date, requested amount, purpose, personal/commercial distinction, loan type (mortgage, auto, commercial line, term loan), requested tenor, collateral, guarantor status, lifecycle state (draft / submitted / approved / declined / funded).
records.catalog_description: Borrower requests to originate a loan, with amount, purpose, loan type, term, collateral, and lifecycle from draft to funded.

records.description: Retail/commercial customer request to open a deposit or payment account: account type (checking, savings, money market, business), initial funding, linked services (card, online banking, mobile), identity-verification flag. Distinct from ATS recruiting applications.
records.catalog_description: Customer requests to open a deposit or payment account, covering account type, initial funding, linked services, and identity verification.

records.description: Completion record for a new deposit/payment account: institution, account number, IBAN/routing, account type, customer, funding method, activation date, initial balance. Derived from account_applications; drives downstream provisioning.
records.catalog_description: Records of newly opened deposit or payment accounts, with account number, type, customer, funding method, and activation date.

records.description: Know-Your-Customer / Anti-Money-Laundering assessment: customer risk classification, beneficial-ownership confirmation, source-of-funds verification, PEP screening, sanctions-list match, watchlist refresh cadence, reviewer sign-off, refresh-due date. Required for origination and annual recertification.
records.catalog_description: Know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering reviews assessing customer risk, ownership, source of funds, and sanctions screening, required at onboarding and annual recertification.

records.description: Customer-banking issue / dispute / escalation: dispute type (unauthorized transaction, fraud claim, account error, complaint, regulatory concern), account involved, opened date, assigned agent, SLA, resolution status, root cause. Distinct from CSM customer_cases and ITSM incidents.
records.catalog_description: Customer banking issues, disputes, and escalations (unauthorized transactions, fraud claims, account errors, complaints), with account, agent, SLA, and resolution.

records.description: Banking-side fund-transfer instruction: originating account, destination (domestic/international), amount, currency, requested delivery, beneficiary, purpose code, compliance flags (sanctions, threshold reporting), execution status, confirmation number. Distinct from S2P supplier payments.
records.catalog_description: Banking fund-transfer instructions, with originating and destination accounts, amount, currency, beneficiary, purpose code, compliance flags, and execution status.

records.description: Release of approved loan funds: loan_application reference, disbursement date, amount, tranching (full / phased), destination account, conditions satisfied, regulatory reporting flags. Carries funding state.
records.catalog_description: Releases of approved loan funds, with date, amount, tranching, destination account, and conditions satisfied.

records.description: Posted transaction on a bank account: posting date, type (debit / credit / transfer / fee / interest), amount, currency, counterparty, reference, reconciliation status vs bank statement. Distinct from ERP-FIN journal_entries (the accounting side).
records.catalog_description: Posted transactions on a bank account: date, type, amount, currency, counterparty, and reconciliation status against the bank statement.

records.description: Medical equipment in clinical use (infusion pumps, ventilators, patient monitors, imaging systems, patient transport). Specialized regulated asset (FDA/MDR, biocompatibility); distinct from EAM industrial_assets (plant) and HAM hardware_assets (IT).
records.catalog_description: Medical equipment in clinical use such as infusion pumps, ventilators, and imaging systems, as a specialized regulated asset class.

records.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance records per medical_device: PM schedule completion, technician notes, parts replaced. Regulatory audit trail for clinical compliance.
records.catalog_description: Preventive and corrective maintenance records per medical device, covering schedule completion, technician notes, and parts replaced.

records.description: FDA/regulatory recall notices and clinical-facility response: recall scope, risk level (Class I/II/III), affected serial numbers, remediation, patient-safety impact assessment, regulatory reporting.
records.catalog_description: Regulatory recall notices and facility responses for medical devices, covering recall scope, risk class, affected serials, and patient-safety impact.

records.description: Request from clinical staff for device repair, configuration, training, or incident investigation; routed via clinical-engineering team. Links to device_maintenance_logs and device_incident_reports for closed-loop traceability.
records.catalog_description: Requests from clinical staff to repair, configure, train on, or investigate medical devices, routed to the clinical-engineering team.

records.description: Accuracy verification for clinical equipment (scales, infusion pumps, diagnostic devices). Frequency mandated by FDA/accreditation; tracks calibration date, technician, tolerance acceptance.
records.catalog_description: Accuracy verification records for clinical equipment such as scales and infusion pumps, tracking calibration date, technician, and tolerance acceptance.

records.description: FDA MDR-style adverse-event report (patient injury, near-miss, unexpected behavior): root cause (user error vs device defect); links to device_recalls when patterns emerge.
records.catalog_description: Adverse-event reports for medical devices, such as patient injury or unexpected behavior, with root cause and links to recalls when patterns emerge.

records.description: Autoclave/steam-sterilization records for reusable surgical instruments: cycle parameters (time, temp, pressure), batch ID, QA certification. Validates sterile-field integrity pre-procedure.
records.catalog_description: Sterilization records for reusable surgical instruments, capturing cycle parameters, batch, and quality certification before a procedure.

records.description: Scheduled visit between patient and provider: provider, location, scheduled time, visit type (new / follow-up / annual / urgent), status (scheduled / confirmed / arrived / completed / no-show / canceled), reason for visit. Drives front-of-house workflow and resource utilization.
records.catalog_description: Scheduled visits between patient and provider, with location, time, visit type, reason, and status from scheduled through completed or no-show.

records.description: Documented patient-provider clinical contact: encounter date, type (office visit / telehealth / inpatient / ED), chief complaint, vitals, ICD diagnosis codes, CPT procedure codes, provider, attending. The atomic billable clinical event; precedes patient_charts and clinical_notes.
records.catalog_description: Documented patient-provider visits with date, type, chief complaint, vitals, diagnosis and procedure codes, and attending clinician.

records.description: Coordinated care document for a patient condition: goals, interventions, target dates, responsible providers, monitoring frequency, escalation triggers. Used in chronic-disease management, transitions of care, and oncology pathways. Patient-centric (distinct from project plans, treatment protocols).
records.catalog_description: Coordinated care documents for a patient condition, with goals, interventions, target dates, responsible providers, and escalation triggers.

records.description: Provider-initiated request for specialist consultation or external service: referring provider, target specialist/facility, clinical indication, urgency, status (requested / scheduled / completed / declined), insurance authorization status. Drives in-network coordination and revenue capture.
records.catalog_description: Provider-initiated requests for specialist consultation or external service, with clinical indication, urgency, insurance authorization, and status.

records.description: Provider order for diagnostic test, medication, therapy, or procedure: order type (lab / imaging / prescription / referral / DME), order date, ordering provider, target facility/department, priority, result attachment. CPOE-compliant; distinct from S2P purchase orders.
records.catalog_description: Provider orders for tests, medications, therapies, or procedures, with order type, priority, target facility, and results.

records.description: Provider documentation of patient encounter: SOAP-style (subjective/objective/assessment/plan), nurse notes, progress notes, discharge summaries. Patient-chart artifact; supports billing, continuity, legal record. Distinct from ECM documents (filing-cabinet view) — clinical_notes are structured clinical artifacts.
records.catalog_description: Provider documentation of patient encounters, including progress notes, nurse notes, and discharge summaries.

records.description: Master record from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement; P&C and life insurance scope. Carries claim type, loss date, reported date, claimant, adjuster, status (open / in-investigation / settled / closed / litigated), gross/net liability. Scope-qualified to avoid collision with HR claims, warranty claims, healthcare claims.
records.catalog_description: Insurance claim records from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement, with claim type, dates, claimant, adjuster, status, and liability.

records.description: Underwritten contract defining coverage terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, effective/expiration dates; the contractual artifact a claim is filed against. Distinct from GRC `policies` (control documents) and tenant lease policies.
records.catalog_description: Underwritten insurance policies defining coverage terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and effective dates, against which claims are filed.

records.description: Individual coverage line within an insurance_policy: line of business, coverage code, limit amount, deductible, coinsurance %, effective period. Determines claim eligibility and adjudication.
records.catalog_description: Individual coverage lines within an insurance policy, with line of business, limit, deductible, coinsurance, and effective period that govern claim eligibility.

records.description: FNOL event giving rise to a claim: occurrence date, location, loss description, cause, subtype (property damage, liability, injury, death), first-reported date. P&C-primary; distinct from ITSM incidents (internal IT operational events).
records.catalog_description: First-notice-of-loss events giving rise to a claim, with occurrence date, location, cause, loss type, and description.

records.description: Allocation of claims to adjusters: adjuster, assigned_date, claim_count, caseload_status, assignment_reason (intake / escalation / specialty / reassignment). Drives adjuster workload analytics.
records.catalog_description: Allocations of claims to adjusters, with assigned date, caseload status, and reason, driving adjuster workload analytics.

records.description: Settlement agreement specifying approved amount, conditions, releases, and closure terms for a resolved claim: settlement_date, payee, breakdown by coverage, structured-settlement schedule, release language.
records.catalog_description: Settlement agreements for a resolved claim, with approved amount, conditions, releases, payee, and closure terms.

records.description: Disbursement to claimant, provider, or vendor: amount, payment date, check/EFT reference, reserve basis, line-item allocation to coverages. Distinct from generic payments (rent, AR, supplier).
records.catalog_description: Disbursements to a claimant, provider, or vendor, with amount, payment date, reference, and allocation to coverages.

records.description: Recovery of salvageable property or proceeds from damaged/totaled assets following settlement: salvage vendor, recovery_amount, disposal record, applied against claim total. P&C-specific.
records.catalog_description: Recoveries of salvageable property or proceeds from damaged or totaled assets after a claim settles, with vendor and recovery amount.

records.description: Insurer pursuit of recovery from a liable third party: claim reference, third party, coverage class, demand amount, status, recovery amount, date range. Reduces net loss after a claim is paid.
records.catalog_description: Insurer efforts to recover paid losses from a liable third party, with claim reference, demand amount, status, and recovery amount.

records.description: Special Investigation Unit fraud-investigation case: claim reference, indicators triggered, investigator, status (open / closed-confirmed / closed-unconfirmed), referral to law enforcement. Distinct from generic banking/compliance investigations.
records.catalog_description: Special Investigation Unit fraud cases on insurance claims, with indicators triggered, investigator, status, and any law-enforcement referral.

records.description: In-house legal matter (dispute / transaction / advisory / IP case / regulatory response): client department, opposing parties, matter type, key dates, assigned in-house counsel + outside counsel, budget, status. Scope-qualified to distinguish from law-firm `legal_matters` (id 391, LEGAL-PRACT-MGMT-mastered).
records.catalog_description: In-house legal matters such as disputes, transactions, advisory, IP, and regulatory responses, with client department, parties, counsel, budget, and status.

records.description: Demand-signal record: business-unit request for legal advice or service. Carries description, priority, required-by date, requesting department, triage outcome (matter creation / policy guidance / escalation). The front door to LSD.
records.catalog_description: Business-unit requests for legal advice or service, with description, priority, required-by date, and triage outcome. The front door to legal services.

records.description: eDiscovery / litigation preservation notice: matter reference, affected record types (email, documents, messages, files), custodian scope, issued date, lifting date. Drives enforcement across data systems.
records.catalog_description: Litigation preservation notices, with matter reference, affected record types, custodian scope, and issued and lifting dates, enforced across data systems.

records.description: Litigation data request (internal or from external counsel): matter reference, scope (custodians, date range, keywords), requested record types, production timeline, chain-of-custody.
records.catalog_description: Litigation data requests with matter reference, scope, requested record types, production timeline, and chain of custody.

records.description: Engagement with external law firm/counsel: firm, attorney, matter reference, scope, billing arrangement (hourly / fixed / contingent), budget, contract reference, status. Tracks spend and coordination.
records.catalog_description: Engagements with external law firms, covering firm, attorney, matter, scope, billing arrangement, budget, and status to track spend and coordination.

records.description: Documented legal opinion / consultation: matter or requestor reference, advice narrative, applicability scope, confidence, expiry/review date, privilege classification.
records.catalog_description: Documented legal opinions and consultations, with matter reference, advice narrative, scope, confidence, review date, and privilege classification.

records.description: Notification from regulator (SEC, FTC, GDPR authority, state AG): jurisdiction, inquiry type, subject, deadline, assigned counsel, response status. Distinct from PS-LIC inspections (regulator-as-issuer vs regulator-as-investigator).
records.catalog_description: Notifications received from a regulator, with jurisdiction, inquiry type, subject, deadline, assigned counsel, and response status.

records.description: Court-centric tracking for litigated matters: court/jurisdiction, case number, judge, calendar (filing, hearing, trial, appeal dates), opposing counsel, key documents. Subset of in_house_legal_matters with litigation metadata.
records.catalog_description: Court-centric tracking for litigated matters: court, case number, judge, calendar dates, opposing counsel, and key documents.

records.description: Citizen or business submission requesting a license or permit: applicant, permit type (building / business / professional / event / environmental), submission date, jurisdiction, supporting documents, fees due, status (submitted / under-review / approved / denied / withdrawn). Scope-qualified to avoid collision with ATS, IDP, banking, healthcare applications.
records.catalog_description: Citizen or business submissions requesting a license or permit, with applicant, permit type, fees due, supporting documents, and review status.

records.description: Active issued license or permit: license number, holder, type, issue date, expiration date, conditions, jurisdiction, current status (active / suspended / expired / revoked). The post-approval authoritative record.
records.catalog_description: Active issued licenses or permits, with holder, type, issue and expiration dates, conditions, jurisdiction, and current status.

records.description: Field inspection tied to a permit (pre-construction, in-progress, final, complaint-driven): inspection type, scheduled date, inspector, location, outcome (pass / fail / conditional), required corrections, follow-up inspection. Scope-qualified vs CLIN-DEV / EAM / FSM inspections.
records.catalog_description: Field inspections tied to a permit, with type, scheduled date, inspector, location, outcome, and required corrections or follow-up.

records.description: Renewal application for an existing license: source license, renewal cycle, submission date, updated requirements, fees, conditions changes, outcome. Workflow distinct from initial issuance.
records.catalog_description: Renewal applications for existing licenses, tracking submission, updated requirements, fees, condition changes, and outcome.

records.description: Cited non-compliance with permit conditions, building code, business regulation, or other government code: subject (property / business / individual), violation code, citation date, issuing inspector, severity, fines assessed, remediation status.
records.catalog_description: Cited non-compliance with permits, building code, or regulations, with the subject, severity, fines, and remediation status.

records.description: Government-side fee assessment for permits, licenses, inspections, citations: fee type, amount, due date, payer, payment status, allocation to fund. Distinct from S2P / billing.
records.catalog_description: Government-assessed fees for permits, licenses, inspections, and citations, with fee type, amount, due date, payer, and payment status.

records.description: Task assigned to retail associates (shelf stocking, planogram execution, zone cleaning, till reconciliation, safety checks). Core unit of store-level workforce execution and accountability. Scope-qualified vs onboarding_tasks, project_tasks.
records.catalog_description: Tasks assigned to retail associates, such as shelf stocking, planogram execution, cleaning, reconciliation, and safety checks.

records.description: Shift assignments, associate availability, store labor roster. RET-STORE-mastered scheduling execution; WFM masters canonical `work_schedules` for workforce-planning. Retail-specific scheduling logic (coverage bands, register staffing) lives here.
records.catalog_description: Retail store labor schedules covering shift assignments, associate availability, and coverage, with retail-specific staffing logic.

records.description: In-store compliance/operational audit (health/safety, merchandising, inventory accuracy, point-of-sale). Distinct from enterprise AUDIT (`audit_plans` / `audit_findings`).
records.catalog_description: In-store compliance and operational audits covering health and safety, merchandising, inventory accuracy, and point of sale.

records.description: Third-party store quality assessment (customer experience, compliance, staff courtesy). Distinct from internal store_audits.
records.catalog_description: Third-party store quality assessments covering customer experience, compliance, and staff courtesy, distinct from internal store audits.

records.description: Shelf-layout and product-placement compliance vs corporate planogram standards: deviation, remediation, photo evidence, visual compliance verification.
records.catalog_description: Shelf-layout and product-placement compliance checks against corporate planogram standards, with deviations, remediation, and photo evidence.

records.description: Daily/shift store operational checklist (open / close / safety / cleanliness / loss-prevention). Template-driven execution and sign-off records.
records.catalog_description: Daily and per-shift store operational checklists for opening, closing, safety, cleanliness, and loss prevention, with sign-off records.

records.description: Commercial service offerings with technical specifications, rate plans, and SLA terms; TM Forum eTOM catalog master. Distinct from internal IT service catalogs and SaaS pricing catalogs.
records.catalog_description: Commercial service offerings with technical specifications, rate plans, and SLA terms, serving as the telecom service catalog master.

records.description: Service provisioning order (activate / modify / suspend / deactivate). Carries customer, service catalog reference, requested date, status, fulfillment workflow reference. Distinct from B2C-COMM `orders` (commerce) and SUB-MGMT customer-subscription change orders.
records.catalog_description: Service provisioning orders to activate, modify, suspend, or deactivate a service, with customer, requested date, status, and fulfillment workflow.

records.description: Active service instance per subscriber (mobile line, fiber connection, leased circuit): carrier-customer relationship with the operational service. Distinct from SUB-MGMT `customer_subscriptions` (SaaS seller-side).
records.catalog_description: Active service instances per subscriber, such as a mobile line, fiber connection, or leased circuit.

records.catalog_description: Orchestration state and task list for activating, changing, or closing a service, showing how a service order is executed.

records.description: Logical/physical network inventory mastered by the telco operator: ports, circuits, IP address blocks, fiber routes, MSAN/DSLAM ports, allocated/free status. Distinct from NPMD network observability (`network_flow_records` etc.) and CMDB `configuration_items`.
records.catalog_description: Telco network inventory of ports, circuits, IP address blocks, fiber routes, and access-node ports, with allocated or free status.

records.description: Subscriber bill — multi-rated usage + subscription + tax lines, billing-period summary, payment status. Distinct from S2P invoices, SUB-MGMT `customer_invoices`, and rent_payments.
records.catalog_description: Subscriber bills combining rated usage, subscriptions, and tax lines, with billing-period summary and payment status.

records.catalog_description: Subscriber-reported service degradation or outage tickets, with service, severity, timestamps, root cause, and resolution.

records.description: Legal customer-premise record tied to a utility service territory: contract, billing profile, meter assignment, connection status. Residential, commercial, industrial scopes. Distinct from CRM `customers` (sales context).

records.catalog_description: Operator-collected or automated consumption readings, with read date, consumption value, unit, read method, and anomaly flags.

records.description: Meter-to-grid/pipe hookup asset: pole/pedestal/pit location, conductor/pipe size, install date, maintenance history. Parent to outage-impact assessment and work-order routing.
records.catalog_description: Meter-to-grid or meter-to-pipe hookup assets, with location, conductor or pipe size, install date, and maintenance history.

records.description: Utility-owned network infrastructure (substations, transformers, poles, distribution lines, pipelines): type, location, capacity, age, operational status. Distinct from EAM `industrial_assets` (corporate plant) and HAM (IT).
records.catalog_description: Utility-owned network infrastructure such as substations, transformers, poles, lines, and pipelines, with type, location, capacity, age, and operational status.

records.description: Unplanned loss-of-service affecting one or more service_connections: detection time, cause (storm / fault / equipment failure / load), estimated restoration, affected customer count. Distinct from ITSM `incidents` (IT) and EAM `eam_work_orders`.
records.catalog_description: Unplanned losses of service affecting customer connections, with detection time, cause, estimated restoration, and affected customer count.

records.description: Work request to establish new connection / disconnect / move / modify service (not maintenance): premise, requested date, work type, fulfillment status. Distinct from EAM `eam_work_orders` and FSM customer work orders.
records.catalog_description: Work requests to connect, disconnect, move, or modify service at a premise, with requested date, work type, and fulfillment status.

records.description: Customer invoice: aggregates meter_reads, regulatory adjustments (demand charges, time-of-use rates, tariffs), payment terms. Distinct from telco_customer_bills, S2P invoices, and rent_payments.
records.catalog_description: Customer utility invoices aggregating meter reads, regulatory adjustments, and payment terms into a billable statement.

records.catalog_description: Visitor arrival events at facility entry, with credential verification and a badge-issuance trigger.

records.catalog_description: Physical or digital badges issued at check-in, encoding visitor identity, host assignment, access scope, and expiration.

records.catalog_description: Bindings between a visitor and an internal employee host, covering access scope, duration, and supervision responsibility.

records.description: Real-time roster of visitors present on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for emergency response and accountability.
records.catalog_description: Real-time rosters of visitors on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for evacuation and accountability.

records.catalog_description: Signed or electronically acknowledged non-disclosure agreements captured per visit as a legal-hold artifact.

records.description: Pre-arrival or arrival-time screening result against external watchlists (sanctions, banned-visitor, threat databases): compliance-hold record.
records.catalog_description: Screening results checking visitors against external watchlists such as sanctions, banned-visitor, and threat databases, held for compliance.

records.catalog_description: Timestamped audit trail of visitor state transitions such as registration, check-in, badging, and check-out, for compliance.
