records.catalog_description: Let employees submit referrals, track each one through the pipeline, and pay out rewards automatically when a hire sticks. Campaigns and reward tiers keep participation high without manual bookkeeping.

records.description: Requisitions → postings → applications with pipeline-stage lifecycle. Realizes REQ-MGMT and CANDIDATE-EXP (application flow slice). Embedded-masters `candidates`, optionally `hcm_positions` and `org_units` for canonical position/org context.
records.catalog_tagline: Move applicants from requisition to decision on a structured, auditable pipeline.
records.catalog_description:
Open and approve requisitions, distribute postings, collect applications, and advance candidates through configurable stages, with screening questions, stage transitions, and hiring-team assignments captured as you go.

Applicant-flow and disposition records are built in, so equal-opportunity reporting is a by-product of normal work rather than a separate project.

records.description: Interview scheduling, panel coordination, scorecards, and structured assessments. Realizes INTERVIEW-MGMT. Realizes the `interviewing` lifecycle state on `job_applications` (state pruned when this module is not installed).
records.catalog_tagline: Run consistent, structured interviews and collect comparable feedback.
records.catalog_description: Schedule interviews against panel availability, equip interviewers with kits and question banks, and gather scorecards and assessments in a single structured record. Consistent inputs make hiring decisions easier to defend and faster to reach.

records.description: Offer drafting, approval, extension, signature, and acceptance. Realizes OFFER-MGMT. Realizes the `offer_extended` state on `job_applications`. Requires an external `sign_document` tool, drops module Semantius coverage to ~83%.
records.catalog_tagline: Generate, approve, and send offers without losing a version.
records.catalog_description: Draft offers from templates, route them through approval chains, and track every version until acceptance. Generated offer letters stay linked to the offer record, so what was approved is exactly what was sent.

records.description: Pre-employment background-check orchestration with adverse-action workflow. Coordinates external vendor handoffs and gates offer-to-firm conversion on clearance. Requires an external `send_email` tool for FCRA adverse-action notices.
records.catalog_tagline: Run compliant background screening with the adverse-action flow built in.
records.catalog_description:
Order screening packages, track each component to completion, and adjudicate results in one place. The full FCRA flow (disclosures, summary-of-rights acknowledgments, pre-adverse and adverse-action notices, and dispute handling) is modeled as part of the workflow.

Screening is necessity-scoped, so deployments outside FCRA jurisdictions enable only what applies to them.

records.description: The bridge between offer-accepted and start-date: ATS owns the pre-employee lifecycle stage (paperwork in flight, pre-boarding tasks open, background check pending). Realizes the `hired` state on `job_applications`. Publishes the `pre_employee.activated` event that hands the canonical reconciliation to HCM-mastered `employees`. Formerly NEW-HIRE-HANDOFF, renamed per §7.1 because HCM canonically masters `employees`.
records.catalog_tagline: Hold the new hire's record between offer acceptance and day one.
records.catalog_description: Once a candidate accepts, the pre-employee record carries their details through the gap before onboarding starts. It is the clean handoff point to onboarding and your HRIS, so a new hire's first day never starts from a blank page.

records.description: The investment-opportunity pipeline backbone: deal sourcing through closure, deal-team collaboration, and IC investment memos. Structurally similar to standalone deal-flow products. Masters deals and investment memos.
records.catalog_tagline: Run every investment from first meeting to signed term sheet with the diligence, memo, and committee approvals all in one pipeline.
records.catalog_description:
Move each opportunity through a shared pipeline so the whole deal team sees where it stands. Capture a new deal the moment it is sourced, work it through diligence, and pull the supporting material together as you go. When it is ready for the committee, draft the investment memo, lock it for the vote, and record the decision.

Keep the approvals where they belong. The stages that matter, committee review, term sheet, and close, carry their own permission gates, so the right people sign off before a deal advances and a pass is logged just as clearly as a win. Per-deal roles keep accountability tied to the opportunity rather than to a static org chart.

The payoff is a pipeline leadership can trust, faster handoffs between sourcing and diligence, and an auditable trail of how each investment decision was actually made.

records.description: Auto-inferred relationship graph from email/calendar metadata with warm-introduction path computation across the firm's network. Identity reconciliation of founders, executives, and co-investors across deal stages.
records.catalog_tagline: Map who in your firm knows whom, surface the warmest path to any target, and route introductions to the colleague best placed to make them.
records.catalog_description:
Build a relationship graph from the signals your team already produces. The system reads email and calendar metadata to infer who is connected to whom and how strong each tie is, then keeps that map current as relationships grow or go quiet. Founders, executives, co-investors, board members, and advisors all sit in one network directory.

Use the graph to open doors. When you want to reach a person or an organization, see the shortest warm path in and ask the colleague who actually holds that relationship to make the introduction. Track the request through to a yes or a no so nothing stalls in someone's inbox.

The payoff is more introductions that land, less guessing about who can reach a target, and a network that becomes a shared firm asset instead of a set of private address books.

records.description: Fundraising-side CRM for LP outreach, meetings, and capital-commitment pipeline. Also lightweight portfolio-company awareness for deal-team consumption (full portfolio monitoring lives in PORT-MONIT).
records.catalog_tagline: Manage limited partners from first research through soft circle to a firm commitment, then hand the relationship cleanly to fund administration.
records.catalog_description:
Run your fundraise as a relationship pipeline, not a spreadsheet. Track each prospective limited partner from initial research through outreach, meetings, and a soft circle to a signed commitment, with the people leading the relationship clearly assigned. See at a glance who is in motion, who is stalled, and where the next conversation needs to happen.

Keep the capital side connected to the rest of the firm. When an LP commits, hand the relationship to fund administration so the commitment is recorded without re-keying, and surface capital-call and fund activity back into the relationship record so the people who back you always feel looked after.

The payoff is a fundraise you can forecast, warmer long-term investor relationships, and a clean boundary between the courtship of an LP and the administration of the fund they join.

records.description: Fund accounting: GP books for the fund vehicle, multi-currency support, GAAP/IFRS partnership accounting, and audit-support packaging. Masters funds, fund ledger entries, and close periods.
records.catalog_tagline: The fund's general ledger: book every contribution, expense, fee, and gain, then close the period with confidence.
records.catalog_description:
The fund ledger is the system of record for fund accounting. It captures every accounting entry against the fund vehicle, contributions, fees, expenses, and gain or loss recognitions, under GAAP or IFRS, and rolls them up through structured close periods.

Because the partner capital account statements and the audit pack are built directly from these entries, the close cycle becomes a controlled workflow rather than a quarter-end scramble. Teams get a faster, cleaner close and a defensible trail behind every reported figure.

records.description: LP onboarding (KYC/AML + subscription document collection), PCAP (partner capital account) statement generation, and LP-facing portal for statement and document access.
records.catalog_tagline: Onboard limited partners and hold the commitment book: subscriptions, KYC and AML, and the partner capital accounts LPs see.
records.catalog_description:
LP commitments is where investors enter the fund and where their standing with the fund lives. It runs subscription intake with the KYC, AML, and accreditation checks onboarding requires, then maintains each LP's active commitment: committed, called to date, distributed to date, and current value.

It is also the home of the partner capital account statement, the quarterly document every LP reads. Driven from the commitment record and the fund ledger, the module keeps investor-facing balances accurate and gives the LP-relations team a single trustworthy view of who committed what and where they stand today.

records.description: Capital-call notice generation, LP payment tracking, and call schedule management across funds. Requires approval workflow (GP sign-off, sometimes IC).
records.catalog_tagline: Call capital from LPs and track the cash back: issue the call, allocate by commitment, and reconcile every response.
records.catalog_description:
Capital calls turns the need for cash into a controlled drawdown. It allocates a call across LPs by their commitment percentages, issues the call, and tracks each LP's response, what was due, what was funded, and when, so the fund always knows its real cash position.

Handling the slow payers and the defaults is part of the workflow, not an afterthought. Funded responses flow straight back to the commitment record, advancing each LP's called-to-date balance without a second round of data entry.

records.description: Distribution notice generation with European/American/hybrid waterfall calculations, catchup, clawback, and hurdle-rate handling.
records.catalog_tagline: Return money to investors the right way: compute the waterfall, split preferred return, catch-up, and carry, then pay LPs.
records.catalog_description:
Distributions is where the fund pays its investors and where the math has to be exactly right. It runs the distribution waterfall per the fund agreement, European, American, or hybrid, working through hurdle tests, GP catch-up, carried interest, and the return to each LP.

Because the calculation is the highest-stakes number the fund produces, the module treats it as a reviewed, approved step rather than a one-off spreadsheet. Approved distributions update each LP's distributed-to-date balance and post to the general ledger, keeping investor accounts and fund books in lockstep.

records.description: KPI collection from portfolio companies via portal upload, email parsing, or accounting connectors. Also ESG and diversity metric collection for LP disclosure and SFDR compliance. Masters portfolio companies and the KPI / ESG record streams.
records.catalog_tagline: Collect KPI, ESG, and diversity data from every portfolio company on a predictable reporting cadence.
records.catalog_description: Stand up a reliable pipeline for the numbers behind every holding. Request and capture KPI submissions per portfolio company each period, gather ESG and diversity metrics for LP disclosure, and review and accept what comes in before it flows downstream. Keep a clean, period-by-period record of revenue, runway, headcount, margins, and sustainability indicators so analysts stop chasing data and start comparing it across the portfolio.

records.description: Fair-value marks per ASC 820 with methodology-tagged audit trail across reporting cycles. Distinct from CAP-TABLE's 409A valuations (which are issuer-side IRS valuations); these are LP-side fair-value marks.
records.catalog_tagline: Mark holdings to fair value each cycle with a methodology trail you can defend in an audit.
records.catalog_description: Produce quarter-end fair-value marks per portfolio company with the valuation methodology recorded alongside every number. Move each mark through proposal, review, and approval, lock it once final, and keep the rationale attached so the audit trail is complete. Built for the fair-value reporting that LPs and auditors expect, with a single-approver gate where it matters.

records.description: Time-weighted IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI computation across multi-vintage funds with PME benchmarking and J-curve normalization. Aggregate dashboards over portfolio holdings.
records.catalog_tagline: Compute fund and position returns across vintages with benchmarking and J-curve normalization.
records.catalog_description: Roll holdings up into the performance numbers that define a fund: time-weighted IRR, MOIC, TVPI, and DPI at both the position and fund level. Normalize for the J-curve on early-stage vintages and benchmark against public market equivalents so results are comparable and credible. Give the team aggregate dashboards over the whole portfolio instead of a maze of disconnected return calculations.

records.description: Quarterly LP-facing performance reports with fund and individual position metrics. Distinct from FUND-ADMIN's PCAP statements (which are accounting-side capital-account ledgers); these are performance narratives.
records.catalog_tagline: Package quarterly LP performance reports that tie every fund number back to the marks behind it.
records.catalog_description: Assemble the quarterly story LPs read: position-level marks, fund-level performance metrics, GP commentary, and portfolio highlights in one report per fund. Move each report through draft, review, and publication, and lock it once distributed so the version LPs receive is the version of record. Turn the latest valuations and returns into a polished, defensible LP narrative without rebuilding it by hand every quarter.

records.description: Authoritative record of equity holders, security classes (common, preferred, SAFE), and the historical transaction log for the issuing company.
records.catalog_tagline: Maintain an accurate, always-current shareholder ledger across every security class.
records.catalog_description: Track every shareholder, share class, and certificate in one authoritative ledger. Record issuances, transfers, and ownership changes as your company evolves, and see fully-diluted ownership at a glance. The ledger stays consistent with grants, valuations, and exit scenarios so the numbers always reconcile.

records.description: Option pool tracking (size, available headroom), RSU/option grant issuance with board approval, grant acceptance, vesting-schedule administration. Multi-masters equity_grants alongside COMP-MGMT (which holds the compensation-policy slice).
records.catalog_tagline: Issue, approve, and manage stock and option grants with the option pool always in view.
records.catalog_description: Propose and approve equity grants, set strike prices against the current 409A, and apply vesting schedules. Manage your option pool so you always know what's reserved, granted, and available, and refresh it when the board approves more. Handle exercises and forfeitures, and keep grants in sync with the ledger and the employee portal throughout their life.

records.description: IRS 409A fair-market-value determination per methodology (income, market, asset, OPM backsolve), and ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense recognition with Black-Scholes or lattice models.
records.catalog_tagline: Order 409A valuations and run ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense.
records.catalog_description: Capture and finalize 409A fair-market-value determinations that set the strike price for new grants, with a clear review-and-approval trail. Calculate stock-based compensation expense across reporting periods under ASC 718 so finance can book the right numbers and close each period with confidence.

records.description: Scenario modeling for exit proceeds distribution with multiple preferred-class participation rights, liquidation preferences, and conversion economics.
records.catalog_tagline: Model acquisitions and IPOs to see exactly what each shareholder takes home.
records.catalog_description: Build exit scenarios at any valuation and watch the waterfall distribute proceeds through liquidation preferences, participation, and common shares. Compare outcomes for founders, investors, and option holders, commit the scenario the board approves, and apply the result back to the ledger when the exit closes.

records.description: Employee-facing portal for grant acceptance, vesting visibility, exercise workflows, and tax-document access. Distinct from board-side grant administration (which lives in CAP-TABLE-GRANTS).
records.catalog_tagline: Give employees a clear, self-service view of their equity and vesting.
records.catalog_description: Let employees see their grants, vested and unvested shares, and current value in one place. They can accept new grants, follow their vesting schedule, and start an exercise without back-and-forth emails, while every action stays reconciled with the grant records and the ledger.

records.description: Tender offers, employee liquidity programs, and shareholder-initiated secondary transfers with board-approval workflow.
records.catalog_tagline: Process secondary share transfers between holders with the right approvals.
records.catalog_description: Handle the sale or transfer of shares between existing holders and new buyers, from drafting the transaction through approval, execution, and settlement. Enforce right-of-first-refusal and approval gates, then move the shares cleanly in the ledger and adjust affected grants once the transfer settles.

records.description: End-to-end fund-vehicle setup: entity formation, EIN application, banking onboarding, and templated LPA.
records.catalog_tagline: Form the legal vehicle, file with the state and IRS, open the bank account, and get subscription documents in front of investors.
records.catalog_description:
Take a new fund or vehicle from idea to operational. Set up the entity, prepare and track the formation filings, apply for the tax identification number, and start the banking application, all in one checklist you can actually finish. Generate the limited partnership agreement and side letters from proven templates instead of paying for every document from scratch.

Keep every artifact in one record so nothing stalls. See which filings are pending, which are accepted, and what is blocking the vehicle from going live, then hand the operational vehicle off to the teams that run capital calls, cap table, and the investor portal.

records.description: Single-deal special-purpose-vehicle creation with templated docs and ongoing admin.
records.catalog_tagline: Spin up a single-deal vehicle, collect investor subscriptions, run the verification checks, and close.
records.catalog_description:
Raise deal by deal without standing up a whole fund. Create a special purpose vehicle for the opportunity, send subscription documents, and track each investor from draft through signed, funded, and confirmed. Run know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering checks per subscription so the close is clean.

Watch the raise fill in real time and see exactly who still needs to sign or wire. When the vehicle is active, the capital it gathers flows into the same operations and reporting your investors expect, so a one-off syndicate runs as smoothly as a full fund.

records.description: Simplified LP onboarding, capital calls, and LP portal for single-fund single-class structures. Deliberately less complex than the FUND-ADMIN equivalents; the simplification IS the value engineering.
records.catalog_tagline: Run capital calls, onboard limited partners, and keep investors informed without a back-office team.
records.catalog_description:
Handle the recurring work of running a live vehicle. Issue capital calls, track who has funded and who is late, and onboard new limited partners with the verification steps built in. Keep investor communications and documents in one place so the people who put money in always know where things stand.

The workflow is sized for a manager running lean: enough structure to stay compliant and organized, without the overhead of a full fund-administration platform. When the operation outgrows the lite shape, the records are ready to carry forward.

records.description: Basic shareholder ledger and grant tracking for the GP entity and portfolio cap-table awareness. Not the full ASC 718 / 409A / exit-waterfall machinery of standalone CAP-TABLE.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep a clear record of who owns what across the vehicle, with allocations and positions in one view.
records.catalog_description:
Track ownership across the fund or vehicle without a standalone equity platform. Record each holder's position, see allocations at a glance, and keep the cap table current as commitments fund and the vehicle evolves.

This is the lite shape: the ownership picture a solo or small-team manager needs to answer investor questions and prepare reporting, kept in step with formation and ongoing operations so the numbers always reconcile.

records.description: Discovery of sanctioned and shadow SaaS, app inventory, ownership, integrations, lifecycle staging, catalog publication, and operational signal/alerts. The discovery substrate of an SMP deployment.
records.catalog_tagline: Find every SaaS app in use, including the ones nobody told you about.
records.catalog_description: Automatically discover sanctioned and shadow SaaS across your org, assign an owner to each app, and connect the integrations that feed usage and spend data. Publish a clean app catalog, stage each application through its portfolio lifecycle, and get alerted the moment something needs attention.

records.description: Renewal pipeline tracking, vendor relationship management, contract coordination with procurement and legal, spend allocation, and per-SaaS vendor-risk attestation. The commercial layer of an SMP deployment.
records.catalog_tagline: Run every SaaS renewal on your terms, not the vendor's deadline.
records.catalog_description: Track every upcoming renewal, assign renewal tasks, and manage vendor negotiations from first outreach to signed agreement. Allocate spend across cost centers, coordinate contracts with procurement and legal, and keep a per-vendor risk and attestation record so renewals are decisions, not surprises.

records.description: The core LMS workflow: course authoring, content delivery, enrollment, completion tracking, and transcript posting. Masters `courses`, `course_enrollments`, `learning_records`. Realizes COURSE-AUTHOR and CONTENT-DELIVERY capabilities. The backbone module every LMS deployment installs first; the other LMS modules embedded_master courses to reference content.
records.catalog_tagline: Build, publish, and deliver online courses, then track every enrollment through to completion.
records.catalog_description: Create courses from lessons, content assets, and assessments, and publish new versions when material changes. Enroll learners, deliver self-paced training in the browser, and grade quizzes and exams as they go. Watch progress and completion in real time, and keep a clean record of who finished what.

records.description: Mandatory regulatory training assignment, tracking, and certification: sexual harassment training (CA SB-1343), HIPAA, OSHA, anti-bribery, SOX, GDPR, AML. Masters `compliance_assignments` and `learner_certifications`. Realizes COMPLIANCE-TRAIN and CERT-MGMT. Distinct from general LMS course delivery: assignments are mandatory and time-bound, lifecycle includes `overdue`/`waived`/`expired` states with regulator-evidence retention, and ownership typically sits with GRC/Compliance, not L&D.
records.catalog_tagline: Assign mandatory training, chase overdue learners automatically, and capture the evidence regulators ask for.
records.catalog_description: Run regulatory and policy training as repeatable campaigns. Assign required courses to the right people, track completion against deadlines, and escalate overdue assignments without manual chasing. Capture signed training evidence, manage recertification, and produce the filings and audit records compliance reviewers expect.

records.description: Authors and assigns sequenced learning paths inside the LMS. Masters learning_paths; consumes skill_profiles (mastered by SKILLS-MGMT after migration) to recommend paths against skill gaps.
records.catalog_tagline: Guide learners along structured paths that build the skills each role needs.
records.catalog_description: Sequence courses into curricula and learning paths so learners always know what comes next. Tie each step to the skills and proficiency a role requires, recommend the next best course, and roll individual development into longer-term career plans. Track progress across the whole path, not just one course at a time.

records.description: Plan templates, journey instances, stages, tasks, and cohorts. The core orchestration surface for new-hire onboarding programs.
records.catalog_tagline: Design onboarding journeys once and run them for every new hire automatically.
records.catalog_description: The orchestration core of onboarding. Build reusable plan templates, then spin up a journey instance for each new hire that sequences stages, tasks, and cohort programs from pre-boarding through the 30/60/90 milestones. Tasks are generated conditionally by role, location, and employment type and routed to the teams that own them, so IT provisioning, workspace setup, access requests, and training enrollments all kick off from one journey without manual chasing. Coordinators and program managers track progress in real time, catch stalled steps before day one, and prove that every new hire was ready to work on schedule.

records.description: Collection and validation of new-hire paperwork (I-9, tax, NDA, direct-deposit), with handoff to HCM/Payroll on completion.
records.catalog_tagline: Collect, validate, and route every new-hire document without the paper chase.
records.catalog_description: A focused workspace for new-hire paperwork. Gather and verify the documents a hire must complete, including eligibility, tax, agreements, and direct-deposit forms, with a clear submission, review, and approval flow that locks records once they are filed. Approved collections hand off automatically to the systems that depend on them so worker records and payroll activate without re-keying. Built-in status tracking and an auditable trail keep compliance teams confident that every required form was collected, reviewed, and retained correctly.

records.description: Pre-boarding communications, day-one welcome cadences, buddy pairing, and intro meeting coordination.
records.catalog_tagline: Make every new hire feel expected, connected, and supported from day one.
records.catalog_description: The human side of onboarding. Schedule pre-boarding and day-one welcome communications, pair each new hire with a buddy or mentor, and coordinate the introductions that turn a start date into a sense of belonging. Welcome cadences are timed to the journey and routed through the channel each workplace prefers, while buddy assignments are tracked from pairing through completion. Stronger first impressions lift early engagement, speed up ramp time, and improve new-hire retention through the critical first weeks.

records.description: Capture, triage, route, and resolve service-disrupting incidents. Includes major-incident command, AI-assisted classification, and skill-based assignment.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture, prioritize, and resolve outages and disruptions before they spread.
records.catalog_description:
Incident Management turns every report of something broken into a tracked ticket with an owner, a priority, and a clock. Agents triage incoming issues, route them to the right team, and drive each one from new to resolved while keeping the requester informed.

Built-in prioritization, assignment, and resolution gates keep major incidents from slipping through the cracks, and a clean audit trail shows exactly how each disruption was handled. The faster you restore service, the less an outage costs you.

records.description: End-user-driven request workflow, including catalog authoring, request routing, approvals, and self-service portal.
records.catalog_tagline: Let employees order the services they need and fulfill each one with confidence.
records.catalog_description:
Service Request Fulfillment gives your workforce a single front door for the everyday things they need from IT: access, equipment, software, and standard changes. Each request follows a defined path through submission, approval, and fulfillment so nothing stalls in someone's inbox.

Approval routing and fulfillment tracking make the experience predictable for the requester and measurable for the team. Repeatable requests become catalog-driven, freeing agents to focus on the work that genuinely needs a human.

records.description: Root-cause analysis, known-error tracking, and corrective action for recurring or major incidents.
records.catalog_tagline: Find the root cause behind recurring incidents and stop them coming back.
records.catalog_description:
Problem Management connects the dots across repeated incidents to surface the underlying fault, document the known error, and drive a permanent fix. Instead of firefighting the same outage week after week, your team works the cause once.

A structured path from identification through analysis to resolution keeps investigations disciplined, and a shared record of known errors speeds up every future diagnosis. Fewer repeat incidents means a calmer service desk and lower operating cost.

records.description: Change request capture, CAB workflow, approval routing, release planning, and standard-change catalog.
records.catalog_tagline: Ship changes to production with the right approvals and a clear rollback path.
records.catalog_description:
Change and Release Management governs how work reaches your live environment. Every change is proposed, assessed for risk, approved by the right authority, and scheduled so it lands without colliding with other work or breaking dependent services.

Approval gates, submission controls, and a full change history give you the assurance to move fast without inviting the next outage. The payoff is a higher rate of successful changes and far fewer self-inflicted incidents.

records.description: Reactive event filtering, deduplication, and routing into the incident workflow. Bridge between observability platforms and ITSM.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn the flood of monitoring alerts into the few incidents that actually matter.
records.catalog_description:
Event and Alert Handling sits between your monitoring tools and your service desk, taking in the constant stream of alerts and deciding what deserves a human response. Noise is filtered, related signals are grouped, and only meaningful events become tracked incidents.

By promoting the right alerts automatically and suppressing the rest, the team spends its attention on real problems rather than chasing false alarms. Faster detection of genuine issues shortens the time to restore service.

records.description: Authoring, review, publication, and consumption of knowledge articles supporting ITSM agents and self-service portals.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture what your team knows and put it to work for agents and self-service.
records.catalog_description:
Knowledge Management gives experts a place to write, review, and publish the articles that resolve issues faster. Content moves through a clear authoring and review lifecycle so what reaches your users is accurate and current.

Published articles power both agent-assisted resolution and self-service deflection, so common questions get answered without a ticket. Every reuse of a good article is time your team gets back.

records.description: Unified agent experience: workspace, walk-up support, virtual agent / conversational ITSM, and continuous-improvement reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Give agents one workspace and leaders the reporting to run the service desk.
records.catalog_description:
Agent Workspace and Reporting brings the agent's queue, context, and tools into a single view so they can work tickets without hunting across screens. Everything needed to understand and act on the next item is in one place.

For team leads, built-in reporting turns daily activity into the trends, volumes, and service metrics that drive staffing and improvement decisions. A productive agent and an informed manager together raise the whole desk's performance.

records.description: SLA / OLA definitions, breach tracking, escalation rules, service-cost tracking, and chargeback to consuming business units.
records.catalog_tagline: Set service-level targets, track them in real time, and account for the cost.
records.catalog_description:
SLA and Chargeback Management defines the response and resolution commitments your service desk operates to, then measures every ticket against them so breaches are caught before they become escalations. Targets are explicit and performance is visible.

Linking service consumption back to cost lets you show what IT delivers and what it costs to deliver, turning the service desk from a black box into an accountable function the business can plan around.

records.description: Masters customer accounts and their associated contacts. The structural backbone of the CRM market: every other CRM module hangs off the account/contact graph. Folds the cross-cutting Customer 360 capability because the unified-customer-view is anchored on the account/contact records this module owns.
records.catalog_tagline: One trusted record for every customer and contact, with the full account history in one view.
records.catalog_description:
Account and Contact Management is the system of record for who you sell to. Maintain a clean, deduplicated record of every account and the people inside it, with segmentation, account tier, and the relationships between parent companies and their divisions.

Give everyone who touches the customer a single, current view: the contacts and their roles, the open and won deals, the activity history, and the signals coming back from service, billing, and product. Keep that record accurate as customers sign up, change tier, and grow, so every team works from the same truth.

records.description: Captures inbound and prospected leads, scores and routes them, and converts qualified leads to contacts and opportunities. The top-of-funnel module: a CRM deployment without lead management is viable for pure account-management shops, which is why this is a separate module rather than folded into Account Management.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture, score, and qualify every lead, then convert the best into accounts and live deals.
records.catalog_description:
Lead Management captures inbound interest from marketing, partners, web forms, and outbound prospecting into one routed queue. Score each lead, work it through a clear qualification status, and assign it to the right rep with rules that keep response times fast.

When a lead is ready, convert it cleanly into a contact, an account, and an opportunity so no context is lost in the handoff. The result is a predictable top of funnel where good leads move forward quickly and weak ones are filtered before they waste selling time.

records.description: Masters opportunities, the pipeline-stage definitions that opportunities progress through, and the forecasting roll-ups computed from weighted pipeline. The revenue-execution module: where deal management, sales forecasting, and pipeline health analytics live.
records.catalog_tagline: Run every deal through a pipeline you control, from first touch to close, with forecast you can trust.
records.catalog_description:
Pipeline Management is where deals get worked and won. Define your sales stages, exit criteria, and default probabilities, then move each opportunity through them with full visibility into amount, products, competitors, and close date.

Managers see the whole pipeline at once, spot stalled or at-risk deals early, and forecast the period with confidence. Stage changes trigger the right downstream motions, from generating a quote to alerting the teams that take over on close, so winning a deal flows straight into delivering it.

records.description: Masters the sales activity log (calls, emails, meetings, demos, tasks) and the touchpoint history on accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities. Includes the mobile and offline access surface for field sales: the activity-log mobile app is the canonical mobile CRM use case.
records.catalog_tagline: Log every call, email, and meeting against the right account so the full conversation is never lost.
records.catalog_description:
Activity Management captures the day-to-day work of selling: calls, emails, meetings, demos, and content views, each tied to the contact and opportunity it belongs to. Reps see exactly what has happened on an account and what is due next, and managers see real engagement instead of guesswork.

Tracked emails and scheduled meetings become part of the account's permanent history, and completed activities feed pipeline and forecast signals automatically. The team stays coordinated, follow-ups happen on time, and no customer interaction goes unrecorded.

records.domain_module_name: AI Sales Copilot and Workflow Automation
records.description: AI-assisted sales workflows: generative copilot, intelligent next-best-action suggestions, automated approval routing, and process automation across CRM. A standalone module because AI copilots and workflow engines are increasingly packaged as a separate paid tier on top of core CRM.
records.catalog_tagline: An AI assistant that drafts outreach, summarizes accounts, and recommends the next best move on every deal.
records.catalog_description:
AI Copilot works on top of your live customer, contact, lead, opportunity, and activity records to take the busywork out of selling. Ask it to summarize an account before a call, draft a personalized follow-up email, or explain why a deal is at risk, and it answers from the data already in your CRM.

It recommends the next best action, surfaces signals a rep might miss, and turns long histories into a quick brief, so sellers spend their time in conversations and decisions rather than searching and typing. The assistant reads and acts on the canonical records the rest of CRM maintains, so its guidance always reflects the current state of the relationship.

records.description: Annual / semi-annual / continuous performance review cycles plus goal-setting (OKRs, KPIs) and rating calibration. The foundation module of any talent-management deployment; review cycles produce the calibrated rating that COMP-MGMT consumes for merit cycles and that downstream succession planning relies on.
records.catalog_tagline: Set goals, run reviews, and calibrate ratings so performance management stays fair, consistent, and tied to results.
records.catalog_description:
Give every employee clear goals and a structured review. Define individual goals and OKRs with metrics and weights, then track progress through the year and roll outcomes into the review cycle.

Run reviews the way your business works. Move each review through self-assessment, manager assessment, submission, and publishing, with the right people gated into each step.

Remove rater bias with calibration. Bring managers together to normalize ratings across teams, lock the calibrated outcomes, and publish results that downstream merit, succession, and 9-box decisions can trust.

records.description: Succession planning, 9-box talent grid, and employee career aspirations / development planning. Layered on top of Performance Management because it consumes calibrated ratings and goal-completion outcomes. Used standalone in large enterprises with formal succession programs.
records.catalog_tagline: Build the bench for critical roles and give people a clear path forward with succession plans, 9-box placement, and career aspirations.
records.catalog_description:
Protect the business from key-person risk. Build succession plans for critical positions, identify ready successors with readiness ratings, and capture risk-of-loss so you always know where the gaps are.

See talent at a glance. Place people on a performance-by-potential grid to focus development and investment where it pays off, and feed confirmed placements straight back into succession planning.

Make career growth a two-way conversation. Record each person's target roles and mobility preferences so you can match them to internal opportunities and keep your best people moving forward.

records.description: Continuous feedback, 1-on-1 notes, peer recognition / praise / kudos, and 360-degree feedback collection. The lightweight always-on companion to the annual review cycle. Often the first module customers adopt before a full review cycle.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep feedback flowing all year with kudos, one-on-one notes, and requested feedback that feed straight into reviews.
records.catalog_description:
Make recognition and coaching part of everyday work. Capture kudos, one-on-one notes, peer comments, and requested feedback as they happen, independent of the formal review calendar.

Share feedback with the right timing and the right people. Move each record from draft to shared to acknowledged so feedback lands clearly and is confirmed by the recipient.

Connect continuous feedback to formal performance. Aggregate the year's feedback into review summaries so managers walk into every review with the full picture.

records.description: Core worker record: identity, employment lifecycle, contracts, and effective-dated employment events. The system-of-record layer for every employee.
records.catalog_tagline: Maintain the authoritative worker record, employment contracts, and the personal data the rest of HR depends on.
records.catalog_description:
The core worker module is where every employee profile lives: identity, status, manager, position, org unit, and the employment contracts that bind them. Capture each worker from pre-hire through active employment to termination, with personal-content fields protected by the access controls a workforce of record requires.

Keep contracts and core attributes current and let downstream systems read from a single trusted source. When a worker is hired, promoted, or leaves, this module is the event that triggers payroll, access provisioning, benefits, and asset recall, so the data here stays clean and the handoffs stay reliable.

records.description: Organization design: org units, positions, and job profiles. Effective-dated org structure with position approval workflow, job-profile authority, and the hierarchical backbone every downstream HR system reads. Foundation for workforce planning and span-of-control analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Design your organization: build the job catalog, define positions, and shape the org structure headcount planning runs on.
records.catalog_description:
The org and positions module is where you model the shape of the organization rather than the people in it. Author and publish job profiles, approve and open positions against budgeted headcount, and maintain the org-unit hierarchy through creation, reorganization, merges, and closures.

This is the planning surface that recruiting, compensation, and workforce planning all consume. Publishing a job profile opens the door to a requisition; approving a position signals where to hire; reorganizing a unit cascades to access and reporting lines. Get the structure right here and every downstream people process inherits a clean foundation.

records.description: Employee and manager self-service portal coordinating cross-domain lifecycle: onboarding intake from ATS, lifecycle change requests, leave/absence visibility, and offboarding handoffs to ITSM/IGA/PAYROLL. Workflow surface on top of HCM-CORE-WORKER and HCM-ORG-POSITIONS, no masters of its own.
records.catalog_tagline: Move people through the moments that matter: onboarding, job and leave changes, and a coordinated offboarding.
records.catalog_description:
The lifecycle workflows module orchestrates the transitions in an employee's journey. Reconcile new hires arriving from recruiting into active workers, route everyday change requests like transfers and leaves of absence, and coordinate a clean offboarding across IT, identity, and payroll.

Employees and managers drive much of this themselves through self-service, while HR keeps oversight. Each step reads from and writes back to the authoritative worker record, so a completed onboarding, an approved leave, or a finished separation lands consistently everywhere it needs to without manual rekeying.

records.description: Cross-asset reference-data layer: model recognition, software-title normalization, SaaS app catalog, and identity reconciliation across HAM, SAM, SMP, and FINOPS. The substrate that turns disparate asset feeds into a unified portfolio. No own masters in v1; reference data lives in third-party taxonomies. Computed/reconciliation layer over HAM/SAM/SMP/FINOPS/EAM masters; intentionally has no own data_objects.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn messy, inconsistent asset feeds into one clean, trusted inventory.
records.catalog_description: Every discovery source names the same hardware and software a little differently, leaving you with duplicate and mismatched records. This module reconciles those feeds into a single normalized catalog, so one model means one entry no matter where it was found. Keep your reference data current and let the rest of your asset management work from inventory you can trust.

records.description: Unified contract management for agreements spanning multiple asset types. Masters asset_contracts at the umbrella layer because a single contract often covers hardware leases plus software licenses plus SaaS bundles plus cloud commitments.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every lease, warranty, and support agreement tied to the assets it covers.
records.catalog_description: Track the contracts that govern your assets, from leases and maintenance to warranties and support, in one connected record. See which assets each agreement covers, when it activates, renews, or expires, and act before a deadline catches you off guard. Stay ahead of renewals, avoid lapses in coverage, and keep procurement and finance aligned on what is committed and when.

records.description: Cross-asset event log capturing acquisition, assignment, transfer, and retirement across all asset types. Masters asset_lifecycle_events as the single source of truth for the asset audit trail.
records.catalog_tagline: Follow every asset from procurement to disposal in one audit-ready timeline.
records.catalog_description: Record every step in an asset's life, procurement, deployment, transfer, retirement, and disposal, as a single connected history that spans hardware, software, and SaaS. Capture events as they happen, including the ones triggered elsewhere such as an incident, a provisioning request, or an employee leaving, so the record is always complete. When you need to prove what happened to an asset and when, the timeline is already there.

records.description: Total cost of ownership and portfolio-level reporting rolling up HAM, SAM, SMP, FINOPS, and EAM. Derived module: no own masters, consumes from every sub-domain and the cross-cutting umbrella modules.
records.catalog_tagline: See total cost and portfolio position across your whole technology estate.
records.catalog_description: Roll your assets, contracts, and lifecycle activity into total-cost-of-ownership and portfolio-position reporting that the whole organization can use. Spot redundant spend, plan refreshes, and answer finance, procurement, and leadership with numbers you trust. Turn a scattered estate into clear decisions about what to keep, renew, consolidate, or retire.

records.description: Items, balances, lot and serial tracking, stock movements, transfers, and cycle counts. The deployable base module of INV-MGMT.
records.catalog_tagline: The accurate, auditable single source of truth for every item you hold.
records.catalog_description: Establish the foundation of inventory control: items, locations, and live on-hand balances across every warehouse and bin. Capture each receipt, issue, adjustment, and transfer as a posted stock movement so balances are always defensible, and track lots and serial numbers for traceability, expiry, and recall. Run scheduled cycle counts to catch shrinkage early and reconcile variances before they reach the general ledger, giving operations and finance one trusted stock record they can both stand behind.

records.description: Reorder rules, ABC-XYZ classification, and available-to-promise calculation. Layered on top of Core Stock to drive automated replenishment.
records.catalog_tagline: Stop guessing what to buy. Let reorder rules and demand signals decide.
records.catalog_description: Turn stock data into buying decisions. Set reorder points, safety stock, and supplier preferences per item and location, then let the system flag what to replenish the moment on-hand falls below threshold. Classify items by value and demand variability with ABC and XYZ analysis so attention goes where it matters, and surface accurate available-to-promise figures so sales commits dates it can keep. The result is fewer stockouts, less cash tied up in dead inventory, and replenishment that runs on rules instead of firefighting.

records.description: Kit definitions, kit explosion at order or production time, and finished-kit on-hand maintenance. Add-on for sellers with bundled-SKU or light-manufacturing flows.
records.catalog_tagline: Sell bundles and build assemblies without losing track of components.
records.catalog_description: Define kits and bundles once, then let component stock deplete automatically as kits are assembled or sold. Maintain finished-kit on-hand alongside raw components, explode bills of materials at order or production time, and post the resulting component-consumption movements straight into your stock record. Ideal for sellers shipping bundled SKUs and shops running light manufacturing, so bundle availability stays accurate and component counts never drift.

records.description: Engagement, pulse, and lifecycle surveys; question library; response collection; driver scoring. The ongoing voice-of-employee surface for continuous listening programs.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep a steady pulse on engagement with surveys your people answer and scores leaders can act on.
records.catalog_description: Design and run engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 listening from a reusable question library. Set cadences, target the right audiences, and protect respondents with anonymity floors that keep candor high. As responses arrive, scores aggregate into engagement drivers at the team, department, and segment level, so you can spot strengths and trouble spots without combing through raw answers. This is the always-on voice-of-employee surface that feeds every downstream conversation about how the organization is doing.

records.description: Survey-result-driven action plans owned by managers or HRBPs. Tracks driver-to-action linkage, completion, and downstream WORK-MGMT task spawn. Closes the listen-act loop for engagement programs.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn survey results into manager-owned action plans and track them through to real change.
records.catalog_description: Close the loop between listening and doing. When driver scores reveal where a team needs attention, managers and HR business partners create focused action plans tied directly to the result that prompted them. Track each commitment from creation through completion, spawn the supporting tasks that get the work done, and see whether follow-through actually lifted the next round of scores. Repeated inaction becomes its own signal, so accountability stays visible and engagement programs deliver outcomes rather than just reports.

records.description: The foundational PLM module: part and item master, engineering BOM, revision control, and engineering change workflow. Every PLM rollout starts here.
records.catalog_tagline: Own the part master, BOM, and engineering change control.
records.catalog_description: Author and release engineering parts, revisions, and bills of material, then govern every change through a structured change-order workflow: open the change, run a where-used impact assessment, take it through review and approval, and release the controlled result. Keep one authoritative item master that the rest of the product record extends, so a released part means the same thing to engineering, manufacturing, and procurement.

records.description: Product Data Management module: vaulting, check-in / check-out, version control, and viewable generation for CAD files. Integrates with mechanical and electronic CAD authoring tools.
records.catalog_tagline: Vault, version, and release your CAD models and drawings.
records.catalog_description: Give design teams a managed vault for CAD models and drawings with check-in, check-out, and revision history so the latest controlled geometry is never in doubt. Tie each model and drawing to its engineering part and release it as the controlled artifact that manufacturing and field service rely on, ending the lost-file and wrong-version problems of shared folders.

records.description: Bridges engineering release to the shop floor: mBOM authoring, manufacturing routing, work instructions, and configuration / variant resolution at order time.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn the engineering BOM into a buildable manufacturing process.
records.catalog_description: Translate the as-designed engineering BOM into a manufacturing BOM and routing the shop floor can actually build, and resolve configurable products into concrete variants at order time. Release the manufacturing process as a controlled output so production execution and ERP pick up a consistent, costed, change-aware definition instead of a hand-reconciled copy.

records.description: Substance tracking and reporting for product regulations: RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals, PFAS. Captures supplier material declarations and generates compliance evidence per shipment / market.
records.catalog_tagline: Prove material and substance compliance for every market.
records.catalog_description: Collect supplier material declarations, track regulated substances, and roll the results up into product compliance declarations that show each part meets the rules for the regions you sell into. Manage declaration validity and expiry, re-flag affected parts when a declaration lapses, and keep an auditable record for regulators instead of scrambling for evidence after the fact.

records.description: Requirements capture, decomposition, and traceability from customer / regulatory inputs through design, test, and validation. Used heavily in aerospace, automotive, and medical-device.
records.catalog_tagline: Trace requirements from definition through verification.
records.catalog_description: Capture and decompose product requirements, link them to the parts and changes that satisfy them, and build a traceability matrix that shows what is covered, reviewed, approved, and verified. Catch unmet or orphaned requirements before release so the product you ship is the product that was actually specified.

records.description: The catalog backbone of benefits administration: masters benefit_plans and benefit_open_enrollments, defines deduction codes used by PAYROLL, and scopes plan offerings by legal_entity.
records.catalog_tagline: Build your plan catalog and set up each enrollment window.
records.catalog_description: Define the medical, dental, vision, retirement, and voluntary plans you offer, set eligibility and pricing, map payroll deductions, and scope offerings by legal entity. Schedule and configure each open enrollment window so employees see the right choices when the window opens.

records.description: The employee-facing workflow surface: elections, dependents, life-event handling, and decision-support tooling. Masters benefit_enrollments, benefit_dependents, life_events; embeds employees for the benefit-eligibility slice (coverage tier, dependent linkage, beneficiary designation).
records.catalog_tagline: Guide employees through elections, dependents, and life events.
records.catalog_description: Give employees a guided path to elect coverage, add and verify dependents, and report qualifying life events such as marriage, a new child, or a move. Benefits teams review and approve changes, lock records once verified, and keep every election accurate from onboarding through termination.

records.description: EDI / API connectivity to insurance carriers, 401(k) record-keepers, and equity providers. Masters benefit_carriers and carrier_feeds (834 EDI, custom API, file-drop). Owns the identity-reconciliation problem between per-carrier member IDs and the HRIS employee_id.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep carriers and record-keepers in sync automatically.
records.catalog_description: Connect to insurance carriers, retirement record-keepers, and equity providers over EDI, API, or file feeds. Transmit enrollment changes, reconcile carrier acknowledgments, and resolve member-identity mismatches so coverage on file always matches what employees elected.

records.description: 1094-C / 1095-C reporting, affordability tracking, and ACA penalty avoidance. Consumes benefit_enrollments, employees, and legal_entities to produce IRS-bound filings and monthly affordability snapshots.
records.catalog_tagline: Stay ahead of ACA reporting and affordability obligations.
records.catalog_description: Track monthly affordability and coverage offers, generate 1094-C and 1095-C filings, and produce the audit trail that keeps the organization clear of ACA penalties. Pull enrollment, employee, and legal-entity data together so year-end reporting is a confirmation step, not a fire drill.

records.description: Core HR case management surface: HR cases, case taxonomy, triage, approval routing, and AI-assisted classification. Masters hr_cases and case_categories. The execution backbone of any HRSD deployment.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture, triage, and resolve every employee HR request in one tracked queue.
records.catalog_description:
Turn employee questions and requests into structured cases that move through a clear workflow: intake, triage, assignment, work, approval, and resolution. Each case lands with the right specialist, carries its full history, and closes against a service level everyone can see.

Route sensitive cases to the right owner, escalate to payroll, benefits, or access teams when a request crosses into their scope, and reopen a closed case cleanly when something changes. Managers get a real-time view of workload, aging, and approvals so HR support stays predictable instead of reactive.

records.description: Employee self-service intake surface: catalog browse, request submission, knowledge search, and case status. Workflow layer on top of HRSD-CASE-MGMT, no masters of its own. Hands intake off to case-mgmt and can route IT-flavored requests through to ITSM.
records.catalog_tagline: A single front door where employees ask, request, and self-serve HR needs.
records.catalog_description:
Give employees one place to start anything HR-related. They search for answers first, raise a case when they need a person, and check the status of everything they have open without sending a follow-up email.

The portal connects to the same case workflow HR teams use, so a request submitted here arrives fully formed and ready to triage. Familiar self-service patterns reduce inbound volume and let employees resolve common needs on their own time.

records.description: HR knowledge surface: HR-audience articles, FAQs, and policy explainers. Consumes the cross-cutting knowledge_articles entity (mastered by ITSM/KMS) and feeds back authoring suggestions when cases are resolved.
records.catalog_tagline: Build and publish the HR knowledge that answers employees before they ask.
records.catalog_description:
Maintain a living library of HR answers, policies, and how-to guidance that employees can find from the portal and that agents can attach to a case in seconds. Articles are organized by the same categories that classify cases, so the right answer surfaces in the right context.

Every resolved case is a candidate for new knowledge, so the library compounds over time, deflecting repeat questions and keeping guidance consistent across the whole employee population.

records.description: Annual merit, bonus, and equity cycles. Masters merit_cycles, merit_recommendations, and compensation_plans. Drives manager workflows, calibration, approvals, and posting of effective-dated pay changes.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan merit and bonus cycles, calibrate awards to budget, and route them for approval.
records.catalog_description: Open a compensation cycle, set merit and bonus guidelines, and let managers propose increases for their teams. Calibrate recommendations against your budget and pay-equity targets, then route them through review and approval before they post. Give your compensation partners a controlled, transparent way to turn budget into fair, defensible pay decisions.

records.description: Bonus, commission, and long-term equity plan administration. Masters equity_grants and folds INCENTIVE-MGMT + EQUITY-MGMT capabilities (grant lifecycle, vesting, exercise, expense tracking).
records.catalog_tagline: Grant equity and incentive awards, then track them from proposal through vesting.
records.catalog_description: Propose equity and incentive awards as part of total rewards, approve them, and follow each grant through vesting, exercise, forfeiture, and expiration. Keep award terms, schedules, and statuses in one place so finance, payroll, and your people all see the same numbers. Give your team a clean record of every long-term incentive you have promised.

records.description: Market data ingestion, salary band maintenance, and pay-equity analysis. Masters salary_bands and compensation_benchmarks; surfaces compa-ratio and pay-gap analytics consumed by planning and people analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Benchmark pay to the market and build salary bands you can defend.
records.catalog_description: Bring in market pay data, match your roles to it, and build salary bands and ranges that keep offers and increases competitive. Surface pay gaps against the market and across your workforce so you can close them before they become a risk. Give your compensation team the evidence to set, justify, and update pay structures with confidence.

records.description: Headcount, attrition snapshots, span-of-control, workforce composition, and people-KPI scorecards. Masters people_kpis and workforce_segments. Entry-point module for People Analytics deployments.
records.catalog_tagline: Track headcount, attrition, and workforce composition with people-KPI scorecards.
records.catalog_description:
Workforce Metrics gives you the core people numbers: headcount, hires and exits, attrition snapshots, span of control, and workforce composition by org unit, tenure, and performance band. Define the KPIs that matter, snapshot them on a schedule, and publish scorecards leaders can trust.

Segment the workforce into the cohorts you care about and feed those segments into planning, predictive, and diversity work. This is the entry point for People Analytics, the metric layer everything else builds on.

records.description: Pulse and engagement-survey campaigns, driver-score computation, sentiment aggregation. Masters engagement_surveys; consumes survey_responses from EMP-EXP.
records.catalog_tagline: Run pulse and engagement surveys, then turn responses into driver scores and action.
records.catalog_description:
Engagement Surveys lets you design and launch pulse and engagement campaigns, collect responses, and compute the driver scores that explain how employees feel and why. Aggregate sentiment across teams and time, spot where engagement is slipping, and route the signal to the people who can act.

Close the loop by tracking action plans and feeding engagement trends into broader people analytics, so survey results drive change instead of sitting in a slide deck.

records.description: Attrition-risk, flight-risk, succession-readiness, hire-success ML models. Masters attrition_forecasts and predictive_models; emits scored populations to TALENT-MGMT, HCM, and SWP.
records.catalog_tagline: Score flight risk and future outcomes with predictive people models.
records.catalog_description:
Predictive Models brings machine learning to your people data: attrition and flight-risk scoring, succession readiness, and hire-success prediction. Train models on historical patterns, validate them, deploy the ones that earn trust, and retire the ones that drift.

Publish scored populations and attrition forecasts to the teams that act on them, so retention, succession, and planning decisions start from a forward-looking signal rather than a rear-view report.

records.description: Representation analytics, pay-equity analysis, DEI dashboards, skill-gap signaling. No native master entities (computes over HCM, COMP-MGMT, and PA-WORKFORCE-METRICS data).
records.catalog_tagline: Measure representation and pay equity, and close diversity gaps with evidence.
records.catalog_description:
DEI Analytics measures representation across the workforce and analyzes pay equity by comparing compensation across comparable groups. Surface diversity gaps, detect pay-equity issues before they escalate, and give leaders the dashboards they need to set and track inclusion goals.

It computes over your workforce, compensation, and metric data to support regulatory reporting and diversity strategy, turning fairness from an aspiration into something you can measure and improve.

records.description: Personalized total-rewards statement assembly, delivery, and acknowledgment. Masters compensation_statements; consumes merit_cycle outputs and equity_grant events to compose worker-visible statements.
records.catalog_tagline: Generate total-rewards statements and deliver them to every employee.
records.catalog_description: Pull base pay, bonus, equity, and benefits into a single total-rewards statement, generate it for each employee, and deliver it for them to review and acknowledge. Show people the full value of what they earn, not just their paycheck, in a clear and personal format. Give your team a repeatable way to communicate rewards and capture that employees have seen them.

records.description: Engagement scoping, project structure, tasks, milestones, deliverables, SLAs. The master of service_projects and project_tasks; consumes opportunities, contracts, and external work projects to ground the engagement.
records.catalog_tagline: Scope, structure, and deliver client engagements on time.
records.catalog_description: Stand up a new engagement from an approved opportunity or signed contract, break it into tasks and milestones, and drive it to completion. Track scope, schedule, and delivery status in one place, see when a project needs staffing, and close out the work cleanly when it is done. Keep delivery teams aligned on what is committed and what is at risk so nothing falls through the cracks.

records.description: Resource pool, skills, demand-supply matching, project assignments and resource allocations, utilization forecasting. Masters project_assignments, resource_skill_inventories, project_resource_allocations.
records.catalog_tagline: Match the right people to the right work, and keep them utilized.
records.catalog_description: See who is available, what they are skilled in, and where demand is going, then commit and confirm assignments against it. Plan resource allocations ahead of need, fill staffing requests as projects ramp, and release people back to the bench when work wraps. Forecast utilization, surface skill gaps early, and keep your billable workforce productive without overbooking or idle time.

records.description: Timesheet capture, expense reporting, approval workflows for project work. Consumes time_entries and expense_reports owned by WFM and EXPENSE respectively; produces approved data for billing and cost posting.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture time and expenses against projects and get them approved fast.
records.catalog_description: Let consultants log billable and non-billable time and submit expenses against the projects and tasks they are working, then route everything through the right approvals. Clean, approved time and cost flow straight into billing and project accounting, so invoices are accurate and margin is real. Cut the chase at period close and give delivery and finance trustworthy actuals.

records.description: Project budgets, billing-rate cards, invoice generation against milestones and time, revenue recognition tied to performance obligations. Masters project_billing_milestones; contributes to revenue_recognition_records ahead of the ERP GL post.
records.catalog_tagline: Bill accurately and recognize project revenue with confidence.
records.catalog_description: Manage project budgets and rate cards, generate invoices against reached milestones and approved time, and recognize revenue using percentage-of-completion or milestone methods. Track billing status from planned to paid, flag slipped or written-off milestones, and keep recognized revenue tied to delivered work. Hand finance a clean, auditable bridge from project delivery to the general ledger.

records.description: Core pay-cycle execution: opens runs, ingests inputs (time, comp, benefits, expenses), performs gross-to-net calculation, books payroll journal entries, and triggers disbursement. Masters pay_runs and payroll_journal_entries.
records.catalog_tagline: Take each pay cycle from open to disbursed, with gross-to-net calculated for every employee.
records.catalog_description: Open a pay run, gather the earnings and deductions that apply, and calculate gross-to-net pay for everyone in the cycle. Route the run for approval, disburse net pay, and post the results so the next cycle starts clean. Track every run through its lifecycle and keep the full calculation trail for audit.

records.description: Tax authority configuration, periodic statutory filings, year-end forms, and multi-jurisdiction tax rate management. Masters tax_authorities and tax_filings; consumes pay_runs for filing inputs.
records.catalog_tagline: Calculate, file, and track every statutory payroll tax return to acceptance.
records.catalog_description: Determine which taxing authorities apply to each pay run, calculate the taxes owed, and prepare the statutory filings each jurisdiction requires. Submit returns, track acceptance or rejection, and manage amendments and corrections, with a clean record of what was filed and when.

records.description: Catalog of earning codes, deduction codes, and court/agency garnishment orders that drive payroll calculation. Masters earning_codes, deduction_codes, garnishment_orders.
records.catalog_tagline: Define the earning and deduction codes that shape every paycheck, and process garnishments correctly.
records.catalog_description: Maintain the catalog of earning and deduction codes that drive how pay is calculated: pre-tax and post-tax deductions, recurring and one-time earnings, and the rules behind each. Take in court-ordered wage garnishments, apply them to the right runs within legal limits, and track each order from receipt to release.

records.description: Generation, publishing, and employee self-service of pay slips, W2/1099/equivalent year-end statements. Masters pay_slips; reads from pay_runs.
records.catalog_tagline: Publish accurate pay statements and give every employee on-demand access to their pay history.
records.catalog_description: Generate a clear pay statement for every employee each cycle, showing earnings, deductions, taxes, and net pay. Publish statements on schedule, handle amendments and reissues when corrections happen, and keep an accessible archive so employees can retrieve their pay history whenever they need it.

records.description: Headcount and position demand modeling. Masters headcount_plans, position_demand_forecasts, and skills_gap_analyses. Publishes the canonical hiring-demand signal that ATS, HCM, and LMS subscribe to. Contributor on the requisition slice of job_requisitions (the authorization-to-hire layer that ATS then executes).
records.catalog_tagline: Forecast the headcount and skills you will need, role by role, and authorize hiring against the plan.
records.catalog_description:
Demand Forecast turns business targets into a concrete picture of future hiring need. Build headcount plans by org unit and period, forecast position demand role by role, and run a skills-gap analysis that compares the capabilities you will need to the ones you have.

When a plan is approved it becomes the authorization to hire: the canonical hiring-demand signal that recruiting, HR, and learning teams subscribe to. This is where workforce planning meets execution, the layer that tells the rest of the organization who to hire and what skills to build.

records.description: Talent supply, internal-mobility forecasts, retirement curves, and gap reconciliation. Consumes employees, hcm_positions, org_units, job_profiles, attrition_forecasts, and skills_gap_analyses to build the supply side of the workforce plan. No unique master entities today; supply artifacts are derived from consumed sources and feed back into demand-vs-supply reconciliation inside the planning cycle.
records.catalog_tagline: Model the workforce you already have and where attrition, mobility, and pipeline will leave you.
records.catalog_description:
Supply Planning models the workforce you have today and how it will change. Project supply forward by factoring in attrition forecasts, internal mobility, and the talent pipeline, then reconcile that supply against the demand the plan calls for.

See where shortfalls and surpluses will appear by role, location, and skill, and feed the reconciled view back into planning so demand and supply stay in step. This is the half of workforce planning that keeps the plan honest about the people you can actually count on.

records.description: What-if workforce scenarios, org-design alternatives, labor-market intelligence, and M&A or transformation models. Masters workforce_plans, workforce_scenarios, org_designs, and labor_market_benchmarks. Adopted scenarios cascade into HCM org changes, EPM financial-plan assumptions, and downstream cost projections.
records.catalog_tagline: Compare growth, reduction, and restructure scenarios, design the org, and overlay labor-market data.
records.catalog_description:
Scenario Modeling is the what-if workbench of workforce planning. Build and compare scenarios for growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, and cost optimization, and see how each one reshapes headcount, skills, and cost before you commit.

Design the future org structure, publish the approved design into position changes, and overlay external labor-market benchmarks so assumptions about pay, availability, and skills reflect the real market. This is where leadership tests the hard choices and lands on the plan worth executing.

records.description: Workforce cost projections, cost-of-plan, and the EPM handoff. Masters workforce_cost_projections (the boundary-object SWP authors and EPM consumes into the consolidated budget). Contributor on financial_plans for the labor-cost slice. Consumes salary_bands, merit_cycles, cost_centers, employees, and hcm_positions to size the loaded-comp envelope.
records.catalog_tagline: Project the fully loaded cost of every workforce plan and hand it to finance for the budget.
records.catalog_description:
Cost Projections puts a number on the plan. Project the fully loaded compensation expense of any workforce plan or scenario by period, org, geography, and level, so the cost of growth, reduction, or restructure is clear before the decision is made.

Approved cost projections roll straight into enterprise budgeting, keeping the people-cost line connected to the workforce plan instead of drifting in a separate spreadsheet. This is the module that lets finance and workforce planning speak the same language.

records.description: Foundational location registry for an IWMS deployment. Canonically masters `locations` (sites, offices, branches, buildings, floors). Embedded-masters lease and property metadata where the IWMS holds the integrated record. Read by every other IWMS module as the spatial anchor.
records.catalog_tagline: One trusted registry of every site, building, and floor.
records.catalog_description: Establish the spatial backbone the rest of the workplace runs on. Maintain the canonical record of sites, offices, buildings, and floors, attach lease and property metadata where the workplace team holds the integrated record, and let every reservation, service, and analytics flow read the same location anchor. The value is consistent space data across the portfolio so no two systems disagree about what exists or where it sits.

records.description: Hot-desking, hoteling, and desk-booking flows for hybrid-work programs. Masters `desk_bookings` and `workplace_experience_feedback`. The canonical entry-point module for return-to-office buyers.
records.catalog_tagline: Self-service desk booking that makes return-to-office actually work.
records.catalog_description: Give employees a frictionless way to reserve a desk for the days they come in and give workplace teams the demand signal they need. Handle hoteling and hot-desking with date, time, and work-mode selection, drive check-in and no-show recapture so reserved space is real space, and capture workplace experience feedback to keep improving the office. The result is higher confidence that a seat will be there and cleaner data on how the workplace is actually used.

records.description: Conference room booking with calendar integration, room equipment (AV) tracking, no-show recapture, and check-in flows. Masters `room_reservations`. Often deployed alongside desk-reservation but has a distinct booking model (durations, attendees, recurring).
records.catalog_tagline: Meeting rooms that are booked, checked into, and never sit empty.
records.catalog_description: Make conference and collaboration space easy to find and hard to waste. Reserve rooms with calendar integration, attendee and capacity matching, and the equipment a meeting needs, then enforce check-in and reclaim no-shows so booked rooms get used. The payoff is fewer ghost reservations, less hunting for an open room, and reliable data on which spaces earn their footprint.

records.description: Facility ticket flow: light-bulb out, temperature complaint, broken chair, spill cleanup. Masters `workplace_service_requests`. Distinct from ITSM (workplace-scoped, often dispatched to in-house facilities staff or building management) and from EAM/FSM (no equipment-asset orientation).
