records.catalog_tagline: A workplace ticket flow built for facilities, not IT.
records.catalog_description: Turn every burned-out bulb, broken chair, temperature complaint, and spill into a tracked request that reaches the right hands. Capture the issue, triage and route it to in-house facilities staff or building management, and drive it to resolution with a clear audit trail. The value is a responsive workplace where employees know problems get fixed and facilities leaders can see where time and money are going.

records.description: Occupancy measurement, space-utilization reporting, stack diagrams, and scenario modeling for portfolio rationalization. Masters `space_utilization_reports`. Reads desk_bookings + room_reservations + sensor data; publishes utilization signals to REAL-EST and ESG.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn occupancy signals into the case for right-sizing real estate.
records.catalog_description: Convert badge swipes, bookings, and sensor data into a clear picture of how space is really used. Measure occupancy, surface peak patterns and underutilized zones, model scenarios with stack diagrams, and publish utilization signals to real-estate and sustainability teams. The payoff is an evidence-based footprint decision: keep, consolidate, or redesign space on data rather than anecdote.

records.description: The inventory backbone. Masters enterprise_applications, application_interfaces, technology_platforms and business_capability_maps. The first thing a buyer installs: the structured catalog of what's in the application landscape.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep one reliable inventory of your applications, interfaces, and platforms, with the capabilities they support.
records.catalog_description:
Capture every application, the interfaces that connect it, and the technology platforms it runs on, then link each one to the business capabilities it supports. Record owners, lifecycle stage, and technical detail so anyone can answer what you run and why.

Drive each application and platform through a clear lifecycle, from planned and emerging to operating, sunsetting, and retired, with the right approvals at each gate. The result is a single source of truth your teams can plan, govern, and report against.

records.description: The analyst seat. Masters application_costs, application_value_scores and technology_fit_assessments. Once the registry is populated, this module scores it (TIME), bridges to FINOPS for cost, and drives invest/migrate/eliminate decisions.
records.catalog_tagline: Score your applications on cost, value, and technical fit so you know what to invest in, migrate, or eliminate.
records.catalog_description:
Turn your application inventory into decisions. Assess each application on what it costs, the business value it delivers, and how well it fits your technology direction, then rank the whole portfolio on a consistent scale.

Use the scores to find redundant, low-value, or aging applications, justify migrations and retirements, and bring a clear, evidence-based recommendation to every portfolio review. Cost and value signals stay current so your invest, migrate, and eliminate calls hold up to scrutiny.

records.description: Authoring of strategic objectives, strategy maps, and the cascading hierarchy from corporate strategy down to team-level OKRs.
records.catalog_tagline: Author your strategy once and cascade it everywhere.
records.catalog_description: Capture strategic objectives, build strategy maps across financial, customer, process, and learning perspectives, and cascade the hierarchy from corporate strategy down to team OKRs. Everyone sees how their goals ladder up, so the plan stays aligned as priorities shift.

records.description: Strategic initiative registers, progress capture, traceability between execution work and strategic intent, and investment-alignment views.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every initiative tied to the strategy it serves.
records.catalog_description: Maintain a register of strategic initiatives, capture progress as work moves, and trace execution back to the objectives it advances. Investment-alignment views show where effort and spend are landing, so leaders can spot stalled programs and reallocate early.

records.description: Operating-cadence orchestration (QBR / MBR / weekly business reviews), agenda templates, structured commentary capture, action-item and decision tracking.
records.catalog_tagline: Run reviews that drive decisions, not just status updates.
records.catalog_description: Orchestrate the operating cadence of quarterly, monthly, and weekly business reviews with agenda templates and structured commentary. Capture action items and decisions in one place, and lock each review as the durable record of what was agreed.

records.description: The authoritative configuration item record, its class definitions, and the relationships between CIs. Houses discovery ingestion, reconciliation, stewardship, and the canonical CI lifecycle.
records.catalog_tagline: Maintain the authoritative inventory of every configuration item and the relationships that connect them.
records.catalog_description:
Register, classify, and govern every configuration item in one place, from servers and databases to applications and the dependencies that link them. Bring in records from across the environment, organize them under a class model you control, and move each item through its lifecycle from first sighting to retirement.

With ownership and access controls on the records that matter, the inventory stays trustworthy: people see what depends on what, changes are reasoned about against real relationships, and the rest of your IT operation works from a single source of truth.

records.description: Business-service-to-CI topology projection. Maps applications and business services onto the underlying CI graph so ITSM impact analysis and AIOPS correlation have a runtime-accurate model.
records.catalog_tagline: Map infrastructure and applications up into the business services they support.
records.catalog_description:
Turn a flat list of components into a living map of the services your business actually runs on. Connect applications, hosts, and dependencies into service views, publish them for the teams that rely on them, and keep them current as the underlying estate shifts.

When an incident hits or a change is planned, you can see the affected service end to end and who it touches, so impact is understood before work begins instead of discovered afterward.

records.description: Captures pre-change CI baseline snapshots and continuously compares live state against them, raising drift events for change-management investigation.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture configuration baselines and catch unauthorized drift before it becomes an incident.
records.catalog_description:
Take point-in-time snapshots of how your configuration items are set up, then compare live state against those approved baselines on an ongoing basis. When something changes outside the approved path, you see the deviation early and can act on it.

Validated baselines give change and compliance teams a defensible record of what good looks like, so drift is surfaced, reviewed, and resolved rather than left to surface as an outage or an audit finding.

records.description: Customer-facing case capture, triage, routing, resolution, and CSAT close-out. Masters customer_cases and csat_responses. The execution backbone of the CSM category.
records.catalog_tagline: One queue for every customer case, from omnichannel capture through triage to resolution and CSAT.
records.catalog_description:
Case Management is the working surface for your support team. Capture cases from any channel into a single queue, classify and route them with AI-assisted triage, and give agents the customer and interaction history they need to resolve on first contact.

Drive cases through a clear lifecycle to resolved and closed, with workflow gates that protect each step. Capture satisfaction on close-out so you can see how every interaction landed and feed health signals to the teams that own the account.

records.description: Service entitlements, support tiers, SLA tracking, and contractual support hours. Masters customer_entitlements. Consumes subscription and contract context to bind eligibility and SLA targets.
records.catalog_tagline: Bind support to what the customer has paid for, with service tiers and SLA clocks that reflect real commitments.
records.catalog_description:
Entitlements and SLA Management defines what support each customer can use: service tier, included channels, support hours, named contacts, and response and resolution targets. Activate entitlements directly from the customer's subscription and contract so eligibility is always current.

Tie SLA clocks to those commitments so agents and supervisors see what is owed on every case, catch breaches before they happen, and prove that contractual service levels were met.

records.description: Customer-facing knowledge base presentation and authoring. Contributes audience-filtered edits to the cross-cutting knowledge_articles entity mastered by ITSM-KNOWLEDGE; consumes case data so article authoring is informed by support patterns.
records.catalog_tagline: A customer-facing knowledge surface that speeds resolution and turns proven fixes into self-service.
records.catalog_description:
Customer Knowledge Surface puts the right answers in front of agents as they work a case and lets them publish audience-filtered articles for customers to find on their own. Authoring is informed by real support patterns, so the knowledge base grows around the questions customers actually ask.

The result is faster resolution, fewer repeat cases, and a self-service experience that deflects routine inquiries before they ever become a case.

records.description: The core conversational surface of a workstream collaboration platform: persistent channels, messages, threads, channel membership, file attachments, and presence. Hosts the search/retention and chat-to-work-escalation features that live at the channel/message layer.
records.catalog_tagline: Channels, threads, and messages that keep every conversation organized and searchable.
records.catalog_description: Create channels for teams, projects, and topics so the right people see the right discussion. Reply in threads to keep side conversations tidy, post messages with rich formatting and attachments, and search back through everything when you need an answer. Archive channels that have run their course and keep the history that goes with them.

records.description: Voice and video huddles anchored to channels or DMs; ad-hoc and scheduled forms.
records.catalog_tagline: Jump into a voice or video huddle straight from any conversation.
records.catalog_description: Turn a back-and-forth into a quick call without scheduling a meeting. Start a voice or video huddle from any channel or direct message, pull in the people already in the conversation, and pick up recordings and transcripts afterward so anyone who missed it can catch up. It is the fastest way to settle something that chat alone cannot.

records.description: External guest invitations, scoped access into channels for partners and vendors, and access-revocation workflow on guest offboarding.
records.catalog_tagline: Work with partners and guests in shared channels without losing control of access.
records.catalog_description: Invite people from outside your organization into the specific channels where they need to collaborate, and nowhere else. Set the scope of what each guest can see, watch invitations move from sent to accepted, and revoke access the moment a project ends or someone moves on. Collaborate across company lines with the confidence that access stays exactly where you put it.

records.description: CSA membership lifecycle, weekly share-pack composition, member self-service portal, dietary swaps and pauses, full-season pre-pay and installment billing.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your CSA from signup to the last share of the season without the spreadsheet juggling.
records.catalog_description: Enroll members, take full-season or installment payments, and let subscribers manage their own swaps, pauses, and dietary preferences from a self-service portal. Compose each week's share, track who gets what, and keep billing and pickup choices in sync so packing day runs clean and members stay enrolled season after season.

records.description: Public-facing farm e-commerce storefront, on-farm farmstand POS and inventory, pickup-location management, delivery-window catalog.
records.catalog_tagline: Open a branded farm store online and on the farm, with pickup and delivery windows built in.
records.catalog_description: Stand up an e-commerce storefront with member-only pricing tiers and gift cards, sell at the farmstand, and let customers choose pickup locations or delivery windows at checkout. Keep on-farm inventory and online catalog aligned so you never oversell, and turn every visitor into a repeat buyer without paying for a generic shopping cart that does not understand how a farm sells.

records.description: Route optimization, driver manifests, ETA notifications, multi-stop sequencing for direct-to-consumer delivery.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan tight delivery days that get every order to the door on time.
records.catalog_description: Build optimized multi-stop routes for direct-to-consumer delivery, hand drivers a clear manifest, and send customers ETA notifications so they are home for the drop. Sequence stops to save fuel and hours, see which CSA shares, wholesale orders, and butcher pickups ride along on each route, and turn delivery from a daily scramble into a repeatable plan.

records.description: Stall-side POS for farmers market days, sale capture across markets, end-of-market reconciliation, multi-market reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Ring up market-day sales fast and reconcile the till before you pack the truck.
records.catalog_description: Take card, cash, and EBT-SNAP at the stall, capture SKU-level sales across every market you work, and reconcile the day's tender mix on the spot. Roll multi-market performance into one view so you know which markets, products, and days actually pay, and close out each market day without a shoebox of receipts.

records.description: Wholesale catalog, B2B order capture (chefs, restaurants, food hubs), multi-farm aggregation, producer payout splits.
records.catalog_tagline: Sell to chefs, restaurants, and food hubs with a wholesale catalog and clean order-to-invoice flow.
records.catalog_description: Publish a wholesale catalog with buyer-specific pricing tiers, capture B2B orders, and move them from submitted to confirmed, fulfilled, and net-30 invoiced. Aggregate product across multiple farms and split producer payouts so a food hub can run on the same platform, giving the smallholder operator a wholesale channel that bills as cleanly as the storefront does.

records.description: Cut-sheet templates, whole/half/quarter animal pre-orders, deposit and balance billing, processor coordination.
records.catalog_tagline: Take whole, half, and quarter-animal pre-orders with deposits, cut sheets, and processor dates handled.
records.catalog_description: Reserve animal shares, collect deposits and balances, and capture each customer's cut-sheet preferences before the animal goes to the processor. Coordinate the processing date and pickup, track every order from reserved through ready to delivered, and run whole-animal pre-sales without losing a deposit or a cut sheet in your inbox.

records.description: Yield forecasting per crop and field, projected share availability, member-facing harvest previews.
records.catalog_tagline: Forecast what the field will yield so you can sell shares and SKUs you can actually deliver.
records.catalog_description: Project harvest by crop and field, translate yield into available shares and SKU planning, and publish member-facing previews of what is coming. Drive reserve lists and dynamic pricing from the forecast, revise as conditions change, and stop overselling or underplanting by matching demand across every channel to what the ground will produce.

records.description: Template-driven contract drafting with the approved clause library. Masters contract_templates and contract_clauses; produces draft legal_contracts that flow into CLM-NEGOTIATION. Realizes CLM-CONTRACT-AUTHORING and CLM-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-MGMT.
records.catalog_tagline: Assemble new contracts fast from a library of approved clauses and templates.
records.catalog_description:
Build new agreements from pre-approved language instead of starting from a blank page. Pull clauses and templates from a maintained library, assemble a draft, and route it through legal and business review with a clear approval trail.

Versioning and approval states keep the clause and template library trustworthy, so every new contract starts from terms the organization has already agreed it can stand behind.

records.description: Track-changes negotiation with counterparty exchange, version comparison, and clause-risk detection. Consumes legal_contracts and contract_clauses; gates the in_negotiation -> approved lifecycle transition. Requires sign_document for signature workflow; coverage drops below 100% on the sign_document leg.
records.catalog_tagline: Redline counterparty terms and reach agreement without losing track of changes.
records.catalog_description:
Work through counterparty markups in a structured negotiation, comparing proposed language against approved positions and capturing each round of changes. Surface the terms that need legal attention and route them for sign-off.

When both sides agree, the negotiated contract moves cleanly into approval and execution, with a record of how the final language was reached.

records.description: Executed-contract index. Masters legal_contracts (post-signature) and signature_records. Contributes terms to saas_subscriptions and software_licenses (the buyer-side records that consume contract terms). The system of record for the active, expired, renewed, and terminated lifecycle states.
records.catalog_tagline: Store every executed contract in one searchable, always-current system of record.
records.catalog_description:
Keep every signed agreement in a single repository with the counterparty, contract type, key dates, value, and governing terms captured as structured data. Find any contract in seconds and see its full history, including amendments and renewals.

The repository is the authoritative record of what the organization has signed, ready to answer questions for finance, legal, audit, and the teams that depend on each agreement.

records.description: Register, tracking, and alerting for contract obligations (deliverables, SLA milestones, payment terms). Masters contract_obligations. Publishes obligation.due and obligation.breached events that fan out to OP-RES / GRC.
records.catalog_tagline: Track every commitment a contract creates and act before a deadline slips.
records.catalog_description:
Turn the promises buried in a signed contract into tracked obligations with owners, due dates, and status. Watch performance, payment, delivery, reporting, and compliance commitments move from open to satisfied, and catch the ones at risk of breach.

Clear ownership and visible due dates mean obligations are met on time, and the moment one is breached or waived, the right people know.

records.description: Date-based renewal alerting, auto-renewal-clause detection, and renewal execution. Consumes legal_contracts; publishes renewal.30_day_warning and legal_contract.renewed. Distinct from amendments which run through CLM-REPOSITORY.
records.catalog_tagline: Get ahead of every expiry and renewal so no contract lapses by accident.
records.catalog_description:
Know which contracts are coming up for renewal well before they expire, and decide deliberately whether to renew, renegotiate, or let them end. Renewal countdowns and early warnings turn a reactive scramble into a planned workflow.

Capture each renewal against the original agreement so the repository always reflects the live commitment, and value is never lost to a missed deadline.

records.description: Captures customer feedback and feature ideas, triages them, and prioritizes the backlog that feeds the roadmap. Covers feedback aggregation, opportunity and idea management, and feature prioritization (RICE, value-vs-effort, weighted scoring).
records.catalog_tagline: Collect feedback and feature requests, then triage them into a clear, prioritized backlog.
records.catalog_description: Bring every customer signal into one place, from raw feedback to explicit feature requests. Classify and link incoming input, weigh demand against effort, and triage requests through to an accept-or-reject decision. Accepted work flows straight into roadmap planning, so nothing gets lost between listening and building.

records.description: Manages the product roadmap, plans and ships releases, runs beta programs, and tracks product metrics against strategy and OKRs. Bridges prioritized opportunities to delivered features and measured outcomes.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan releases, publish your roadmap, and run beta programs from one delivery workspace.
records.catalog_description: Shape accepted features into a release plan and a roadmap your teams and customers can rely on. Manage product lines across their lifecycle, coordinate releases through ship and rollback, and validate with beta cohorts before general availability. Watch adoption and product metrics so you know which bets paid off.

records.description: Central matter lifecycle: intake-to-active-to-closed-to-archived, parties (clients, opposing, co-counsel, courts), key-date and statute-of-limitations alerting, matter status reporting, and matter-scoped document storage. The hub every other legal-practice module attaches to.
records.catalog_tagline: Open, run, and close every matter with the parties, key dates, and documents that belong to it in one organized file.
records.catalog_description:
Move each matter cleanly from intake to active to closed and archived, with the status of every case visible at a glance. Keep the clients, opposing parties, co-counsel, and courts attached to each matter so everyone knows who is involved.

Track the deadlines and statute-of-limitations dates that carry the most risk, store the documents tied to each case alongside the work, and give every other part of the practice a single matter record to build on.

records.description: Intake forms, conflict-of-interest graph search across existing matters and adversaries, conflict-waiver and ethics-wall tracking, engagement-letter drafting from templates, retainer-payment collection, and intake-to-matter conversion.
records.catalog_tagline: Clear conflicts, sign the engagement letter, and collect the retainer before a new client ever becomes a matter.
records.catalog_description:
Capture new-client details through intake forms, then run a conflict-of-interest search across your existing matters and adversaries so you can decline, clear, or waive before you commit. Record conflict waivers and ethics-wall arrangements as part of the file.

Draft engagement letters from templates, send them for signature, and collect the opening retainer, then convert a cleared intake into a live matter without rekeying anything.

records.description: Timekeeper time-entry capture against ABA UTBMS task and expense codes, hourly versus flat-fee versus contingency versus alternative-fee-arrangement billing, prebill review and partner approval, e-bill submission in LEDES 1998B and 2000 formats, and AR aging on client invoices.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture every billable minute, review prebills, and send client-ready invoices in the formats your clients demand.
records.catalog_description:
Record time against standardized legal task and expense codes whether you bill by the hour, a flat fee, contingency, or an alternative fee arrangement. Roll entries into prebills your partners can review and adjust before anything reaches the client.

Issue invoices, submit them in the electronic-billing formats large clients require, and follow outstanding balances through accounts-receivable aging so the firm gets paid on time.

records.description: Separated IOLTA trust-account ledger per client and matter, three-way reconciliation (bank versus ledger versus client-balance), state-specific retention rules, retainer-to-trust deposit and trust-to-operating transfer on earned fees, and state-bar reporting on exceptions.
records.catalog_tagline: Hold client money safely in separated trust ledgers with three-way reconciliation and the exception reporting your bar expects.
records.catalog_description:
Keep every client and matter balance in a dedicated trust ledger that stays separate from operating funds, and reconcile bank, ledger, and client balances three ways so the books always agree.

Deposit retainers into trust, transfer earned fees out to the operating account only when they are actually earned, apply the retention rules your state imposes, and surface reconciliation exceptions for review before they become a compliance problem.

records.description: Court filing capture and submission, jurisdiction-specific deadline rule application, statute-of-limitations and key-date alerting, service-of-process tracking, and electronic court filing (ECF) integration.
records.catalog_tagline: Calendar court deadlines from jurisdiction rules so filing dates and statutes of limitations are never left to memory.
records.catalog_description:
Capture and submit court filings, then let jurisdiction-specific rules calculate the deadlines that follow so the calendar fills itself instead of relying on someone remembering. Track statute-of-limitations and other key dates with alerts well ahead of time.

Follow service of process and connect to electronic court filing so submissions and confirmations flow into the matter file without manual re-entry.

records.description: Multi-tenant service-ticket queue across customer estates, with per-customer SLA timers that pause and resume on hold, a customer portal for self-service ticket submission, and CSAT capture on resolution.
records.catalog_tagline: Take in, triage, and resolve customer tickets against the SLAs you committed to.
records.catalog_description: Capture issues from any channel, route them to the right technician, and work them through to resolution while the SLA clock tracks response and fix targets and pauses when a ticket is on hold. Every ticket ties back to the customer it belongs to and the time spent on it, so support effort stays visible and billable.

records.domain_module_name: MSP Client Roster and Service Contracts
records.description: MSP client roster and master service agreements with consumption tracking (block-hour decrement, value-tier pricing), renewal-window alerting, and contract-lifecycle gates for activation, suspension, and termination.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage customer accounts and the recurring service agreements that drive your revenue.
records.catalog_description: Keep a clean roster of the customers you manage and the contracts that define their service, from draft through activation, suspension, and renewal. Contracts set the pricing model, block-hour entitlements, and SLA terms that the rest of the service delivery and billing work reads from, and renewal timing surfaces well before agreements lapse.

records.domain_module_name: MSP Time Tracking and Customer Billing
records.description: Technician time-entry capture against tickets and contracts, time-approval routing, recurring billing per contract terms, and customer-side invoice issuance with AR-side aging from the MSP's perspective.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn logged technician time into approved, billed, and paid invoices.
records.catalog_description: Capture time against tickets and contracts, route it through approval, and roll approved effort plus contracted charges into invoices. Track each invoice from draft to issued, paid, overdue, or written off, so the work your team delivers is consistently and accurately billed.

records.description: Technician scheduling and dispatch board, skill-and-availability matching, on-site versus remote work routing, and load balancing across the technician roster.
records.catalog_tagline: Schedule and assign the right technician to the right job at the right time.
records.catalog_description: Coordinate technician workload across open tickets, matching skills and availability to the jobs that need attention and keeping scheduled work and on-site visits organized. Dispatch decisions feed straight into ticket handling and time capture so assignment, execution, and billing stay connected.

records.description: Core merchandising master: products, attributes, variants, categories, translations, supplier onboarding, compliance attributes, and the review-and-approve workflow before publish. The deploy entry-point for any PIM rollout.
records.catalog_tagline: Author, enrich, and approve rich product content in one workspace.
records.catalog_description: Build complete, accurate product records and keep them that way. Define the attributes and validation rules each product type needs, organize items into the taxonomies your channels expect, and manage size, color, and pack variants under a single parent. Take every product through a structured enrichment workflow, from draft through enrichment, review, and approval, so only complete, on-brand content moves forward. Manage translations for every market in step with the source content, so a product launches in all of its languages at once instead of trickling out market by market.

records.description: Image, video, 3D model, and document assets tied to products: ingestion, rights metadata, renditions, CDN distribution, and asset-to-product linking. Lives inside PIM in v1; can be split into its own DAM domain when warranted.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage the images, video, and rich media that bring products to life.
records.catalog_description: Keep every image, video, 3D model, and document tied to the products they depict, with rights and usage metadata so you always know what you can publish where. Upload, review, and approve assets through a clear workflow, generate the renditions each channel needs, and deliver them from one managed source. No more hunting through shared folders for the latest hero shot or publishing an asset you do not have the rights to use.

records.description: Per-channel feed shaping and publish orchestration: marketplace seller feeds, search-engine merchant feeds, commerce-platform catalogs, retailer feeds, GDSN datapools. Validation against destination schemas; syndication-job state machine; rejected-listing remediation queue.
records.catalog_tagline: Publish approved products to every channel and fix rejections fast.
records.catalog_description: Define each destination once: marketplaces, storefronts, retailer feeds, and datapools, with the field mapping and rules each one requires. Push approved products and their assets out on demand or on a schedule, then watch each publish run from queued through running to succeeded, partial, or failed. When a channel rejects a listing, see the exact reason and remediate it in one queue, so products stay live and sellable across every place you do business instead of silently dropping off a feed.

records.description: Joiner/mover/ad-hoc access request workflow: request submission, SoD pre-check, approval routing, provisioning handoff.
records.catalog_tagline: Let people request the access they need and route it through the right approvals automatically.
records.catalog_description:
Access requests turn a manual, email-driven scramble into a guided workflow. People pick what they need from a clear catalog, the request is checked for segregation-of-duties conflicts before anyone approves it, and it routes to the right approvers based on the entitlement and the requester.

Approvals are tracked end to end, and an approved request hands off straight to provisioning so the access actually shows up without a separate ticket. The result is faster time-to-access, fewer help-desk tickets, and a complete record of who asked for what, who approved it, and why.

records.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc access recertification campaigns. Reviewers attest or revoke; revoke decisions drive provisioning; campaign closure produces GRC evidence.
records.catalog_tagline: Run access reviews on a schedule so reviewers confirm what people should keep and revoke the rest.
records.catalog_description:
Access certification puts business owners in the driver's seat for periodic reviews. Campaigns are scheduled, scoped to the right population, and routed to the reviewers who actually know whether each grant still makes sense.

Reviewers approve or revoke line by line, and revocation decisions feed straight into provisioning so removals happen instead of sitting in a spreadsheet. Every campaign produces clean, timestamped evidence that auditors can trust, which turns recurring compliance reviews from a quarterly fire drill into a routine that runs itself.

records.description: Toxic-combination ruleset, detection engine, triage workflow, mitigation tracking, accepted-risk register.
records.catalog_tagline: Catch toxic access combinations before they become audit findings.
records.catalog_description:
Segregation-of-duties management defines the access combinations that should never sit with one person and watches for them continuously. Rules are evaluated when access is requested and across the existing population, so conflicts surface at the moment of decision rather than at audit time.

Detected violations move through a clear remediation path: triage, mitigate, or formally accept the risk, with every step recorded. Owners get a defensible trail of how each conflict was handled, which keeps financial and regulatory controls intact without slowing the business down.

records.description: Catalog of access primitives (roles, groups, permission sets, birthright bundles). Lightweight lifecycle: draft -> published -> deprecated -> retired.
records.catalog_tagline: Maintain one authoritative catalog of what each entitlement means and who can request it.
records.catalog_description:
The entitlement catalog is the single source of truth for the access an organization can grant. Each entitlement is defined once, with a clear owner, description, and lifecycle from draft to published to retired, so requesters and reviewers always see accurate, business-friendly choices instead of cryptic system permissions.

Published definitions feed the request and review workflows and keep segregation-of-duties rules anchored to real, current entitlements. Curating access centrally means fewer orphaned permissions, cleaner reviews, and a catalog that stays trustworthy as systems change.

records.description: Connector framework + provisioning event log. Executes create/modify/suspend/delete actions in downstream systems on receipt of approved requests or JML events.
records.catalog_tagline: Push approved access changes out to connected systems automatically and prove they landed.
records.catalog_description:
Automated provisioning closes the loop between a governance decision and the systems that enforce it. When access is approved, certified, or revoked, connectors apply the change to the target systems without manual rework, and the result is captured as a tracked event.

Each provisioning run records whether it completed, failed, or rolled back, so there is always proof that the intended access state was actually achieved. That removes the gap between what was approved and what is real, cuts the standing risk of lingering access, and gives auditors hard evidence that decisions were carried out.

records.description: Cross-functional task and project execution surface: work items with owners, due dates, dependencies, statuses, and assignments; project containers with timelines, dashboards, and board views; user-authored automation rules that fire on item state changes. The deployable substrate every team-based work-management product orbits.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan projects, assign tasks, and track them from kickoff to done.
records.catalog_description:
Organize work into projects and sections, then assign tasks with owners, due dates, priorities, and dependencies. Track everything on boards, lists, and timelines, and keep work moving with approval steps, milestones, and automations that handle routine status changes and notifications.

Standardize recurring work with reusable project and task templates, tailor records with custom fields, and use workload views to spot who is over or under capacity before deadlines slip.

records.description: Team-execution OKR tracking surface: objectives with key results that link to work items for automatic progress rollup, weekly check-in cadences, scoring, and closure. Deploys alongside the task-execution module for full integration, or standalone with a thin embedded work-item shell for KR linking.
records.catalog_tagline: Set objectives, score key results, and see progress roll up from the work behind them.
records.catalog_description:
Define objectives and measurable key results for the quarter or year, assign owners, and keep them current with regular check-ins. Link objectives to the tasks and projects that drive them so progress updates as work gets done instead of being re-entered by hand.

Commit objectives once agreed, track them through the cycle, and score them at close so the team learns what worked.

records.description: Agent-facing workflow from lead capture through closing. Lead nurture (writes back into CRM contributor flow), listing creation and MLS syndication, tour scheduling and execution, transaction management (offer to escrow to contingencies to close), and buyer/seller disclosure handling. The deployable unit for solo agents and small firms; agents in larger brokerages work here while broker oversight runs in BROKERAGE-OPS.
records.catalog_tagline: Work every deal from lead to close in one place.
records.catalog_description: Capture leads and turn them into listings, syndicate to the MLS, and schedule showings with access windows and follow-ups. Drive each transaction from accepted offer through inspection, financing, and contingencies to a clean close, with buyer and seller disclosures tracked at every step. The deployable unit for solo agents and small firms.

records.description: Broker-level oversight on top of agent operations. Multi-agent commission-split engine with franchise overrides and per-agent caps, broker compliance review of transactions and disclosures, trust-account / escrow oversight, broker-level MLS conformance review. Only deployed when the brokerage has grown past informal-broker-supervision scale (typically 10+ agents).
records.catalog_tagline: Give the broker oversight of money and compliance.
records.catalog_description: Run multi-agent commission splits with franchise overrides and per-agent caps, review transactions and disclosures for compliance before close, and keep trust and escrow accounts reconciled. Add broker-level MLS conformance review so the brokerage scales past informal supervision without losing control of the deal.

records.domain_module_name: Real Estate Agent (solo / small firm bundle)
records.description: Solo-agent and small-firm persona bundle. Single-install deployable for individual real estate agents covering lead capture and contact relationships (CRM-LEAD-MGT, CRM-ACCT-MGT), listing creation and MLS syndication, tour scheduling, transaction execution, disclosure handling (RE-BROK-AGENT-OPS), and contract reference (CLM-REPOSITORY). One module to install; larger brokerages deploy the underlying full modules and skip the starter.
records.catalog_tagline: A working surface for the real-estate agent.
records.catalog_description: Bring contacts, listings, and the documents behind each deal into one agent-facing workspace. Move leads forward, keep listing and transaction paperwork organized, and stay on top of every active deal from a single view that travels with the agent across the systems they already use.

records.description: Entry-tier deployable for a basic hiring workflow: post jobs, capture applications, run interviews, generate offers. Embeds the canonical masters from the full ATS modules and inherits their lifecycle states. Ships three baseline permissions and one system skill; no workflow gates, no requisition approvals, no background-check orchestration, no pre-employee reconciliation. Upgrades to the full ATS surface without tenant data migration via the embedded-master demotion path.
records.catalog_tagline: Everything a small team needs to hire, in one lightweight package.
records.catalog_description: A starter bundle covering the core hiring path (postings, candidates, applications, interviews, and offers) without the breadth of the full module set. Stand up hiring quickly, then grow into the full modules as your volume increases; your data moves with you when you do.

records.description: Authoring and maintenance of bibliographic, authority, and holdings records for all library materials regardless of medium. Owns the catalog substrate every other library module reads from.
records.catalog_tagline: Describe every title once, find it everywhere.
records.catalog_description: Create and maintain bibliographic records, authority headings, and holdings so every title is described consistently and surfaces reliably in search. Catalog physical and electronic materials, control headings against external authority files, and keep item and holdings data accurate from receipt through withdrawal.

records.description: Daily circulation activity: check-out, check-in, renewals, holds, fines, and circulation policy administration. The most patron-facing operations module.
records.catalog_tagline: Check out, check in, and keep the queue moving.
records.catalog_description: Run the daily circulation desk. Loan and return items, renew loans, place holds and trap them when copies become available, and manage the pickup queue. Apply loan rules by patron and item type, accrue and collect fines, and handle lost and claimed-returned items without losing the thread.

records.description: Library member registration, profile maintenance, patron category administration, and card issuance.
records.catalog_tagline: Register, organize, and support every patron.
records.catalog_description: Manage the patron community from registration to renewal. Create patron accounts, sort them into categories that drive borrowing privileges, issue and renew cards, and suspend or archive accounts when needed. Keep contact and eligibility data current so circulation and discovery work the way each patron expects.

records.description: Ordering and receiving of physical materials, serials subscription management, and electronic resource license management.
records.catalog_tagline: Acquire print and digital materials and keep licenses current.
records.catalog_description: Order, receive, and pay for library materials in one acquisitions workflow. Place orders with vendors, track partial and full receipts, reconcile invoices, and manage budgets. Renew serial subscriptions on schedule and keep e-resource licenses active, renewed, or cleanly terminated so access never lapses unexpectedly.

records.description: Public-facing catalog search and browse interface, faceted search over bibliographic and holdings data, saved searches, and reading lists.
records.catalog_tagline: Let patrons find what the library holds, on their own.
records.catalog_description: Give patrons a public catalog and search experience over the library's collection. Expose titles, availability, and holdings for self-service discovery, let patrons save searches and place holds, and connect search results straight to circulation and request workflows.

records.description: Borrowing and lending workflows between libraries, request routing, and resource sharing partner management.
records.catalog_tagline: Borrow what you do not own, lend what others need.
records.catalog_description: Fill requests for materials the library does not hold and supply materials to partner libraries. Route, accept, ship, and track interlibrary loan requests end to end, manage resource-sharing partners, and keep borrowers informed from request through return.

records.description: Field-service operational core: work-order creation and lifecycle, technician assignment via dispatch records, field-visit execution, real-time route optimization, and truck-stock parts management. The module the dispatcher and field technicians both live in.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn inbound service requests into scheduled, dispatched, and completed work orders with the right technician on the job.
records.catalog_description: The dispatch operations module is the desk-and-truck heart of field service. It takes work orders from intake to close: scheduling the visit, assigning a technician, tracking the dispatch from en route to on site, and recording the field visit outcome. Dispatchers see capacity, skills, and travel at a glance so they commit only to jobs they can deliver, and technicians get a clear day plan. The payoff is fewer missed appointments, shorter drive time, and clean completion data that feeds billing and customer follow-up.

records.description: Asset register of customer-owned equipment the service organization installs and maintains, plus the recurring preventive-maintenance schedules that drive proactive service. Tracks equipment from install through decommission, with PM cadence per unit.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep a living record of every installed unit and its preventive-maintenance schedule across each customer site.
records.catalog_description: The installed base module is the system of record for equipment in the field. Each unit is tracked from install through active service, maintenance, and eventual decommission or replacement, tied to the customer site where it lives. Preventive-maintenance schedules drive proactive visits before something breaks, and overdue work surfaces automatically. Service teams gain a complete asset history that shortens diagnosis on the next call, protects warranty and contract coverage, and turns reactive break-fix into planned, recurring service revenue.

records.description: Recurring service agreements between the service organization and customers, covering specific installed equipment under defined SLA terms. Drives entitlement checks on work orders, renewal workflows, and revenue recognition on the recurring stream.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage service contracts and coverage so every visit is billed and every entitlement is honored.
records.catalog_description: The service contracts module governs the agreements that sit behind field work. Contracts move from draft to active to renewal or expiry, and each one defines what coverage a customer is entitled to and how visits get priced and billed. Tying contracts to the installed equipment they cover means dispatch knows whether a job is in-scope, and finance knows what to invoice. Teams reduce revenue leakage from uncovered work, renew on time instead of letting coverage lapse, and give customers a clear picture of what their agreement includes.

records.description: Configurable product definitions, product bundles, and pricing rules. The reference data CPQ quote-building reads from. Includes AI price-optimization and subscription-pricing variants.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every product, bundle, and pricing rule in one place so quotes are always built on correct, current data.
records.catalog_description: This is the reference layer your quotes are built from: configurable products, reusable bundles, and the pricing rules that decide what each customer pays. Define options and constraints once and every seller inherits them, so no one quotes an invalid configuration or an out-of-date price. Volume tiers, seat-based and duration-based pricing, and segment overrides all live here, ready to drive consistent, defensible numbers across the whole sales team.

records.description: Sales-quote authoring workflow: quote header, line items, discount application, guided-selling navigation, and quote-document generation. The seller-facing CPQ surface.
records.catalog_tagline: Assemble quotes line by line with guided selling, live pricing, and discounts that stay inside policy.
records.catalog_description: This is where sellers actually build the deal: add line items, follow guided-selling prompts to the right configuration, and watch totals update as they go. Discounts apply at the line or quote level and surface for approval the moment they cross a threshold, so reps move quickly without giving away margin. Finished quotes generate a clean, professional document ready to send, and accepted quotes flow straight downstream with no rekeying.

records.description: Discount-approval workflows and contract-draft handoff to CLM. Captures the multi-tier sign-off path that gates high-discount or non-standard quotes from advancing to execution.
records.catalog_tagline: Route discounts and non-standard terms through the right approvers, then hand a clean draft to contracting.
records.catalog_description: This module runs the sign-off path that protects your margins. When a quote carries a deep discount or off-standard terms, it moves through a tiered approval chain with a clear record of who approved what and when. Once it clears, an approved contract draft is generated and handed to your contract lifecycle process, so nothing advances to signature until the deal has passed review. The result is faster, auditable approvals and a clean handoff into execution.

records.description: Subscription record lifecycle (active, paused, canceled, churned), usage metering and rating, revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, entitlement management, and SaaS churn analytics. The recurring-revenue substrate.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage the subscription lifecycle and the usage that drives it.
records.catalog_description: Take subscriptions from trial to active, handle upgrades, downgrades, renewals, cancellations, and reactivations, and capture metered usage as it happens. Keeps subscription state and usage in one place so billing, revenue, and customer teams always work from the same source of truth.

records.description: Invoice generation, payment processing, tax calculation, and dunning workflows for failed-payment recovery. Sits downstream of the subscription lifecycle.
records.catalog_tagline: Issue recurring invoices and recover the payments that slip.
records.catalog_description: Generate, issue, and track invoices across the billing cycle, then catch and work past-due balances through structured dunning. Gives finance and collections teams a clear view of what was billed, what was paid, and what needs follow-up, with every invoice state change recorded for audit.

records.description: Authoritative register of hardware assets and their reference models. Tracks discovery feeds, lifecycle states, financial attributes (purchase, depreciation), and ownership.
records.catalog_tagline: One source of truth for every hardware asset and the models behind it.
records.catalog_description: Capture devices the moment they are discovered, assign them to people and locations, and follow each one through its full lifecycle. Hold a clean catalog of the models you standardize on, track purchase and depreciation for finance, and see at a glance what is deployed, in repair, or ready to retire.

records.description: Warranty registrations, end-of-life disposal records, and spare-parts inventory at warehouses and on technician trucks. Sits adjacent to the asset registry; feeds field-service operations.
records.catalog_tagline: Warranties, spare parts, and clean end-of-life, all in one place.
records.catalog_description: Register warranty coverage and get ahead of expirations before they cost you. Keep spare parts stocked across warehouses and field technicians so repairs do not stall, and run device disposal with sanitized media, certificates, and the evidence auditors and regulators expect.

records.description: Small-shop persona bundle for HVAC service businesses (5-30 technicians). Single-install deployable covering customer accounts and contacts (CRM), service dispatch and field execution (FSM-DISPATCH-OPS), installed equipment register and PM cadence (FSM-INSTALLED-BASE), recurring maintenance agreements (FSM-SERVICE-CONTRACTS), quote-to-invoice (CPQ + SUB-MGMT), and parts inventory (HAM). Larger organizations deploy the full modules and skip the starter.
records.catalog_tagline: A ready-to-run home-services starter that takes an HVAC job from customer call to scheduled visit and invoice.
records.catalog_description: This starter packages the field-service essentials a heating and cooling service business needs on day one. It bundles the customer and contact record, the installed equipment at each site, work orders and field visits, service contracts, and the quote-to-invoice path so a small team can book a call, schedule a technician, complete the job, and bill it without stitching tools together. It is a fast on-ramp to field service for trades operators who want the core workflow working immediately and can grow into the full modules later.

records.description: CSA-only subscription management for farms operating a single direct-to-member channel. Embedded shells for memberships, share packs, customers, and pickup locations support membership lifecycle, weekly share fulfillment, pickup-site coordination, and member billing. Upgrade by installing the matching full modules (FDS-CSA-MGMT, FDS-ONLINE-STORE, FDS-HARVEST-PLANNING, FDS-DELIVERY-OPS, FDS-WHOLESALE, FDS-MARKET-POS) as the operation expands into storefront, harvest forecasting, routed delivery, wholesale, or market-day channels.
records.catalog_tagline: Start a CSA in a day: memberships, weekly shares, pickups, and member billing in one lightweight kit.
records.catalog_description: Run a single direct-to-member CSA channel without standing up the full platform. Enroll members, compose and fulfill weekly shares, coordinate pickup sites, and bill subscribers, all from a compact starter. When the operation grows into a storefront, routed delivery, wholesale, market days, or harvest forecasting, install the matching full modules and keep your data.

records.description: Authors the skill ontology, the role-to-skill competency bundles, and the source-of-truth references that other modules consume.
records.catalog_tagline: Curate the shared skills ontology and the role-to-skill competency frameworks the rest of the business reads from.
records.catalog_description:
Own the language of skills. Define and organize skills, relationships, and proficiency scales in one curated ontology so every team is talking about the same thing.

Tie skills to roles. Build competency frameworks that say what each role needs, and publish versions cleanly so downstream profiles and gap analysis always assess against the current standard.

Govern change with confidence. Move taxonomies and competency models through draft, active, and deprecated states, and signal each change so profiles and inferences re-key against the new substrate.

records.description: Maintains per-worker skill profiles, runs the inference pipeline, captures assessments and validations, and produces gap and inventory analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep an accurate, up-to-date skill profile for every worker, blending inference, assessment, and endorsement.
records.catalog_description:
Maintain a living profile for each person. Combine inferred skills, self-ratings, formal assessments, and peer endorsements into one profile that reflects what someone can actually do.

Let evidence build the picture. Run inference against incoming signals, capture assessments and validations, and record endorsements so proficiency reflects real activity rather than a one-time survey.

Find and close the gaps. Compare profiles to role requirements, produce gap and inventory analytics, and hand clean signals to learning, mobility, and planning so development effort lands where it matters.

records.description: Operates the internal opportunity marketplace: posting, matching, and applying across gigs, projects, full-time internal moves, and mentorships.
records.catalog_tagline: Run an internal talent marketplace where employees discover and apply to gigs, projects, mentorships, and internal roles.
records.catalog_description:
Give your people one place to grow without leaving. Post internal opportunities of every shape, gigs, projects, stretch assignments, mentorships, and full-time moves, and let employees browse and apply.

Move applications through a clear flow. Track each expression of interest from submitted through review to accepted or rejected, with the right approvers gated into each step.

Connect people to mentors. Match mentors and mentees, set goals and a cadence, and follow each engagement through to completion so development happens in the open.

records.description: AI recommendations, fit scores, succession ranking, career-path projection, and skills-based hiring assist.
records.catalog_tagline: Surface AI fit scores, mobility recommendations, and career paths that guide every employee toward their next best move.
records.catalog_description:
Turn skills data into next steps. Compute fit scores between people and roles, generate mobility recommendations with clear rationale, and project career paths from where someone is to where they want to go.

Support skills-based hiring and succession. Rank candidates by fit for open roles and successor slots so managers make faster, fairer talent decisions grounded in evidence.

Keep recommendations fresh and explainable. Each match run records its inputs, model version, and outputs, so every score and suggestion can be traced and trusted.

records.description: Org-level skills heatmaps, gap and supply analytics for HR leaders.
records.catalog_tagline: Give HR leaders org-wide skills heatmaps and gap analytics to see where talent is strong and where it is thin.
records.catalog_description:
See your workforce's capabilities at a glance. Roll individual skills and inferences up into org-level heatmaps that show concentration, depth, and coverage across teams.

Find the gaps before they bite. Compare the skills you have against the skills you need and pinpoint where to hire, develop, or redeploy.

Feed strategic workforce planning. Hand clean supply-and-gap signals to planning so capability decisions line up with where the business is headed.

records.description: Scheduled course delivery: offerings and sessions, instructor assignments, attendance capture (OSHA evidence substrate), waitlist management, virtual-classroom integration, and per-session resources. Structurally distinct from evergreen e-learning in LMS-COURSE-DELIVERY because it carries its own cardinality (course -> many offerings -> many sessions), its own roles (instructors are not learners), and its own per-session compliance footprint.
records.catalog_tagline: Run instructor-led and virtual classroom training: schedule sessions, book rooms, and track attendance.
records.catalog_description: Plan classroom and virtual instructor-led training from one place. Schedule offerings and sessions, reserve rooms and resources, and manage rosters, waitlists, and cancellations. Record attendance and completion so classroom learning lands in the same record as everything else.

records.description: Catalog and lifecycle for certifications, micro-credential badges, and continuing-education credits. Masters learner_certifications (re-mastered from LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING) since professional development, FINRA CE, internal product certifications, and Open-Badges micro-credentials all live here, not just compliance training. Compliance training embeds learner_certifications for the regulated-training certification workflow.
records.catalog_tagline: Issue certifications and digital badges, then manage renewals and let others verify them.
records.catalog_description: Define certifications and badges, issue them when learners qualify, and track expiry and renewal across the workforce. Let learners share verifiable credentials and let third parties confirm them, so a qualification is easy to prove long after the course is done.

records.description: Learner data privacy substrate that compliance training depends on: GDPR Article 6/7 consent capture, Article 15 subject access requests, and Article 17 right-to-erasure processing for training data. Carved out from LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING because privacy obligations apply across the LMS even where statutory training is out of scope.
records.catalog_tagline: Handle learner data-subject requests, consent, and retention so training data stays privacy-compliant.
records.catalog_description: Give learners control over their training data. Capture and track consent, process data-subject access and deletion requests, and enforce retention policies that remove records when they should expire. Keep a defensible trail of how learner data is handled.

records.description: Horizontal automation surface across LMS deployment: dynamic audience segments, automated training assignment rules, reusable notification templates, learner notification log, manager-directed nudges for overdue training, and escalation policies. Cuts across LMS-COURSE-DELIVERY, LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING, LMS-PATHS, and LMS-CREDENTIALS.
records.catalog_tagline: Automate enrollments, reminders, and escalations so the right training reaches the right people on time.
records.catalog_description: Put routine learning administration on autopilot. Enroll people automatically based on role, team, or hire date, send reminders and nudges before deadlines, and escalate when training slips. Set the cadence once and let the rules keep learners on track.

records.description: Deployable starter kit for small and mid-market organizations that outsource training delivery to external vendors (EasyLlama, Traliant, Ethena, NAVEX, KnowBe4) and need to retain audit-ready evidence in their own catalog. Embeds compliance assignments, training evidence records, learner certifications, signature records, and per-regulation training records from the full LMS-COMPLIANCE-TRAINING and LMS-CREDENTIALS modules; deploys standalone without requiring the full LMS substrate. Buyer persona: HR Director or Compliance Officer at a 50 to 500 person organization. When the org later adopts the full LMS, embedded shells deterministically demote to consumer.
records.catalog_tagline: A lightweight way to assign training and keep completion records, ready to deploy on day one.
records.catalog_description: Start small without standing up the full learning suite. Assign training, record completions, and keep the essential evidence a small or first-time team needs. Upgrade to the full modules later without losing any of the records you have already captured.

records.description: Structured request-intake surface: form definitions, form submissions, routing rules. Pre-task surface that converts a submission into a work_item in the target TASK-EXEC project. Backs the WORK-INTAKE-FORMS capability with entities. Vendor reference: Asana Forms, Monday Forms, ClickUp Forms, Workfront Request Queues, Smartsheet Forms.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture work requests through structured forms and route them straight into the right project.
records.catalog_description:
Replace ad-hoc requests with structured intake forms that collect exactly what the team needs to start. Submissions are triaged and converted into work items in the right project, with the requester's details captured along the way.

Standardized intake means no lost requests in chat or email, a consistent starting point for every piece of work, and a clear record of what was asked and what happened next.

records.description: Usage analytics, license rightsizing, reclamation actions, per-app cost benchmarks, and optimization recommendations. The cost-and-utilization substrate of an SMP deployment.
records.catalog_tagline: Stop paying for licenses nobody uses.
records.catalog_description: Track real usage for every SaaS seat, surface rightsizing and savings recommendations, and reclaim idle or duplicate licenses with a safe grace period. Benchmark your cost-per-seat against peers so you know where you are overspending and act on it.

records.description: Declarative automation workflows, workflow run history, and employee-facing self-service app-access requests. The automation surface of an SMP deployment.
records.catalog_tagline: Automate the busywork of granting, moving, and removing app access.
records.catalog_description: Build declarative workflows that provision and deprovision SaaS access automatically, track every run, and give employees a self-service way to request the apps they need with manager and IT approval built in. Less manual ticket-pushing, faster access, cleaner offboarding.

records.description: Transcribes and analyzes recorded sales conversations, extracting topics, action items, competitor mentions, and market signals from the call corpus. The analytics layer over the call-recording substrate: it turns raw conversations into structured insight records, topic and objection tags, and competitive-signal feeds consumed by deal scoring and coaching.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn every recorded call into searchable insight: topics, competitor mentions, objections, and follow-ups, captured automatically.
records.catalog_description: Conversation Intelligence transcribes and analyzes your team's calls and meetings, surfacing what was discussed: pricing pushback, competitor names, next-step commitments, and risk signals. Reps stop taking notes and managers stop guessing what happened on a call. Extracted topics and action items flow straight into deal scoring and coaching, so the signal in every conversation reaches the people who need it.

records.description: Computes per-opportunity risk scores and named deal warnings from activity, conversation, and CRM signals, then rolls them up into the manager-grade pipeline inspection surface. Per-deal scoring and the portfolio review of those scores are two grains of one engine: the score primitive plus the pipeline-health diagnostics, deal-coverage views, and stage-progression analytics built on it.
records.catalog_tagline: Know which deals will close and which are slipping, with an AI risk score and named warnings on every opportunity.
records.catalog_description: Deal Intelligence scores each open opportunity for risk using the activity, conversation, and CRM signals your team already generates, then flags the specific problems behind a low score: no decision-maker, no next step, single-threaded. Managers inspect the pipeline by risk instead of by gut feel, and reps see exactly what to fix on each deal before the forecast call.

records.description: Produces period revenue forecasts by segment and roll-up, captures the rep-and-manager submission cycle, and scores forecast accuracy against actuals over time. The finance-grade forecasting surface: forecast snapshots, category calls (commit, best-case, pipeline), submission and adjustment history, and the accuracy records that train the forecasting models.
records.catalog_tagline: Submit, roll up, and stress-test your revenue forecast, with accuracy tracked every period so the number gets better over time.
records.catalog_description: Forecasting replaces the spreadsheet scramble with a structured submission and roll-up cycle. Reps submit their call, managers adjust and lock the team number, and an AI-generated baseline gives leadership a second opinion. Every period's submitted forecast is measured against actuals, so forecast accuracy is a metric you manage, not a mystery.

records.description: Anchors 1-on-1 coaching to recorded calls: session scheduling, scorecard evaluation against talk-track rubrics, timestamped call-review comments, and playbook-compliance tracking. The enablement-facing review workflow over the conversation corpus, kept distinct from the per-deal scoring engine.
records.catalog_tagline: Coach reps on real calls: replay the conversation, score it against your playbook, and track improvement over time.
records.catalog_description: Coaching turns recorded calls into a structured development loop. Managers and enablement run 1-on-1 sessions anchored to a specific call, score it against a rubric, and leave timestamped comments reps can revisit. Patterns across the team surface what to train next, closing the loop between what happens on calls and how the team improves.

records.description: Automatically captures emails, meetings, and calls and attributes them to opportunities and accounts, removing the manual CRM data-entry burden. The activity data foundation: captured-activity records, configurable attribution rules, and per-account and per-rep engagement rollups that feed deal scoring, forecasting, and pipeline inspection.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture every email, call, and meeting automatically and attach it to the right deal, no manual CRM entry required.
records.catalog_description: Activity Capture removes the data-entry tax on reps by automatically logging emails, calls, and meetings and attributing them to the right opportunity and account. The result is a clean, complete activity record that powers deal scoring, engagement metrics, and forecasting, without anyone updating the CRM by hand.

records.description: Receipt capture and expense entry, rules-based policy enforcement, time-card collection feeding expense entry, and the approval-to-reimbursement workflow over expense reports and their lines.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture expenses, check them against policy, and route reports for approval without chasing paper.
records.catalog_description: Submit, itemize, and report business expenses in one place. Add expense lines, attach receipts, and let each line check itself against your spending rules before it ever reaches an approver. Send completed reports up the chain for review, watch them move from draft to approved, and hand the approved amounts off cleanly for posting and reimbursement. Spend less time on data entry and reminders, and give finance a reliable, auditable record of every claim.

records.description: Corporate card feeds, auto-matching of card transactions to expense lines, and reconciliation over the issued-card register and its transaction stream.
records.catalog_tagline: Match corporate card charges to expenses and close the books on card spend with confidence.
records.catalog_description: Bring every corporate card charge into one workspace and pair it with the expense it belongs to. Review posted transactions, match them to submitted expense lines, and surface the charges that still need a receipt or an explanation. Keep card programs and statements reconciled month after month, so finance can trust that recorded spend matches what actually hit the card.

records.description: Travel-booking integration, itinerary capture, pre-trip approval, and post-trip expense reconciliation over imported travel bookings.
records.catalog_tagline: Book and track business travel and per diem in step with your expense and approval rules.
records.catalog_description: Plan, reserve, and track business trips alongside the expenses they generate. Move bookings from request to confirmed and completed, apply per diem and travel rules as you go, and keep travelers and approvers informed at each step. Connect trip details to the expenses they produce so travel spend stays visible, in policy, and ready to report.

records.description: Captures clock-in / clock-out and break events, runs time-card collection and approval, and enforces break-and-meal labor-law compliance. Approved time becomes the payroll handoff payload.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture hours worked, approve time cards, and stay compliant with break and meal rules.
records.catalog_description: Record clock-in and clock-out events, breaks, and meal periods, then collect them into time cards your managers review and approve. Built-in break and meal rules flag missed or short breaks before they become a liability, so approved time is clean and ready to pay. Give your team an accurate, audit-ready record of every hour worked.

records.description: Builds demand-driven shift schedules and rosters, assigns shifts with skill matching and dispatch, supports swaps and self-scheduling, and reconciles budgeted-versus-actual labor hours from labor-demand forecasts.
records.catalog_tagline: Build demand-driven schedules, fill every shift, and keep labor on budget.
records.catalog_description: Plan rosters from forecasted demand, assign shifts by skill and availability, and let workers pick up, swap, or self-schedule open shifts. Track scheduled hours against your labor budget so you can adjust before costs run over. Give managers a faster way to cover every shift and give workers more say over when they work.

records.description: Manages time-off requests, statutory and discretionary leave, accrual and entitlement policies, and per-worker leave balances tracked against those policies.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage time-off requests, leave policies, and balances in one place.
records.catalog_description: Let workers request time off and check their balances, route requests for fast approval, and apply your accrual and entitlement rules automatically. Track every type of leave against the policies you define, so balances stay accurate and approvals stay consistent. Give your team a clear, self-service view of the time off they have earned.

records.description: Authors marketing campaigns and email content, runs the send pipeline, performs A/B and send-time optimization, applies generative content assistance, and measures multi-touch attribution against engagement.
records.catalog_tagline: Build, send, and optimize marketing email campaigns from one workspace.
records.catalog_description: Create marketing campaigns and design the emails that go with them, then schedule and send to your audience. Compose content, run A/B variant tests, and let your campaigns reach the right people at the right time. Track how each send performs so you can refine the next one and keep improving results across every campaign you run.

records.description: Designs and runs multi-step, multi-channel nurture journeys spanning email, mobile push, in-app, and SMS, with branching, wait conditions, and frequency capping.
records.catalog_tagline: Guide every contact through multi-step nurture journeys across email, push, in-app, and SMS.
records.catalog_description: Design automated journeys that move each contact through the right sequence of touches, from a first welcome to a re-engagement nudge. Reach people on whichever channel fits the moment, whether that is email, push, in-app, or SMS, and branch the path based on how they respond. Keep every journey running on its own without manual follow-up, so the right message arrives at the right step for each person.

records.description: Computes behavioral and demographic lead scores from explicit and implicit signals, applies grading and decay rules, and triggers nurture enrollment and qualified-lead routing.
records.catalog_tagline: Score and prioritize leads automatically, and trigger nurture the moment they are ready.
records.catalog_description: Rank your leads with scores that combine what they do with who they are, so your team always knows who to focus on first. Set the signals that matter and let scores update as behavior changes. When a lead crosses the threshold you set, kick off the right nurture automatically and hand the best leads to sales at exactly the right moment.

records.description: Builds hosted landing pages and embeddable lead-capture forms with progressive profiling, conditional logic, and post-submit routing into scoring and nurture.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture leads with hosted landing pages and forms that grow richer over time.
records.catalog_description: Publish landing pages and lead-capture forms without waiting on a developer, and start collecting interest right away. Use progressive profiling to ask for a little more each visit, so a contact record fills in over time instead of all at once. Turn every submission into a known lead, ready to score, nurture, and route to the rest of your marketing workflow.

records.description: Maintains the normalized publisher/product software catalog and the agent-based and agent-less inventory of installed software across endpoints. Masters the canonical software product catalog and the discovered-installation record, overlaying configuration-item and org-unit context.
records.catalog_tagline: See exactly what software is installed across your fleet, all normalized into one clean product catalog.
records.catalog_description: Stop guessing what is running on your endpoints. This module pulls installation signals from your inventory and discovery feeds, then cleans up the raw data into a single, normalized catalog of real software products, editions, and versions. You get one trustworthy list of what you actually have deployed, with the noise of duplicate entries and cryptic install names removed. Use it as the foundation for every license and compliance decision: when you know precisely what is installed and where, reconciling entitlements and answering auditor questions becomes a lookup instead of a fire drill.

records.description: Reconciles installed and used software against purchased entitlements, meters per-application usage to drive reclamation of unused licenses, and manages renewal dates, true-up windows, and co-termination decisions. Masters the license entitlement record.
records.catalog_tagline: Match what you have deployed against what you have paid for, and never get caught short at renewal.
records.catalog_description: Know your true license position at a glance. This module reconciles installed and actively used software against the entitlements you have purchased, so you can see where you are over-deployed and exposed, and where you are paying for licenses nobody touches. Reclaim and reassign unused seats to cut spend, and stay ahead of every renewal, true-up window, and co-termination date instead of scrambling when a deadline lands. The result is a defensible, always-current picture of compliance and cost that lets you renew with confidence and negotiate from real numbers.

records.description: Collects deployment and usage evidence, attests compliance, and assembles reporting packages tailored to publisher audit demands and internal true-up reviews. Masters the audit/true-up record.
records.catalog_tagline: Walk into any software audit with the evidence already assembled and your response ready to send.
records.catalog_description: Turn a publisher audit from a panic into a routine. This module gathers the deployment and usage evidence you need, organizes it into a complete response package, and tracks each finding from first request through negotiation to resolution. Reviewers and counsel can sign off on the response before it goes out, and every submission is captured so nothing is lost or contradicted later.
