Whether you are facing a formal vendor audit or running an internal true-up review, you respond on your terms with documented proof, protecting the organization from surprise compliance bills and unbudgeted true-up costs.

records.description: Vehicle-as-asset module: maintains the vehicle master from acquisition through in-service, reassignment, retirement and disposal, and runs utilization analytics (productive vs idle vs deadhead, cost-per-mile and cost-per-hour benchmarking, right-sizing).
records.catalog_tagline: Manage every vehicle as an asset, from acquisition to resale, and know exactly what each one costs you to run.
records.catalog_description: Keep a single, trusted record for every vehicle you own or lease, and follow it through its whole life: acquisition, putting it in service, reassigning it, retiring it, and selling it on. See utilization clearly, productive miles versus idle and deadhead time, and compare cost per mile and cost per hour across the fleet so you can right-size and replace at the right moment. Stop guessing about your assets and make purchase, hold, and disposal decisions on real numbers.

records.description: Driver-and-operations module: maintains driver master records (license, medical card, training, HOS status), pre/post-trip inspection reports, and the time-bound assignment of vehicles to drivers, routes and jobs with daily dispatch boards and capacity matching.
records.catalog_tagline: Match the right driver to the right vehicle, run the daily dispatch board, and keep every inspection on file.
records.catalog_description: Maintain complete driver records, licenses, medical cards, training, and hours-of-service status, so you always know who is cleared to drive. Assign vehicles to drivers, routes, and jobs for set windows, and run a daily dispatch board that matches available capacity to the work in front of you. Capture pre-trip and post-trip inspection reports so defects surface early and nothing unsafe leaves the yard. Everything driver, assignment, and inspection lives together, ready when you need to prove it.

records.description: Fuel-cost and regulatory-rollup module: ingests fuel-card and charging transactions, detects fueling exceptions and mpg trends, and produces DOT registration, IFTA fuel-tax, IRP apportioned registration and audit-evidence reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Track every fuel and charging dollar, flag the exceptions, and turn the data into your DOT and IFTA filings.
records.catalog_description: Bring every fuel-card and charging transaction into one place, then spot fueling exceptions and mpg trends before they quietly drain the budget. Watch cost per mile and cost per gallon by vehicle and by driver, and act on the outliers. When filing season comes, turn your fuel and mileage data into DOT registration, IFTA fuel-tax, and IRP apportioned-registration reporting, with the audit evidence ready to hand. Spend less time chasing paperwork and more time keeping the fleet compliant.

records.description: Per-engagement workflow templates and task assignment across service lines, sign-off checkpoints and partner-review routing, tax-calendar-driven recurring deadlines, and engagement-letter and proposal management with recurring annual re-engagement. Owns the engagement record as the workflow envelope that scopes the work.
records.catalog_tagline: Scope, staff, and run client engagements from proposal to close.
records.catalog_description: Open and track every client engagement through its lifecycle, scope the tax returns each engagement covers, and keep the right people notified as work moves forward.

records.domain_module_name: Tax Return Preparation and Document Retention
records.description: Tax-return preparation and filing lifecycle (in-prep, review, ready-for-signature, filed, accepted, rejected) and client-folder document storage with preparer retention rules, prior-year carryforward, and classification by year and form type. Publishes return-state transitions to downstream compliance and billing consumers.
records.catalog_tagline: Prepare, sign, file, and track tax returns to acceptance.
records.catalog_description: Take returns from preparation through review, e-signature, and filing, then track acceptance or rejection from the taxing authority and manage amendments, with documents retained per retention rules.

records.domain_module_name: Client Portal and Time and Billing
records.description: Secure client portal for document upload and e-signature with client-task-list tracking, plus timekeeper time-entry per engagement, value-billing and hourly options, WIP and AR reporting, and fee-quote-to-invoice workflow. The client-facing surface and the monetization surface of the practice.
records.catalog_tagline: Give clients a portal and bill for the time your team logs.
records.catalog_description: Turn logged time entries into client billing and keep clients informed through a secure portal.

records.description: System-of-record for the agency book of business: client jobs with traffic state and deliverable rollup, time capture against client rate cards, retainer agreements with live burn-down, pre-engagement estimating with change orders, cost-plus / markup billing logic, and per-job and per-client profitability rollups.
records.catalog_tagline: Run every client job from estimate to invoice, with live retainer burn-down and per-job profitability.
records.catalog_description: Manage your agency's book of business in one place. Open client jobs, track their traffic state and deliverables, and capture time against client rate cards. Build estimates and change orders before work starts, watch retainers draw down in real time, and apply your markup and cost-plus billing rules automatically. See profitability per job and per client the moment time and costs post, then issue invoices without re-keying a thing.

records.domain_module_name: Media Plan and Insertion Order Management
records.description: Per-campaign media planning broken down by outlet, channel, daypart, audience, and budget; conversion of approved plans into insertion orders committing budget to media outlets at negotiated rates with commission terms and make-good provisions; reconciliation of orders against media-outlet invoices.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan campaigns by outlet and channel, commit budget through insertion orders, and reconcile against publisher invoices.
records.catalog_description: Build media plans broken out by outlet, channel, daypart, audience, and budget, then turn approved plans into insertion orders that commit spend at negotiated rates with commission and make-good terms. When publisher invoices arrive, reconcile them against the orders so posted media costs flow straight to finance. Keep every campaign's planned-versus-actual spend in view from first plan to final reconciliation.

records.description: Creative production lifecycle from the initiating brief through deliverable authoring and multi-stakeholder proofing: brief origination and client approval, deliverable version history, annotated review and approval routing, and final-version registration to the asset library.
records.catalog_tagline: Take creative from brief to approved deliverable with versioned, annotated proofing and clean asset hand-off.
records.catalog_description: Originate creative briefs, get them approved by the client, and author deliverables with full version history. Route each version through annotated, multi-stakeholder review and approval so feedback lands in one place instead of scattered email threads. When a deliverable is signed off, register the final version to your asset library so the approved work is always the version that ships.

records.description: Sellable-product catalog, storefront presentation, faceted search and discovery, and the promotion / coupon rules engine. Owns the merchandised catalog and the channel storefronts a shopper browses.
records.catalog_tagline: Build your product catalog and run the storefront that shoppers browse and buy from.
records.catalog_description: Create and publish products, organize them into a storefront customers can browse, and launch the promotions that move them. Set up catalog content, configure how products appear across your sites, and run coupons and discount campaigns from one place. Keep the catalog accurate and the storefront ready to sell.

records.description: Cart persistence, multi-step checkout, order placement and validation, order lines, and payment authorization. Includes headless commerce APIs and B2B purchasing flows (account hierarchies, quote-to-order, requisition lists). The transactional spine from cart to placed order.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn carts into paid orders and keep every checkout moving.
records.catalog_description: Guide shoppers from cart to confirmed order: capture the cart, run checkout, take payment, and create the order with its line items. Track each order through its lifecycle, handle refunds when they are needed, and keep payment status in view. Reads the shared customer record so every order ties back to the right shopper.

records.description: Fulfillment instruction groups derived from order lines and the shipments that carry them to the customer, including carrier tracking, delivery status, and returns. Hands off to OMS / ERP for distributed fulfillment.
records.catalog_tagline: Get paid orders picked, packed, and out the door to your customers.
records.catalog_description: Take confirmed orders through fulfillment and shipping. Create fulfillments from order lines, assign them to a location, and generate shipments with carrier and tracking so customers know their package is on the way. Keep delivery status current from pick to doorstep.

records.description: Real-time and batch collection of behavioral, transactional, and identifier data from sources, plus deterministic and probabilistic stitching of disparate identifiers into a unified entity graph. Houses the raw event firehose and the identity-resolution overlay that turns anonymous interactions into resolved profiles.
records.catalog_tagline: Collect every signal and resolve it to one identity.
records.catalog_description: Stream behavioral, transactional, and identifier data from any source, then stitch anonymous and known identifiers into a single unified profile with deterministic and probabilistic matching.

records.domain_module_name: Unified Profile, Attributes, and Predictive Scoring
records.description: Persistent golden-record profile spanning attributes, computed traits, consent flags, and lifetime engagement history, with a derived scoring layer (LTV, RFM, churn risk, propensity) and consent and privacy state on the resolved profile. The materialized profile that downstream segments and personalization read from.
records.catalog_tagline: One golden profile, enriched and scored.
records.catalog_description: Maintain a persistent profile spanning attributes, computed traits, consent state, and engagement history, with predictive scores for lifetime value, churn risk, and propensity that downstream teams read from.

records.description: Visual rule building for static and dynamic audiences over profile attributes and behavioral events, plus pushing those audiences and traits to ad platforms, marketing tools, CRM, and ad-server destinations via reverse-ETL or native connectors, including warehouse-native zero-copy operation. Authors and activates segments outbound.
records.catalog_tagline: Build audiences and push them everywhere they're needed.
records.catalog_description: Compose static and dynamic audiences from profile attributes and behavioral events, then activate them to ad platforms, marketing tools, and CRM, including warehouse-native zero-copy delivery.

records.description: Observed multi-channel journey progression (the inbound view of how a customer moved through touchpoints over time) reconciled into a single queryable customer view across transactional, marketing, and operational systems. Descriptive journey history rather than orchestrated outbound sequences.
records.catalog_tagline: See the whole customer journey in one view.
records.catalog_description: Reconcile observed multi-channel journey progression into a single queryable customer view across transactional, marketing, and operational systems for a complete 360-degree picture.

records.description: Central repository for design-time process models with BPMN authoring, version graphs, check-in/check-out, lifecycle states, review and approval workflows, and stakeholder publication portals. The authoring backbone of the domain.
records.catalog_tagline: Author, review, and publish your process models from one repository.
records.catalog_description: Build and maintain a governed library of business process models. Draft new versions, route them for review, and publish the approved model so every team works from the same picture. Notify stakeholders automatically when a process is published.

records.description: Hierarchical business capability maps with maturity, investment, and strategic-fit heatmaps, plus pre-loaded reference framework content that can be imported, synced, and extended with organization-specific content.
records.catalog_tagline: See what your business can do, and where to invest next.
records.catalog_description: Build capability maps that show what your organization does, independent of how it is structured today. Anchor them to reference frameworks, keep them current as the business evolves, and publish a shared view that planning, architecture, and leadership can align around.

records.description: End-to-end value stream maps with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, and waste categorization, together with discrete-event and Monte Carlo simulation of process scenarios for bottleneck identification and scenario comparison.
records.catalog_tagline: Model your value streams and test changes before you make them.
records.catalog_description: Map how value flows to your customers, spot the bottlenecks that slow delivery, and model improvements with simulation before you roll them out. Run what-if scenarios, compare outcomes, and share the results with the teams that act on them.

records.description: Unified analytics storage over open table formats with ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time travel, plus declarative and code-first batch and streaming pipelines with scheduling, dependency management, lineage capture, and run observability. Includes collaborative multi-language notebooks running against the lakehouse with shared compute and scheduled execution.
records.catalog_tagline: Land all your data in one open, governed lakehouse and build the pipelines that keep it fresh.
records.catalog_description:
Bring batch and streaming data together in a single analytics store you actually control, with reliable transactions, schema changes that do not break downstream work, and the ability to look back at how a table looked at any point in time. Build the ingestion and transformation pipelines that fill it, schedule them, see their dependencies at a glance, and get clear run-level visibility when something slows down or fails.

Work side by side in collaborative notebooks that run directly against your lakehouse, mixing languages and sharing compute, so analysts and engineers can explore, prototype, and ship on the same data without copying it around. The result is one trustworthy foundation that your reporting, governance, and machine learning all sit on.

records.domain_module_name: Semantic Layer, Governance, and Data Products
records.description: Semantic and ontology modeling that maps physical tables to governed business concepts and reusable measures, a single-pane catalog with lineage, business glossary, and fine-grained access control across all platform assets, and published governed data products with explicit contracts. Includes operational data applications backed by the semantic and ontology layer with write-back to systems of record.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn raw tables into governed business concepts, trusted metrics, and shareable data products.
records.catalog_description:
Map your physical tables to the business concepts and reusable measures everyone agrees on, so a metric means the same thing in every report, dashboard, and AI answer. Give your teams a single place to find any data asset, trace where it came from, read its plain-language definition, and request the right level of access, all under fine-grained controls.

Package the data others depend on into governed data products with explicit contracts for schema, quality, and ownership, so consumers know exactly what they are getting and producers know who relies on them. Build lightweight operational apps on top of the same governed layer that can write changes back to your systems of record, closing the loop between insight and action.

records.description: End-to-end machine-learning lifecycle: feature engineering and feature store, distributed training, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment to serving endpoints, drift monitoring, and continuous evaluation.
records.catalog_tagline: Take models from first experiment to monitored production without losing track of anything.
records.catalog_description:
Engineer and reuse the features your models depend on, train them at scale, and keep every experiment and result recorded so you can compare runs and reproduce the one that worked. Register your best models, promote them through clear stages, and deploy them to serving endpoints when they are ready.

Keep an eye on models after they go live with drift monitoring and continuous evaluation, so you find out early when accuracy slips or the data shifts underneath them. The whole lifecycle stays connected, from raw features to a live, watched model, so teams can ship confidently and act fast when something changes.

records.description: Foundation-model hosting and routing, embedding generation, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-use orchestration, agent runtimes, prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses, and gateway controls for cost, safety, and audit.
records.catalog_tagline: Build, ground, and govern AI agents and assistants on top of your own trusted data.
records.catalog_description:
Host and route the foundation models your assistants run on, generate embeddings, and stand up vector search so agents can retrieve the right context and answer from your real data instead of guessing. Orchestrate tool use and multi-step agent workflows, version and test your prompts, and check quality with evaluation harnesses before anything reaches users.

Keep cost, safety, and auditability under control with gateway-level guardrails, so you can scale generative features across the business while staying in command of what your agents do and what they spend. This gives you a dependable path from a working prototype to governed, production AI assistants grounded in your own knowledge.

records.description: Individual-cow system of record spanning the full animal lifecycle (calving, lactation cycles, dry-off, culling), reproduction and breeding history, and herd-health events with treatment and withdrawal tracking. Holds the per-animal master and its lactation, breeding, and health event records.
records.catalog_tagline: One record per cow, from calving through lactation, breeding, health, and the culling call.
records.catalog_description:
Keep a living record for every animal in the herd. Track parity, current lactation status, and pen location, and move each cow through her lifecycle as she calves, peaks, dries off, and is eventually replaced.

Log the work that drives the herd forward. Record breeding events with the sire and technician, follow pregnancy checks to confirmation, and capture health incidents with their treatment and withdrawal period so a treated cow never ships milk too soon. Lactation records open with each calving and carry days-in-milk, peak yield, and the 305-day projection.

The result is a herd you can manage by exception: see which cows are open, which are due to dry off, which are under withdrawal, and which are candidates to cull, all from the same place.

records.description: Parlor and automatic-milking-system integration: captures per-cow per-session milking telemetry (yield, conductivity, duration) and aggregates it into outbound bulk-tank shipments to processors and cooperatives.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture every milking from the parlor and turn finished milk into bulk shipments ready to leave the farm.
records.catalog_description:
Bring parlor and robot output into one record. Capture per-cow, per-session milkings with yield, conductivity, and duration straight from parlor or automated-milking telemetry, and reconcile sessions so the day's production reconciles cow by cow.

Move milk off the farm with a clean trail. Build bulk tank shipments to the processor or cooperative with pickup time, volume, grade, and hauler, so every load that leaves is accounted for and ready for the next step in traceability.

The payoff is production you can trust at the cow level and at the tank level, with shipment records that line up against quality results before milk is dispatched.

records.description: Milk-quality testing and records: somatic cell count, bacterial counts, butterfat and protein components, and antibiotic-residue screening at the bulk-tank and per-cow level, driving drug-residue and mastitis-management workflows.
records.catalog_tagline: Test the milk that leaves the farm and hold what fails: SCC, bacteria, components, and residue in one place.
records.catalog_description:
Test milk where it matters, at the bulk tank and the individual cow. Record somatic cell count, bacterial count, butterfat, protein, and antibiotic-residue screens, and follow each result from sampled through submitted to a pass, fail, or appeal.

Turn a failing result into action, not just a number. A failed test or an active treatment can gate a shipment so milk that should not leave the farm does not, protecting the load, the premium, and the buyer relationship.

Quality history rolls up so trends are visible over time, supporting DHIA testing standards and FDA Grade A obligations with the evidence already captured.

records.description: Feed rationing and total-mixed-ration management: per-group ration formulation, feed inventory and shrink tracking, feed-mixer integration, and income-over-feed-cost computation per cow group.
records.catalog_tagline: Formulate rations by group, log every mix, and tie feed cost back to milk income.
records.catalog_description:
Build total-mixed rations the way the herd is actually fed: by group, with ingredients and inclusion percentages set for each pen's stage and production level. Each ration is formulated, put into use, and superseded when the recipe changes, so the current formulation is always clear.

Log what goes in the mixer, not just what was planned. Mixing records capture the real batch so feeding can be checked against the formulation.

Close the economic loop. Tie ration cost to milk income so income-over-feed-cost is a number you manage rather than estimate, and so a ration change can be weighed against its effect on production and margin.

records.description: Authoring surface for data-protection policies, classification and labeling rules, content fingerprints, and time-limited policy exceptions. Defines what counts as sensitive and which actions (block, quarantine, redact, mask, watermark, alert) apply, then governs the exception lifecycle that relaxes those rules under business justification.
records.catalog_tagline: Decide what counts as sensitive and the rules that protect it, all in one policy workspace.
records.catalog_description:
Build the policy layer that powers data loss prevention. Classify your data, author detection rules tied to those classifications, and tune severity and enforcement actions per channel and audience.

Manage the full lifecycle of every policy from draft through review and approval to retirement, and handle the exceptions that real work demands: review requests, approve time-boxed waivers, and keep them from quietly becoming permanent. The result is a clear, reviewable set of controls your enforcement points can act on with confidence.

records.description: Runtime detection and enforcement at the egress point across email, endpoint, network, web, and cloud SaaS channels. Captures exfiltration attempts, raises and triages incidents, holds blocked artifacts in quarantine pending review, and records a forensic user-activity trail for investigation and remediation.
records.catalog_tagline: Catch data leaving across every channel and run each incident to a clean close.
records.catalog_description:
Watch email, web, endpoints, cloud apps, and chat for sensitive data on the move, and act the instant a rule fires: block, quarantine, or alert. Every exfiltration attempt and policy violation becomes a tracked incident your team can triage, investigate, and remediate.

Hold risky artifacts in quarantine until someone reviews them, release or destroy them on decision, and keep a per-user activity trail so investigators can see the full story. Built to turn raw detection signal into a response workflow that closes the loop.

records.description: Enumerates cloud data stores (object storage, managed databases, warehouses, SaaS instances), classifies the sensitivity of the data they hold, traces lineage and flow across pipelines, and surfaces shadow or unmanaged stores absent from the official inventory. This is the at-rest discovery and sensitivity surface that feeds the access and risk engine.
records.catalog_tagline: See every cloud data store and know exactly how sensitive the data inside it is.
records.catalog_description: Continuously find the object stores, managed databases, warehouses, and SaaS instances that hold your data, including the shadow stores no one put on the official inventory. Each store is scanned and its contents classified by sensitivity, so you always know where regulated and high-value data actually lives. Lineage tracing shows how that data flows across pipelines, and unmanaged or newly discovered findings are queued for an owner to review. The result is a trustworthy, always-current map of your data estate that feeds every access, risk, and incident decision downstream.

records.description: Enumerates identity principals and their effective permissions on data stores, detects over-privilege and toxic combinations (sensitive data plus over-permissive policy), and combines sensitivity, access breadth and exposure vector into per-asset risk scores that prioritize the remediation queue.
records.catalog_tagline: Know who can reach your sensitive data and fix the access that should not exist.
records.catalog_description: Map every identity and the permissions it actually has on each data store, then surface over-privilege and toxic combinations where sensitive data meets an over-permissive policy. Sensitivity, access breadth, and exposure are combined into a single risk score per asset, so your team works the highest-risk findings first instead of chasing noise. Policies that fail review are flagged and routed for correction, and risk scores recompute as the picture changes. You get a prioritized, defensible queue of access problems and a clear path to closing each one.

records.description: Triages detected sensitive-data incidents (over-privilege, toxic combinations, unauthorized access, shadow-data exposure) through investigation and containment, and drives templated and custom policy enforcement for IAM corrections, bucket-policy updates, and entitlement reviews.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn a sensitive-data exposure into a contained, resolved incident with a clear audit trail.
records.catalog_description: Triage detected incidents such as over-privilege, toxic combinations, unauthorized access, and shadow-data exposure, then drive each one through investigation, containment, and resolution. Templated and custom enforcement applies the fix directly, whether that is an IAM correction, a bucket-policy update, or an entitlement review, and the right people are notified at each step. Every transition is recorded, so you can show how an exposure was caught, contained, and closed. The outcome is faster response, less standing risk, and the evidence to prove it.

records.description: Page-level and component authoring, content modeling, publishing, and centralized management of multiple sites, brands, and locales for branded customer-facing web experiences.
records.catalog_tagline: Author web pages and reusable content once, then publish across every site and brand you run.
records.catalog_description:
Create and edit web pages and reusable content components in a structured draft, review, and approval flow. Assemble experiences from shared building blocks so a change in one place updates everywhere it is used.

Publish to many sites and brands from a single workspace, control when content goes live or comes down, and refresh delivery caches so visitors always see the current version.

records.description: Rule-based and audience-targeted personalization of content and journeys, plus A/B and multivariate experimentation across variants with statistical reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Show the right experience to the right audience and prove what works with built-in experimentation.
records.catalog_description:
Define visitor segments and target them with personalization rules that tailor pages, offers, and content in real time. Activate, pause, and retire rules as your audiences and goals change.

Run A/B and multivariate tests to measure which variations perform best, then roll the winner out with confidence. Publish segments once and reuse them across personalization and testing.

records.description: Authenticated customer and partner portal experiences with self-service, plus form authoring, progressive profiling, and multi-step journey orchestration integrated with content and personalization.
records.catalog_tagline: Guide visitors through multi-step journeys and self-service portals that respond to who they are.
records.catalog_description:
Design guided journeys and portal flows step by step, deciding what each visitor sees next based on their profile and behavior. Track who enters, completes, or drops off so you can refine each path.

React to live audience updates from your customer data so journeys and portal experiences stay relevant as visitor segments change.

records.description: Authors the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and approved budgets. Owns the dollar plan and budget records, driver-based modeling inputs, and the workforce / headcount spend slice of the plan. The budget, once approved, drives downstream spend authorization.
records.catalog_tagline: Build the annual operating plan and approve the budget that sets each team's spend for the year.
records.catalog_description:
Plan the year top to bottom: shape the long-range plan, model the drivers that move revenue and cost, and turn the plan into an approved budget that each cost center spends against. Bring the people-cost line into the same place so headcount and compensation plans roll up with everything else.

Move a plan from draft through review to a locked, approved budget that downstream teams can trust. Once the budget is set it becomes the baseline that forecasts refresh against and that variance reporting measures actuals against, so the whole organization works from one agreed set of numbers.

records.description: Maintains rolling forecasts that refresh the expected outlook against actuals, and what-if scenario models layered on a base plan (upside, downside, cost-cut, M and A cases). Forecasts and scenarios feed downstream re-alignment.
records.catalog_tagline: Refresh the outlook with rolling forecasts and stress-test the plan with what-if scenarios.
records.catalog_description:
Keep the outlook current. Refresh a rolling forecast each cycle so the expected landing point reflects the latest actuals and assumptions, and re-forecast quickly when the business changes instead of waiting for the next planning cycle.

Model the alternatives before you commit. Layer upside, downside, cost-reduction, and growth scenarios on top of the base plan, compare them side by side, and hand the chosen path back to planning. Forecasts and scenarios give leaders an early read on where the year is heading and the confidence to re-align spend in time.

records.description: Produces actual-vs-plan variance reconciliations with root-cause commentary and management reporting. The operational analytic output consumed by org leaders and finance partners when variance is material.
records.catalog_tagline: Reconcile actuals against plan, explain the variance, and report the results to leadership.
records.catalog_description:
Close the loop on the plan. Pull period actuals against the approved budget and the latest forecast, surface where results diverge, and capture the root-cause commentary that explains why. Route material variances to the people accountable so nothing material goes unexplained.

Turn the reconciliation into management reporting that leaders and finance partners actually read. Cost-center owners and the finance team get a clear, repeatable view of performance against plan, with the context they need to decide what to do next.

records.description: Metadata-driven document repository with check-in / check-out, version history, hierarchical folders, full-text indexing, scan / OCR capture, and manual plus ML-driven classification of inbound unstructured content.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture every document, find it instantly, and keep one trusted version under control.
records.catalog_description:
Bring scanned, uploaded, and emailed files into one organized repository where every document carries rich metadata and lives in a folder structure your team actually understands. Full-text search and saved views turn a pile of files into something you can find in seconds.

Check documents out to edit them safely, publish new versions without losing the old ones, and let automatic classification flag what is confidential, restricted, or public the moment it arrives. Your people stop guessing which copy is current and start trusting the one source of truth.

records.description: Retention schedules, legal holds, defensible disposition, policy authoring, and immutable compliance audit trails of access, change, share, and disposition events across the unstructured-content estate.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep what you must, dispose of what you can, and prove it whenever you are asked.
records.catalog_description:
Define retention schedules once and let every document inherit the right keep-or-dispose rule automatically, so nothing lingers past its time and nothing important is deleted too soon. When a matter requires it, place a legal hold and freeze disposition until the hold lifts.

When records reach the end of their retention period, run defensible disposition with a clear, recorded decision. An immutable trail of who accessed, changed, shared, and disposed of each document gives auditors and regulators the evidence they ask for, without a last-minute scramble.

records.description: Routing, approval, and content-centric process automation tied to documents and their versions, with auditable transitions for contracts, claims, invoices, and case files.
records.catalog_tagline: Route documents to the right people and capture every approval on the record.
records.catalog_description:
Turn document handling into repeatable, auditable processes. Send contracts, claims, invoices, and case files to the right reviewers in the right order, with clear steps, due dates, and a record of every decision along the way.

Each transition is captured, so you always know where a document is, who has it, and what happens next. Approvals are no longer buried in inboxes; they are part of the document's history.

records.description: The accounting system of record: chart of accounts, journal posting, cost-center and legal-entity dimensions, fiscal-period management, period-end close orchestration, intercompany postings, and multi-entity consolidation. Holds the ledger masters every other finance module posts into.
records.catalog_tagline: Post journal entries, maintain your chart of accounts, and run a controlled close across every legal entity.
records.catalog_description:
Keep your general ledger accurate and your close on schedule. Record and review journal entries, organize accounts and cost centers, and manage multiple legal entities and currencies from one place, with the controls that keep postings reliable.

When period end arrives, open, soft-close, and hard-close accounting periods in a controlled sequence, match intercompany activity between entities, and produce results you can hand to leadership and auditors with confidence. Reopen a period only when policy allows, and keep a clean trail of every change.

records.description: Capitalization, depreciation, and disposal of fixed assets. Maintains the asset register and per-book depreciation schedules that feed the monthly depreciation journals.
records.catalog_tagline: Capitalize, depreciate, and dispose of fixed assets with a clean tie-out to the ledger.
records.catalog_description:
Track the full life of every capital asset, from acquisition and capitalization through in-service use, depreciation, and disposal. Set depreciation methods and schedules, run depreciation on a predictable cadence, and keep each asset tied to the entity that owns it.

When an asset is sold, retired, or impaired, record the event and let the resulting gains, losses, and adjustments flow into the close. Reconcile the asset ledger to the general ledger so capital balances always agree.

records.description: Bank-account management, cash transaction recording, receipt and disbursement handling, and reconciliation of cash movements against the ledger. The cash-side of receivables collection and payables disbursement.
records.catalog_tagline: Reconcile cash and bank activity so your bank balances and your books always agree.
records.catalog_description:
Bring in bank statements, post cash transactions, and match them against your records so nothing slips through. Maintain bank accounts across entities and currencies, and see your true cash position at any moment.

Work through unmatched items quickly, reconcile each statement, and clear exceptions before they reach the close. Clean reconciliations mean the cash on your books matches the cash in the bank, every period.

records.description: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition: performance-obligation allocation, deferred-revenue schedules, and recognition timelines bridging contracts and the ledger.
records.catalog_tagline: Recognize revenue accurately and on time, in line with current accounting standards.
records.catalog_description:
Turn billing and delivery events into correctly recognized revenue. Track recognition records from pending through recognized and reversed, apply the right timing and schedules, and keep revenue aligned with the goods and services actually delivered.

Connect project and subscription activity to the ledger so recognized revenue posts cleanly into the close. When something changes, reverse and re-recognize with a clear trail, and give finance numbers that hold up under review.

records.description: Shop-floor execution module: work-order intake from inspection defect, telematics fault, or driver report; task-line composition with labor and parts; in-shop versus out-of-shop routing; mechanic and shop assignment; defect triage; completion sign-off and post-repair quality check.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn every defect, fault, and driver report into a tracked repair from intake to sign-off.
records.catalog_description: Open a work order the moment a problem shows up, whether it comes from a failed inspection, a telematics fault, or a driver's note. Build the job with labor and parts lines, assign it to the right mechanic and shop, and decide what stays in-house and what goes out. Triage incoming defects by severity, keep each repair moving through its stages, and close it out with a completion sign-off and a quality check so the vehicle goes back into service ready to run.

records.description: Planning module: PM-schedule definition per vehicle class with triggers on mileage, engine hours, calendar time, or DTC codes; auto-generation of work orders ahead of due dates; deferred-maintenance tracking.
records.catalog_tagline: Service every vehicle on time by mileage, hours, or calendar, and let the work orders write themselves.
records.catalog_description: Set up a preventive maintenance plan for each vehicle class and let the right triggers fire it, whether that is miles driven, engine hours, time elapsed, or a fault code from the road. Work orders generate automatically ahead of each due date so nothing slips, and anything you choose to put off is tracked as deferred maintenance instead of being forgotten. Stay ahead of wear instead of reacting to breakdowns.

records.description: Parts and coverage module: parts master with cross-reference to vehicle make, model, and year; on-hand stock and reorder thresholds per location; parts consumption against work orders; OEM-warranty coverage tracking per VIN; eligible-claim identification on repair events; recall notification ingestion and recall-completion tracking across the fleet.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep the right parts on hand and claim every warranty and recall dollar you are owed.
records.catalog_description: Track parts stock and reorder points by location so a job never stalls waiting on a part, and tie every part used back to the work order that consumed it. Know which repairs are covered by an OEM warranty before you pay for them, and flag eligible claims as the work happens. Pull in recall notices and match them to your VINs, then track each recall through to completion across the whole fleet.

records.description: GIS field and boundary mapping with seasonal crop planning and multi-year rotation modeling. Defines the spatial units of farm operations and the seasonal plan layered onto each field.
records.catalog_tagline: Draw your fields once, then plan every season and rotation on top of accurate boundaries.
records.catalog_description:
Map field and paddock boundaries from GPS, imagery, or existing records so every operation downstream is tied to the right acres. Adjust boundaries as fields split, merge, or change use, and keep one trusted set of spatial units for the whole operation.

Layer a crop plan onto each field for the coming season and model multi-year rotations to balance soil health, input cost, and market timing. Commit plans when they are ready so planting, spraying, and harvest teams all work from the same intended program.

records.description: Per-pass operational record-keeping across the season: planting events, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yield capture. The compliance and audit trail of what happened in each field.
records.catalog_tagline: Log what actually happened in each field, pass by pass, with an audit trail you can stand behind.
records.catalog_description:
Record planting events, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yields as operations happen in the field, on a phone or in the cab. Capture the rate, product, timing, weather, and operator for each pass so nothing is reconstructed from memory at season end.

The result is a complete, time-stamped history of every field that supports re-entry and pre-harvest interval checks, proves what was applied and when, and feeds traceability and food-safety requests. When a buyer or auditor needs evidence, the record is already there.

records.description: Site-specific prescription authoring and machinery telemetry integration. Generates variable-rate application maps from yield zones and soil tests and ingests normalized equipment telemetry over CAN-bus, ISOBUS, and OEM machinery APIs.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn field data into variable-rate maps and bring your machinery telemetry into the same system.
records.catalog_description:
Author site-specific prescriptions that vary seed, fertilizer, and chemical rates by zone, built from yield history and soil tests, then publish them to your equipment for execution. Apply inputs where they pay off and pull back where they do not, instead of treating every acre the same.

Ingest normalized machinery telemetry from your fleet so as-applied and as-harvested data flows back automatically over standard equipment buses and OEM connections. Close the loop between the map you planned and the work the machines actually did.

records.description: Ag-input stock tracking reconciled against application and purchase records, paired with multi-season yield and field-performance analytics for profitability-per-zone and return-on-input analysis.
records.catalog_tagline: Know what input stock you have, what each field cost, and which acres returned the most.
records.catalog_description:
Track seed, fertilizer, and chemical inventory and reconcile it against application and purchase records so on-hand quantities stay accurate and low stock is flagged before it stops an operation. Tie every input draw back to the field and pass that consumed it.

Pair that with multi-season yield and field-performance analytics to see profitability per zone and return on each input. Compare fields and seasons, find where money was made or lost, and carry those lessons into next year's plan.

records.description: Capture FSMA-204 critical tracking events and their key data elements against traceability lot codes, and traverse forward and backward lot genealogy from raw-material lots through transformation to finished SKUs. Generates the FDA-sortable KDE response used for 24-hour traceback.
records.catalog_tagline: Record receive, transform, and ship events against lot codes and walk lot genealogy in both directions.
records.catalog_description:
Log the critical tracking events and key data elements for every lot as it moves through receiving, transformation, and shipping. Each event is tied to a lot code so the full history of a product is always reconstructable.

Walk the genealogy graph forward from a raw-material lot through transformation to finished goods, or backward from a finished SKU to its sources, and produce the sortable record needed to answer a traceback request inside the required timeframe.

records.description: Initiate, track, and report on product recalls: identify affected lots from lot genealogy, notify downstream consignees, manage hold-and-segregate status, and file Reportable Food Registry submissions against the governing compliance obligations.
records.catalog_tagline: Run a recall end to end: find affected lots, notify consignees, hold stock, and file with regulators.
records.catalog_description:
Start a recall and immediately identify every affected lot using lot genealogy, then classify it by severity to set the right notification and filing path. Track who has been notified, what stock is on hold, and what has been recovered, all against a single recall record.

Keep a defensible communications log per recipient, file the required regulatory submissions, verify that the recall was effective, and close it out with a complete, audit-ready trail.

records.description: Centralized vault for supplier certifications (GFSI, organic, kosher, halal, allergen, insurance) with expiry and renewal tracking, plus verification and tamper-evident anchoring of origin and provenance claims surfaced to downstream stakeholders.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep supplier certifications and provenance claims current, verified, and ready for audit.
records.catalog_description:
Hold supplier certifications in one vault with expiry and renewal tracking, so an out-of-date or revoked certificate is caught before it affects a shipment. Onboard new documents, validate them, and flag the ones that need attention.

Verify origin and provenance claims against the documents that back them, and surface trustworthy provenance to the people and partners who depend on it.

records.description: Author and maintain HACCP plans, define critical control points with critical limits, capture shift-frequency CCP monitoring readings, and drive deviation, hold-and-test, and corrective-action workflows from food-safety incidents.
records.catalog_tagline: Build HACCP plans and catch every critical-limit deviation as it happens.
records.catalog_description:
Author HACCP and preventive-control plans, define critical control points with their critical limits, and route each plan through review and approval before it takes effect. Capture monitoring readings at the line on every shift and flag deviations the moment a limit is crossed.

When a reading goes out of limit, trigger a product hold, open a food-safety incident, and work the corrective action through to closure, with a full record of who did what and when for your next audit.

records.description: Define content types, fields, references, and validation rules exposed automatically as REST and GraphQL endpoints, and manage isolated content environments (dev, staging, production) for safe schema and content migrations.
records.catalog_tagline: Shape your content structure and ship schema changes safely
records.catalog_description: Design reusable content types with fields, references, and validation rules that become ready-to-use APIs the moment you save them. Work across isolated environments so you can test schema and content changes before they reach production, and migrate with confidence.

records.description: Non-technical authoring of content entries with rich text, references, draft and publish, scheduling, role-based editorial workflows, multi-locale translations, inline and visual editing, version history, and content-bound media assets.
records.catalog_tagline: Write, review, translate, and publish content without code
records.catalog_description: Create and edit content entries in a friendly editor, then move them from draft to published through review steps that fit your team. Schedule entries to go live automatically, translate them into every locale you serve, and roll back to any prior version when you need to.

records.description: Serve a single content source to many channels through cached, low-latency delivery APIs, coordinate scheduled content releases, and trigger downstream actions through outbound webhooks and integration hooks on content state changes.
records.catalog_tagline: Deliver content everywhere and trigger downstream actions
records.catalog_description: Serve one source of content to every channel through fast, cached delivery APIs built for any front end. Coordinate scheduled releases so related changes go live together, and fire webhooks to keep downstream systems in sync the moment content changes.

records.description: Run hygiene and contamination-control programs: per-product-line allergen maps and changeover validation, pathogen environmental-monitoring sampling plans with zone trend analytics, and per-shift sanitation completion and verification records.
records.catalog_tagline: Run allergen, sanitation, and environmental monitoring without the spreadsheets.
records.catalog_description:
Map allergens by product and line, validate changeovers, and review labels so the right warnings reach the right packaging. Plan environmental-monitoring swabs by zone, track results, and watch for trends before a single positive becomes a pattern.

Schedule master sanitation, confirm each cycle is completed and verified, and keep pre-operational inspection evidence ready. Every hygiene and contamination-control activity lands in one record set you can hand to an auditor on request.

records.description: Prepare for GFSI-benchmarked certification audits, score and segment ingredient and packaging suppliers by safety and food-fraud risk, track supplier certifications and compliance obligations, and execute product recalls.
records.catalog_tagline: Walk into every certification audit prepared and keep supplier risk in view.
records.catalog_description:
Prepare for benchmarked certification audits with evidence binders, score forecasts, and a calendar that keeps nothing a surprise. Score and segment your ingredient and packaging suppliers by safety and food-fraud risk, and track the certifications and compliance obligations each one owes you.

When a recall is unavoidable, execute it with traceability and regulatory reporting built in, so you can act fast and show your work to customers and authorities.

records.description: Design-time authoring surface for low-code applications: visual page composition, custom business-object schema, bound external data sources, and AI-assisted generation. The build-side of the platform that produces deployable application artifacts.

Managed execution of built applications: process and workflow orchestration on a vendor-operated runtime, environment promotion across dev/test/prod, versioning, rollback, and observability. The run-side governance layer that keeps deployed apps enterprise-credible.

Server, network, storage, hypervisor, and container monitoring with metric collection, threshold policies, log aggregation, and topology-aware alerting. Ingests, normalizes, de-duplicates, and correlates the raw event stream into human-relevant alerts that page or ticket.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn a flood of infrastructure signals into a short list of alerts that matter, each tied to the service it affects.
records.catalog_description:
The monitoring and event core of IT operations. Ingest events from across servers, networks, and services, then let the policies you author decide what is normal, what is a warning, and what is a real problem. Correlate related events so one underlying fault raises one actionable alert instead of a hundred, and route each alert to the team that owns the affected service.

Operators get a single live view of infrastructure health, acknowledge and resolve alerts on a clear workflow, and hand off to incident management automatically when an alert needs a ticket. Tuning your monitoring policies over time means less noise, faster detection, and fewer surprises in production.

records.description: Trend analysis, forecasting, and what-if modeling of compute, storage, network, and license consumption from periodic resource utilization snapshots, supporting proactive scaling and cost allocation.
records.catalog_tagline: See where capacity is running out and forecast the upgrade before it becomes an outage.
records.catalog_description: Track how much of each resource you are actually using over time and turn that history into a forward view. Capture utilization datapoints across the estate, establish baselines for normal load, and project when CPU, memory, storage, or throughput will hit its ceiling. Planners spot the resources trending toward exhaustion, justify upgrades with evidence instead of guesswork, and avoid both the cost of overprovisioning and the risk of running out. Capacity decisions become a scheduled, data-backed routine rather than a reaction to the last incident.

records.description: Codified operational runbooks executed with approval gates for common incidents and maintenance tasks, plus enterprise job scheduling, batch automation, and dependency-aware cross-platform workload orchestration triggered by operational alerts.
records.catalog_tagline: Automate the routine recovery steps and scheduled work so the team is not paged for problems a runbook can fix.
records.catalog_description: Take the repeatable operational work off people's plates. When an alert fires, trigger the runbook that restarts the service, clears the queue, or scales the resource, and let a human step in only when the automation cannot resolve it. Schedule the recurring jobs and workloads that keep the estate healthy, and tie automated actions back to the alerts that prompted them so every run is traceable. The result is faster recovery, fewer after-hours pages, and consistent execution of the steps an experienced operator would take anyway.

records.description: Models the business domain as a formal ontology and stores it on a purpose-built graph engine that infers facts the team never asserted by hand. Authors and version-controls ontology classes, properties, and constraint shapes; runs the reasoning tier that materializes entailed relationships; and persists everything on a native graph store with transactions, replication, and backup.
records.catalog_tagline: Model your business as a living ontology and let the graph infer the facts you never wrote down.
records.catalog_description:
Capture your domain as a formal ontology: define the classes, properties, and constraints that describe how your business really works, and version every change so you can trust what gets published.

A built-in reasoning tier turns those definitions into answers, materializing relationships and entailed facts your team never had to assert by hand. Everything lives on a native graph store with transactions, replication, and backup, so the model that powers your apps and agents is durable and auditable.

Validate before you publish, promote a reviewed version when it is ready, and keep earlier versions for lineage. Downstream queries, applications, and AI agents all read from one shared, governed source of meaning.

records.description: Queries the unified graph, federates across remote and virtual sources without ETL, and grounds AI agents and operational apps in typed, lineage-tracked facts. Runs federated graph queries with named-graph access control, exposes relational and API sources as native graph data on demand, joins symbolic queries with vector search for retrieval, and lets code-first or low-code apps read and write back to the underlying graph entities.
records.catalog_tagline: Query one unified graph across every source, and ground your apps and AI agents in trusted, connected facts.
records.catalog_description:
Ask questions across your entire knowledge graph and federate to remote and virtual sources without moving or copying data first. Named-graph access control keeps each team scoped to what it is allowed to see.

Expose relational, document, and API sources as native graph data on demand, and combine symbolic queries with vector search so retrieval returns precise, explainable results instead of guesses. Every answer carries the lineage that shows where it came from.

Code-first and low-code applications read and write back to the same graph entities, and AI agents get typed, connected context they can reason over. Reconcile and merge duplicate records so the graph stays clean as it grows.

records.description: Member enrollment, profile, and program/tier design. Configures points-earn rules, tier thresholds, qualification windows, and retention logic, and links each member identity to the canonical customer record.
records.catalog_tagline: Enroll members, keep their profiles current, and move them up tiers as they engage.
records.catalog_description:
Stand up your loyalty program and bring members in. Capture each member's profile, track the activity that counts toward their status, and manage enrollment from sign-up through every change to their account.

Design the tier structure that fits your program: set the thresholds members reach, define what each tier unlocks, and let members climb (or slip) automatically as their engagement changes. Your most engaged customers see the recognition and perks that keep them coming back.

records.description: Double-entry points ledger and rewards fulfillment. Records accrual, redemption, adjustment, and expiry events with an auditable per-member balance, and runs the redeemable rewards catalog and redemption settlement.
records.catalog_tagline: Track every point earned and spent, and let members redeem rewards from a catalog you control.
records.catalog_description:
Run the engine that powers your rewards. Record every point a member earns or spends in a clear ledger, apply your accrual rules automatically, and keep balances accurate as activity posts, reverses, or expires.

Publish a catalog of rewards members can choose from and manage each one through its full life, from draft to live to retired. When a member redeems, walk the request through fulfillment to delivery so people get what they earned and you keep a complete record of every redemption.

records.description: Member-facing engagement surface. Runs time-bound bonus and multiplier promotions and gamified challenges, manages multi-brand coalition and partner-issued-points programs, and powers the branded self-service portal and mobile app.
records.catalog_tagline: Run bonus campaigns, partner offers, and a self-service member portal that keeps people coming back.
records.catalog_description:
Keep members active between purchases. Launch bonus-point promotions and limited-time offers that nudge the behavior you want, and extend reach through partner coalitions so members earn and redeem across a wider network.

Give members a portal where they can see their status, explore offers, and engage with the program on their own terms. Steady engagement turns occasional buyers into loyal regulars and gives your team a direct channel to the people who matter most.

records.description: Canonical registry where business metrics and the logical dimensional model are authored once and reused everywhere. Captures numerator, denominator, filters, dimensions, time grain, ownership, certification status, and lineage to physical sources, plus entity, hierarchy, conformed-dimension, and slowly-changing-dimension structure decoupled from physical tables. Governs metric and model changes through approval, certification, deprecation, and impact analysis on downstream consumers.
records.catalog_tagline: Define metrics and dimensional models once, then certify the version everyone trusts.
records.catalog_description:
Author each metric and the dimensional model behind it in one place, with a draft-to-certified workflow so consumers only ever see the trusted definition. Reviewers certify the version that becomes the single source of truth, and deprecate or retire old ones cleanly.

Compile and validate metrics before they ship, and translate plain-language questions into the right metric, dimension, and filter combination. When a definition changes, every downstream dashboard, report, and agent picks up the same update at once.

records.description: The execution tier that resolves the semantic model against physical sources and accelerates reads. Plans federated joins and pushes computation down to each backend across warehouses, relational databases, object storage, and APIs, then serves cached and pre-aggregated rollups from columnar storage with query rewriting and automatic invalidation. Captures an executed-query audit trail linking every metric read back to source tables, transformations, and the requesting identity.
records.catalog_tagline: Federate queries, cache the heavy ones, and keep full lineage for every metric.
records.catalog_description:
Schedule and run materializations so common metric queries return instantly instead of scanning the warehouse every time, and refresh them on demand when freshness matters. Stale and failed refreshes are surfaced so you can act before consumers notice.

Capture column-level lineage for every query the layer runs, so you can always trace a number back to the tables and definitions it came from, and estimate query cost before a heavy request runs.

records.description: Exposes the governed semantic model through many consumption surfaces at once: SQL for analytics tools, REST and GraphQL for applications, MDX for spreadsheet and legacy clients, and JDBC and ODBC for enterprise integration, alongside natural-language and tool-use access for AI agents grounded on certified metrics. Enforces row-level and metric-level access policy at the semantic-definition tier so every consumer reads the same governed numbers under the same rules.
records.catalog_tagline: Serve governed metrics over SQL, REST, and AI interfaces with access control built in.
records.catalog_description:
Deliver the same certified metrics to dashboards, web apps, and AI agents through SQL, JDBC, REST, and GraphQL, so every consumer asks for a metric by name and gets one consistent answer.

Control who can see which metrics, and at what row or cell grain, with access policies you author, activate, and supersede over time. Policy changes take effect on the next query, with no consumer rewrite required.

records.description: Manage CRE deals from prospect through letter-of-intent to executed lease, including lease-clause negotiation, sublease grants, and commercial-tenant credit underwriting that gates leasing decisions.
Partnership accounting for real-estate funds: maintain partner capital accounts, fee and carry schedules, and the mechanics of capital calls and waterfall distributions across GP and LP tiers.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep the books for your real estate funds, from capital calls and distributions to management fees and net asset value.
records.catalog_description: Run day-to-day fund accounting for every real estate fund you manage. Issue capital calls and track them through to funded, declare and pay distributions, and accrue asset management fees on a schedule you control. Maintain each fund's capital accounts and net asset value as activity flows in, so your numbers stay current between reporting cycles. When a call goes out or a distribution is declared, your limited partners are notified automatically, and the resulting entries are ready to post downstream to your general ledger.

records.description: Quarterly statements, capital-account roll-forwards, and tax forms delivered to limited partners through an investor-facing portal, drawing on lease income, capital calls, and distribution records.
records.catalog_tagline: Give your limited partners clear statements, live balances, and a portal they can log into any time.
records.catalog_description: Deliver a professional reporting experience to every investor in your funds. Produce capital account statements, distribution notices, and tax documents, and publish them to a self-service portal where limited partners can see their commitments, contributions, and balances on demand. Notify investors the moment a statement, capital call, or distribution is ready, and keep their records in sync with the underlying fund activity. The result is fewer one-off investor requests and a reporting cycle you can run on time, every period.

records.description: Property and portfolio valuation via cap rate, DCF, and direct comparison; acquisition underwriting with pro-forma cash flows and sponsor returns; net operating income and net asset value rollups across assets and funds.
records.catalog_tagline: Value your properties, refresh fund NAV, and underwrite new acquisitions from one portfolio view.
records.catalog_description: Track the value of every property across your portfolio and keep fund net asset value current. Schedule and record valuations, capture the inputs behind each one, and roll the results up so a quarterly NAV reflects the latest marks. Underwrite prospective acquisitions against the same data your existing holdings sit on, comparing assumptions and returns before you commit. With valuation and underwriting in one place, your investment team works from a single, trusted picture of the portfolio.

records.description: The core data-modeling surface: a self-contained namespace holding user-defined tables, rich field types, linked-record relationships across tables, formula and rollup columns, and the runtime schema that downstream views, forms, and automations bind to. The reason the platform is bought: model structured data without a developer.
records.catalog_tagline: Model your data without code: design tables, pick the right field types, and link records across them.
records.catalog_description:
Create the data model behind your tools without writing a line of code. Add your own tables, choose from rich field types for text, numbers, dates, attachments, single and multi-select, and more, and connect related records across tables so a customer, a project, or an order pulls in everything tied to it.

Go beyond plain storage with formula and rollup columns that calculate and summarize automatically as records change. The schema you build here becomes the foundation the rest of your workspace reads from, so the views, forms, and automations your team uses all stay in step with one source of truth.

records.description: The presentation and intake surface over the data model: switchable grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views that each filter, sort, group, and share independently, plus public or authenticated forms that write directly into a table. The everyday working surface for non-database users who read and contribute structured data.
records.catalog_tagline: See your data your way and collect new records through forms that write straight into your tables.
records.catalog_description:
Give every person the right window onto the same data. Switch between grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views, and filter, sort, and group each one independently so a planner, a reviewer, and an executive each see exactly what they need. Share a view with a teammate or a stakeholder without handing over the whole table.

Capture clean information at the source with forms that write directly into your tables. Publish a form for public or authenticated submissions, and every response lands as a structured record ready to work with, no copying or re-keying. It is the everyday working surface for people who read and contribute data without ever touching the underlying schema.

records.description: The no-code operations layer: record-triggered workflows, scheduled jobs, and outbound API calls, together with live or scheduled bidirectional synchronization to external systems of record so the database becomes a working surface over canonical data rather than a static copy.
records.catalog_tagline: Automate the busywork and keep your tables in sync with the systems you already run on.
records.catalog_description:
Replace manual follow-up with automations that run themselves. Trigger actions when a record is created or changes, or on a schedule you set, then notify the right people, update records, and call out to other services as part of the flow. The repetitive steps your team does by hand become reliable, hands-off workflows.

Keep your database connected to your systems of record. Sync data in or out, live or on a schedule, so your tables stay current with the canonical source instead of drifting into a stale copy. Your workspace becomes a working surface over real data, not a snapshot that someone has to keep refreshing.

records.description: Vacancy marketing, applicant screening, and lease execution for residential units. Advertises open units, syndicates listings, converts leads into applications, screens prospective tenants on credit, criminal, and eviction history, and drives the application-to-signed-lease workflow with move-in scheduling.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn vacant units into signed leases: market listings, screen applicants, and sign tenants in one pipeline.
records.catalog_description: Move every prospect from first inquiry to move-in. Publish vacant units to listing sites, capture applications, and screen applicants against credit, criminal, and eviction history with the required adverse-action steps. Draft, send, and sign leases, then track each tenant from prospective through current, notice given, and move-out. Fair-housing-aware inquiry handling and FCRA-compliant screening are built into the flow.

records.description: Rental-unit inventory of record plus the tenant-facing maintenance request portal. Tracks each lettable unit's amenities, occupancy, and current rent, and runs tenant-submitted maintenance tickets from intake through urgency triage, vendor dispatch, and resolution with tenant status updates.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep the portfolio running: track every unit's status and resolve maintenance requests end to end.
records.catalog_description: Manage the physical side of the portfolio. Hold the source-of-truth record for every rental unit and its availability, from vacant and listed through occupied and vacating. Take in maintenance requests from residents, triage and assign them, dispatch in-house or vendor crews, and follow each work order through to resolved and closed so nothing slips through the cracks.

records.description: Tenant rent collection and per-property accounting. Processes recurring and one-time rent payments across ACH, card, and cash, assesses late fees per lease terms, and maintains a per-property general ledger with portfolio rollup, owner statements, trust-account separation, and 1099 reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Collect rent, chase late balances, and keep the books straight for every property.
records.catalog_description: Run the money side of the portfolio. Bill recurring rent and charges, take payments, and apply prorations, late fees, and deposits automatically. Track each payment from due through received, late, delinquent, and collections, and keep a per-property general ledger that feeds owner statements, distributions, and investor reporting. Vendor bills paid through accounts payable reconcile back to the property they belong to.

records.description: Owned and leased property portfolio with building records, floor plans, and lease agreements. Covers acquisition and disposal lifecycle plus lease dates, renewals, rent calculations, and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 amortization.
Desk, room, and parking allocation with real-time occupancy tracking. Drives utilization heatmaps, badge-in rates, hybrid-work patterns, and occupancy forecasting across the workplace.

Preventive and corrective maintenance on buildings and workplace assets, plus electricity, water, gas, and waste metering. Tracks technician dispatch, asset history, cost allocation, and emissions activity data.
Building improvements, renovations, and expansions. Plans budgets, tracks timelines, and records completion status for capital work on the portfolio.

Annual reconciliation of common-area-maintenance expense pools across tenants with gross-up to occupancy and audit caps, plus CPI-indexed, stepped, fixed-percent, and percentage-rent escalation calculations against breakpoints.

Visualize building stacking plans by floor and suite, track vacant, leased, and expiring space, benchmark lease and sale comparables by submarket, manage commercial-tenant relations, and maintain property certifications that support underwriting and tenant appeal.

Establish and operate attended and unattended remote-control sessions over workstations and servers: code or agent based connection, NAT-traversal relay, in-session file transfer and clipboard sharing, and just-in-time privilege elevation. Owns the remote session as the unit of work and reads the operational agent liveness view plus the linked service incident.
records.catalog_tagline: Run live attended and unattended remote-control sessions on any endpoint, with file transfer and just-in-time privilege elevation built in.
records.catalog_description:
Establish a remote-control session to a workstation or server, whether a technician is invited in by the end user or you reach an unattended device on your own schedule. Work across firewalls and NAT without opening inbound ports, move files in both directions, share the clipboard, and step up to administrator rights only for the task at hand.

See live device health while you work, link the session to the open service ticket, and close it cleanly so downstream teams pick up exactly where you left off.

records.description: Capture, store, and govern session recordings and audit logs from remote-control sessions: full-session video, keystroke and command audit, tamper-evident retention, redaction state, and downstream compliance evidence. Owns the recording artifact with its own lifecycle distinct from the parent session.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture, store, and retain a tamper-evident record of every remote session, ready for any audit.
records.catalog_description:
Record full-session video alongside a keystroke and command audit trail for every remote-control session, then keep it safe and unaltered for as long as your retention policy or regulator requires.

Find the recording behind any session in seconds, control who can view it, redact sensitive content where needed, and release the evidence to your compliance and governance teams when they need proof of exactly what happened.

records.description: Multi-step outbound sequencing engine. Reps and automation enroll prospects into cadences that combine email, call, social, and video touches with timing and branching rules. Includes power and click-to-call dialing and third-party intent and buyer-signal scoring that triggers enrollment.
records.catalog_tagline: Put every prospect into a consistent, multi-channel outreach motion and dial through your list without losing the thread.
records.catalog_description:
Design multi-step sequences that combine email, calls, social touches, and manual tasks, then enroll prospects in bulk or one at a time. Timing and branching rules advance each prospect automatically, so reps always know exactly who to contact next and never let a follow-up go cold.

Work your call list faster with built-in dialing and let buyer-intent and engagement signals push the warmest prospects to the top of the queue, so your team spends its time where the interest already is.

records.description: One-to-one sales email with open, click, and reply tracking, reusable templates and snippets, and AI-assisted drafting and reply suggestions from prospect context. Includes prospect-facing booking links with availability, round-robin routing, and qualifier forms.
records.catalog_tagline: Send personal, trackable sales email and let prospects book time with you in a couple of clicks.
records.catalog_description:
Write one-to-one email that still scales, with reusable templates and snippets, and see who opened, clicked, and replied so you can follow up at the right moment. AI-assisted drafting and reply suggestions help reps respond faster and in the prospect's context.

Skip the scheduling back-and-forth with prospect-facing booking links that show real availability, route meetings to the right rep, and qualify attendees up front so the calendar fills with the meetings that matter.

records.description: Call and meeting recording, transcription, and AI-extracted talk ratios, objections, commitments, and next steps. Feeds scorecard-driven coaching workflows, cadence A/B comparison, and manager one-to-one preparation.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn every recorded call and meeting into clear next steps and repeatable coaching that ramps the whole team.
records.catalog_description:
Record and transcribe sales calls and meetings automatically, then get the highlights without listening to the whole thing: talk ratios, objections raised, commitments made, and the next steps that were agreed.

Use those insights to coach with evidence. Score conversations against your playbook, compare what's working across reps and cadences, and prep managers for one-on-ones so new reps ramp faster and your best techniques spread across the team.
