records.description: Authoring, scheduling, and publishing posts across connected social accounts from a unified queue and editorial calendar, with per-channel variants, approval workflow, bulk upload, an asset library, employee-advocacy content distribution, and cross-channel performance reporting.
Unified inbox for inbound comments, mentions, direct messages, and reviews on brand-owned accounts, with team assignment, SLA tracking, canned responses, and per-contact conversation history.

Saved monitoring queries that watch brand mentions, keywords, competitors, hashtags, and sentiment across networks, news, blogs, forums, and review sites, with topic clustering and alerting on off-channel buzz.

Discovery, vetting, contracting, briefing, content review, payment, and measurement of influencer and creator partnerships, including audience-overlap analysis, fraud detection, and user-generated-content campaigns.

Issuance and lifecycle of physical and virtual corporate cards plus real-time network-side authorization decisioning. Evaluates each authorization request against per-card limits, merchant category, vendor, amount, time, and geography, declining out-of-policy transactions before settlement. Covers multi-currency card spend with bank-grade FX.
records.catalog_tagline: Issue corporate cards with spending limits and approve or decline every charge against your rules in real time.
records.catalog_description:
Open and manage corporate card accounts, set per-card and per-category limits, and freeze or close cards the moment you need to. Every swipe is checked against your spending rules and approved or declined in real time, so out-of-policy charges never post.

Review authorizations as they happen, escalate high-value charges for an extra look, and keep multi-currency spend in view. Posted transactions flow on to expense and accounting so reconciliation is a check, not a chase.

records.description: Direct payment of vendor bills via ACH, wire, card, or check without a sourcing or purchase-order match. Routes each vendor payment authorization through an approval chain, enriches bank details, batches disbursements into payment runs, and reconciles to the ledger.
records.catalog_tagline: Approve vendor bills and route every payment by the right method, then release it on the next run.
records.catalog_description:
Approve what you owe each vendor, choose how to pay (ACH, wire, virtual card, or check), and route every payment through the right sign-off chain before it goes out. Approved authorizations queue for the next payment run and release automatically when a matching invoice clears.

Keep vendor invoices, payment runs, and supplier records in one view so bill pay stays in step with accounts payable and the general ledger.

records.description: Proactive employee requests for spend authorization before any transaction, evaluated against a versioned policy library and an approval workflow. The approval becomes the enforceable commitment used at card-authorization and bill-pay time. Covers out-of-pocket reimbursement requests, receipt capture, and aggregated spend analytics with anomaly detection.
records.catalog_tagline: Request spend, check it against policy, and get the right approval before any money is committed.
records.catalog_description:
Stop overspend before it starts. Employees submit a request, the system checks it against your spending policy, and it routes to the right approver based on amount, category, and team. Nothing is committed until it clears.

Maintain one policy library that drives approvals across cards, bill pay, and reimbursement, and watch requested versus committed spend so budget owners always know what is in the pipeline before it lands on the ledger.

records.description: Continuous vehicle-location and movement telemetry: GPS waypoint streaming, trip segmentation, idle detection, geofence crossings, and engine-diagnostic ingestion. The position-and-utilization data layer feeding live maps, route playback, and downstream fleet analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Track every vehicle in real time and turn raw GPS, trips, and idling into decisions you can act on.
records.catalog_description:
Watch your whole fleet move on a live map and replay any trip after the fact. Every vehicle reports its position continuously, so you always know who is where, which routes ran long, and where time is being lost to idling or out-of-area driving.

Geofences alert you the moment a vehicle enters or leaves a site, and trip-level summaries roll the raw waypoints up into mileage, stops, and utilization you can report on. The result is tighter routing, less wasted fuel, and answers to dispatch and customer questions in seconds instead of phone calls.

records.description: The regulated and safety-facing surface: electronic hours-of-service logs, video-telematics incident capture, driver-behavior event detection, and composite safety scoring. Hosts the FMCSA hours-of-service compliance leg and the video-and-coaching workflow that turns risky-event triggers into driver safety outcomes.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep drivers safe and audits painless with hours-of-service logs, video events, and safety scores in one place.
records.catalog_description:
Capture electronic hours-of-service logs automatically and certify them without paper, so drivers stay legal and audits stop being a fire drill. When a driver brakes hard, speeds, or has a near-miss, the event and its video land in one queue ready for review and coaching.

Per-driver safety scorecards turn those events into a clear, trend-able measure of risk, so you can coach the right people, reward the safest, and show insurers and regulators that your fleet is getting safer over time. Fewer incidents, lower premiums, and a defensible record when you need one.

records.description: Enroll, onboard, and retire managed endpoints across Windows, Apple, Android, and ChromeOS. Covers zero-touch provisioning, enrollment-token issuance and redemption, and the deployment-result log that records each onboarding and policy push outcome per device.

Author and deploy OS-level configuration profiles and distribute managed applications to endpoint cohorts. Covers Wi-Fi, VPN, certificate, restriction, and encryption settings templates alongside the app catalog, silent install and update, and per-device app assignment tracking.

Define endpoint compliance baselines and evaluate device posture on a recurring cadence. Covers OS-version floors, encryption and password enforcement, jailbreak and root detection, and the per-device scan results that drive conditional-access decisions and remediation.

Deploys, tracks, and governs the installed agent fleet across multi-tenant endpoint estates: agent liveness and health, hardware and software inventory, network discovery of unmanaged hosts, and per-customer logical isolation of the managed estate.
records.catalog_tagline: Roll out monitoring agents, watch every device stay online, and retire them cleanly when hardware leaves service.
records.catalog_description: Deploy a lightweight agent to each endpoint and server, then track its check-in, version, and health at a glance. As agents come online they surface the hardware, software, and devices they find, so your inventory stays current without manual audits. When a machine goes quiet you know right away, and when an asset is retired the agent is removed without leaving loose ends.

records.description: Collects real-time telemetry from managed endpoints, evaluates it against thresholds and policies, generates de-duplicated alerts with notification routing, and applies AI assistance for triage, root-cause hints, and natural-language operations queries. Reads the alert and policy masters owned by the broader IT operations monitoring layer.
records.catalog_tagline: Catch problems on managed devices the moment they start, and route the right alert to the right person.
records.catalog_description: Define what to watch on each device and the thresholds that matter, then let incoming telemetry be checked continuously against those policies. When a condition crosses the line, an alert is raised, deduplicated, and sent to whoever needs it. Acknowledge, resolve, or suppress alerts to keep the noise down, and hand off anything that needs a ticket to your service desk automatically.

records.description: Discovers, approves, schedules, and deploys OS and third-party patches across endpoint groups within maintenance windows, with per-endpoint execution status and rollback on failure. Emits change records into the service-change pipeline.
records.catalog_tagline: Patch operating systems and third-party software on schedule, within maintenance windows, with a safety net.
records.catalog_description: Plan patch jobs against the exact set of devices you choose and run them inside approved maintenance windows so users are not interrupted. Track each deployment as it runs, see per-device success and failure, and roll back when a patch causes trouble. Keep machines current against known fixes without standing over them, and feed the change record straight into your change-management process.

records.description: Authors, versions, schedules, and executes scripts against managed endpoints from a reusable script library, with secure parameter passing and per-target execution history. The remediation and bulk-operation engine driven by alerts and patch outcomes.
records.catalog_tagline: Run trusted scripts across your whole fleet to fix issues and automate routine work, safely and on demand.
records.catalog_description: Build a library of reusable scripts with version history and parameters, approve the ones cleared for production, and run them against one device or thousands. Automate the repetitive fixes that used to eat an afternoon, respond to alerts with remediation that runs itself, and keep a record of what ran where and how it turned out. Approval gates keep risky changes from reaching endpoints before a human has signed off.

records.description: Raise staffing requisitions, distribute them to tiered staffing suppliers, govern pre-agreed rate cards, and onboard contingent workers with a typed classification basis. Procurement governs the supplier panel and rate cards; HR governs worker classification.
records.catalog_tagline: Source contingent workers through approved staffing suppliers and govern the rate cards they bill against.
records.catalog_description: Raise staffing requisitions and distribute them to a tiered panel of approved suppliers, then track candidates through to active worker assignments. Approve rate cards by role and region so every engagement bills against a governed rate, and classify each worker so tenure and co-employment risk stay visible. Procurement runs the supplier panel and rates; HR owns worker classification.

records.description: Capture and approve contingent timesheets against assignments, then compute and reconcile supplier invoices from approved hours and rate cards for downstream three-way match and payment.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture and approve contingent timesheets, then reconcile supplier invoices to approved hours and rates.
records.catalog_description: Collect contingent-worker timesheets against their assignments and move them through submit, approve, and bill. Compute supplier invoices from approved hours and the published rate cards, then reconcile each invoice through three-way match before it is released for payment. Approved hours and matched invoices flow on to payroll, project accounting, and the general ledger automatically.

records.description: Crawl-based inventory and scheduled audit of web content across one or more sites. Surfaces page-level metadata, ownership, freshness, health scoring, and orphaned-page detection so the web team can govern the full content estate.
records.catalog_tagline: See every page you publish, and how healthy it is.
records.catalog_description: Crawl your sites to build a living inventory of every page, then run scheduled audits that score freshness, ownership, and health. Spot orphaned pages, stale content, and gaps before your visitors do. Give the web team a single, trustworthy map of the whole content estate so nothing slips through unmanaged.

records.description: Editorial calendar, briefs, assignments, and draft / review / approval workflow over web content production, plus content-lifecycle governance: review cadence, refresh frequency, retirement, and successor planning across campaigns, channels, audiences, and personas.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan, assign, and refresh content on a calendar everyone can see.
records.catalog_description: Manage content production from brief through draft, review, and approval, and govern what happens after publish. Set review cadences, schedule refreshes, plan retirements, and line up successors so pages never go stale unnoticed. Keep editorial work and lifecycle planning organized across campaigns, channels, audiences, and personas in one shared view.

records.description: Automated scanning of web content for accessibility conformance, brand voice and style adherence, readability, and policy compliance, with prioritized remediation queues, severity scoring, and evidence reporting for legal and procurement.
records.catalog_tagline: Catch accessibility and brand-voice problems before your visitors do.
records.catalog_description: Scan your web content automatically for accessibility conformance, brand voice and style, readability, and policy compliance. Triage findings by severity, route them to the right owner, and track remediation from detected through resolved or verified. Produce the evidence reports legal and procurement need to show your site meets its accessibility obligations.

records.description: Continuous monitoring of crawlability, indexation, canonical and structured-data health, and broken internal / external links across large web estates, with owner notification and remediation tracking into editorial workflow.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep your site crawlable, indexed, and free of broken links.
records.catalog_description: Continuously monitor crawlability, indexation, canonical and structured-data health, and broken internal and external links across large web estates. Surface technical SEO issues and dead links, notify the owners who can fix them, and track each finding to resolution. Protect search visibility and visitor experience without manual spot checks.

records.description: Animal-patient clinical record: species/breed/weight/microchip master, examination history, vaccination protocols, lab-results integration with reference labs and in-house analyzers, and preventive-care reminder management driving recall outreach.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every animal patient's clinical record, vaccinations, and lab results in one place, and never miss a preventive-care recall.
records.catalog_description:
Manage the full clinical picture for every animal patient. Capture species, breed, weight, and microchip details, record examinations over time, and run vaccination protocols that fit each patient.

Order diagnostics, review results as they come back, and flag critical findings for fast follow-up. Built-in preventive-care reminders drive recall outreach so patients return on schedule and nothing falls through the cracks.

records.description: Pet-owner client relationship master with contact, communication preferences, and balance history, plus appointment scheduling with species/exam-type fit and waitlist handling, and services/product/lab/drug invoicing with in-clinic point-of-sale and payer integration.
records.catalog_tagline: Manage client relationships, book the right appointments, and bill for visits and products from one front desk.
records.catalog_description:
Give your front office one place to manage every pet owner: contact details, communication preferences, and account balances. Reach clients the way they prefer to keep them informed and engaged.

Schedule appointments that match the patient and exam type, handle waitlists with ease, and invoice for services, products, lab work, and medications. In-clinic point-of-sale and payment handling close the loop from booking to payment.

records.description: Drug inventory with lot tracking and automated reorder thresholds, plus the DEA-required controlled-substance receipt, dispensation, and disposal ledger with Schedule II to V reconciliation evidence.
records.catalog_tagline: Track drug inventory and keep a defensible controlled-substance ledger ready for inspection.
records.catalog_description:
Stay on top of your pharmacy. Track drug inventory by lot, set automated reorder thresholds, and avoid running short on what your patients need.

Maintain a complete controlled-substance ledger covering receipt, dispensation, and disposal, with reconciliation evidence for Schedule II through V. Every entry is captured and attributable, so you can demonstrate compliance with confidence.

records.description: The real-time signal-reduction half of AIOps. Ingests high-volume events, alerts, metrics, and traces from the monitoring estate, detects anomalies against learned baselines, correlates and deduplicates related signals into single incidents, and applies suppression rules (including planned-change windows) to cut alert noise. Masters event_correlations, anomaly_detections, and alert_suppression_rules; consumes monitoring_events, monitoring_alerts, distributed_traces, and configuration_items owned by OBS / RMM / CMDB. Used standalone by ops teams that only need noise reduction, or alongside Predictive Intelligence for the full closed loop.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn a flood of raw events and alerts into a short, correlated, low-noise list of incidents your on-call teams can actually act on.
records.catalog_description:
Event Correlation sits across the events, alerts, metrics, and traces your IT estate produces every second and uses machine learning to find the few patterns that matter. It detects anomalies against learned baselines, groups related signals into a single correlated incident, and deduplicates the rest so a storm of alerts becomes one clear issue.

Noise reduction is built in: suppression rules silence flapping alerts and mute the estate during planned changes, and those suppression decisions flow straight back to the monitoring layer so the whole operational loop stays in sync. The result is fewer pages, less triage, and an on-call experience focused on real problems instead of alert fatigue.

records.description: The analytical, forward-looking half of AIOps. Forecasts incidents and capacity problems, elevates predictive signals above action thresholds, infers probable root cause for correlated incidents, and runs the ML training lifecycle (including drift detection) that keeps the detection and prediction models trustworthy. Masters predictive_signals, incident_predictions, root_cause_analyses, and ml_model_training_records; consumes data_pipelines and configuration_items owned by DATA-AI-PLAT / CMDB. Typically deployed alongside Event Correlation, which supplies the correlated incidents that root-cause and prediction reason over.
records.catalog_tagline: Forecast outages before they hit, surface the probable root cause, and keep the models behind it all trained and trustworthy.
records.catalog_description:
Predictive Intelligence is the part of AIOps that looks ahead. It detects leading indicators of trouble, elevates high-confidence predictive signals, and forecasts incidents and capacity exhaustion while there is still time to act, opening proactive tickets before users feel the impact.

When an incident does land, it infers the probable root cause from topology, change, and signal evidence so responders start from an answer. Behind the scenes, detection and prediction models are continuously retrained and watched for drift, and completed root-cause findings flow into incident and problem workflows. The result is faster mean time to resolution and a forward-looking view of service health rather than a purely reactive one.

records.description: Owns the physical-asset register and the space hierarchy: sites, rooms, rows, cabinets, racks, and rack-unit occupancy, plus the moves/adds/changes workflow that keeps the live model aligned with what is physically installed. This module is the system of record for where every piece of equipment sits and how much rack and floor space remains.
records.catalog_tagline: Know exactly what is installed in every rack and how much space is left, with a live floor plan instead of a stale spreadsheet.
records.catalog_description:
Asset and Space Management gives facilities and IT infrastructure teams an authoritative model of the physical estate. Map every site, room, row, cabinet, and rack, then place equipment unit by unit so you always know what is installed and where.

Rack-unit occupancy, weight, and depth are tracked against each cabinet, so planners can see headroom at a glance and avoid the surprise of a full rack. Every install, decommission, and relocation flows through a moves-adds-changes workflow, keeping the register accurate and producing a clean audit trail for the configuration database and downstream operations.

records.description: Models the full power chain from incoming circuit through PDUs and uninterruptible supplies to the outlet, the cooling estate that keeps equipment in range, and the environmental sensor telemetry that triggers alarms. This module realizes the power, thermal, and environmental capabilities and emits the failure, overload, failover, and threshold-breach events the catalog already hands off to ITSM, ITOM, and AIOPS.
records.catalog_tagline: Trace power from the circuit to the outlet, keep every cabinet in its thermal envelope, and catch environmental problems before they cause an outage.
records.catalog_description:
Power and Environmental Monitoring tracks the chain that keeps a data center alive. Follow power from the incoming circuit through distribution units and uninterruptible supplies down to the individual outlet, with phase balance, redundancy, and draw measured against rated capacity at each link.

Cooling units and thermal zones are modeled alongside cabinet-level temperature and humidity, so equipment stays inside its operating range. Sensors stream temperature, humidity, smoke, water-leak, and airflow readings, and when a circuit overloads, a UPS fails over, a cooling unit fails, or a threshold is breached, the event is captured and routed to the teams and systems that need to act.

records.description: Combines forward-looking capacity planning for power, cooling, space, and bandwidth with the physical connectivity map of ports and cables. Capacity plans roll up utilization and growth forecasts per site and zone (handed off to SPM for build-out decisions), while the port and cable register feeds the configuration database and is cross-validated by NPMD.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan power, cooling, space, and bandwidth headroom with confidence, and map every port and cable so nothing is a mystery.
records.catalog_description:
Capacity and Connectivity Planning turns the live asset and telemetry layer into a forward-looking plan. Project power, cooling, space, and bandwidth headroom per site and zone, run what-if scenarios for new equipment, and use the headroom view to schedule growth, justify build-outs, and negotiate colocation.

Underneath sits the physical connectivity map: every port and every cable, including patch panels and trunk runs, documented end to end. When a connection is added or changed, the configuration database picks up the new physical topology and network operations can cross-validate logical paths against the wiring that actually exists.

records.description: The ACD and flow engine. Owns omnichannel ingestion, skills-based queueing, and the IVR/self-service flow runtime that places each interaction into the right queue. Realizes routing and IVR capabilities. Masters queue_statistics as the computed view of queue health and disposition_codes as the catalog of outcome codes applied downstream. Consumes CRM customers and KMS knowledge as routing and self-service context.
records.catalog_tagline: Route every call, chat, and message to the right agent, and let self-service handle the rest.
records.catalog_description:
Bring voice and every digital channel into one set of queues and route each interaction to the agent best suited to handle it, by skill, priority, and customer tier. Self-service menus and callback offers deflect and speed up the simple requests before they ever reach a queue.

Watch queue health in one place: wait times, abandon rates, and service levels update live, and threshold alerts fire before service slips. Outcome codes captured at the desk roll up here so you can see why customers are calling and tune routing accordingly.

records.description: The live interaction workspace. Owns the support session as the unit of agent work, the contact record captured for every interaction, and agent_states that track presence and availability. Realizes the agent-desktop and workforce-engagement/adherence capabilities. Consumes WFM schedules to compare actual state against plan rather than mastering scheduling here.
records.catalog_tagline: Give agents one screen to handle every interaction, with full context and clean wrap-up.
records.catalog_description:
Agents see the customer's cross-channel history the moment an interaction connects, and handle it with hold, transfer, conference, and consult from a single workspace. Each contact ends with a clear disposition code that feeds reporting and follow-up.

Presence and availability are tracked continuously, so routing always knows who can take the next interaction and supervisors can see who is on, off, or in wrap. Time spent in each state is compared against the plan to flag adherence and auxiliary-time issues as they happen.

records.description: Post-interaction quality and reporting. Owns call recordings as the captured evidence of each interaction, interaction_evaluations as supervisor scoring against forms, and evaluation_forms as the reusable scorecard catalog. Realizes the recording, quality-management/coaching, and analytics capabilities. Consumes contact_records and support_sessions as the interactions under review and SLA definitions for breach reporting.
records.catalog_tagline: Record, score, and report on every interaction to keep quality and service levels on target.
records.catalog_description:
Capture voice and transcript for every interaction, with consent handling and pause/resume so sensitive data stays out of the recording. Recordings are available for quality review, dispute resolution, and compliance retention.

Supervisors score interactions against evaluation forms, calibrate across reviewers, and assign coaching to close the gaps. Real-time dashboards and historical reports break performance down by queue, agent, skill, and disposition so you can act before service levels slip.

records.description: Owns the discovery-to-finding pipeline: scan jobs run against an asset population, results are matched to the vulnerability knowledge base, and per-asset findings are created and deduplicated into the vulnerability lifecycle. Consumes asset masters from ITAM/CMDB and software inventory from SAM rather than mastering them.
records.catalog_tagline: Scan everything you own continuously and turn raw scan output into deduplicated, tracked findings.
records.catalog_description:
Discover what you own, then scan it on a continuous cadence so new exposures surface within hours instead of at the next quarterly review. Network, host, web, container, and cloud scans run against your asset population and produce findings tied to a specific asset and a specific vulnerability definition.

Each finding is matched against a maintained knowledge base of known vulnerabilities, deduplicated, and tracked through its own lifecycle so a weakness opened today is the same record you confirm, remediate, and verify weeks later. The knowledge base keeps CVE metadata, advisories, and check definitions current so detection stays accurate as the threat surface moves.

records.description: Owns the ranking layer and the point-in-time assessment lens. Computes risk-based priority over open vulnerabilities using exploit intel, asset criticality, and exposure, and groups vulnerabilities into scoped assessments or campaigns for posture snapshots and audit windows. Consumes exploit and known-exploited intelligence from THREAT-INTEL.
records.catalog_tagline: Fix the weaknesses an attacker would actually use first, and prove your posture over time.
records.catalog_description:
Not every finding deserves the same urgency. Layer exploit-prediction signals, known-exploited and actively-attacked intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure on top of base severity to produce a ranked queue that answers the only question that matters at scale: what do we fix this week.

Scope assessments and remediation campaigns over an asset population to capture a point-in-time posture snapshot for an audit window or program milestone, and watch the ranked queue shrink as the right fixes land. Exploit and active-attack signals are consumed from a dedicated threat-intelligence source so prioritization always reflects the current threat landscape.

records.description: Owns the closed loop after prioritization: remediation work with ownership and due dates, governed exceptions and risk acceptances, verification re-scans, and compliance evidence. Remediation records are mastered here as the security-side workflow; where an org routes fixes through a service desk, these hand off to ITSM change/incident records rather than duplicating them.
records.catalog_tagline: Route fixes to the right owner, govern the exceptions, verify the close, and hand auditors the evidence.
records.catalog_description:
Route prioritized findings to the team that owns the fix as remediation work with due dates, ownership, SLAs, and patch or configuration guidance. Give the business a governed path to formally accept and time-box the risks it chooses not to fix yet, with approver sign-off and expiry-driven re-review.

Close the loop and keep it auditable. Re-scan to confirm fixes actually landed, reopen anything that regresses, and watch mean-time-to-remediate trend down by asset group, business unit, and severity. Hand auditors defensible evidence that scanning cadence, remediation timelines, and exception approvals meet the obligations that frameworks such as PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, and NIS2 expect.

records.description: Connector registry, cross-platform content inventory, content-type policy, and health scoring.
records.catalog_tagline: See every piece of content across all your intranets in one map.
records.catalog_description: Connect SharePoint, Viva, Staffbase, Simpplr, or WordPress and automatically build a living inventory of every page, hub, library, and form. Classify content by type, score its health and accessibility, and know exactly what exists before you decide what to fix.

records.description: Accountable ownership assignments, recertification attestations, and the improvement backlog.
records.catalog_tagline: Put a name on every page and keep it accountable over time.
records.catalog_description: Assign an accountable owner and review cadence to each piece of content, run recertification cycles so owners confirm what is current or flag what is stale, and turn the gaps into a prioritized improvement backlog. The accountability layer that keeps your intranet from decaying into a ghost town.

records.description: The discovery and inventory surface: crawls and registers data assets, organizes them into subject-area data domains, and exposes search, browse, and metadata. Masters data_assets and data_domains. Deploys standalone as the catalog core or alongside the governance modules.
records.catalog_tagline: Find and understand every dataset across your data estate from one searchable catalog.
records.catalog_description: Automatically discover datasets, tables, files, and APIs across your sources and bring them into one searchable inventory. Organize assets into business subject areas, see ownership and technical detail at a glance, and give everyone a trusted starting point for finding the right data. The catalog is the home base that the lineage, glossary, stewardship, and governance modules build on.

records.description: Captures and presents flow edges between data assets with column-level mapping and transformation logic, and runs impact analysis when a source changes. Masters data_lineage_relationships; carries an embedded shell of data_assets so it deploys standalone.
records.catalog_tagline: Trace where data comes from and what breaks when it changes, end to end.
records.catalog_description: See how data flows from source to report across every pipeline and transformation, down to the column level. When a schema or upstream source changes, run impact analysis to know exactly which downstream assets, dashboards, and consumers are affected before anything breaks. Lineage turns the catalog from a static inventory into a living map of how your data actually moves.

records.description: The shared business-language layer: authors, reviews, publishes, and deprecates glossary terms and links them to physical assets. Masters glossary_terms; embeds ontologies as an optional formal-model shell. Runs a draft-review-publish-deprecate workflow.
records.catalog_tagline: Give the whole organization one agreed definition for every business term.
records.catalog_description: Build a shared vocabulary so Revenue, Active Customer, and Churn mean the same thing everywhere. Propose terms, route them through steward review, publish the approved definition, and link each term to the real data assets behind it. Optional ontology authoring adds formal relationships between concepts. A governed glossary is what lets self-service data consumers trust what they find.

records.description: The accountability layer: assigns stewards and owners to assets and terms, tracks responsibility, runs escalation, and manages the certification attestation by which an owner declares an asset production-ready. Masters data_stewardship_assignments and data_certifications; embeds data_assets.
records.catalog_tagline: Put a named owner behind every important dataset and certify what is fit to use.
records.catalog_description: Assign stewards and owners to the data that matters, make responsibility visible, and escalate when stewardship gaps appear. When an owner attests that an asset meets quality and compliance bars, certify it so consumers can tell trusted data from the rest at a glance, with validity periods and revocation when things change. Clear ownership is what turns a catalog into governed data people can rely on.

records.description: The policy and sensitivity layer: classifies assets (PII/PCI/PHI/confidential) through an approval workflow, authors data access policies, and routes access requests to a single accountable approver. Masters data_classifications and data_access_policies; embeds data_assets. Authors policy; enforcement is provisioned downstream (DLP/DSPM/IGA).
records.catalog_tagline: Classify sensitive data and decide who can use it, by policy not by ticket.
records.catalog_description: Detect and label sensitive data, run classifications through steward approval, and lock them once approved so access cannot quietly drift. Author access policies that say who can use which data under what conditions, and route every access request through one accountable approver. Access Governance is where the catalog stops being a map and starts being the control point for safe, compliant data use.

records.description: The publishing and marketplace surface: packages governed data products with explicit contracts, surfaces certified metric definitions, and tracks usage and popularity. Masters data_usage_metrics; embeds data_products (canonical DATA-AI-PLAT) and metric_definitions (canonical METRICS-LAYER).
records.catalog_tagline: Publish governed data products and metrics consumers can find, trust, and reuse.
records.catalog_description: Turn raw datasets into governed data products with explicit contracts: schema, SLA, owner, access policy, and intended consumers. Publish certified metric definitions so everyone calculates Revenue the same way, and track usage and popularity to see what is actually valuable and what has gone stale. This is the marketplace where producers ship trusted data and consumers shop for it within the rules.

records.description: Captures incoming demand (ideas, requests, project proposals), screens it, and scores each candidate on business value, cost, risk, and strategic alignment. The output is a prioritized, value-assessed funnel that feeds Portfolio Planning. Deployable standalone as a lightweight intake-and-scoring layer.
records.catalog_tagline: Take in every request, score it on business value, and let the strongest ideas rise to the top.
records.catalog_description:
Demand and Value Management is the front door to your portfolio. Ideas, requests, and project proposals come in through one standardized intake, get screened by an intake board, and are scored on business value, cost, risk, and strategic fit.

A published value assessment freezes so funding and prioritization decisions can rely on it. Approved demand graduates into funded initiatives, ready for portfolio planning, so you spend your capacity on the work that matters most.

records.description: The heart of SPM: groups funded initiatives into strategic portfolios, schedules roadmap items with their dependencies, maps dependency chains that threaten delivery, and tracks benefits against each investment's business case. Embeds strategic_initiatives from SEM (local shell when SEM is absent, defers to SEM's canonical master when co-deployed).
records.catalog_tagline: Group initiatives into portfolios, schedule the roadmap, and follow the benefits to realization.
records.catalog_description:
Portfolio Planning turns funded initiatives into a defensible plan. Structure portfolios that roll up to corporate strategy, sequence roadmap items with their dependencies in view, and surface the dependency chains that put delivery at risk.

After the plan is set, keep it honest: track benefits against the case that justified each investment, flag the ones falling behind, and rebalance the portfolio when priorities shift.

records.description: Commits people, budget, and capacity to initiatives against available supply, detects allocation conflicts, and models what-if scenarios before a commitment is made. Consumes workforce_scenarios (SWP), financial_scenarios (EPM), position_demand_forecasts (SWP), work_items (WORK-MGMT), and service_projects (PSA) to ground capacity decisions.
records.catalog_tagline: Match people and budget to the work, spot conflicts early, and model the trade-offs before you commit.
records.catalog_description:
Resource and Capacity Planning is the engine that makes the portfolio real. Every initiative competes for the same people, budget, and time, so allocations are committed against actual capacity and conflicts are caught before they bite.

Model what-if scenarios side by side, freeze each evaluated plan as a stable snapshot for comparison, and commit with confidence using a single resource-committee sign-off.

records.description: Sources bookable travel content across GDS, NDC, and direct suppliers, runs policy-aware shopping, and creates and manages air, hotel, rail, and car reservations. Masters the search results, the reservations, and the unused-ticket credits. Used standalone for a self-booking program and alongside the policy, profile, and duty-of-care modules for a managed program.
records.catalog_tagline: Shop in-policy travel across every source and book it in seconds.
records.catalog_description: Search flights, hotels, rail, and cars from one place, with policy-fit and price shown up front so travelers pick the right option fast. Hold, change, and cancel reservations cleanly, and never lose prepaid value: unused tickets and credits are tracked and reapplied to the next trip automatically.

records.description: Assembles booked segments into a single trip the traveler can view, change, and track, keeping the itinerary synchronized through additions, modifications, and disruptions. Masters the trip container and the itinerary. The seam where the trip record and its charges hand off to the expense and spend domains.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep the whole trip in one itinerary, always up to date.
records.catalog_description: Every booked segment rolls up into one trip your traveler can see and change, and stays in sync when plans shift or flights are disrupted. The complete trip record flows straight to expense and spend, so finance reconciles charges without chasing anyone for details.

records.description: Maintains per-traveler profiles (preferences, loyalty, documents, emergency contacts) and the travel policy plus pre-trip approval workflow. Masters traveler profiles, travel policies, and trip approvals. Drives policy-aware shopping in the booking module and feeds traveler identity into duty-of-care.
records.catalog_tagline: Personalize booking with traveler profiles and keep trips within policy.
records.catalog_description: Give every traveler a profile with their loyalty numbers, document details, preferences, and emergency contacts, so booking is fast and compliant. Set travel policy once and route out-of-policy or high-cost trips for pre-trip approval, capturing exceptions and sign-offs along the way.

records.domain_module_name: Duty of Care and Traveler Risk
records.description: Monitors traveler location against destination risk intelligence, raises alerts on emerging threats, and supports locating and assisting travelers during disruptions. Masters the duty-of-care alerts. Reads traveler profiles and trip itineraries to know who is where.
records.catalog_tagline: Know where your travelers are and keep them safe on the road.
records.catalog_description: See where every traveler is at a glance, match their trips against live destination risk, and get alerted the moment something threatens them. When disruption hits, locate affected travelers fast and act on your duty-of-care obligation instead of scrambling.

records.description: Masters the marketing plan hierarchy (plans and plan lines) and the shared marketing calendar. Coordinates the planned program across teams, channels, and time, and references work-management tasks/projects and marketing-execution campaigns rather than re-implementing them. Deployed alongside the budget module for a full planning-plus-budget kernel, or standalone for plan and calendar coordination.
records.catalog_tagline: Lay out the whole marketing program as a plan hierarchy on one shared calendar.
records.catalog_description: Author the annual and quarterly marketing plan as a hierarchy of plan lines, each with an owner, objective, and time window, and see the entire program on a shared campaign and content calendar. Link plan lines to the campaigns your execution tools run and the tasks your teams own, so the plan stays connected to the work without duplicating it.

records.description: Masters marketing budgets, plan-line budget allocations, spend records, and plan-level performance metrics. Provides top-down allocation, committed-and-actual spend capture, spend-to-plan reconciliation, and marketing-ROI measurement. The defensible MRM kernel that no work-management or asset domain owns.
records.catalog_tagline: Allocate marketing budget top-down and reconcile every dollar of spend back to the plan.
records.catalog_description: Set marketing budgets and allocate them top-down across plans, plan lines, campaigns, and channels. Capture committed and actual spend, reconcile it against each allocation to reveal remaining budget and variance, and route allocations and spend through approval. Measure plan-level performance and marketing ROI so you can tie results and pipeline contribution back to what funded them.

records.description: Core safety system-of-record. Masters safety incidents, hazards, occupational risk assessments, and corrective actions, plus the statutory OSHA 300 and 301 injury logs. Used standalone as the entry point for any EHS program and alongside the inspection, hygiene, and environmental modules.
records.catalog_tagline: Log every incident and near-miss, control your hazards, and close out corrective actions fast.
records.catalog_description: Report injuries, illnesses, and near-misses from any device, then run a structured investigation to root cause and recordability. Build a living hazard register from job hazard analyses and risk assessments, and turn every finding into a tracked corrective or preventive action with owners and due dates. Keep your OSHA 300 and 301 logs accurate and ready for the annual summary and electronic submission.

records.description: Occupational health and exposure module. Masters industrial-hygiene samples, occupational health records, and the chemical inventory and safety data sheets that drive hazard communication and exposure assessment. Used by manufacturing, process, and lab-heavy organizations where worker exposure is a primary risk.
records.catalog_tagline: Monitor exposures, manage occupational health records, and keep chemicals and SDS under control.
records.catalog_description: Plan and record industrial-hygiene sampling against occupational exposure limits for chemical, noise, and other agents, and link results back to the workers and tasks exposed. Maintain medical surveillance and exposure records, respirator fit tests, and audiometric results with the retention rules occupational health demands. Keep a current chemical inventory and safety data sheet library so hazard communication and exposure assessment stay accurate.

records.description: Environmental side of the EHS program. Masters environmental permits and their conditions, and contributes emission and release records into corporate sustainability disclosure. Tracks aspect and impact obligations for ISO 14001 and statutory environmental reporting. Used by permitted and regulated sites.
records.catalog_tagline: Stay on top of environmental permits, limits, and emissions reporting before deadlines slip.
records.catalog_description: Track every environmental permit, its conditions and limits, and the monitoring and renewal obligations for air, water, and waste. Record emissions and releases against limits and feed the same data into corporate sustainability disclosure. Keep your environmental aspect and impact register current for ISO 14001, and never miss a regulatory reporting deadline.

records.description: Assurance module. Masters EHS inspections and management-system audits, contractor safety qualification records, and EHS training and competency records. Shares corrective actions with the safety module. Used to demonstrate conformance to ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 and to govern contractors and required training.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan and run inspections and audits, qualify your contractors, and prove training is current.
records.catalog_description: Schedule and conduct safety inspections, observations, and management-system audits against standards such as ISO 45001 and ISO 14001, and route every finding into a tracked corrective action. Prequalify and monitor contractors against safety criteria tied to site access and permit-to-work. Map required EHS training to roles and regulations, deliver it, and keep the competency and certification records that prove your program is working.

records.description: The ASC 842 / IFRS 16 accounting kernel. Masters the right-of-use assets, lease liabilities, classifications, payment and amortization schedules, modifications, disclosures, and the journal entries that post lease activity to the general ledger. This is the certification-grade financial-compliance core owned by the controller's team; it is not part of any real-estate domain.
records.catalog_tagline: Recognize, measure, and disclose every lease on the balance sheet.
records.catalog_description: Run the lease subledger your auditors trust. Calculate right-of-use assets and lease liabilities, generate amortization and interest schedules, classify finance versus operating under ASC 842 or run the IFRS 16 single model, and post clean journal entries to the general ledger. Handle modifications and remeasurements without rebuilding the math, and produce the weighted-average rate, maturity-analysis, and lease-cost disclosures your footnotes require, all on an immutable audit trail.

records.description: The lease record and obligation-management layer that sources the accounting. Masters lease agreements (the accounting-subledger view of the contract), critical dates and alerts, renewals and terminations, payment terms, and the lease documents. Overlaps the real-estate and commercial-real-estate domains on lease records; scoped here to the lessee accounting feed, not workplace occupancy or landlord operations.
records.catalog_tagline: Track lease records, critical dates, and documents that feed the books.
records.catalog_description: Keep every lease and its obligations in one organized record. Capture lease agreements and their components, store the source documents, and never miss a renewal, option, or termination deadline with critical-date alerts. Manage payment terms and the changes that flow straight into your lease accounting, so the numbers always tie back to the contract.

records.description: The animal-centric system of record: individual-animal records, mobs and groups, mob movements, weigh sessions with average daily gain, breeding and calving records, treatment and medicine records with withholding periods, sale and purchase records, and the electronic-identifier traceability layer. Used standalone by a records-keeping operation or alongside the grazing module.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep a record for every animal and every mob: weights, breeding, treatments, movements, and sales.
records.catalog_description: Give every animal and mob a living record. Capture weigh sessions in the yard and watch average daily gains, log breeding and calving, and record every treatment with its withholding period so you never sell or send an animal too early. Move mobs between paddocks and properties, register sales and purchases, and keep electronic ear-tag identifiers and traceability movements in order for your region's scheme.

records.description: The pasture and grazing-planning system of record: paddocks, pasture allocations, and rotational grazing plans with rest periods, stocking rate, and carrying capacity. Used standalone by a grazing-focused operation or alongside the herd module to drive mob movements.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan your rotations: allocate pasture, set rest periods, and match stocking rate to carrying capacity.
records.catalog_description: Map your paddocks and plan how mobs graze them. Allocate pasture, schedule rotations with the rest periods each paddock needs, and keep stocking rate matched to carrying capacity so feed lasts and paddocks recover. Build grazing plans you can follow through the season and adjust as conditions change.

records.description: Owns the paid-social campaign structure and live operations: social ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, audiences, bid strategies, budget allocations, conversion events, and the performance-metric record. Carries the campaign lifecycle and the auto budget-reallocation loop. Used standalone for in-housed paid social and alongside the creative-optimization module when creative versioning is in scope.
records.catalog_tagline: Structure, launch, and steer paid social campaigns across every ad platform from one control plane.
records.catalog_description: Build campaigns, ad sets, and ads against your connected social ad accounts and run them across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and more. Attach audiences and bid strategies, set budgets, and let auto budget reallocation move spend toward the ad sets that are pacing and returning. Ingest conversion events through server-side APIs and watch per-ad performance in real time so the whole paid social estate is managed in one place instead of five native ad managers.

records.description: Owns social ad creative as versioned assets and the dynamic creative optimization loop: creatives, creative variants, creative assets, DCO rules, and product feeds. Generates and tests variant combinations, weights delivery to winners, and keeps a versioned, auditable creative trail. Deploys alongside Campaign Orchestration, which consumes the winning creatives.
records.catalog_tagline: Version your ad creative and let dynamic creative optimization find and scale the winning combinations.
records.catalog_description: Manage creative as versioned assets with named variants, approval state, and platform-specific renditions. Assemble creatives from modular headlines, bodies, images, and product feeds, then let dynamic creative optimization generate and test the combinations and weight delivery toward the best performers. Iterate, roll back, and audit every creative change, and hand the winning variants straight to live campaigns.

records.description: The always-on signal layer. Masters user risk scores, monitored activity, risk indicators, and the prioritized alert queue, plus the detection rules that generate them. Consumes egress events from DLP, sensitive-data context from DSPM, and identity context to baseline behavior and surface anomalies.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn endpoint, email, file, and cloud signals into a ranked queue of risky users.
records.catalog_description: Continuously score every user's behavior and watch for anomalous data movement across endpoints, email, cloud, and removable media. Tune detection rules to your risk tolerance, fold in egress and sensitive-data signals you already collect, and get a prioritized alert queue that puts the riskiest insiders at the top, so analysts triage real threats instead of chasing noise.

records.description: The human investigation workflow. Masters insider-risk cases (full lifecycle), investigation evidence, and exit-risk assessments for departing users. Provides activity timelines and file-lineage forensics, and hands high-risk cases off to HR and Legal with defensible evidence packages.
records.catalog_tagline: Investigate insider cases end to end and hand defensible evidence to HR and Legal.
records.catalog_description: Work alerts into a structured case queue and investigate with a full activity timeline and file-lineage forensics. Collect and preserve evidence as you go, assess exit risk for departing employees during their highest-risk window, and package everything for HR and Legal review with a clear chain of custody. Close cases with a documented disposition that stands up to scrutiny.

records.description: The durable execution kernel. Masters deployed process definitions and their running instances, advances each instance through its activities, records every state change as a process event, holds runtime variables, and surfaces incidents on failed jobs. The runtime substrate every other module builds on.
records.catalog_tagline: Deploy a process once and run thousands of resilient instances that recover from any failure.
records.catalog_description: The engine room. Register an executable process definition, then start an instance for each real-world case and let the engine drive it through its steps. Instances survive crashes and restarts, retry failed work automatically, wait on timers and incoming events, and run branches in parallel. When something cannot proceed, an incident is raised so an operator can inspect the variables, fix the cause, and resume. Every transition is written to an immutable event history, so you can always see what ran, replay it, and feed the stream into analytics.

records.description: The human and decision layer on top of the engine. Masters human tasks (the work-item inbox with assignment and escalation), case records (flexible non-sequential case handling), and decision tables with their runtime evaluations under DMN. Where automated orchestration meets people and business rules.
records.catalog_tagline: Route work to the right people and evaluate your business rules in real time.
records.catalog_description: Bring people and decisions into your processes. Human steps become work items that land in the right person's inbox, with claiming, reassignment, due dates, and escalation when they stall. For knowledge work that does not follow a fixed path, open a case file and let workers add activities and close milestones as the situation demands. And keep your business rules out of code: author decision tables once, then have running processes evaluate them in real time, with every evaluation recorded for audit.

records.description: The mobile-first reach and engagement surface. Masters frontline broadcasts and message channels; carries broadcast audiences, mandatory-read acknowledgments, and recognitions. Consumes the workforce's employees so messages and recognition target real people on the floor.
records.catalog_tagline: Reach every frontline worker and prove they saw it.
records.catalog_description: Send targeted announcements and let supervisors cascade them down to their teams across mobile, kiosk, and shared devices. Confirm who has read mandatory messages, recognize good work in the same feed, and deliver content in the language and policy rules each location needs.

records.description: The do-the-work surface. Masters frontline tasks, checklists, shift-swap requests, and learning modules; carries task submissions and learning completions. Consumes shifts from Workforce Management and emits handoffs when a swap is approved or a task is completed.
records.catalog_tagline: Push the work, get it done, and prove it from any phone.
records.catalog_description: Send tasks and checklists to the floor and collect photo and form evidence as workers complete them. Let workers swap shifts and pick up open coverage on their own devices with one manager tap, finish short training between tasks, and hand approved swaps back to scheduling and completed work back to store and plant operations.

records.description: Curates brand content into shareable items, organizes it into topic streams and time-boxed campaigns, broadcasts it to enrolled advocates with personalizable share copy, and records every employee share to their linked social accounts. Masters the advocacy program, content, share, advocate profile, and campaign records; consumes HCM employees and SMM social content; sends each advocate a personalized internal newsletter.
records.catalog_tagline: Curate on-brand content and put one-click sharing in front of every employee, with copy they can make their own.
records.catalog_description: Build a steady pipeline of approved content, sort it into the topics your people care about, and run focused sharing campaigns around launches and events. Employees enroll, link their LinkedIn, X, and Facebook accounts, and reshare in one click using suggested copy they can personalize. A weekly newsletter lands in each person's inbox with exactly what is worth sharing, so participation does not depend on chasing anyone. Every share is captured automatically, ready to be scored and measured.

records.description: Incentivizes and measures employee advocacy. Awards points and badges for sharing, ranks advocates on leaderboards, runs a reward catalog with redemptions, scores each advocate's influence, and computes reach, earned media value, and share-to-revenue attribution. Masters the leaderboard, reward, points-ledger, advocate-score, and share-metric records; reads the shares produced by content distribution; hands reach and pipeline signals to Revenue Intelligence.
records.catalog_tagline: Reward the people who show up, rank your top advocates, and prove the reach and pipeline their shares drive.
records.catalog_description: Turn sharing into something people want to do: award points and badges, run challenges, and put a leaderboard front and center. Let advocates redeem points from a reward catalog, and surface who is genuinely moving the needle with an influence score per person. Then connect the dots to results: clicks, impressions, reach, and earned media value per share, rolled up to the program and tied to the leads and pipeline that employee shares influenced. Marketing finally gets a defensible number for what advocacy is worth.

records.description: Masters rental listings, channel connections, and rate plans. Sets up properties, distributes them across booking channels and OTAs, and runs dynamic nightly pricing. Deployable standalone for a host who only needs distribution and pricing.
records.catalog_tagline: Set up your listings once and sync them, with the right nightly price, to every booking channel.
records.catalog_description: Build rich listings with amenities, photos, and house rules, then publish them across the major booking channels from one calendar. Channel sync keeps rates and availability aligned so you never double-book, and dynamic pricing adjusts nightly rates to demand and season.

records.description: Masters reservations, guests, guest messages, and reviews. Captures bookings from every channel, runs a unified guest inbox, and manages reviews. Embeds the listing shell.
records.catalog_tagline: Take bookings from every channel and talk to guests in one inbox, from inquiry through review.
records.catalog_description: Capture reservations from all your channels into one place, with check-in and check-out tracking and payment status at a glance. A unified inbox consolidates guest messages across channels with templates and automation, and review management helps you collect and respond to feedback that builds your reputation.

records.description: Masters housekeeping and turnover tasks scheduled off reservation checkouts. Embeds listing and reservation shells. Deployable standalone for cleaning/ops teams.
records.catalog_tagline: Schedule, assign, and verify every turnover clean so the next guest walks into a spotless unit.
records.catalog_description: Turn each checkout into a scheduled turnover task, assign it to the right cleaner or team, and track it through completion and inspection. Operations stays in sync with the booking calendar so cleans land in the gap between guests, every time.

records.description: Masters property owners, owner statements, and (jurisdiction-conditional) lodging-tax records and short-term-rental permits. Embeds listing and reservation shells; rolls up booking revenue into commission-based statements.
records.catalog_tagline: Pay your owners accurately every cycle and stay on top of lodging taxes and local permits.
records.catalog_description: Roll booking revenue and pass-through expenses into commission-based owner statements, finalize them, and pay out. For regulated markets, collect and remit occupancy and lodging taxes and keep local short-term-rental permits and registrations current.

records.description: Masters the physical estate: marinas, docks, slips, moorings, dry-stack racks, and storage units, plus slip-size classes and vessel-to-slip assignment. Deployable standalone for a facility that only needs to lay out and assign space.
records.catalog_tagline: Map every dock, slip, mooring, and rack, then assign each vessel to the right space by fit.
records.catalog_description: Build a visual layout of your marina: docks, slips, moorings, dry-stack racks, and land storage, each with dimensions, utilities, and a size class. Assign vessels to spaces by length, beam, and draft, and keep a clear picture of what is open, occupied, or out of service across the whole facility.

records.description: Masters reservations, transient and seasonal bookings, and the slip waitlist. Captures demand against the inventory, runs check-in and check-out, and offers freed space to waitlisted boaters. Embeds slip, boater, and vessel shells.
records.catalog_tagline: Take transient and seasonal bookings, check boats in and out, and offer freed slips to your waitlist.
records.catalog_description: Capture reservations and transient bookings against your available space, confirm them, and run check-in and check-out as boats arrive and leave. When a slip frees up, offer it to the next boater on the waitlist automatically, so you fill space and keep guests moving.

records.description: Masters boaters and vessels with insurance and registration documents. The shared customer-and-asset record other modules embed. Deployable standalone as a boater directory.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every boater and vessel on file, with insurance and registration current and at hand.
records.catalog_description: Maintain a clean directory of boaters and their vessels, with contact details, vessel particulars, and the documents you are required to keep: certificates of insurance and state or federal registrations. Expiring paperwork is easy to spot, so you keep coverage current across the marina.

records.description: Masters seasonal and annual slip contracts, recurring charges, house accounts, dockage invoices, and metered electric and water utilities. Rolls reservation and contract activity into boater billing. Embeds slip, boater, and reservation shells.
records.catalog_tagline: Put boaters on recurring contracts, meter their electric and water, and bill it all accurately every cycle.
records.catalog_description: Place boaters on seasonal or annual slip contracts with recurring charges and house accounts, and turn submetered electric and water readings into accurate utility lines. Generate dockage invoices for contracts, transient stays, and yard work, collect payments, and keep each boater's account balance clear.

records.description: Masters boatyard work orders, service estimates, haul-out jobs, dry-stack launch requests, and Clean Vessel Act pump-out logs. Embeds vessel and slip shells. Deployable standalone for a service yard.
records.catalog_tagline: Quote and run boatyard work, schedule haul-outs and launches, and log every pump-out.
records.catalog_description: Estimate and approve boatyard jobs, open work orders, and track them from request through completion and billing. Schedule haul-outs, splashes, and dry-stack launches against your lift and forklift capacity, and keep the pump-out logs the Clean Vessel Act and your grants require.

records.description: Masters fuel sales, fuel tanks, fuel-inventory reconciliation logs, and ship-store point-of-sale transactions. Embeds the boater shell so sales post to accounts. Deployable standalone for a fuel dock and store.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the fuel dock and ship store, post sales to boater accounts, and keep fuel inventory reconciled.
records.catalog_description: Sell marine fuel and ship-store retail, charge it to a boater's house account or take payment on the spot, and keep fuel-tank inventory reconciled against deliveries and pump totals so your records stand up to a storage-tank inspection.

records.description: The single front door to Legal: business users submit requests, which are triaged and routed or converted into matters. Hosts the request intake, triage, and self-service surface.
records.catalog_tagline: Give the business one front door to Legal and turn every request into tracked, routed work.
records.catalog_description: Take in legal requests from anywhere in the business through a single intake portal, then triage each one and either resolve it, route it, or open it as a matter. Requesters see status without chasing email, and the legal team works from one prioritized queue instead of scattered inboxes. The result is faster response, clear ownership from the first touch, and a complete record of what the business asked Legal to do.

records.description: Running matters end to end: matter records, legal advice records, and case dockets. The operational core where in-house counsel manages active legal work.
records.catalog_tagline: Run every matter from open to close, with advice and docket activity captured in one place.
records.catalog_description: Manage each legal matter through its whole life: open it, work it, put it on hold, and close it, with every piece of advice and docket entry attached. In-house counsel keeps a single trusted record of what was asked, what was advised, and what happened, so nothing falls through the cracks and history is always at hand. Spend less time reconstructing context and more time moving the work forward.

records.description: Legal holds and ediscovery: issuing and releasing holds, acknowledgment tracking, and the collect-process-review-produce ediscovery workflow. Consumes content documents under hold from ECM.
records.catalog_tagline: Issue holds, track acknowledgments, and run ediscovery from collection to production.
records.catalog_description: Preserve evidence the moment a matter requires it: issue legal holds, track custodian acknowledgments, and release holds cleanly when they lapse. Run ediscovery end to end, from collection through processing, review, and production, with a defensible trail at every step. Keep the business out of spoliation risk and give counsel confidence that what should be preserved actually is.

records.description: Outside-counsel engagements: proposing, engaging, and completing external-counsel relationships, with scope and accrual handoffs downstream to spend, contract, and conflict-check systems.
records.catalog_tagline: Engage and manage outside counsel, and keep scope, spend, and conflicts connected.
records.catalog_description: Propose, engage, and close out external-counsel relationships from one place, with scope and the engagement letter captured up front. As engagements start, the right downstream teams see them: spend tracking accrues the budget, contract management holds the engagement letter, and risk runs its conflict checks. Stop losing track of who is engaged on what, and keep outside-counsel spend and obligations under control.

records.description: Regulator and agency inquiries: receiving, acknowledging, responding to, and closing regulatory inquiries as an in-house workflow distinct from enterprise GRC.
records.catalog_tagline: Take in regulator inquiries and drive each one to an on-time, documented response.
records.catalog_description: Handle inquiries from regulators and agencies as a managed workflow: log each one, acknowledge it on time, assemble and send the response, and close it with a complete record. Deadlines stay visible, ownership is clear, and the full response history is auditable when it matters. Keep the organization responsive and defensible without running regulator inquiries out of email threads.

records.description: Competitor tracking, intelligence records, battlecards, and win/loss programs. The competitive-enablement core bought from Klue and Crayon.
records.catalog_tagline: Track every competitor and put a battlecard in your sellers' hands the moment they need it.
records.catalog_description: Keep a living record of every competitor: their moves, their pricing, their pitch, and your counter. Turn that intel into battlecards your sellers reach for in the deal, and run structured win/loss interviews to learn why you actually win and lose. Stop letting competitive knowledge live in one person's head and arm the whole revenue team with what works.

records.description: Go-to-market launch planning and coordination: launch plans, product launches, milestones, readiness gating, and cross-functional activities. The launch-marketing surface relocated from GTM-PLAN and anchored on Aha! Roadmaps Create.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan and coordinate every launch from kickoff to GA, with readiness gates nothing ships past.
records.catalog_description: Run launches as a managed motion, not a scramble: build the launch plan, set milestones, and gate go-live on a readiness checklist every function signs off. Track each product launch through its tiers and dates, coordinate the activities across marketing, sales, and product, and keep one calendar of what is shipping when. Fewer missed dates, fewer half-ready launches, and a clear record of how each one went.

records.description: Messaging frameworks, positioning, personas, and value propositions. The positioning-craft surface that keeps the company telling one story.
records.catalog_tagline: Define the message once, and keep the whole company telling the same story.
records.catalog_description: Build the messaging framework, positioning, and value propositions in one place, grounded in real buyer personas, and put them through review and approval so nothing goes out half-baked. When marketing, sales, and product all pull from the same messaging house, the story stays consistent from the website to the sales call to the launch. Stop reinventing the pitch in every deck.

records.description: Sales-enablement content production, collections, trainings, and engagement analytics. The enablement-platform surface bought from Highspot and Seismic.
records.catalog_tagline: Produce the content sellers actually use, and see what moves deals.
records.catalog_description: Create, organize, and ship the sales-enablement content your reps need, group it into collections by stage and persona, and back it with enablement training so sellers know how to use it. Track which content gets opened, shared, and tied to won deals, and double down on what works. Turn enablement from a content dump into a measured driver of sales productivity.

records.description: The who-do-we-sell-to layer: market segmentation, ICP authoring, named target-account lists, planning-grade account scoring, and strategic channel-mix. The segmentation surface every planning vendor co-locates.
records.catalog_tagline: Define who you sell to: segments, your ideal customer, named target accounts, and how you score them.
records.catalog_description: Decide where to play before you spend a dollar. Build your market segments, define the ideal customer profile, and author the named target-account lists the whole revenue team works from, then score accounts so reps chase the right ones. Set the strategic channel mix that says which routes carry which segments. The output is a shared, governed view of your market that feeds territory design, sales engagement, and demand programs.

records.description: Territory carving and quota allocation: balanced territory design and quota setting against coverage and capacity. The single most universal planner surface.
records.catalog_tagline: Carve balanced territories and set quotas that hold up, against real coverage and capacity.
records.catalog_description: Turn the plan into who-owns-what: design balanced territories, see coverage and white space, and allocate quotas that tie back to capacity and segment potential. Reps get fair, defensible patches and numbers, and leadership gets a territory and quota model that survives the year instead of being reworked every quarter. When the design locks, it pushes cleanly into Sales execution.

records.description: Sales-capacity modeling: coverage, ramp, productivity assumptions, headcount, and hiring plans against revenue targets.
records.catalog_tagline: Model the capacity you need to hit the number: coverage, ramp, productivity, and hiring.
records.catalog_description: Answer how many sellers, of what kind, by when. Model coverage and productivity assumptions, factor in ramp time, and build the hiring plan that closes the gap between capacity and the revenue target. See where you are short or over-built before the year starts, and give Finance and Recruiting a headcount plan grounded in real coverage math rather than a top-down guess.

records.description: What-if scenario modeling and plan versioning across segmentation, territory, capacity, and channel choices.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the what-ifs and compare versions before you commit the plan.
records.catalog_description: Stress-test the plan before you lock it. Model alternative scenarios across segments, territories, capacity, and channels, compare them side by side, and keep every version so you can see what changed and why. When the business asks what happens if we add ten reps or shift to a new segment, you answer with a modeled scenario, not a hunch, and you carry the winning version forward into the locked plan.

records.description: Plan approval, lock, and the downstream push: approvals, lock records, and handoff of the committed plan to CRM, SPM, Marketing, and Finance.
records.catalog_tagline: Lock the plan and push it cleanly to Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
records.catalog_description: Close the planning cycle with control. Route the plan for approval, lock it so it stops moving, and push the committed segments, territories, quotas, and capacity to the systems that execute: CRM and Sales Performance for territories and quotas, the ABM platform and Marketing for target accounts, and Finance for the capacity numbers. One source of truth for what was committed, and a clean handoff instead of a spreadsheet hand-off.

records.description: Intent capture, account identification, and engagement scoring, plus the consent governance over contact-level signal processing. The signal-ingestion-and-scoring layer vendors lead with.
records.catalog_tagline: See who is in-market: capture intent, resolve accounts, and score engagement, with consent built in.
records.catalog_description: Find demand before it raises its hand. Capture first- and third-party intent signals, resolve anonymous traffic to real accounts, and score engagement so sales and marketing know exactly which accounts are heating up. Govern it all with consent records and data-subject requests so contact-level signals are processed lawfully. This is the intelligence layer the rest of your account-based motion runs on.

records.description: Multichannel orchestration: campaigns, account journeys, playbooks, and engagement audiences. Consumes the ICP and target lists authored in GTM-PLAN.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the right play for every account, across every channel, from one orchestration brain.
records.catalog_description: Coordinate the whole account-based motion: build campaigns, define the journey stages accounts move through, run orchestration playbooks, and assemble the audiences each play targets. Pull in the ICP and target account lists your planning team authored and engage against them across ads, web, and outreach. Stop running disconnected campaigns and give every account a coherent, measured journey.

records.description: Account-based programmatic advertising: ad targeting, audiences, creatives, placements, spend, and content syndication.
records.catalog_tagline: Put your ads in front of the buying committee at your target accounts, and prove the spend works.
records.catalog_description: Run advertising that targets accounts, not cookies. Build ad campaign targets and audiences from your account list, manage creatives and placements across display, social, and content syndication, and allocate spend by account tier. See which accounts you reached and how it moved engagement, so the ad budget goes where the pipeline is, not where the clicks are cheapest.

records.description: 1:1 account and visitor web personalization: rules, dynamic experiences, and the visitor-to-account resolution that drives them. Carries its own contact-level PII exposure.
