Teams that adopt it cut travel and idle time, hit service-level commitments, and turn every completed visit into accurate billing and a cleaner equipment history.
records.business_logic: Routing and dispatch optimization under technician skill, parts, SLA, and travel constraints, operations-research solver at the core.

records.description: Order capture, orchestration, and fulfillment across channels and inventory pools.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture orders from any channel, route them to the right inventory node, and orchestrate everything from sourcing to returns in one place.
records.catalog_description:
Take in orders from web, store, marketplace, and call center, then decide how each one gets fulfilled. Rate-shop and source every line against the inventory you actually have, split shipments when that is cheaper or faster, and commit a delivery promise the customer can count on. One view shows where each order is, what is allocated, and what still needs attention.

Run the omnichannel paths that buyers expect. Reserve stock for buy-online-pickup-in-store and curbside, hand pick lists to the right location, and keep the customer posted from confirmation to ready-for-pickup. When inventory shifts or an allocation fails, reroute the order instead of letting it stall.

Close the loop after the sale. Issue return authorizations, route items back to the right node for inspection and restock, and trigger the refund and credit so finance, support, and the storefront all stay in sync. The payoff is fewer split-cost surprises, faster fulfillment, and orders that follow through from capture to return without falling through the cracks.
records.business_logic: Inventory allocation, sourcing/fulfillment rules, and split-shipment optimization — operations-research heavy.

records.description: Authoring, governance, and retrieval of organizational knowledge for internal and external audiences.
records.catalog_tagline: Capture, organize, and govern your organization's know-how, then surface the right answer wherever people and assistants ask for it.
records.catalog_description:
Turn scattered tribal knowledge into a single trusted corpus. Authors draft articles, route them through review and approval, publish them to the audiences that need them, and retire what is out of date, with every revision tracked so you always know what changed and who approved it.

Organize the corpus with categories and taxonomies, group related material into curated collections, and gather reader feedback so the articles that fall short get flagged and fixed. See what people actually search for, where the answer was found, and where the search came up empty, so the gaps become a worklist instead of a guess.

Feed the same governed corpus to help centers, support agents, and AI assistants, so self-service deflection, agent answers, and retrieval-augmented assistants all draw from one reviewed source of truth instead of stale copies scattered across teams.
records.business_logic: Search and RAG retrieval over the knowledge corpus, vector embeddings, ranking, and relevance models. Authoring, versioning, taxonomies, and access workflow are the CRUD majority.

records.description: Virtual agents, chatbots, and voice bots for customer and employee self-service.
records.catalog_tagline: Deploy virtual agents that resolve customer and employee questions across chat and voice, around the clock.
records.catalog_description: Conversational AI lets you stand up self-service assistants that understand what a person is asking and carry the conversation through to a resolution. Teams author bots, intents, and dialog flows once, train them on real utterances, and publish them to every channel a customer or employee uses, from web chat and messaging apps to voice. At runtime each conversation is captured turn by turn, intents are detected and scored, and unresolved or sensitive requests are handed off to a live agent with full context. The result is faster answers, lower contact volume in the service center, and a transcript trail that feeds analytics, compliance, and continuous improvement. Buy this when you want to deflect routine inquiries, give support and operations teams a way to build and govern automated conversations without deep engineering, and keep human agents focused on the cases that genuinely need them.
records.business_logic: NLU/LLM stack, dialog management, intent/entity extraction, and tool-use orchestration — the model is the product.

records.description: Joiner-mover-leaver workflows, access reviews, segregation-of-duties, and entitlement governance.
records.catalog_tagline: Govern who has access to what across every system, from the first day on the job to the last.
records.catalog_description:
Identity governance gives security and IT teams one place to control the full lifecycle of access. When someone joins, moves, or leaves, the right entitlements are granted, adjusted, or revoked automatically, so nobody keeps access they no longer need.

Business owners review and certify access on a schedule, segregation-of-duties rules catch toxic combinations before they become audit findings, and a single entitlement catalog keeps every grant traceable. Provisioning connectors push approved changes out to downstream systems and pull back proof that they landed.

The payoff is faster onboarding, cleaner audits, and far less standing risk: access stays current, every decision is recorded, and compliance evidence is a query away rather than a fire drill.
records.business_logic: Segregation-of-duties engine, certification ML for outlier detection, and access analytics. The rest is joiner/mover/leaver workflow.

records.description: Cloud-native iPaaS for integrating SaaS and on-prem applications via prebuilt connectors and flows.
records.catalog_tagline: Connect your cloud apps, on-premise systems, and event streams and keep data flowing between them without writing custom integration code.
records.catalog_description:
An integration platform lets teams build, run, and monitor the automated flows that move data between business applications, databases, and event streams. Instead of hand-coding and maintaining brittle point-to-point integrations, builders assemble flows from a library of prebuilt application connectors, map fields from one system to another, and set the triggers and schedules that decide when each flow runs.

Once a flow is published it runs on its own: it picks up new records and events, transforms them to match the target system, and delivers them with retry logic that recovers from transient failures. Every execution is captured as a run record with status, timing, and error detail, so teams can see exactly what moved, what failed, and why, and can replay or fix a flow with full audit history.

Webhook subscriptions let outside systems push events in the moment they happen, and managed credentials with rotation keep every connection secure as it ages. The result is faster delivery of new integrations, fewer manual data-entry tasks, and reliable, observable data movement across the whole application landscape.
records.business_logic: Integration runtime executing connectors, transformations, error handling, and event delivery at scale — code-dominant by definition.

records.description: Visual and model-driven development of custom enterprise applications with managed runtime.
records.business_logic: Runtime, compiler, and visual modeler — the entire platform is code. The end-user app surface is whatever the customer builds; the LCAP itself is platform.

records.description: UI-level automation of repetitive, rule-based tasks across legacy and modern applications.
records.catalog_tagline: Automate repetitive, rule-based work across your existing applications without changing the underlying systems.
records.catalog_description: Software robots log in to the applications your team already uses and carry out the keystrokes, clicks, and data entry of high-volume manual processes, so people are freed from copy-and-paste work and routine swivel-chair tasks. You design a bot once by recording or mapping the steps of a process, then run it attended at a person's desk or unattended on a schedule. A central control surface deploys bots, queues their work, manages the credentials they use, and keeps a full execution trail of every run. The payoff is faster cycle times, fewer manual errors, and around-the-clock throughput on processes that would otherwise wait for a human, all without the cost and delay of rebuilding or integrating the legacy systems the work touches.
records.business_logic: Bot execution VM, UI automation (screen scraping, OCR, computer vision), and orchestration runtime — code at every layer.

records.description: Capture, classification, extraction, and validation of structured and unstructured documents.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn the documents flowing into your business into clean, structured data your systems can act on.
records.catalog_description: Intelligent Document Processing takes in documents from any channel, sorts them by type, and pulls the key fields, tables, and signatures out of each one, then checks the results against your business rules before handing clean records to the systems that need them. Confidence-rated extractions move forward on their own when they are clearly correct, while anything uncertain drops into a human review queue so a person can confirm or fix it in seconds. Teams train the underlying models on labeled samples, watch accuracy in production, and retrain when results start to drift, so the pipeline keeps getting more hands-off over time.
records.business_logic: Document classification, key-value extraction, table extraction, and validation ML — the entire product is the model.

records.description: Event-log-driven discovery, conformance, and enhancement of business processes.
records.catalog_tagline: See how your business processes actually run: pull event logs from your ERP, CRM, and case systems, discover the real workflow, and pinpoint the bottlenecks, deviations, and rework that slow it down.
records.catalog_description:
Process Mining turns the timestamps your systems already record into an honest picture of how work really flows. Pull event logs out of the source systems, validate them, and let discovery algorithms reconstruct the actual end-to-end process instead of the one drawn on a whiteboard.

From there the work is to find what to fix. Conformance checking compares the real flow against the reference model and flags every deviation, missing step, and out-of-order trace, with severity and root cause, so audit and operations teams can act on it. Variant analysis groups the distinct paths a process takes and shows which ones cost the most time, while bottleneck findings surface the high-wait steps and queue points that throttle throughput.

The output feeds the rest of the operation: discovered models and detected deviations flow to process design and automation teams, and the control logic mined from the logs is routed for analyst review and codification. The result is a defensible, evidence-based view of where each process leaks value and what it is worth to fix.
records.business_logic: Event-log algorithms (alpha miner, heuristic miner, inductive miner), conformance checking, and performance analysis — academic algorithms made commercial.

records.description: Visibility, allocation, optimization, and accountability for cloud spending across business units.
records.catalog_tagline: See, allocate, and optimize cloud spend before it surprises you at month-end.
records.catalog_description:
Turn an unpredictable cloud bill into a cost line every team can read and own. Pull raw spending from every cloud account into one normalized view, then attribute it by tag, account, team, product, or unit so finance, engineering, and product owners all see the same number and agree on what caused it. Catch anomalies the moment a service starts overspending instead of discovering it on the invoice, and forecast where the next billing cycle is heading.

The practice closes the loop from visibility to action. Set budgets per team or product that raise an alert before a threshold is crossed, and act on rightsizing, idle-resource cleanup, and commitment-purchase recommendations that lower the bill without slowing delivery. Unit-economics views tie spend back to the business, so cost per customer, per transaction, or per workload becomes a metric leaders can manage rather than a mystery they absorb.
records.business_logic: Unit-cost allocation, anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, and commitment optimization. Algorithm-led; the rest is reporting.

records.description: Operations and business support systems for service providers: catalog, order, inventory, billing.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the commercial and operational backbone of a communications service provider: publish service offers, capture and provision orders, manage subscriptions, bill customers, and resolve service trouble end to end.
records.catalog_description:
Telecommunications OSS/BSS is where a carrier turns network capability into a sellable, billable, supportable service. Teams define the product and service catalog, take customer orders, orchestrate provisioning across network inventory, activate and change subscriptions, and rate and bill usage, all on a single operational spine. When something breaks, the same spine opens and tracks trouble tickets through to resolution.

Buy into this market when manual order handling, fragmented billing, and disconnected provisioning are slowing time to revenue and frustrating customers. The payoff is faster order-to-activation, accurate convergent charging, fewer revenue leaks, and a clear, auditable trail from offer to invoice to support case.

It connects outward to incident management for service trouble, to finance for invoicing and revenue recognition, and to customer service for subscription changes and care, so the order, the bill, and the support history all stay in sync.
records.business_logic: Rating engine and online charging system — high-throughput algorithmic kernel; the rest is catalog, order, and customer records.

records.description: Origination, onboarding, servicing, and case-management workflows for retail and commercial banking.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the full banking back office from one workflow spine: open accounts, originate and disburse loans, clear KYC and sanctions checks, move money, and resolve customer disputes.
records.catalog_description:
Banking Operations gives retail and commercial banking teams a single place to take a customer from application to active account and from loan request to funded disbursement. Front-line staff capture account and loan applications, route them through identity, beneficial-ownership, and AML review, and track each request through its approval, decline, or funding decision with a clear audit trail.

Payment and money-movement work is first class: initiate wire transfers, screen them for sanctions and threshold-reporting triggers, and post the resulting transactions to the right accounts with reconciliation built in. When something goes wrong, open and work banking cases for disputes, fraud claims, account errors, and complaints, with assignment, SLA, and resolution tracking.

Compliance is woven through the workflow rather than bolted on, so KYC reviews, sanctions hits, and suspicious-activity signals are captured as the work happens and are ready to hand to your risk and finance teams.
records.business_logic: Risk-based decisioning rules (KYC, credit, AML) and fee/interest calculations; the rest is case management and journeys.

records.description: First notice of loss, adjudication, settlement, and recovery workflows for P&C and life insurance.
records.catalog_tagline: Take every claim from first notice of loss through settlement, payment, and recovery in one place.
records.catalog_description: Handle the whole claim from the moment a loss is reported. Capture first notice of loss, verify coverage against the policy, assign the right adjuster, and keep the case file complete as the investigation unfolds. Set and adjust reserves, adjudicate the coverage decision, agree the settlement, and disburse payment with a clean audit trail at every step. Screen for fraud early, open a special investigation when the indicators warrant it, and pursue subrogation and salvage to recover what is owed. Claims teams cut cycle time and leakage, treat claimants fairly and consistently, and stay ready for state and federal claims-handling scrutiny.
records.business_logic: Adjudication rules engine, fraud detection, and reserve calculations: the irreducible insurance kernel; FNOL and case workflow are declarative.

records.description: Patient scheduling, care coordination, and clinical workflow management for providers.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the patient front office and clinical floor on one record: schedule visits, document encounters, place orders, coordinate care, and route referrals.
records.catalog_description: Healthcare Patient Operations gives provider organizations a single workflow spine for the work that happens around every visit. Front-desk teams book and confirm appointments and manage no-shows; clinicians capture encounters, place lab, imaging, and medication orders, and sign clinical notes; care coordinators build and track care plans for chronic conditions and transitions of care; and referral managers route patients to specialists and chase the authorizations that keep care in-network. Because every record carries protected health information, the platform enforces HIPAA-grade access, immutable signed documentation, and a clear audit trail. Buy this to cut scheduling leakage, speed documentation, close referral loops, and give every member of the care team a shared, real-time view of what each patient needs next.
records.business_logic: Patient scheduling optimization (provider availability, room constraints, payer rules) is the meaningful algorithmic layer.

records.description: Application, review, issuance, inspection, and renewal of licenses and permits for governments.
records.catalog_tagline: Take permit and license applications, issue and renew them, schedule inspections, enforce code, and bill regulatory fees in one civic-services workflow.
records.catalog_description: Run the full licensing and permitting lifecycle for a government agency from a single workflow. Applicants submit permits and license applications, staff review and route them, and approved records are issued, tracked, and renewed on schedule. Field inspectors work scheduled inspections against each permit, and failed inspections open code-enforcement cases that carry through contest and resolution. Regulatory fees are assessed at each gated step and handed to finance for collection, while constituents follow their case from submission to approval. The result is faster turnaround, a defensible audit trail on every decision, and one connected record of every license, permit, inspection, and fee an agency manages.

records.description: Shop-floor execution, work-instruction delivery, and operator-case management for manufacturers.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the shop floor in real time, from order release to the as-built record.
records.catalog_description: Manufacturing operations turns released production orders into finished, traceable units. Schedulers sequence work across lines and cells, operators follow current work instructions step by step, and every build is captured as an as-built record with its lot and serial. Quality inspections gate pass, fail, and hold decisions at the point of build, downtime and stoppages are logged for live OEE, and shop-floor cases route operator escalations to the problem-solving team. The result is a connected floor where plant managers, supervisors, operators, and quality inspectors share one live view of what is being built, how fast, and at what quality.
records.business_logic: MES execution loops (work-instruction delivery, andon, downtime capture) and SPC calculations bridge the IT/OT boundary.

records.description: Task management, labor scheduling, and store-associate workflows for retail.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the store floor: dispatch daily tasks, audit execution, and staff the right hours in the right places.
records.catalog_description:
Retail Store Operations is the daily operating rhythm of the sales floor. It pushes the work that has to happen in every store down to the right associate at the right time: shelf stocking, planogram resets, zone cleaning, opening and closing checklists, and safety walks, then tracks completion so district and store managers can see, store by store, whether the plan actually got done.

The same workflow runs the controls that keep a fleet of stores consistent. Operational and compliance audits, planogram compliance checks with photo evidence, and mystery-shopper assessments turn the in-store experience into scored, remediable records, while labor scheduling matches associate availability and coverage bands to forecasted demand so no shift is over- or under-staffed.

The payoff is execution you can prove: consistent merchandising and service across every location, fewer compliance and shrink gaps, and frontline accountability that holds up. The domain feeds completed tasks and published schedules into workforce time and labor, opens coaching and service follow-ups from audit and mystery-shopper findings, and escalates overdue checklists so nothing on the floor quietly falls through.

records.description: Meter-to-cash, outage, work, and asset workflows for electric, gas, and water utilities.
records.catalog_tagline: Run meter-to-cash, outage response, and field work for electric, gas, and water utilities from one operational backbone.
records.catalog_description: Operate the full utility service lifecycle in one place: open and manage customer accounts and service connections, capture and validate meter reads, rate and issue bills, and keep cash flowing. When the grid goes down, declare and track outages, dispatch crews, and restore service while keeping customers informed. Plan and execute connect, disconnect, and field work against your network assets, and surface the reliability and revenue signals regulators and operations leaders depend on. Built for the operational reality of electric, gas, and water utilities so teams spend less time stitching systems together and more time keeping the lights, gas, and water on.
records.business_logic: Meter-to-cash rating, outage prediction and crew dispatch, and demand-response calculations — utility-specific algorithmic kernels.

records.description: Medical-device inventory, preventive maintenance, recalls, and clinical engineering workflows.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every medical device safe, maintained, and ready for patient care.
records.catalog_description: Run one trustworthy register of the medical equipment in clinical use, from infusion pumps and ventilators to monitors and imaging systems. Schedule and prove preventive maintenance, manage calibration, and validate sterilization so equipment stays accurate and safe at the bedside. When a recall or adverse event hits, isolate affected units fast, drive the response to closure, and produce the evidence accreditors and regulators expect. Clinical engineering teams cut downtime, stay inspection-ready, and protect patients without drowning in paperwork.
records.business_logic: Preventive-maintenance schedules and recall propagation for medical devices — mostly declarative rules over inventory.

records.description: Inventory, lifecycle, and disposal management of physical IT hardware assets.
records.catalog_tagline: Know every device you own, where it is, and what it costs.
records.catalog_description: Build a single trustworthy register of laptops, desktops, servers, network gear, and mobile devices. Track each asset from purchase through deployment, repair, and retirement, manage warranties and spare parts, and run secure, evidenced disposal at end of life. Cut surprise spend, satisfy audits, and refresh hardware on a plan instead of in a panic.

records.description: Discovery, normalization, entitlement reconciliation, and audit defense for software licenses.
records.business_logic: Entitlement reconciliation engine (matching deployed installs against complex license metrics): the genuinely hard kernel of SAM.

records.description: Maintenance, work order, and lifecycle management for physical plant, equipment, and infrastructure.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep plant and equipment running. Plan preventive maintenance, dispatch work orders, and track every asset from commissioning to retirement.
records.catalog_description:
Enterprise Asset Management gives maintenance and reliability teams one place to run the physical side of the business: the machines, lines, and infrastructure that production depends on. Build an asset register that captures each piece of equipment, its hierarchy of components, and its full history from commissioning through retirement, then drive upkeep from preventive-maintenance schedules tied to runtime hours, meter readings, and condition data so failures are caught before they stop the line.

Work flows through a single work-order lifecycle. Requests become planned jobs, jobs get scheduled and assigned to crews, technicians execute and close them out in the field, and every labor hour, part, and inspection result lands back on the asset record. Safety and compliance steps such as lockout/tagout and calibration are built into the same flow, so the audit trail is a byproduct of getting the work done rather than a separate chore.

EAM sits at the center of operations. It receives capital projects as new assets to maintain, reacts to production downtime and schedule changes with the right maintenance windows, and feeds completed work, asset costs, and retirement events back to finance, manufacturing, and compliance. The result is higher uptime, longer asset life, lower maintenance spend, and a defensible record of how every asset has been cared for.
records.business_logic: Preventive-maintenance scheduling rules driven by meter readings, runtime hours, or condition data. Mostly declarative but benefits from a calculation engine for asset risk and maintenance intervals.

records.description: Core HR system of record covering worker data, organization and position management, self-service, and lifecycle workflows. The HRIS / system-of-record layer of the HR stack.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the single source of truth for your workforce, from the employee record to org structure, positions, and the full hire-to-retire lifecycle.
records.catalog_description:
Human Capital Management is the system of record for your people. Maintain every worker's core profile, employment contracts, and the org structure they sit in, then drive each change through a governed workflow: hiring, transfers, promotions, leaves of absence, and offboarding. Self-service lets employees and managers raise and track their own changes while HR retains approval control.

Because the worker record is authoritative, the lifecycle events you record here ripple cleanly downstream: a new hire provisions access and payroll, a termination recalls assets and closes accounts, a promotion updates compensation. You define jobs and positions once, plan headcount against them, and keep compliance evidence in step with the regulations that apply to your workforce.
records.business_logic: Org-chart and headcount calculations, FTE roll-ups, and span-of-control analytics: calc layer over master HR data.

records.description: Gross-to-net calculation, statutory tax filing, garnishments, pay distribution, and multi-country payroll execution.
records.catalog_tagline: Pay your people accurately and on time, with taxes filed and every paystub in their hands.
records.catalog_description: Run the full pay cycle end to end: pull in hours, earnings, and deductions, calculate gross-to-net for every employee, and disburse net pay on schedule. File the statutory tax returns each jurisdiction requires, process court-ordered wage garnishments correctly, and post the resulting journal entries to your books. Give every employee a clear, accurate pay statement and keep a defensible record of how each amount was calculated.
records.business_logic: Tax tables, gross-to-net calculation, garnishment logic, statutory filings, and country-specific compliance kernels: irreducible and continuously updated.

records.description: Requisition management, candidate sourcing, interview workflows, and offer management. AI-assisted matching and screening overlays are increasingly bundled.
records.catalog_tagline: Hire faster with a connected pipeline from sourcing through offer acceptance.
records.catalog_description:
Track every candidate from first contact through hire. Manage job requisitions, posting distribution, application intake, interview scheduling, scorecard collection, and offer generation in one connected pipeline.

When a candidate accepts an offer, the workflow hands off cleanly to onboarding so your new hire's first day doesn't start from a blank page. Built-in support for EEOC-compliant funnel analytics, requisition approval routing, and offer-letter version control.
records.business_logic: Candidate matching and resume parsing ML — significant in modern ATS products; the rest is pipeline stages, scheduling, and offers.

records.description: Course authoring, content delivery, compliance training, certifications, and learning paths for employees and extended audiences.
records.catalog_tagline: Train your whole workforce and prove it, from first enrollment to audit-ready completion records.
records.catalog_description: Run corporate learning end to end. Author and publish courses, deliver them online or in the classroom, and track every enrollment through to completion. Issue the certifications and badges that show who is qualified, and keep the evidence auditors and regulators ask for. Assign mandatory training automatically, chase overdue learners without manual follow-up, and feed completion signals to the HR, compliance, and identity systems that depend on them.
records.business_logic: Learning-path recommendation engines; otherwise pure content, enrollment, and tracking records.

records.description: Performance reviews, goals and OKRs, continuous feedback, succession planning, and career development. Often bundled into HCM suites but a strong standalone point-solution market exists.
records.catalog_tagline: Grow, evaluate, and retain your people with one connected talent practice, from goals and reviews to succession and continuous feedback.
records.catalog_description:
Run the full talent cycle in one place. Set and track individual goals, run performance reviews with self and manager assessments, and calibrate ratings across teams to keep them fair and consistent.

Spot and develop your future leaders. Place people on a performance-by-potential grid, build succession plans for critical roles, and capture each person's career aspirations so you can match them to internal moves.

Keep the conversation going all year. Capture kudos, one-on-one notes, and requested feedback that feed naturally into the next review, so recognition and coaching never wait for an annual cycle.
records.business_logic: Calibration math (normalization of ratings across populations) and 9-box placement; otherwise pure forms and workflow.

records.description: Time and attendance tracking, shift scheduling, absence and leave, labor forecasting, and labor-law compliance for hourly and shift-based workforces.
records.business_logic: Demand forecasting and workforce-scheduling optimization solvers (mixed-integer programming or heuristics) — the algorithmic core of the product.
records.notes:
2026-05-20 reanalysis:
- Added consumer rows: employees, positions, job_profiles, org_units (all from HCM) as the schedulable-resource pool inputs.
- Added cross-domain handoffs: HCM->WFM employee.created (low), WFM->HCM absence.approved (medium; accruals + country carry-over rules), WFM->SWP actuals.posted (medium; plan-vs-actual feed).
- Added HCM and PAYROLL as consumers of WFM-mastered absence_requests.
- POSTPONED: friction reassessment of WFM->PSA time_entry.approved (currently low).

records.description: Compensation planning cycles, pay-equity analysis, bonus and incentive plans, market benchmarking, and equity administration.
records.catalog_tagline: Run pay cycles, benchmark to the market, and reward your people with confidence.
records.catalog_description: Plan and run compensation cycles end to end: set pay ranges from market data, propose merit increases and bonuses, grant equity, and give every employee a clear total-rewards statement. Calibrate awards against budget and pay-equity targets so spend stays fair and on plan, then route every change for the right approvals. Give your compensation team one place to design pay, defend it with data, and deliver it accurately.
records.business_logic: Incentive calculation engine — quotas, accelerators, splits, draws — typically a dedicated calc layer with regulatory implications.

records.description: Open enrollment, life-event handling, carrier connectivity, ACA compliance, and benefits decision support.
records.catalog_tagline: Run open enrollment, life events, and carrier connectivity in one place.
records.catalog_description: Benefits Administration gives HR and benefits teams a single workspace to design plan offerings, run annual open enrollment, capture employee elections and dependents, process qualifying life events, and keep insurance carriers and retirement record-keepers in sync. It tracks affordability and ACA reporting obligations so employees get the coverage they choose and the organization stays compliant without spreadsheet wrangling.
records.business_logic: Eligibility rules that determine which benefits a worker can elect; declarative and well-suited to a rules engine.

records.description: Engagement and pulse surveys, 360 feedback, lifecycle (onboarding, exit) listening, and action planning. Distinct from HRSD case management.
records.catalog_tagline: Listen to your workforce continuously and turn what you hear into action that managers actually take.
records.catalog_description: Run engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 feedback programs from one place. Build your question library, schedule listening cadences, and collect responses under anonymity protections your people trust. Scores roll up into the drivers that explain how teams feel, so leaders see what is working and where to focus. Hand each result to the manager who owns it as a concrete action plan, then track follow-through to closure. The full listen-and-act loop sits in a single workflow: ask, understand, act, and measure whether the action moved the needle.

records.description: HR metrics, dashboards, workforce composition analysis, attrition prediction, and DEI analytics on top of the HR data stack.
records.catalog_tagline: See your whole workforce in numbers: headcount, attrition risk, engagement, and pay equity in one analytics workspace.
records.catalog_description:
People Analytics turns your HR, payroll, and talent data into decisions. Build headcount and attrition scorecards, slice the workforce by org unit, tenure, and performance, and watch the metrics that signal where the organization is headed.

Run engagement and pulse surveys, score flight risk with predictive models, and surface pay-equity and representation gaps before they become problems. Publish dashboards your HR business partners and leaders actually use, and push the insights that matter into talent, planning, and compensation work.

Start with workforce metrics, then layer in engagement listening, predictive modeling, and diversity analytics as your team grows into a data-driven people function.
records.business_logic: Predictive models (attrition, performance, DEI) and benchmarking calculations — the analytics engines beneath the report layer.

records.description: Contingent-workforce sourcing, staffing-supplier management, rate cards, contingent timesheets, and worker-classification compliance. Used by procurement and HR jointly.
records.catalog_tagline: Source contingent workers through approved staffing suppliers, manage rate cards, and reconcile timesheets and invoices end-to-end.
records.catalog_description: Manage the full contingent-workforce cycle, requisitions, supplier distribution, candidate submissions, worker assignments, timesheets, and invoices, in one system. Approve rate cards by role and region; classify each worker against IR35, California AB5, and EU Platform Work rules; and feed approved timesheets to payroll and project accounting automatically. Procurement and HR run it jointly: procurement governs the supplier panel, HR governs the worker classification.
records.business_logic: Rate-card refresh recomputes accrued cost across all active timesheets when a rate row supersedes; worker-classification engine applies IR35 / California AB5 / EU PWD precedence rules per engagement, producing a typed classification record that downstream payroll and AP-AUTO rely on for withholding rules.

records.description: General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, fixed assets, period close, multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation, and revenue recognition. The accounting system of record.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your financial accounting backbone end to end, from posting transactions to closing the books and reporting results you can stand behind.
records.catalog_description:
Bring every financial transaction into one ledger and keep it accurate, auditable, and ready for reporting. Record journal entries, maintain your chart of accounts and cost centers, manage multiple legal entities and currencies, and run a controlled period close so the numbers are trustworthy when leadership and auditors need them.

Go beyond the general ledger to manage the accounting that surrounds it: capitalize and depreciate fixed assets, reconcile cash and bank activity, recognize revenue under current standards, and match intercompany activity across entities. Every sub-ledger posting flows into the same controlled close, giving finance a single source of truth and a faster, cleaner month end.
records.business_logic: Consolidation, allocation, multi-GAAP translation, and period-close orchestration: the regulated calc kernel inside an otherwise transactional ledger.

records.description: FP&A: budgeting, rolling forecasts, driver-based modeling, scenario planning, workforce planning, and management reporting. Sits above the GL.
records.business_logic: Planning, modeling, and consolidation engines (multi-dimensional cubes, allocation, currency translation, eliminations); the calc kernel is the product.

records.description: Receipt capture, expense entry, policy enforcement, corporate card reconciliation, travel-booking integration, and reimbursement.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn employee spending into clean, policy-checked, reimbursable records from receipt to repayment.
records.catalog_description: Manage the full life of a business expense, from the moment money is spent to the moment it is reimbursed. Capture receipts and card charges, itemize them into reports, and check every line against your spending policy before it reaches an approver. Route reports for review, reconcile corporate card activity, and handle travel and per diem alongside everyday expenses. When a report is approved, the right amounts flow on for posting and repayment. Give employees a fast, simple way to get paid back, and give finance a trustworthy, audit-ready picture of where the money went.
records.business_logic: Policy engine (per-diem caps, currency, category limits) and OCR for receipt extraction — both increasingly declarative or ML-based.

records.description: Resource planning and allocation, project accounting, project time and expense, project billing, and utilization tracking for services organizations.
records.catalog_tagline: Run client work profitably from sold engagement to recognized revenue.
records.catalog_description: Plan and staff billable engagements, track every hour and expense against the right project, and turn delivered work into invoices and recognized revenue. You get one connected place to scope projects, match the right people to the work, watch utilization and margin in real time, and bill milestones or time and materials with confidence. Forecast demand against available capacity, flag at-risk projects before they slip, and keep finance, delivery, and resourcing working from the same numbers.
records.business_logic: Resource scheduling and revenue recognition (percentage-of-completion, milestone billing), calc-heavy but bounded.
records.notes:
2026-05-20 reanalysis:
- Deduplicated Replicon (Replicon PSA solution merged into Replicon; Replicon now primary on both PSA and WFM).
- Added consumer rows: employees + job_profiles (from HCM), opportunities (CRM), contracts (CLM), expense_reports (EXPENSE).
- Added cross-domain handoffs: CRM->PSA opportunity.closed_won (high friction, cross-vendor stack shape), CLM->PSA contract.signed (medium), EXPENSE->PSA expense.approved (medium).
- Added flagship-suite coverage: Oracle NetSuite (primary), SAP S/4HANA (secondary), new Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management (primary).
- POSTPONED: friction reassessment of WFM->PSA time_entry.approved (currently low; cross-vendor stack shape may warrant medium).

records.description: Sales force automation, opportunity and pipeline management, account/contact management, and B2B/B2C customer lifecycle. Distinct from CSM (post-sale service) and MA (marketing).
records.catalog_tagline: Turn every prospect into a tracked relationship: capture leads, work deals through the pipeline, and keep one trusted record of every account.
records.catalog_description:
Customer Relationship Management gives your sales team one place to find every customer, contact, lead, and deal, and to move each one forward with confidence. Capture leads from any source, score and qualify them, then convert the best into contacts, accounts, and live opportunities without losing a thread.

Run the deal from first touch to close on a pipeline you control: define your stages and exit criteria, see amount, probability, and close date at a glance, and log every call, email, and meeting against the right account so nothing falls through. Built-in assistance drafts follow-ups, summarizes account history, and surfaces the next best action so reps spend more time selling and less time on data entry.

When a deal closes, the customer record is ready to hand off to the teams who fulfill, bill, and support it, so the relationship keeps moving long after the sale.
records.business_logic: Forecasting, opportunity scoring, and lead-scoring ML models — invoked from an otherwise CRUD-and-workflow surface.

records.description: Email/SMS/cross-channel campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, and journey management. Includes B2B (account-based marketing) and B2C (consumer engagement) variants.
records.catalog_tagline: Orchestrate marketing emails, nurture journeys, and lead scoring across email, SMS, push, and the web.
records.catalog_description: Run your marketing across every channel from one place. Author and send email campaigns, build multi-step nurture journeys that reach people on email, SMS, push, and in-app, and capture new leads through hosted landing pages and forms. Score and prioritize those leads automatically so the best ones reach sales at the right moment. Connect what each contact does back into the next message they receive, so every touch builds on the last and your whole funnel keeps moving without manual handoffs.
records.business_logic: Journey orchestration runtime, send-time and channel optimization, and segment evaluation at scale; campaign authoring is workflow.

records.description: Storefront, catalog, cart, checkout, and order capture for B2C and B2B digital commerce. Distinct from OMS (post-order distributed fulfillment).
records.catalog_tagline: Sell direct to consumers: catalog, checkout, and fulfillment in one commerce workflow.
records.catalog_description: Run your direct-to-consumer storefront end to end. Publish products and promotions, capture carts and take payment at checkout, and get paid orders picked, packed, and shipped. Track every order from cart to doorstep, tie each one back to the shopper, and keep catalog, payment, and delivery status in one connected place.
records.business_logic: Cart, promotion engine, search/merchandising ranking, and inventory-availability service: the runtime an e-commerce site depends on.

records.description: Real-time identity resolution and unified customer profiles across marketing, service, and commerce data. Activates segments to downstream channels.
records.catalog_tagline: Unify every customer signal into one resolved profile, then turn it into action.
records.catalog_description: Bring behavioral, transactional, and identity data together into a single resolved customer profile. Build audiences from any attribute or event, score customers for value and risk, and activate those audiences to your marketing, ads, and sales tools, with consent respected at every step.
records.business_logic: Identity resolution (probabilistic + deterministic stitching), segmentation evaluation, and activation throughput — the engine is the differentiator.

records.description: Product configuration, guided selling, pricing, discount approvals, and quote generation.
records.catalog_tagline: Build accurate, on-brand quotes fast: configure the product, apply the right price, and route discounts for approval without leaving the deal.
records.catalog_description: Configure-price-quote turns a complex product line and pricing playbook into a guided selling motion your reps can run in minutes. Sellers assemble valid configurations, pull the correct price and bundle, and apply discounts that route through the right approvers automatically, so deals move faster and margins stay protected. When a quote is accepted it hands a clean, approved draft straight to contracting, billing, and the rest of revenue, with no rekeying and no surprises. The result is shorter quote cycles, fewer pricing errors, and proposals that look professional every time.
records.business_logic: Product-configuration constraint solver, pricing engine (rule-based + algorithmic discounting), and proposal generation — irreducible algorithmic core.

records.description: Interactive data exploration, dashboards, governed self-service analytics, and embedded analytics. Distinct from observability (OBS) and process mining (PROC-MIN).
records.catalog_tagline: Turn governed data into reports and dashboards your whole organization can explore, then deliver the answers to the people who need them on a schedule.
records.catalog_description:
Business intelligence and analytics gives teams a self-service way to ask questions of their data without waiting on engineering. Analysts build saved queries against a governed semantic layer, assemble the results into reports and interactive dashboards, and publish them for the wider business to explore on their own.

Shared metric definitions keep everyone working from the same numbers, so a figure on a sales dashboard means the same thing as the one in a finance report. Content moves through a clear lifecycle, from draft to published to certified, and access controls decide who can view, edit, or share each artifact, including when something is shared outside the company.

Once content is live, subscriptions push reports and dashboard snapshots to inboxes on a recurring cadence, and failures or runaway queries raise signals that operations and cost teams can act on. The result is a single place to author, govern, and distribute analytics, turning raw data into decisions that the business can trust.
records.business_logic: OLAP/analytics engine, semantic layer, and query optimizer — irreducible. The report-authoring UI is declarative on top.

records.description: Persistent channel-based messaging, threaded conversations, voice/video huddles, and external collaboration. Distinct from KMS (knowledge artifacts).
records.catalog_tagline: Bring your teams into shared channels where conversation, calls, and files stay in one place.
records.catalog_description: Give everyone a persistent home for work conversations. Organize discussion into channels and threads so context never gets lost in a crowded inbox, and let people drop into a voice or video huddle the moment a chat needs a face-to-face. Share files, react, and follow only the conversations that matter to you. When work spans company lines, invite external partners and guests into the right channels with access you control and can revoke at any time. The result is faster decisions, fewer meetings, and a searchable record of how the work actually happened.
records.business_logic: Message delivery, presence, and search — infrastructure-level, but the application surface (channels, threads, files) is straightforward CRUD.

records.description: Code-first managed runtime for deploying web apps, APIs, and background workers. Distinct from LCAP (low-code) and IPAAS (integration).
records.catalog_tagline: Ship code-first apps to a managed runtime that builds, deploys, and scales without touching servers.
records.catalog_description: Push your web apps, APIs, and background workers to a managed runtime that builds your code on every commit and deploys it for you. Promote a release from staging up to production, watch it roll out, and roll back a bad deploy without managing infrastructure. Spin up the databases, caches, and queues your app needs as attachable add-ons, scale instances up and down as traffic changes, and keep each environment isolated and reproducible. Teams get from commit to running app in minutes and stay focused on product instead of provisioning and patching servers.
records.business_logic: Application runtime, autoscaler, build pipeline, networking, and storage abstractions — the platform IS the kernel.

records.description: Web content management, personalization, customer portals, and headless content delivery for branded digital experiences.
records.catalog_tagline: Build, personalize, and orchestrate every page, audience journey, and experiment across your digital properties.
records.catalog_description:
Run your websites, microsites, and customer portals from one place. Author pages and reusable content, then publish them across multiple sites and brands with a clear review and approval flow.

Tailor what each visitor sees with rule-based personalization, segments, and A/B testing, so the right message reaches the right audience. Guide people through multi-step journeys and self-service portals, and keep everything in sync with your marketing, commerce, and customer data systems.
records.business_logic: Personalization and recommendation engines, A/B testing infrastructure, and search ranking; the content-management side is CRUD.

records.description: Points/tiers, rewards programs, member portals, and partner ecosystems for B2C and B2B2C loyalty.
records.catalog_tagline: Reward repeat customers with points, tiers, and personalized perks that grow customer lifetime value.
records.catalog_description:
Turn one-time buyers into repeat customers by enrolling them in a loyalty program, building rich member profiles, and moving them up tiers as they engage. Set the rules for how members join, what counts toward their status, and what they unlock at each level.

Reward engagement the way you choose: award points for purchases and actions, publish a catalog of rewards members can redeem, and run the redemption workflow end to end. Layer on bonus-point promotions and partner coalitions so members earn and spend across more places.

Give members a self-service portal to check their balance, browse rewards, and track their progress, and use program analytics to see what drives retention. Connect the program to your commerce, customer, and marketing systems so loyalty data flows where your team already works.
records.business_logic: Tier engine and points accrual/redemption rules — declarative but central to the product.

records.description: Full lifecycle API design, gateways, developer portals, security, and monetization for internal and external APIs.
records.catalog_tagline: Design, secure, publish, and monetize your APIs from one place.
records.catalog_description: Run the full life of every API: author the contract, version it cleanly, and push it through gateways with the access, authentication, and rate-limit rules you need. Onboard the developers and partners who consume your APIs, give them a self-service portal and keys, and watch real usage with per-consumer call volumes, latency, and error rates. Catch breaking changes before they reach subscribers, hold deprecated versions to a sunset plan, and turn API traffic into a billable, governed product instead of an unmanaged back door.
records.business_logic: Gateway data plane (request routing, transformation, auth, rate limiting, observability) — a high-throughput runtime. Developer portal and policy management are CRUD.

records.description: End-to-end DevOps platforms covering source control, CI/CD, build, test, release, and value-stream analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Take code from commit to production on one connected platform, with full visibility into how fast and how reliably your teams ship.
records.catalog_description:
A value-stream delivery platform brings source control, code review, continuous integration, build and artifact management, and release automation together so engineering teams can move a change from the first commit all the way to a running deployment without stitching together a chain of disconnected tools.

Developers open pull requests, automated pipelines build and test every change, signed artifacts are promoted through environments, and deployments roll out with the controls and rollback safeguards that release and compliance teams expect. Every step is captured as a record, so the path from idea to production is traceable end to end.

On top of that flow sits value-stream analytics: lead time for changes, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to restore. Engineering leaders use these measures to see where work slows down, prove the impact of process improvements, and keep delivery both fast and safe.
records.business_logic: CI/CD execution graph runtime, artefact management, and policy enforcement; pipelines and projects are CRUD over this.

records.description: Production Kubernetes distributions with day-2 operations, multi-cluster management, and integrated CI/CD.
records.catalog_tagline: Run production Kubernetes clusters and the workloads on them, with day-2 operations and fleet-wide control.
records.catalog_description: Stand up production-grade Kubernetes clusters, size and scale their node pools, and keep them patched, upgraded, and healthy through their whole life. Roll out applications as workloads and packaged releases, install the operators and service meshes they depend on, and wire in the pipelines that build and deploy into the cluster. Manage many clusters as one fleet instead of hand-tending each one. Get reliable container infrastructure with the upgrade, backup, and recovery routines built in, so platform teams ship and operate workloads without assembling the platform from scratch.
records.business_logic: Kubernetes control plane, scheduler, networking (CNI), storage (CSI), and node lifecycle — distributed systems infrastructure.

records.description: Network observability, flow analysis, path tracing, and SaaS/internet performance monitoring across WAN, LAN, and cloud.
records.catalog_tagline: See how traffic flows, where paths break, and how your SaaS and internet performance look to real users, so you catch network trouble before it reaches the help desk.
records.catalog_description:
Network performance monitoring and diagnostics gives operations teams a live picture of how the network is behaving end to end. It collects flow records and path traces, samples latency, jitter, loss, and throughput across links and application paths, and learns a baseline for what normal looks like so that real problems stand out from everyday noise.

When a metric crosses a threshold or a path degrades, the platform raises a network-specific alert with the affected path or flow and the baseline it broke, and walks that alert through acknowledge, resolve, and close. Topology snapshots and interface state keep the map of the network current, so an engineer can move from a symptom to the segment or device at fault in minutes instead of hours.

The same lens reaches past the edge of the corporate network. Synthetic and real-user checks measure how reachable and responsive SaaS applications are from the locations, networks, and carriers your people actually use, exposing internet and last-mile trouble that lives outside your own gear. Alerts open tickets in service management, anomalies feed event correlation and observability, and topology updates reconcile with the configuration database, so network insight drives the rest of the operations toolchain rather than sitting in a silo.
records.business_logic: Flow analysis (NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX), path tracing, BGP/route monitoring, and synthetic probes — stream-processing algorithms at scale.

records.description: Endpoint and synthetic monitoring of the employee or customer digital experience: device health, application responsiveness, and SaaS reachability.
records.catalog_tagline: See the digital experience your people and customers actually get, before they file a ticket.
records.catalog_description: Digital Experience Monitoring tells you whether the apps, devices, and SaaS your workforce and customers rely on are fast, available, and frustration-free. It runs synthetic checks from the locations that matter, captures real session telemetry, scores endpoint and application responsiveness, and flags friction and anomalies the moment they degrade the experience. Use it to catch slowdowns proactively, route the right signal to incident and operations teams, and prove that reachability and responsiveness meet the bar your business expects.
records.business_logic: Endpoint-agent runtime, synthetic transaction generation, and correlation across user / device / app / network signals: code-dominant data plane.

records.description: Asset, capacity, power, cooling, and floor-plan management for physical data centers and edge sites.
records.catalog_tagline: See, power, cool, and plan every rack in your data centers from one live model, so you never run out of space, power, or cooling by surprise.
records.catalog_description:
Data center infrastructure management gives facilities and IT infrastructure teams a single, authoritative model of the physical estate: every site, rack, and cabinet, the power chain that feeds them, the cooling that keeps them within range, and the cables and ports that connect them. Instead of spreadsheets and tribal knowledge, you get a live register of what is installed, where it sits, and how much headroom is left.

Operators track power from the incoming circuit through distribution units and uninterruptible supplies down to the outlet, monitor temperature and humidity from cabinet-level sensors, and map physical connectivity port by port and cable by cable. When a circuit overloads, a cooling unit fails, or an environmental threshold is breached, the event is captured and routed to the teams and systems that need to act.

On top of the asset and telemetry layer sits capacity planning: forward-looking projections of power, cooling, space, and bandwidth per site and zone. Planners use that headroom view to schedule growth, justify build-outs, and negotiate colocation with confidence, while changes to the physical layer flow out to the configuration database and downstream operations so the rest of IT stays in step.
records.business_logic: Power, cooling, and capacity calculations across racks and rooms; physical-asset register and workflow form the larger surface.

records.description: Discovery, optimization, lifecycle management, and renewal management for the company's SaaS portfolio. Distinct from classic SAM which focuses on installed software licenses.
records.catalog_tagline: See every SaaS app your company pays for, cut wasted licenses, and never miss a renewal.
records.catalog_description: Discover every SaaS application in use, sanctioned or not, see who owns each one, and track real usage against what you pay for. Reclaim idle licenses automatically, run renewals on a schedule instead of in a panic, and give employees a self-service catalog to request the apps they need. One place to manage your whole SaaS portfolio, from first sign-up to final offboarding.
records.business_logic: Usage analytics and engagement scoring to identify under-utilized licenses; the rest is discovery, contracts, and renewal workflow.

records.description: Modern device management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and ChromeOS, including MDM, configuration, app distribution, and zero-touch provisioning.
records.business_logic: Policy compiler, device-agent runtime, and OS-specific MDM protocol implementations — code-dominant; admin console is CRUD over policies and groups.

records.description: Authoritative golden records for shared entities (customer, supplier, product, asset) including matching, survivorship, and stewardship.
records.catalog_tagline: Resolve duplicate records from every system into one trusted golden record for each customer, supplier, and employee.
records.catalog_description:
Bring the scattered versions of each customer, supplier, and employee together into a single record everyone can rely on. Pull in records from every connected system, find the ones that point to the same real-world entity, and merge them with rules you control over which value wins per field. Route the uncertain matches to a data steward for review, so nothing gets merged by mistake and nothing slips through.

Once a golden record is set, it flows out to the systems that need it, keeping sales, service, HR, and analytics working from the same trusted facts. Tune your matching and survivorship rules as your data changes, track how each record was resolved, and handle data-subject and erasure requests cleanly across every place the record lives.
records.business_logic: Matching and survivorship algorithms (deterministic + probabilistic), hierarchy management, and stewardship workflows — the irreducible kernel beneath any MDM hub.

records.description: Metadata management, data discovery, lineage, business glossary, and stewardship workflows for the enterprise data estate.
records.catalog_tagline: Find, trust, and govern every data asset across the enterprise from one place.
records.catalog_description: Crawl and catalog your data sources, trace lineage end to end, run a shared business glossary, classify and certify assets, route data-access requests through policy, and publish governed data products. This is the metadata-and-governance layer that sits over the data estate so people can discover the right data and use it within the rules, without filing a ticket for every question or losing track of what is sensitive.
records.business_logic: Lineage extraction, automated tagging, and profiling, the metadata harvesting layer beneath the catalog UI.

records.description: Bulk and streaming data movement, ELT/ETL, and replication for analytical workloads and data warehouses/lakehouses. Distinct from iPaaS (transactional app integration).
records.catalog_tagline: Move data from every source system into your warehouse and lakehouse, on schedule and ready to analyze.
records.catalog_description: Your analytics are only as fresh as the pipelines feeding them. This is where you connect to the source systems your business runs on, pull their data in batch or as a continuous change stream, reshape it into the models your analysts query, and land it in the warehouse or lakehouse where it gets used. You configure a source once, pick what to sync and how often, and the platform keeps the destination current, retrying on failure, tracking each run, and adapting when an upstream schema changes so a new column does not silently break a downstream report. The payoff is trustworthy, timely data without a standing team of engineers hand-coding extracts. Pipelines run unattended, failures surface as alerts you can act on, and the lineage of every load is recorded so you can prove where a number came from and how stale it is.
records.business_logic: Streaming and ELT runtimes, change-data-capture engines, and schema-evolution handling — the platform IS the kernel.

records.description: Profiling, cleansing, standardization, matching, and ongoing monitoring of data fitness for purpose.
records.catalog_tagline: Find and fix the data quality problems that break decisions, before they reach a dashboard, a model, or a customer.
records.catalog_description:
Make your data trustworthy and keep it that way. Profile your tables to learn what is actually in them, write the rules that define acceptable state, and run those rules on every load so cardinality bounds, format patterns, referential integrity, and statistical thresholds are checked the moment data lands. When a rule breaks, raise an incident, route it to the owner, track root cause and remediation, and close the loop, so a bad batch becomes a worklist item instead of a silent corruption that surfaces three reports later.

Monitor fitness continuously across the dimensions that matter: completeness, uniqueness, validity, timeliness, consistency, and accuracy. Roll the dimension scores up into scorecards that show direction and trend, set quality SLAs with hard thresholds, and get alerted the instant a metric breaches or recovers. Catch the silent failures that fixed rules miss by flagging anomalies in volume, freshness, and distribution before downstream consumers notice.

Give every team a shared, defensible answer to a simple question: can I trust this data? Feed quality signals to the catalog so assets carry a health flag, open tickets in the service desk when an SLA is breached, and hand clean, profiled, monitored data to the analytics and AI platforms that depend on it.
records.business_logic: Profiling, matching, anomaly detection, and data observability, the algorithmic plane the workflow sits on top of.

records.description: Document repositories, records management, workflow, and information governance for internal unstructured content. Distinct from DXP (external/customer-facing).
records.catalog_tagline: Store, classify, and retain every document with built-in workflow and audit-ready compliance.
records.catalog_description: Enterprise Content Management gives you one trusted home for every document. Capture content from any source, version it safely with check-in and check-out, and route it through review and approval before it goes live. Apply retention schedules, legal holds, and full audit trails so the right records are kept, the rest are disposed of on time, and you can prove both whenever you are asked. Find what you need in seconds and control who can see it, all the way from first draft to final disposition.
records.business_logic: Full-text search and OCR; the rest is repositories, taxonomies, retention rules, and approval workflows.

records.description: Centralized storage, taxonomy, rights management, and distribution of brand and creative assets (images, video, design files).
records.catalog_tagline: Give every team one trusted home for approved photos, video, and brand files, so the right asset is always easy to find, share, and use on brand.
records.catalog_description:
Digital asset management gives marketing, brand, and creative teams a single, organized library for the photos, videos, logos, and design files the business produces and depends on. Instead of hunting through scattered drives, inboxes, and folders, people upload assets once, tag them, and find them again in seconds through search, categories, and curated collections.

Built into that library is the control the brand needs: assets move through review and approval before they go live, usage rights and model releases are tracked against each file, and version history keeps the latest approved cut front and center. When an asset is ready, teams generate the right size and format for each channel and share it through expiring, watermarked links or push it straight to the websites, stores, and partners that need it.

The payoff is speed and consistency at once: creative work gets reused instead of recreated, every channel ships the approved version, and brand and legal stay confident that what goes out into the world is current, licensed, and on brand.
records.business_logic: Image and video transforms (resize, format conversion, watermark), irreducible but commodified by cloud media services.

records.description: API-first content platforms and headless CMS for omnichannel content delivery, decoupled from presentation.
records.business_logic: CDN and rendering pipeline (delivery, caching, image processing) sit beneath the API — the application surface itself is content models and entries.

records.description: Legally-binding electronic signature capture, identity verification, and audit trails for digital agreements.
records.catalog_tagline: Send agreements out for legally binding electronic signature, verify who is signing, and capture a tamper-evident audit trail for every transaction.
records.catalog_description:
Electronic signature software lets your teams prepare a document, route it to the right people in the right order, and collect legally binding signatures without printing, mailing, or chasing paper. A single signing package moves through a clear lifecycle, from draft to sent to completed, so everyone can see exactly where an agreement stands and what is still outstanding.

Before a signature is accepted, signer identity can be verified through methods such as email authentication, one-time passcodes, knowledge-based questions, or government ID checks, which raises the legal weight of the result. Once all parties have signed, the platform seals the document and produces a certificate of completion that records who signed, when, and from where, giving you defensible evidence if an agreement is ever questioned.

Because signing is a step inside larger business processes, completed agreements flow straight into the systems that need them, such as contract repositories, HR records, and sales operations, while the signing platform remains the system of record for the signature event itself. The result is faster turnaround, fewer errors, and compliance with electronic signature frameworks such as the ESIGN Act, UETA, and eIDAS.
records.business_logic: PKI and crypto kernel for signature creation, timestamping, and validation, small in surface area but irreducible and regulated.

records.description: Outbound sales cadences, multi-channel sequencing, dialler, conversation intelligence, and rep productivity. Sits alongside CRM rather than replacing it.
records.catalog_tagline: Reach more of the right prospects with structured outreach, and turn every call and email into coaching that lifts the whole team.
records.catalog_description:
Run repeatable outbound motions instead of one-off emails. Build multi-step sequences that mix email, calls, social, and tasks, enroll the right prospects, and let timing and branching rules keep each rep on track so nobody slips through the cracks.

Connect with prospects faster using built-in dialing, tracked email with open and reply visibility, reusable templates, and prospect-facing scheduling that books meetings without the back-and-forth.

Record and transcribe calls and meetings automatically, surface what worked and what stalled, and feed scorecard-driven coaching so managers can ramp new reps quickly and help the whole team sell the way your best reps already do.
records.business_logic: Conversation intelligence ML (transcription, sentiment, deal-risk signals) and dialler integration; sequencing and outreach are workflow.

records.description: Channel partner portals, deal registration, MDF management, partner training, and indirect-revenue analytics.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your channel program end to end: recruit and tier partners, register and protect joint deals, fund partner-led marketing, and score partner performance against revenue and growth targets.
records.catalog_description: Partner Relationship Management runs the indirect-revenue motion on one surface. Onboard channel partners into tiered programs, give them a branded portal with role-based access, and operate the day-to-day workflows that hold a channel program together. Register and protect joint deals with conflict resolution when two partners chase the same prospect. Fund partner-led marketing through market development requests and claims with proof of spend, plus co-op fund accrual. Enroll partners in training and track certifications so the right partners stay enabled. Score every partner each quarter on revenue, growth, certification compliance, and fund utilization, then run quarterly business reviews against a shared joint plan. Track partner-influenced pipeline and surface co-sell signals so the team knows where a partner already has the account. Built for channel and partner teams, with clean handoffs to marketing for through-channel campaigns, to finance for fund settlement and partner-channel commissions, and to your CRM for registered opportunities and qualified partner referrals.

records.description: Recurring billing, subscription lifecycle (upgrades, downgrades, suspensions), revenue recognition, and dunning for subscription and usage-based business models.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the full subscription money lifecycle, from sign-up through billing, revenue, and recovery.
records.catalog_description: Operate recurring revenue end to end. Activate and change subscriptions, generate and issue invoices on a schedule, rate metered usage, recognize revenue under modern accounting standards, and recover failed payments through dunning. Built for teams that need every billing event, state change, and revenue entry to stay auditable and tied to the customer record.
records.business_logic: Revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, proration, dunning logic, usage rating, and tax determination — regulated and irreducible.

records.description: Cloud telephony, omnichannel routing, IVR, workforce engagement management, and AI agent assist for contact centers. Distinct from CSM (case-management business app).
records.catalog_tagline: Run your contact center in the cloud: route every call, chat, and message to the right agent, capture and score interactions, and keep teams staffed and on target.
records.catalog_description:
Bring every customer conversation onto one cloud platform. Calls, chats, emails, SMS, and social messages land in unified queues and route to the agent best suited to handle them, with self-service menus and AI assistance deflecting and speeding up the simple requests. Agents see the customer's history across channels as soon as the interaction connects, and wrap up each contact with a clear outcome code that feeds reporting and follow-up.

Behind the scenes you get the tooling to run the operation: live queue dashboards and service-level alerts, agent presence and availability tracking, and full interaction recording for quality and compliance. Supervisors review and score recorded interactions, coach agents on what to improve, and watch real-time metrics so they can shift staffing before service levels slip.
records.business_logic: ACD/routing engine, IVR runtime, real-time analytics, and workforce engagement (recording, QM, WFM) — the platform IS the engine.

records.description: Orchestration of pre-boarding, Day-1, and 30/60/90 workflows for new hires, task lists, welcome experiences, documentation, e-signature, buddy assignments, and downstream provisioning coordination. Operates primarily as a downstream-trigger pattern: offer.accepted (ATS) and employee.created (HCM) drive journey instantiation, which then fans out events to ITSM (provisioning), IWMS (facilities), Payroll (activation), LMS (compliance training), HRSD (case escalation), and IGA (access provisioning), making it the textbook case for the cross_domain_handoffs analytic.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn an accepted offer into a productive, welcomed employee by day one.
records.catalog_description: Employee onboarding orchestrates everything that has to happen between a signed offer and a new hire who is set up, compliant, and engaged. It instantiates a structured journey the moment a candidate is hired or an employee record is created, then drives the pre-boarding, day-one, and 30/60/90 milestones from a single plan. Task lists are generated conditionally by role, location, and employment type, and the right work is routed automatically to IT for provisioning, to facilities for workspace setup, to payroll for activation, to learning for compliance training, and to identity for access. Document intake captures and validates new-hire paperwork, while welcome experiences and buddy pairings make the first weeks feel intentional. The result is a faster time to productivity, fewer dropped handoffs across departments, and an auditable record that every compliance step was completed on time.
records.business_logic: Conditional task generation based on role, location, and employment type; cross-system orchestration to HCM, IGA, and Payroll.

records.description: Multi-year strategic capacity planning: target headcount, skills, location, and cost over a 1-5 year horizon, with what-if scenarios (growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, cost optimization) and labor-market overlay. Distinct from WFM (operational scheduling, time and attendance) and EPM (financial planning) although it produces a cost projection that EPM consumes. Operates upstream of ATS: SWP authorizes hiring (headcount.approved triggers requisition creation), making SWP and ATS co-masters of job_requisitions, the canonical multi-master Signal-1 example.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan the workforce you will need years ahead: target headcount, skills, locations, and cost, modeled against every what-if.
records.catalog_description:
Strategic Workforce Planning connects your business plan to the people who will deliver it. Build a multi-year picture of the workforce you need by role, skill, location, and level, then compare it to the workforce you have and see the gap before it becomes a crisis.

Model growth, reduction, restructure, geography shift, skill pivot, and cost-optimization scenarios side by side, overlay live labor-market data, and turn the chosen plan into approved headcount that flows straight into hiring. Project the fully loaded cost of every plan so finance can fold it into the budget, and reconcile plan against actuals as the year unfolds.

Start with demand and supply modeling, then layer in scenario planning, org design, and workforce costing as planning matures from a once-a-year spreadsheet into a continuous discipline.
records.business_logic: Workforce supply/demand modeling, scenario planning across role taxonomies, skills-gap projection over time.
