records.description: Product discovery, customer-feedback aggregation, feature prioritization, roadmap planning, and release management for software products. Distinct from Strategic Portfolio Management (investment selection) and engineering issue tracking (delivery execution).
records.catalog_tagline: Turn customer signals into a prioritized roadmap and ship features your users actually asked for.
records.catalog_description: Capture feedback and feature requests, weigh them against business value, and decide what to build next. Plan releases, publish a roadmap your stakeholders can trust, and run beta programs to validate ahead of general availability. Track adoption and product metrics after launch so every release closes the loop back to the customers who shaped it.
records.business_logic: Feedback aggregation and clustering, RICE / value-vs-effort scoring, dependency-aware release timeline computation.

records.description: Territory design, quota allocation, sales-capacity planning, incentive compensation management (ICM), commission calculation, plan modeling, payee statements, and SPIF programs for the sales organization. Code is SALES-PERF rather than the analyst-standard SPM because SPM is already used in this catalog for Strategic Portfolio Management (the IT/agile-delivery flavor). Distinct from COMP-MGMT (broad employee compensation: pay equity, bonus, equity admin) and from EPM (finance-led planning).
records.catalog_tagline: Plan, allocate, and pay your sales organization. Design territories and quotas, model commission plans, and run accurate commission statements every period.
records.catalog_description:
Sales Performance Management runs the planning and pay side of your sales motion. Design territories and roll up quotas to match your go-to-market segments, then build commission plans with the rate tables, accelerators, draws, and SPIFs your sales leaders need to motivate the team.

Each period, every credited transaction flows into the engine, calculates commissions per plan, and posts a payee statement your sellers can audit. Sellers raise disputes against statements, finance signs off on commission expense, and the next plan cycle starts with clean territory and quota data.

Built for sales-ops and rev-ops teams who own quota strategy and commission accuracy, with finance partnering on commission expense (ASC 606 amortization) and HR partnering on payee eligibility.
records.business_logic: Commission calculation engine over complex plan rules, retroactive adjustments, territory crediting, payout reconciliation.

records.description: AI-driven analytics on sales activity, deal signals, and customer conversations to produce pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal scoring, and rep coaching insights. Combines conversation intelligence (call/email recording and transcription) with auto-activity capture and revenue forecasting. Distinct from SALES-ENG (outbound cadence execution) and CRM (system-of-record for opportunities).
records.catalog_tagline: See every deal the way your best rep would. AI-driven pipeline analysis, deal scoring, and revenue forecasts from your team's calls, emails, and CRM activity.
records.catalog_description:
Revenue Intelligence reads the signals your sales team generates every day, calls, emails, meetings, opportunity updates, and turns them into deal-level risk scores and an accurate roll-up forecast. Instead of reps hand-rolling pipeline reports, the system tells managers which deals are slipping, which are progressing on schedule, and where coaching attention pays off.

Conversation intelligence transcribes and tags every recorded call, surfacing competitor mentions, pricing objections, and next-step commitments. Auto-activity-capture removes the data-entry tax on reps and keeps the CRM clean. Coaching workflows close the loop, replaying calls against your playbook so enablement can spot patterns across the team.

Built for sales managers, RevOps, and enablement, sitting alongside your CRM rather than replacing it. Forecast accuracy is the headline metric; deal-coverage ratios and rep ramp velocity follow.
records.business_logic: Conversation transcription and topic extraction, deal-risk scoring from activity signals, forecast roll-up models over CRM.

records.description: Cross-functional annual go-to-market planning owned by Sales Operations and RevOps: market segmentation, ICP and named-target-account-list authoring, planning-grade account scoring, territory carving and quota allocation, sales-capacity and coverage modeling, strategic channel-mix, what-if scenario modeling, and the plan-lock and downstream push to Sales, Marketing, and Finance. Authors the ICPs and target account lists that ABM-PLATFORM later engages against, and the territory and quota design that Sales Performance Management executes. Launch orchestration moved to Product Marketing Management; engagement (intent, ads, web personalization) moved to ABM-PLATFORM.
records.catalog_tagline: Plan your year. Decide where to play, how much capacity to invest, and which segments to lead with, then push the locked plan to Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
records.catalog_description:
Go-to-Market Planning runs the cross-functional planning that decides how you enter and grow markets. Define your ideal customer profile, carve segments, score and tier accounts, draft territories and quotas, and model capacity-to-coverage against your revenue targets.

Run what-if scenarios across geographies, channels, and segments, then layer launch orchestration on top: sequence product launches, gate on readiness, and coordinate the cross-functional motion from product marketing through Sales, Marketing, Support, and Success.

When the plan locks, push the artifacts downstream: territories to sales performance management, target accounts to CRM and marketing automation, and capacity numbers to Finance. Built for Sales Ops and RevOps teams who own the annual go-to-market motion, partnering with Marketing Ops, Product, and Finance.
records.business_logic: Territory carving optimization, quota distribution algorithms, capacity modeling against revenue targets and seller productivity benchmarks.

records.description: Structured planning and orchestration for strategic and key accounts, relationship mapping (org charts, influence and sentiment tracking), white-space mapping (which products bought vs available), joint account plans, mutual close/onboarding plans, QBR automation, and key-account metrics. Distinct from CRM (transactional opportunity record), MA (programmatic engagement), and CPQ (quoting).
records.catalog_tagline: Plan, run, and review your strategic accounts the way the best account teams do: map relationships, find white space, write joint plans, and close on QBR commitments.
records.catalog_description: Give account teams a structured surface to plan against named key accounts: who decides, who buys today, and where the next opportunity sits. Relationship maps make the org chart and the political reality visible. White-space maps show every product an account has not bought yet on a per-business-unit grid. Account plans hold the named objectives and strategies the team will pursue this year, with a clean version history. Mutual action plans extend the plan to the buyer with shared milestones, owned roles on either side, and signed acknowledgments as work progresses. Quarterly business review templates and meeting workflows close the loop on every review: actions logged, commitments tracked, and last quarter's promises checked against this quarter's progress. Health and growth metrics roll up across the portfolio, key-account team assignments make staffing legible, white space identified by the planning workflow flows to sales engagement, and account-health decline flows to customer success. Built to sit on top of your CRM and customer-success systems rather than replace them.
records.business_logic: Opportunity-graph rollups and white-space scoring across account hierarchies; coverage and influence maps over key-account org charts.

records.description: Cross-channel social media publishing, scheduling, engagement (unified inbox), listening, analytics, and influencer/advocacy programs. Distinct from MA (lifecycle marketing automation), CDP (customer data unification), and SALES-ENG (1:1 outbound sales engagement).
records.catalog_tagline: Plan, publish, and schedule social content across every channel, then manage conversations, monitor brand mentions, and run influencer programs from one place.
records.catalog_description:
Run your brands whole social presence from a single workspace. Draft posts, route them through approval, and schedule them across all your connected channels with a shared content calendar so teams stay aligned.

Reply to comments and direct messages from a unified inbox, assign conversations to the right person, and never lose track of a customer reaching out on social. Track what people are saying about your brand with listening topics and alerts, so you can catch issues early and act on emerging trends.

Discover and manage creator and influencer relationships from first outreach through active partnership, and tie published content and campaign results back to your broader marketing so you can see what social is actually driving.
records.business_logic: Social listening sentiment classification, audience clustering, optimal posting-time prediction across channels.

records.description: Modern intranet platforms, internal news and announcement broadcasting, targeted employee communications, frontline / deskless worker engagement, federated employee search, and onboarding / journey orchestration. Buyer is Internal Comms or HR. Distinct from Knowledge Management (knowledge artifacts), Workstream Collaboration (chat), HR Service Delivery (case management), and Employee Experience (engagement listening / surveys).
records.catalog_tagline: Reach every employee, from HQ to the shop floor, with one connected internal communications platform.
records.catalog_description: Publish company news, target announcements by department or location, and reach desk-based and frontline workers across web and mobile. Track readership, manage editorial calendars, and run multi-step journeys for onboarding, change initiatives, and policy rollouts. Connect employee directories, surface knowledge across collaboration tools, and let teams amplify approved content on social channels.
records.business_logic: Audience targeting algorithms, content personalization, federated search ranking across employee directories and content sources.

records.description: Inventory, ownership, lifecycle policy, permissions audit, external-sharing controls, sprawl detection, and stale-content remediation across enterprise collaboration suites (document libraries, chat workspaces, file-sync drives, group containers). Buyer is the collaboration-platform administrator (IT operations). Distinct from ECM (the underlying repository market) and from DSPM (data security posture).
records.catalog_tagline: Inventory every workspace, enforce sharing policies, and clean up sprawl across your collaboration tenant.
records.catalog_description: Discover every team site, channel, file-sync drive, and group container in your collaboration tenant. Run permission audits and external-share reviews on a schedule, archive workspaces that have gone stale, and automate provisioning so new workspaces ship with the right ownership and retention policy from day one. Catch oversharing before it becomes a data incident, surface broken or duplicated permission inheritance, and give business owners a path to attest to access without an IT ticket.
records.business_logic: Collaboration-graph inventory crawling, ownership inference, sprawl detection, and external-sharing risk scoring over collaboration metadata.

records.description: Editorial workflow, content audit and inventory, accessibility scanning, content quality / brand-voice enforcement, technical SEO governance, broken-link monitoring, and content-lifecycle planning for external / customer-facing web properties. The people-and-process layer over DXP and HCMS. Buyer is Marketing or the Web team. Distinct from INTRANET (internal audience), DXP (the delivery platform), and DAM (the asset store).
records.catalog_tagline: Govern every page on your public website from one place.
records.catalog_description: Keep your customer-facing web content accurate, accessible, on-brand, and findable as your site grows. Audit and inventory every page, run accessibility and quality scans, catch broken links and technical SEO issues, and plan editorial work and content refreshes on a clear calendar. Route findings to the right owner, track remediation to completion, and prove conformance when legal or procurement asks. Built for the marketing and web teams who own the site, layered cleanly over your delivery platform and content store.
records.business_logic: Accessibility (WCAG) scanning and scoring, technical SEO crawling, broken-link detection, brand-voice and content quality scoring.

records.description: Unified lakehouse-class platform combining storage, pipelines, governance, semantic modeling, analytics, and ML/AI lifecycle under one runtime. Distinct from point-solution data integration (DI), data catalog/governance (DCG), MDM, BI, and data quality (DQ), those domains are features of a Data and AI Platform, not standalone replacements for it.
records.business_logic: ELT/streaming pipeline execution (Spark, Flink, Beam); ML training and inference runtimes; vector indexing and similarity search; semantic ontology resolution mapping physical data to business concepts; declarative semantic layers (dbt-style); feature engineering and feature store; LLM orchestration with RAG and tool-use; fine-grained policy evaluation for row/column-level access; code-first transforms in SQL/Python/Scala; operational apps backed by the ontology layer (Foundry-style).

records.description: Agent-based monitoring, patching, scripting, and automation of distributed Windows/Mac/Linux endpoints and servers across multi-tenant customer estates. Sold to MSPs (per-endpoint pricing) and increasingly to internal IT departments (per-technician pricing). Distinct from ITOM (no full-stack APM/infrastructure observability), UEM (limited mobile/MDM coverage), and ITSM (no human-process workflow engine).
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every laptop, server, and device healthy, patched, and secure from one place, without sending anyone on-site.
records.catalog_description: See the live health of every endpoint you manage, get paged the moment something crosses a threshold, and fix it remotely before anyone files a ticket. Push operating-system and third-party patches on a schedule that respects maintenance windows, and run trusted scripts across hundreds of machines at once. Whether you run an internal IT team or manage devices for many client organizations, you get a single operational view and the controls to act on it from anywhere.
records.business_logic: Real-time agent telemetry ingestion at scale, threshold-based alerting with hysteresis and de-duplication, sandboxed script execution across heterogeneous OS (PowerShell, Bash, batch, Python), SNMP/WMI/ICMP network discovery, patch dependency resolution and rollback, agent self-update protocols, multi-tenant data isolation, NAT-traversal for remote control hand-offs.

records.description: Ticketing, contracts, time tracking, billing, and resource scheduling built around the MSP business model: multi-tenant customer estates, recurring service contracts, block-hour and value-based pricing, and per-customer SLAs. Distinct from generic PSA (services-org variant for consultancies and agencies), different buyer, different competitive set.
records.catalog_tagline: Run a profitable managed-services book: tickets, contracts, time, and billing in one place.
records.catalog_description: Built for the managed-service provider business model, this brings together customer estates, recurring service contracts, block-hour and value-based pricing, per-customer SLAs, ticket handling, time capture, invoicing, and technician scheduling. Service desks resolve customer issues against contracted SLAs, time entries flow into billing, contracts drive recurring revenue, and dispatch keeps the right technician on the right job, all with clean separation between each customer's data.
records.business_logic: Recurring contract billing with block-hour decrement, value-based pricing tiers, SLA timer pause/resume on hold, multi-tenant data isolation between customer estates, technician dispatch and scheduling optimization, time-entry approval routing.

records.description: Attended (technician-initiated with end-user present) and unattended remote control of workstations and servers, with session recording, file transfer, privilege elevation, and NAT-traversal relay. Distinct from VDI (full virtual desktops), VPN (network-layer tunneling), and PAM (privileged-access management with credential vaulting).
records.catalog_tagline: Take control of any workstation or server, with the privilege, recording, and file-transfer controls your auditors expect.
records.catalog_description:
Connect to attended and unattended endpoints and operate them as if you were sitting in front of them. Start a session with end-user consent or reach an always-on device, traverse firewalls and NAT without opening inbound ports, transfer files both ways, and elevate to administrator rights only when the work demands it.

Every session is recorded and audited, so you can prove who did what, on which machine, and when. Retain that evidence for as long as your policy or regulator requires, and hand the right details to your service desk, billing, or compliance team automatically when the session ends.
records.business_logic: Pixel-level remote desktop protocols over WebRTC and proprietary transports, NAT-traversal and relay infrastructure, end-to-end session encryption, multi-platform input injection (Windows/macOS/Linux/mobile), just-in-time privilege elevation, session recording and audit trails, concurrent-session brokering.

records.description: Unified employee-initiated spend across corporate cards, expense reimbursement, vendor bill pay, and pre-spend approval, anchored on real-time card authorization and policy enforcement at the network layer. Distinct from EXPENSE (post-hoc reimbursement / reconciliation of bank-issued cards), S2P (sourcing-led enterprise procurement with three-way-match), and AP-AUTO (invoice OCR + match + payment).
records.catalog_tagline: Give every team a card, a budget, and clear rules, then see and control company spend in real time.
records.catalog_description:
Put company money in employees' hands without losing control. Issue corporate cards with built-in limits, route every purchase request through the right approver, and pay vendor bills on time, all under one set of spending rules.

Set policies once and let them enforce themselves: cards decline out-of-policy purchases at the moment of swipe, requests above a threshold wait for sign-off, and high-value authorizations escalate automatically. Finance sees committed and actual spend as it happens instead of weeks later in a reconciliation.

Close the books faster with transactions, approvals, and vendor payments captured as they occur and handed cleanly to expense, accounts payable, and the general ledger.
records.business_logic: Real-time card-auth decisioning at the payment network (ms-latency decline based on MCC / vendor / amount / time / geography rules); ML-driven merchant categorization and receipt auto-matching; multi-currency FX and treasury netting; bill-pay routing (ACH / wire / card / check) with approval chains; spend anomaly detection.

records.description: Spreadsheet-database hybrids letting non-developers model structured data, link records across tables, build forms/views/dashboards, and automate without code. Bought self-serve by citizen developers in marketing, ops, HR, and PMO; expands to enterprise via Business/Enterprise tiers. Distinct from LCAP (no managed app runtime, no environments/version pipeline, no compiled UI), from BI (no warehouse, no analytical semantic layer), and from work management (the data model is the buy reason, not the project view).
records.catalog_tagline: Build a database without code. Model your data, capture it through forms, view it your way, and automate the rest.
records.catalog_description:
Stand up a working database in an afternoon, no developer required. Design your own tables, add the field types your work actually needs, and link records across tables so related information stays connected. Your data structure is the product: shape it to match how your team works instead of bending your work to fit a rigid tool.

Give everyone a way to read and contribute. Switch the same data between grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, and timeline views, each filtered and sorted to the question at hand, and share any view with the people who need it. Collect new information through forms that write straight into your tables, so submissions land clean and ready to use.

Put the busywork on autopilot. Trigger actions when records change or on a schedule, send notifications to the right people, and keep your tables in sync with the other systems you rely on. The result is a single place where your team models, captures, works, and automates its operational data.
records.business_logic: Spreadsheet-style formula fields with cross-table rollups and lookups; bidirectional sync engines that mirror records to/from external systems; automation actions that combine event triggers with conditional logic and external API calls; embedded AI for record summarization, classification, and generation.

records.description: Task, project, and workflow management for cross-functional work: assignments with owners and due dates, dependencies, statuses, dashboards, automations, and goal/OKR tracking. Bought by PMOs, BizOps, marketing, and any team running structured work that isn't engineering-specific. Distinct from SPM (top-down portfolio investment decision, CIO/EPMO buyer), from PSA (services billing/utilization for revenue-generating projects), and from dedicated software-engineering sprint tooling (developer-specific dev workflow).
records.catalog_tagline: Run every team's projects, tasks, and goals in one place, from first request to finished work.
records.catalog_description:
Bring structured work out of scattered spreadsheets and inboxes. Create projects, break them into assignable tasks with owners and due dates, map dependencies, and watch progress on boards, timelines, and dashboards that update as the work moves.

Set team objectives and key results, then connect them to the tasks that move them so progress rolls up automatically. Standardize repeatable work with templates, and let automations handle status changes, reminders, and routing.

Built for operations, marketing, and any team running cross-functional work that needs one shared view of who is doing what, by when.
records.business_logic: Cross-project resource leveling and capacity calculations; critical-path and dependency scheduling on linked tasks; OKR-to-task progress rollup with weighted contribution; recurring-task generation rules; AI-assisted task summarization, status drafting, and risk flagging.

records.description: Modeling, governance, and publication of an organization's business processes and capabilities. Includes BPMN process authoring, business capability maps, value stream modeling, reference-framework consumption (APQC PCF, TOGAF, ArchiMate, eTOM, SCOR), process simulation, and stakeholder publication portals. Distinct from Process Mining (PROC-MIN, event-log analytics) and from Application Portfolio Management (APM, application-landscape rationalization), though all three increasingly converge.
records.catalog_tagline: Design, document, and publish how your business actually runs.
records.catalog_description: Map your end-to-end processes, capabilities, and value streams in one connected workspace. Author process models, keep a single source of truth for how work flows, and publish approved versions your teams can trust. Simulate changes before you commit to them and hand insights off to the teams that execute, improve, and govern the work.
records.business_logic: Process simulation (Monte Carlo / discrete-event), BPMN execution semantics validation, framework-to-instance mapping (APQC PCF imports), and repository version-graph diff/merge.

records.description: Lightweight semantic tier defining metrics, dimensions, and entity relationships once, then exposing them via SQL/REST/GraphQL/MDX/JDBC to any downstream consumer: BI dashboards, AI agents, embedded analytics, custom apps. Distinct from BI (no UI / dashboard surface), from DI (no data movement), from DCG (no broader governance scope), and from DATA-AI-PLAT (a feature within those platforms, sold separately by pure-play vendors). Buyer: analytics / data-engineering leader.
records.catalog_tagline: Define your business metrics once and serve them to every dashboard, agent, and app.
records.catalog_description:
Different teams compute the same metric in different places, and the numbers stop matching. A revenue figure in a finance dashboard disagrees with the one in a sales report, and nobody can say which is right. Every new dashboard, notebook, or AI agent re-implements the logic, so the drift only gets worse as you grow.

A metrics layer lets you define each metric and its dimensions once, in one governed place, and then serves that single definition to everything downstream. Analysts certify the trusted version, the layer caches and federates the heavy queries, and access policies control who sees which numbers at what grain.

The result is one consistent answer to every metric question, delivered over SQL, REST, and AI-native interfaces, with full lineage back to the source so you can always explain where a number came from.
records.business_logic: Compilation of declarative semantic models into SQL query plans; multi-dimensional caching and aggregation with intelligent invalidation; query federation across warehouses and lakehouses; lineage propagation from physical sources to logical metrics; fine-grained access control at the metric/dimension level; AI-agent tool-use over the metric registry; natural-language-to-metric translation.

records.description: Enterprise platform for modeling, storing, querying, and reasoning over typed business objects via formal ontologies (OWL / RDF / SHACL) or labeled property graphs. Includes ontology authoring, inference, SPARQL/Cypher querying, virtual-graph federation, and operational-app affordances on top of the graph store. Buyer: enterprise architect / CDO / life-sciences R&D lead. Primary JTBD: build AI agents, operational apps, and complex analytical queries on top of a unified semantic model. Distinct from MDM (master-data orchestration without ontology engine), from DATA-AI-PLAT (broader scope including pipelines / lakehouse / ML), and from a plain graph database (KGP adds reasoning, ontology governance, and ontology-mapped operational-app affordances).
records.business_logic: OWL reasoning (RDFS, OWL-EL, OWL-RL, OWL-DL); SHACL constraint validation; SPARQL 1.1 query optimization with federation across remote endpoints; virtual-graph projection of relational/JSON sources as RDF; named-graph access control; hybrid vector+symbolic search for RAG; embedding generation and similarity over graph neighborhoods; provenance and lineage tracking; rule-based inference engines beyond OWL.

records.description: Detects and blocks unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data (PII, PCI, IP, source code) from leaving the organization perimeter via email, USB, cloud uploads, chat, web, and removable media. Classifies content at rest and in motion; applies policies (block, quarantine, mask, watermark, alert). Complementary to DSPM (which discovers data at rest); DLP enforces at the egress point.
records.catalog_tagline: Stop sensitive data from leaving your organization, and respond fast when it tries to.
records.catalog_description:
Catch confidential and regulated data before it walks out the door across email, web, endpoints, cloud apps, and chat. Define the rules that say what counts as sensitive, watch every egress path in real time, and block, quarantine, or coach users the moment a violation happens.

When something slips through, work the incident from detection to closure in one place: triage what happened, hold the artifact for review, grant time-boxed exceptions where the business genuinely needs them, and keep an auditable trail for regulators. Turn a flood of alerts into a managed queue your security team can actually clear.
records.business_logic: Content-scanning engine orchestration (regex / dictionary / statistical / ML pattern detection in files, streams, USB device traffic); policy evaluation on mixed criteria (user role, destination, device, network context); incident creation and remediation workflows; SIEM/SOAR integration for alerting.

records.description: Discovers sensitive data across cloud data stores (object storage, data warehouses, managed databases, SaaS apps), maps data lineage and access paths, identifies over-privilege and toxic combinations (PII + over-permissive policy), scores risk posture, prioritizes remediation. Discovers and secures at rest; DLP enforces at egress.
records.business_logic: Data classification ML (sensitivity scoring, PII/PHI detection); multi-cloud connector orchestration and SaaS API pagination at scale; risk-scoring rules combining sensitivity + access breadth + public-internet exposure; templated and custom remediation workflows requiring authorization checks.

records.description: Umbrella for corporate real-estate, workplace optimization, facilities management, and building operations. Two market tiers: IWMS (enterprise) and CAFM (mid-market) — modeled as sub-domains via parent_domain_id. Covers properties, leases, spaces, occupancy, maintenance, capital projects, and utility consumption (Scope 1+2 emissions source for ESG).
records.business_logic: Space-allocation algorithms (occupancy optimization); utility-consumption analytics; lease-cost modeling and amortization (ASC 842 / IFRS 16); capital-project lifecycle workflows.

records.description: Light-tier facilities management; mid-market and SMB focus. Desk booking, simple space allocation, maintenance ticketing, visitor management. Typically lighter on utility tracking and lease accounting than IWMS.
records.catalog_tagline: Run a smaller building without the enterprise overhead: book desks, reserve rooms, log fix-it tickets, and sign in visitors from one place.
records.catalog_description: Give a lean facilities team the everyday tools to keep a workplace running without standing up a heavy enterprise platform. Employees book a desk or reserve a meeting room from a simple floor map, so people know where to sit and rooms stop double-booking. When something breaks, anyone can raise a maintenance ticket and watch it move from reported to scheduled to fixed, with the work tracked against the right space. Front-desk staff register visitors, print badges, and keep a clean record of who was on site and when. Space allocation stays light: see how desks and rooms are assigned, spot the floors that are crowded or empty, and right-size the layout from occupancy trends rather than guesswork. This is the mid-market and small-business tier of workplace management, focused on reservations and basic service workflow, and intentionally lighter on utility metering and lease accounting than a full enterprise workplace suite. It is built to get a single site or a small portfolio organized fast, then grow into deeper space and real-estate tooling if the need arrives.
records.business_logic: Reservation engines and basic workflow.

records.domain_name: Real Estate Brokerage and Agent Operations
records.description: Lead capture, transaction management (offer→close), MLS syndication, commission splits, tour scheduling, and broker CRM for residential and commercial brokerages. Buyer is the brokerage / individual agent (per-seat pricing) or the franchise (enterprise pricing). Distinct from generic CRM (deal model is the property transaction, not the sales opportunity; commissions are split across cooperating brokerages by MLS rules).
records.catalog_tagline: Run the brokerage from first lead to closed deal.
records.catalog_description: Capture and nurture buyer and seller leads, publish listings to the MLS, schedule and track tours, and move every offer through escrow, contingencies, and closing. Calculate cooperating-broker and internal agent commission splits, keep state-mandated disclosures complete for compliance, and hand the closed transaction off to property management and accounting. Built for the way agents and brokers actually work a deal, not a generic sales pipeline.
records.business_logic: Commission-split engines (listing-side vs buyer-side, franchise overrides, agent caps), MLS-rule conformance (timestamps, mandatory fields, photo limits), transaction-document compliance per state (disclosure forms, agency disclosures), brokerage trust-accounting (escrow).

records.description: Tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance-request portal, leasing pipeline, vacancy marketing, and per-property general ledger for residential landlords (single-family-rental managers, multifamily operators, condo/HOA management). Buyer is the property-management firm or self-managing landlord. Distinct from REAL-EST/IWMS (corporate-tenant view); this is the landlord-of-residential-units view.
records.catalog_tagline: Collect rent, screen tenants, dispatch maintenance, and account for each property, all in one residential-management platform.
records.catalog_description: Run a residential portfolio (single-family rentals, multifamily buildings, condo associations) end to end. Market vacant units to listing sites, screen applicants against credit, criminal, and eviction history, draft and sign leases, collect rent (with prorations, late fees, and security-deposit accounting), and handle maintenance requests with vendor or in-house teams. Per-property general ledger feeds owner distributions and investor reporting, with built-in compliance for the Fair Housing Act, FCRA-regulated screening, and state-by-state landlord-tenant statutes.
records.business_logic: Prorated rent calculation (move-in/move-out), late-fee assessment per lease terms, rent-escalation schedules (CPI, fixed %), security-deposit accounting (state-by-state holding-period rules), tenant-screening score composition (credit + criminal + eviction history), eviction-process timing per jurisdiction.

records.description: CRE leasing pipeline (LOI→executed lease), CAM (common-area-maintenance) reconciliation, rent escalations, stacking plans, market-comp data, and tenant relations for commercial landlords and asset managers (office, retail, industrial, mixed-use). Buyer is the CRE owner/operator or third-party property manager. Distinct from RE-PROP-MGMT (residential lifecycle is operationally different, shorter leases, simpler accounting, no CAM).
records.catalog_tagline: Manage commercial leases, CAM reconciliations, rent escalations, and stacking plans across office, retail, and industrial portfolios.
records.catalog_description:
Run the full commercial leasing pipeline in one place. Move deals from letter of intent through negotiation to an executed lease, underwrite tenant credit before signing, and track subleases and assignments as the head lease changes hands. Every lease term, option, and escalation lives in a single record your team can act on.

Reconcile common-area-maintenance charges and recurring rent escalations without the spreadsheet scramble. Build expense pools, apply gross-ups and audit caps, calculate annual escalations, and produce clean reconciliation statements your tenants can trust at year-end.

See your buildings the way asset managers do. Maintain stacking plans that show who occupies every floor, keep building certifications and green ratings current, and use market context to guide renewals, vacancies, and tenant relationships across the portfolio.
records.business_logic: CAM-reconciliation engines (gross-up, exclusions, audit caps), percentage-rent calculations (sales-driven retail), escalation schedules (CPI, stepped, market-reset), tenant-improvement allowance amortization, free-rent abatement, stacking-plan optimization, rent-roll-to-NOI calculations.

records.description: Fund accounting (carry, waterfall distributions), investor reporting (capital calls, statements), portfolio valuation (cap rates, DCF, NAV), acquisition underwriting, and NOI/IRR modeling for REITs, RE private-equity funds, and institutional asset managers. Buyer is the REIT or fund manager. Distinct from generic fund-accounting platforms by RE-specific asset modeling (cap rates, rent rolls, property-level cash flow) and partner accounting structures (LP/GP waterfalls).
records.business_logic: Waterfall distribution calculations (preferred return, catch-up, carried interest tiers), capital-call apportionment by LP commitment, DCF valuation with cap-rate sensitivity, NOI normalization (one-time vs recurring), portfolio rollup with currency/entity translation, GAAP/IFRS lease-accounting at fund level.

records.description: Umbrella for the operational management of vehicle fleets: vehicle inventory and lifecycle, driver assignment, fuel and expense tracking, dispatch, utilization analytics, and regulatory compliance (DOT/IFTA). Cross-industry buyer (logistics, last-mile delivery, field service, public sector, construction, utilities, rentals). Two sub-domains: TELEMATICS (the GPS/ELD/dashcam data layer) and FLEET-MAINT (preventive maintenance, work orders, parts).
records.catalog_tagline: Run your whole fleet from one place: every vehicle, every driver, and every fuel dollar, with DOT and IFTA compliance built in.
records.catalog_description: Know what you own and how hard it works. Track each vehicle from the day you acquire it through every assignment, repair, and resale, and see at a glance which units earn their keep and which are costing you money. Put the right driver in the right vehicle, keep licenses and medical cards current, and stay on top of pre-trip and post-trip inspections so nothing rolls out unsafe. Watch fuel and charging spend in real time, catch exceptions before they add up, and turn raw mileage and fuel data into the DOT, IFTA, and IRP filings auditors ask for. Whether you run delivery vans, service trucks, or heavy rigs, you get one clear view of cost, safety, and compliance across the entire fleet.
records.business_logic: Vehicle utilization scoring (idle vs productive time), fuel-card transaction matching against vehicle assignments, mileage-vs-IFTA-jurisdiction allocation, route-to-job assignment optimization, regulatory-compliance scoring (DOT, FMCSA, IFTA).

records.description: GPS tracking, ELD (electronic logging device) compliance, driver-behavior monitoring (harsh braking, speeding, cornering), video telematics (dashcam), and engine/vehicle sensor data ingestion. The connectivity-and-data layer for fleet operations; foundation for utilization analytics, maintenance triggers, and incident-claims evidence. Distinct from FLEET-MGMT (the workflow layer above) and from generic IoT platforms (this is vehicle-specific hardware-plus-software).
records.catalog_tagline: See where every vehicle is, how it is driven, and whether it stays compliant, all from one connected view.
records.catalog_description:
Connect your vehicles and the data flows in on its own: live location, completed trips, idling, geofence crossings, engine health, and driving behavior. You get one place to watch the whole fleet move and to spot the trucks, routes, and drivers that need attention today.

The same connected feed keeps you on the right side of the rules. Hours-of-service logs, video of harsh-driving moments, and per-driver safety scores let you coach proactively, prepare for audits without scrambling, and show insurers a fleet that is measurably safer. Less time chasing paperwork and phone calls, more time running the operation.
records.business_logic: GPS-trace cleaning and trip-segmentation, ELD HOS calculation per FMCSA rules, driver-behavior-score composition from sensor events, near-miss / collision detection from dashcam AI, geofence event evaluation, IFTA-jurisdiction allocation from GPS traces.

records.description: Preventive-maintenance scheduling (mileage / engine-hours / time triggers), vehicle work-order management, parts inventory and consumption, mechanic/shop assignment, warranty tracking, and DOT/DVIR inspection workflow. Distinct from EAM (vehicles are mobile assets with telematics triggers; EAM targets fixed plant) and from FSM (FSM dispatches technicians to customers; this dispatches mechanics to internal vehicles).
records.catalog_tagline: Keep every vehicle on the road and control what each mile costs to maintain.
records.catalog_description: Run your whole maintenance operation from one place. Schedule preventive service so it lands before a breakdown does, turn driver reports and inspection findings into tracked repairs, and dispatch the right mechanic to the right shop. Keep parts on the shelf when you need them and off the books when you don't, and recover every dollar of warranty and recall coverage you are owed. See cost per mile and uptime by vehicle so you know when to keep fixing and when to replace.
records.business_logic: PM-schedule generation from telematics triggers (engine hours, mileage thresholds, DTC codes), parts BOM matching to vehicle make/model/year, warranty-claim eligibility computation, mechanic-skill matching to work-order type, DVIR-defect-to-work-order routing.

records.description: Law-firm operational platform: matter management (case lifecycle, parties, key dates, deadlines), timekeeper time capture and billing (ABA UTBMS task codes), IOLTA trust-account ledgering, conflict-of-interest checking across matters and adversaries, client intake, engagement letters, and matter-scoped document management. Buyer is the law firm (solo to mid-size). Vendor unconstrained by formal certification, the attorney carries all regulatory weight under ABA Model Rules and state bar ethics.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your whole law firm in one place, from client intake and conflict clearance through matters, billable time, trust accounting, and court deadlines.
records.catalog_description:
Manage every matter across its full life, from the first intake conversation and conflict check to the day the file is closed and archived. Track the people involved, the key dates that cannot be missed, and the documents tied to each case in one shared workspace.

Capture billable time against standardized task and expense codes, build prebills your partners can review, and send invoices in the electronic-billing formats your clients require. Keep client funds in separated trust ledgers with three-way reconciliation, automatic transfers when fees are earned, and the exception reporting your state bar expects.

Clear conflicts before you take on a new client, generate engagement letters from templates, collect retainers, and calendar court deadlines from jurisdiction rules so statutes of limitations and filing dates are never left to memory.
records.business_logic: Conflict-of-interest checking via graph-search across matters, parties, and adversaries; IOLTA trust-account ledger with three-way reconciliation (bank vs ledger vs client-balance), per-state retention rules; ABA UTBMS task/expense coding on time entries; legal-billing exception rules (block billing, fee-split agreements); statute-of-limitations and key-date alerting per matter type.

records.description: Veterinary-clinic operational platform: animal-patient records, pet-owner relationship management, appointment scheduling (species/exam-type fit), examination notes, vaccination and reminder protocols, drug inventory and controlled-substance ledger, lab-results integration, in-clinic POS, and boarding/grooming scheduling. Buyer is the veterinary clinic or hospital, solo to multi-site. No HIPAA exposure (animals aren't covered entities); DEA Controlled Substances Act applies to e-prescribing modules.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your whole veterinary practice, from the first appointment to the controlled-substance ledger, in one platform.
records.catalog_description:
Bring clinical care, the front desk, and the pharmacy together so your team can focus on patients instead of paperwork. Keep animal-patient records, pet-owner relationships, and appointment schedules in one place, and turn preventive-care reminders into recurring visits.

Handle examinations, vaccinations, and diagnostics, bill clients at the point of care, and keep drug inventory and the controlled-substance ledger accurate and inspection-ready. Whether you are a single-doctor clinic or a multi-site hospital, the practice runs on one connected system.
records.business_logic: Species/breed-specific weight-based drug-dosing calculations, DEA Schedule II–V controlled-substance ledger with reconciliation, preventive-care reminder protocols by species/breed/age, multi-pet household visit consolidation, lab-results trending across visits, boarding/grooming reservation overlap with exam appointments.

records.description: CPA / tax-preparer practice operating platform: client and engagement management, workflow templates per service line (1040, 1120, 1065, audit, bookkeeping, advisory), recurring-task generation against tax-calendar deadlines, time and billing, engagement-letter and proposal management, secure client portal for document exchange, and capacity-vs-due-date analytics. Buyer is the CPA firm or tax-prep practice, solo to mid-size. IRS Pub 4557 and GLBA regulate the preparer; SOC 2 is commercially expected but voluntary.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your accounting practice end to end: engagements, tax returns, and client billing in one workflow.
records.catalog_description: Manage the full lifecycle of professional accounting work, from accepting a client engagement through preparing and filing tax returns to billing for the hours your team logs. Standardize recurring tax-season work, keep client documents and signatures in one secure place, and give clients a portal to share files and pay invoices.
records.business_logic: Tax-calendar-driven workflow generation (Jan 31 1099/W-2, March 15 1120-S/1065, April 15 1040/1120, Oct 15 extensions, etc.), client-folder document-retention rules per IRS/state preparer requirements, engagement-letter e-signature chains with retainer-payment gating, capacity forecasting through tax season (timekeeper bandwidth vs filing deadlines), per-engagement workflow checkpoints with sign-off.

records.description: Vertical operations platform for advertising, marketing, creative, PR, and media agencies. Combines agency-specific job/traffic management, time tracking with client rate cards, retainer accounting with burn-down, media buying (plans + insertion orders + commission), creative review/proofing, multi-rate billing (cost-plus, retainer, T&M, fixed fee), and per-job profitability. Distinct from PSA (services/consulting firms — no media/retainer/commission semantics), from WORK-MGMT (horizontal, no client-billing or media-buying), and from DAM (asset library only).
records.catalog_tagline: Run your agency from estimate to invoice: client jobs, media buying, and creative operations in one place.
records.catalog_description: Manage your agency's client work end to end. Open jobs and track them through traffic and delivery, capture time against client rate cards, and watch retainers burn down in real time. Plan and buy media by outlet and channel, reconcile spend against publisher invoices, and move creative from brief to approved deliverable, then bill clients on markup or cost-plus terms without re-keying a thing.
records.business_logic: Multi-rate billing (cost-plus, fixed fee, retainer burn-down, T&M); media commission and markup (typically 17.65% gross-up or 15% media commission); per-job profitability rollups across time, materials, and media; retainer draw-down and replenishment; project-based revenue recognition under ASC 606; multi-currency client and supplier reconciliation.

records.description: Records, plans, and analyzes farm operations: field mapping, crop planning, planting/application records, harvest tracking, equipment telemetry, yield analytics, work-order assignment, and ag-input inventory. Distinct from generic ERP because operations are weather / soil / season-bound and depend on satellite-imagery, IoT-sensor, and machinery-telemetry feeds (ISOBUS, CAN-bus, John Deere Operations Center API).
records.catalog_tagline: Run the whole farm from one record: map every field, plan each season, log every operation, and turn it into yield and profit insight.
records.catalog_description:
Bring spatial field maps, season crop plans, and day-to-day operations into a single source of truth so you always know what was planted, sprayed, and harvested on every acre. Capture planting passes, chemical and fertilizer applications, and harvest yields as you go, then reconcile them against input stock and machinery activity without chasing paper or spreadsheets.

Use that record to author site-specific application maps, watch input levels before you run out, and answer the questions that move margin: which fields earned their keep, where inputs were over- or under-applied, and how this season compares to the last few. The same trail gives you defensible application and harvest evidence when a buyer, auditor, or regulator asks.
records.business_logic: Variable-rate prescription generation from soil / yield zones, NDVI / satellite-imagery analytics for crop-health scoring, machinery telemetry normalization (CAN-bus, ISOBUS, JD Operations Center API), weather-driven scheduling, agronomic recommendations (planting / spray timing windows), yield-zone clustering.

records.description: End-to-end traceability of food products through the supply chain: lot / batch genealogy, FSMA-204 critical-tracking-event (CTE) capture and key-data-element (KDE) reporting, supplier-document management, recall execution, and provenance / origin verification. Buyer is the food manufacturer, distributor, or grower-shipper subject to FSMA 204 (Jan 2026 enforcement) and equivalents (EU 1169/2011, Canada SFCR). Regulatory tailwind is the primary demand driver. Differs from generic Supply Chain Visibility by SKU-lot-level granularity and regulator-prescribed event capture.
records.catalog_tagline: Trace every lot from origin to shelf, prove provenance, and execute recalls in hours instead of days.
records.catalog_description:
Capture the critical tracking events and key data elements that food safety rules require, so any lot can be traced forward to its customers and backward to its source on demand. When a problem surfaces, identify every affected lot from the genealogy graph, notify the right consignees, place stock on hold, and file the required regulatory submissions from one place.

Keep supplier certifications, origin claims, and provenance documents current and verifiable, with expiry and renewal tracking so a lapsed certificate never slips through. Respond to regulator and trading-partner trace requests within the mandated window, and turn day-to-day production records into an audit-ready traceability trail.
records.business_logic: FSMA-204 CTE / KDE event capture and rule conformance, recall-execution workflow (notify → hold → consolidate → report → reconcile), supplier-document OCR / parsing / expiry tracking, lot-genealogy graph traversal, blockchain anchoring, audit-trail integrity.

records.description: Herd-level dairy operations: individual-cow lifecycle (calving, lactation cycles, dry-off, culling), parlor management, milk-quality testing, somatic-cell-count tracking, breeding and reproduction records, feed rationing, and FDA Grade A milk regulation compliance. Buyer is the dairy farm operator (large grazing or confined operations) or dairy cooperative member. Workflows are fundamentally different from beef / swine.
records.catalog_tagline: Run the dairy by the cow and by the tank: track every animal through her lactation, capture every milking, and keep milk quality and feed cost under control from one record.
records.catalog_description:
Manage the herd one cow at a time. Follow each animal through her whole working life, from heifer to first calving, through each lactation cycle, into dry-off, and on to a culling decision when the time comes. Breeding events, pregnancy results, and health treatments all hang off the individual cow record, so the next action and the withdrawal status are never a guess.

Capture what the parlor and the tank produce. Pull per-session milking yields straight from the parlor or robot, roll them into each lactation, and turn finished milk into bulk shipments ready for pickup. Test the milk that leaves the farm for somatic cell count, bacteria, butterfat, protein, and antibiotic residue, and hold a shipment when a result or an active treatment says it should not ship.

Keep the economics honest. Formulate total-mixed rations by group, log what actually goes in the mixer, and tie feed cost back to milk income so income-over-feed-cost is something you can see, not estimate. Quality results, treatment withdrawals, and shipment records line up to support FDA Grade A and animal-care obligations without a separate paper trail.
records.business_logic: Lactation-cycle stage tracking and dry-off scheduling, somatic-cell-count threshold escalation, reproduction window / heat-detection algorithms, parlor / AMS (automatic milking system) telemetry ingest, milk-meter reconciliation, ration formulation, cull-decision scoring, FDA Grade A milk record audit trail.

records.description: Food-safety management systems: HACCP plan development and audit, hazard analysis, CCP (critical-control-point) monitoring, food-fraud / VACCP / TACCP analysis, GFSI scheme certification audits (SQF, BRC-GS, FSSC 22000, IFS), allergen control, sanitation verification, environmental monitoring program (EMP), and recall management. Buyer is the food manufacturer subject to FSMA Preventive Controls Rule and (for export) GFSI-equivalent certification. Heavy overlap with Food Traceability on recall execution and supplier-document management; FSQM is the broader safety-system-of-record while Traceability is the lot-genealogy / CTE-capture specialist.
records.catalog_tagline: Keep food safe from receiving to release with one connected food-safety program.
records.catalog_description:
Run your entire food-safety and quality program in one place. Build and approve HACCP and preventive-control plans, monitor critical control points in real time, and act on deviations before product ships. Manage allergen controls, sanitation cycles, and environmental monitoring, then capture the records that prove control.

When something goes wrong, open an incident, drive corrective action, and escalate to recall in a few clicks. Walk into certification audits with evidence already organized, score and segment your suppliers by risk, and stay ahead of the obligations that regulators and retail customers expect you to meet.
records.business_logic: HACCP plan rule conformance and CCP deviation escalation, GFSI audit-prep checklists with score forecasting, environmental-monitoring trend analytics (Listeria / Salmonella positives mapping), allergen-changeover validation, supplier-risk scoring, recall traceback.

records.description: Direct-to-consumer (CSA shares, online farm stores, farmers market POS) and farm-to-wholesale (chefs / restaurants / food hubs) commerce platforms for small and mid-scale farms. Provides purpose-built CSA share customization, route optimization for DTC delivery, farmers-market POS reconciliation, and wholesale catalog / order management for the smallholder operator. Captures the small-organic / regenerative / direct-to-consumer segment of the food system.
records.catalog_tagline: Sell every harvest direct, from CSA shares to the farmers market stall to wholesale chefs, on one farm-built platform.
records.catalog_description: Run direct-to-consumer and farm-to-wholesale sales for a small or mid-scale farm without stitching together generic e-commerce, spreadsheets, and a card reader. Manage CSA memberships and weekly share customization, take payments at the market stall, route your own deliveries, and capture B2B orders from restaurants and food hubs, all tied back to what the field will actually yield. You see members, market days, wholesale buyers, and harvest forecasts in one place, so you can plan plantings against demand, cut packing-day chaos, and get paid across every channel you sell through.
records.business_logic: Route optimization for DTC delivery (mapping/routing integration), CSA share customization with swap / pause rules and dietary substitutions, farmers-market POS reconciliation across multiple market days, wholesale-pricing-tier management, payment-plan / installment scheduling, harvest-projection-to-available-shares planning, food-hub multi-farm producer-payout splits.

records.domain_name: Investor Relationship and Deal Flow Management
records.description: Relationship-intelligence CRM and deal-pipeline software for investors (VC, PE, family offices). Tracks founders, executives, deals, portfolio companies, and LP relationships with auto-network inference from email and calendar metadata.
records.catalog_tagline: See who in your network can open the next door, run every deal from first meeting to close, and keep your investor relationships warm in one place.
records.catalog_description:
Turn the relationships your team already has into deal flow. The system reads the email and calendar trails your people generate and builds a living map of who knows whom and how strongly, so when you want to reach a founder or a fund you can see the warmest path in and route the introduction to the right colleague. Founders, executives, co-investors, and advisors all live in one network directory instead of scattered across personal inboxes.

Move every opportunity through a pipeline the whole team can see. Source deals, run diligence, draft and circulate the investment memo, take it to the committee, issue the term sheet, and mark the close or the pass, each stage with the right approvals attached. Per-deal staffing and committee votes stay on the record, so nothing depends on one partner's memory.

Manage the capital side with the same discipline. Track limited partners from first research through soft circle to a firm commitment, hand the relationship cleanly to fund administration when an LP commits, and keep the people who back you informed across the life of the fund. The payoff is more warm introductions that convert, a pipeline leadership can actually trust, and investor relationships that compound instead of decay.
records.business_logic: Email and calendar metadata graph-mining for relationship strength scoring; founder and executive ownership graph reconciliation across deal stages; warm-introduction path computation.

records.description: Fund accounting, capital calls, distribution waterfalls, LP onboarding (KYC/AML), partner capital account (PCAP) statements, and LP-facing reporting for private capital funds (VC, PE, private credit, real estate).
records.catalog_tagline: Run private-capital funds end to end: onboard LPs, call and distribute capital, keep the partner ledger, and report to investors on one system.
records.catalog_description:
Private-capital fund administration is the operational backbone of a GP. It takes a fund from first close through its full life: onboarding limited partners with KYC and AML checks, recording their commitments, issuing capital calls and tracking the cash that comes back, running the distribution waterfall when the fund returns money, and keeping the partner capital accounts that every investor relies on.

This domain unifies the work that is otherwise scattered across spreadsheets and disconnected tools. Fund accounting, capital activity, and LP reporting all read from the same commitment record and the same general ledger, so a capital call, the cash that funds it, and the resulting change to an LP's account stay in agreement without manual reconciliation.

The payoff is accuracy where it counts most and speed where LPs notice it. Waterfall math and partner capital account statements are produced from the underlying transactions rather than rebuilt by hand each quarter, close cycles shorten, and the audit trail behind every number is always available when investors, auditors, or regulators ask.
records.business_logic: European/American/hybrid waterfall calculations with catchup, clawback, and hurdle rates; multi-class equity allocations; PCAP statement generation; GAAP/IFRS partnership accounting; multi-currency consolidation.

records.description: KPI collection from portfolio companies, valuation tracking, performance metric computation (IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI), and LP-facing performance reporting for private capital funds.
records.catalog_tagline: Turn raw portfolio company data into LP-ready performance, valuations, and fund returns in one place.
records.catalog_description: Run the full private capital monitoring cycle without stitching spreadsheets together. Collect KPI and ESG data from portfolio companies each reporting period, mark holdings to fair value with a defensible methodology trail, and compute fund and position returns (IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI) across vintages with public market equivalent benchmarking and J-curve normalization. Then package quarterly LP performance reports that tie every fund-level number back to the underlying marks. Built so investment teams, fund controllers, and investor relations work from one source of truth, close reporting cycles faster, and answer LP questions with confidence.
records.business_logic: Time-weighted IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI computation across multi-vintage funds; PME (public market equivalent) benchmarking; J-curve normalization for early-stage funds; ASC 820 fair-value mark methodology.

records.domain_name: Cap Table Management and Equity Administration
records.description: Shareholder ledger, option-pool management, 409A valuations, RSU/option grant workflows, exit waterfall modeling, and ASC 718 stock-based compensation accounting. Primary buyer is the portfolio-company CFO, not the VC firm.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your company's shareholder ledger, equity grants, and 409A valuations from one source of truth.
records.catalog_description: Keep a single, accurate record of who owns what across founders, investors, and employees. Issue and approve stock and option grants, manage your option pool, and track vesting through to exercise. Order 409A valuations, account for stock-based compensation under ASC 718, model exit waterfalls to see what each shareholder receives, and process secondary transfers. Give employees a self-service portal to view and accept their equity, all kept consistent as your company raises rounds and grows.
records.business_logic: 409A valuation calculation per methodology (income, market, asset, OPM backsolve); ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense recognition with Black-Scholes/lattice models; exit waterfall scenario modeling with multiple preferred-class participation rights; vesting acceleration logic (single-trigger, double-trigger); dilution modeling for new financing rounds.

records.description: Bundled fund formation, administration, light cap-table, and LP portal as a single architectural product targeting solo GPs and 1-5 partner microfunds. Architecturally bundle-only (components not separately purchasable). Competes against the assembled point-solution stack at order-of-magnitude lower price. Recognized as a distinct market via the 5-criterion bundle-as-market test (see SKILL.md rule #2 amendment 2026-05-23).
records.catalog_tagline: Stand up a fund or a single-deal vehicle in days, then run capital calls, investor onboarding, and your LP portal from one place built for solo and small-team managers.
records.catalog_description:
Launch a fund or special purpose vehicle without stitching together a stack of separate tools. Form the legal entity, file what the regulators expect, open the bank account, and put your subscription documents in front of investors, all from a single workspace shaped for a manager running lean.

Once the vehicle is live, run the day-to-day. Issue capital calls and track who has funded, onboard limited partners with the verification checks built in, and keep a simple cap table of who owns what across the vehicle. For deal-by-deal raises, spin up a vehicle per opportunity, collect investor commitments, and close.

Give your investors a clean experience. They see their commitments, capital-call notices, and documents in one portal instead of a thread of emails. The result is a fund or syndicate that runs end to end, from formation through ongoing operations, at a fraction of the cost and effort of assembling the pieces yourself.
records.business_logic: Simplified fund-formation workflow (entity setup + EIN + banking onboarding); single-fund, single-class waterfall (no European-tier catchup complexity); KYC orchestration for small LP bases; SPV scaffolding with templated docs. Deliberately less complex than FUND-ADMIN, which is the value engineering.

records.description: SMB and mid-market multi-location stock control, lot and serial tracking, reorder rules, ABC classification, and stock-movement reconciliation. Distinct from WMS (warehouse execution: picking, packing, wave planning) and from SCP (demand forecasting, MRP).
records.catalog_tagline: Know exactly what you have, where it is, and when to reorder.
records.catalog_description: Run accurate multi-location stock control without the weight of a full warehouse or planning suite. Track every item, lot, and serial number across warehouses, branches, and bins; let reorder rules and ABC classification tell you what to buy before you run out; and keep the books honest with cycle counts, stock transfers, and movement reconciliation. Built for growing businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets but are not ready for enterprise WMS or MRP, so your team commits accurate promise dates, avoids dead stock, and closes the month with inventory that ties out.
records.business_logic: Reorder-point calculation (on_hand + on_order, safety_stock vs reorder_point), ABC-XYZ classification using rolling demand variability, lot and serial cost-layering (FIFO, LIFO, weighted-average) at issue time, available-to-promise reservation logic, kit explosion at order time.

records.description: Manages the digital thread of a physical product from concept through engineering release, manufacturing handoff, service, and end-of-life. Holds engineering BOMs, CAD data vault, part masters, engineering change orders, revisions, requirements traceability, configuration and variant rules, and the as-designed to as-built to as-maintained chain. Distinct from PROD-MGMT (software product management) and from MFG-OPS (shop-floor execution).
records.catalog_tagline: Run the digital thread of every product from concept to end of life.
records.catalog_description: Hold the single source of truth for what a physical product is and how it changes over time. Author and release the part master, engineering BOM, and revisions; drive every change through a controlled change-order workflow with impact analysis and approval; keep CAD models and drawings in a managed vault; hand a clean manufacturing BOM and routing to the shop floor; trace requirements from definition through verification; and prove material and substance compliance for each market you ship into. Replace scattered spreadsheets and folder shares with a connected as-designed, as-built, and as-maintained chain that downstream manufacturing, procurement, and service teams can trust.
records.business_logic: ECO impact analysis via where-used graph traversal across BOM trees, BOM rollup costing, configurator and option-and-variant resolution at order time, requirements traceability matrix computation, CAD geometry and viewable processing.

records.description: Strategy-office software for defining strategic objectives, cascading them through the org, tracking strategic initiatives, running operating cadences (QBRs/MBRs), and maintaining traceability from execution back to strategy. Bought by Chief of Staff / Chief Strategy Officer / Strategy Office, distinct from HR-led Talent Management (performance reviews + goals bundled with HCM), from PMO-led Strategic Portfolio Management (IT/agile portfolio delivery), and from finance-led Enterprise Performance Management (budgeting).
records.catalog_tagline: Turn strategy into measurable execution your whole organization can see.
records.catalog_description: Define strategic objectives, cascade them from the boardroom down to team-level goals, and track the initiatives that deliver them. Run a disciplined operating cadence of quarterly and monthly reviews, keep a clear line of sight from daily execution back to strategic intent, and give leaders the rollups they need to course-correct before goals drift.
records.business_logic: Weighted progress rollup across multi-level strategy hierarchies, AI-generated narrative summaries for executive reviews, anomaly detection on goal drift, and cross-initiative dependency impact analysis.

records.description: Centralized merchandising master for product attributes, descriptions, digital assets, taxonomies, translations, and channel-specific syndication. Distinct from PLM (engineering record), MDM (cross-entity golden records), and the commerce-platform-native catalog (runtime storefront view).
records.catalog_tagline: Enrich every product once, then publish it to every channel that sells it.
records.catalog_description: Bring all of your product content into one trusted place: descriptions, attributes, variants, categories, translations, and the images and videos that sell each item. Move products through a clear enrichment workflow, from draft to enriched to reviewed and approved, so nothing reaches a shopper half-finished. Manage many languages and many channel-specific versions of the same product without duplicating work, and publish to marketplaces, storefronts, retailer feeds, and partner endpoints from a single approved master. When a destination rejects a listing, see why and fix it in one place instead of chasing errors across systems. The result is faster time to market, fewer listing errors, and consistent, on-brand product information everywhere you sell.
records.business_logic: AI-driven attribute generation and translation, per-channel feed-shape validation (marketplace feeds, merchant feeds, GDSN datapools), golden-record survivorship across supplier data sources, locale-specific overrides, and approval workflows before publish.

records.description: Software that manages physical and digital library collections, member services, circulation, acquisitions, cataloging, and discovery for public, academic, special, and school libraries.
records.catalog_tagline: Run your library: catalog every title, lend every item, serve every patron.
records.catalog_description: Manage the whole library operation from one system. Catalog books, journals, e-resources, and special collections, and keep authority headings clean. Run daily circulation: check out and check in items, place and trap holds, and assess or waive fines under your own loan rules. Register patrons, organize them by category, and issue cards. Order print and electronic materials, track serial subscriptions and e-resource licenses, and reconcile vendor invoices. Publish a searchable catalog for self-service discovery, and extend your reach through interlibrary loan with resource-sharing partners.
records.business_logic: Bibliographic record matching against external authority files (Library of Congress, OCLC, VIAF), circulation rules engine (loan periods by patron-type and item-type, renewal limits, fine accrual, holds queue priority and trapping), Z39.50, SIP2, and NCIP protocol handling for self-check kiosks and resource sharing, MARC21 and BIBFRAME format translation and validation.

records.description: Substrate layer for the worker-skill graph: ingests skill signals from learning, performance, and recruiting; runs inference and gap analysis against curated taxonomies and competency models; serves a canonical skill profile per worker to downstream talent, planning, and intelligence consumers.
records.catalog_tagline: Give every team one trusted view of who can do what, with a living skills graph that learning, mobility, and planning all read from.
records.catalog_description:
Build one source of truth for skills across your workforce. Curate a shared skills ontology and competency frameworks, then keep a current skill profile for every worker that other talent processes can rely on.

Let skills surface themselves. Pull signals from learning, performance, and recruiting, infer skills automatically, and combine them with self-ratings, assessments, and peer endorsements so each profile stays accurate without manual upkeep.

Turn skills into decisions. Compare people against role requirements, see where the gaps are, and feed clean skill and gap signals to learning, internal mobility, and workforce planning so the right people get to the right work.
records.business_logic: Maintains the worker-skill substrate that other HR domains read from and write to: ingests skill signals from learning, performance, and recruiting, runs inference and gap analysis against curated taxonomies and competency models, and serves a canonical skill profile per worker to downstream talent, planning, and intelligence consumers. Goes beyond CRUD by running inference pipelines and proficiency-rollup logic that recompute profile state when contributing signals change.

records.description: AI matching and recommendation layer that runs over skill profiles, roles, and opportunities to drive internal mobility, succession readiness, and skills-based hiring decisions. Owns the talent marketplace, the recommendation surfaces, and the audit trail of model inferences; defers person and skill mastership to HCM and SKILLS-MGMT.
records.catalog_tagline: Match your people to internal opportunities, surface their next best move, and make skills-based talent decisions you can stand behind.
records.catalog_description:
Open up internal mobility. Post gigs, projects, stretch assignments, and full-time internal roles in one marketplace, then let AI matching put each opportunity in front of the employees who fit it best.

Show every employee their next move. Generate personalized mobility recommendations, fit scores, and projected career paths from each person's skills and aspirations, so growth conversations start with real options instead of guesswork.

Decide with evidence, and keep the receipts. See org-wide skills heatmaps and gaps for workforce planning, and keep an auditable trail of every match and score the models produce so your talent decisions stay defensible.
records.business_logic: Runs continuous AI matching, scoring, and recommendation workflows over skill profiles, roles, and opportunities to drive internal mobility, succession readiness, and skills-based hiring decisions that pure CRUD HR systems cannot produce. Owns the marketplace, the recommendation surfaces, and the audit trail of model inferences, while deferring person and skill mastership to HCM and SKILLS-MGMT.

records.description: Platform-agnostic inventory, accountable ownership, recertification, content lifecycle, quality and accessibility governance, and improvement planning over content held in an organization's existing intranets. The accountability layer over the intranet platform(s) already in place, not a publishing platform itself. Distinct from Employee Communications & Intranet (the publishing platform), Web Content Operations & Governance (external / customer-facing audience), and Collaboration Governance (Microsoft 365 container and tenant governance).
records.catalog_tagline: Know what is in every intranet, who owns it, and whether it is still true, without replacing the intranet you have.
records.catalog_description: Map every page, hub, library, and form across the intranets you already run, then make someone accountable for each one. Assign owners and review cadences, run recertification cycles so content gets confirmed current or flagged stale, and turn what you find into a prioritized improvement backlog. Connect SharePoint, Viva, Staffbase, Simpplr, or WordPress as governed sources and govern them from one place. Built for the digital-workplace and internal-comms teams who inherit stale, abandoned, unowned content nobody trusts. It is an accountability layer over your existing intranets, not another intranet to migrate to.
records.business_logic: Cures the intranet ghost town by giving organizations a platform-agnostic system of record for what content exists, who is accountable for it, and whether it has been recertified, without forcing a rip-and-replace of their existing intranets.

records.description: Software market for managing a corporate travel program end to end: policy-aware sourcing and booking of air, hotel, rail, and ground travel; trip and itinerary management; traveler profiles with loyalty, documents, and preferences; pre-trip approval workflows; and traveler duty-of-care monitoring. Distinct from post-trip expense reimbursement and from card-authorization spend control: this domain owns the pre-trip sourcing, the reservation, the journey, and the safety obligation, then hands the resulting charges and the trip record outward to the expense and spend domains.
records.catalog_tagline: Book travel within policy, keep every traveler safe, and stay on top of the whole trip from one place.
records.catalog_description: Shop and book flights, hotels, rail, and cars within your travel policy, route out-of-policy trips for approval, and give travelers self-service booking with their own profiles, loyalty numbers, and saved preferences. Every trip lives in one itinerary you can change, track, and reconcile, and unused tickets are tracked so credits never go to waste. When something goes wrong on the road, see where your travelers are, send alerts, and meet your duty-of-care obligations. Trip charges and records flow straight to expense and spend so finance never has to chase them.
records.business_logic: Policy-aware shopping and fare-rule evaluation, GDS and NDC inventory arbitration across multiple content sources, pre-trip approval routing with out-of-policy exception handling, unused-ticket credit tracking and reapplication, and real-time duty-of-care risk monitoring that correlates traveler location against destination intelligence to trigger alerts.

records.description: Top-down marketing planning, budget allocation across plans and campaigns, spend-to-plan reconciliation, and the marketing calendar for in-house marketing departments. Scoped tightly to the planning and budget kernel: the marketing plan hierarchy, plan-line budget allocation, committed and actual spend reconciled to plan, the campaign and content calendar, and plan-level performance measurement.
