Lightweight SaaS headless CMS targeted at small teams and marketing sites, with simple content modelling, blogging features, and REST APIs.
Code-first TypeScript headless CMS / framework: self-hostable with a Next.js-based admin UI, auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, and strong developer ergonomics around access control and hooks.
Multi-channel employee communications platform (intranet, mobile app, email, frontline) with strong analytics and audience targeting.
AI-driven intranet and employee experience platform with content publishing, news, and federated search.
Cross-channel employee communications and journeys platform (formed from SocialChorus + Dynamic Signal merger).
Enterprise employee experience platform with intranet hubs, news, federated search, and integrations with Microsoft 365 and Workday.
Employee experience platform with intranet, journeys, and AI assistant; tight integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.
Employee experience platform built natively on Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, with intranet hubs and journey orchestration.
Digital workplace intranet platform combining content, news, and collaboration spaces.
Employee assistant overlay that aggregates notifications, tasks, and federated search across enterprise systems into a unified employee surface.
Employee communications, advocacy, and engagement platform with strong mobile / frontline focus.
Employee communications and engagement platform (intranet, multi-channel news, employee advocacy) formed from the COYO + Smarp + Jubiwee merger.
Intranet platform with content publishing, news targeting, mandatory-read tracking, and forms.
Intranet platform built primarily on Google Workspace with channels, pages, and federated search.
Omnichannel employee communications platform (email, mobile, digital signage) with strong analytics.
Internal email communications platform with Outlook / Gmail native sending, drag-and-drop templates, and analytics.
Multi-channel internal communications platform (email, Slack, MS Teams, SMS) with newsletter authoring and analytics.
Microsoft 365 intranet experience surfaced through SharePoint home sites, the Viva Connections dashboard, and the Teams app.

Microsoft 365 governance platform: inventory, ownership, access review, lifecycle, and external-sharing controls.
Microsoft 365 and Power Platform governance with policy authoring, automated inventory, and code-quality checks for citizen-developed apps.
SaaS Microsoft 365 management suite (migration, reporting, audit, recovery, license optimisation) consolidating the Metalogix and Cogmotive lineages.

Microsoft 365 and Exchange monitoring, reporting, and license-optimisation platform.

Microsoft 365 site / Team provisioning, lifecycle, and governance platform with templated workspaces and policy enforcement.
Microsoft 365 content services: AI-driven content classification, metadata extraction, content assembly, and SharePoint Advanced Management.
records.notes: Microsoft's first-party content-services / governance overlay on top of SharePoint and OneDrive.

records.notes: Part of the broader Microsoft Purview suite which spans DSPM, eDiscovery, and compliance.

records.description: Web governance platform combining accessibility, quality, SEO, and analytics for large web estates.
Editorial workflow, content briefs, and structured-content production platform; acquired by Bynder.
Enterprise content governance: linguistic guidance, brand voice, terminology, and consistency enforcement across writing teams and channels.
Organic-marketing and content-intelligence platform with SEO governance, content audits, and real-time monitoring (incl. former ContentKing).

Digital accessibility platform combining automated remediation, manual audits, and legal-evidence reporting.
Web governance platform for accessibility, quality, SEO, and analytics across Acquia DXP and external sites (formerly Monsido).

Ontology-driven data and AI platform: data integration, semantic ontology mapping physical data to business objects, operational applications writing back to source systems, and AIP — Palantir's LLM-orchestration tier — built directly on the same ontology.
records.notes: AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform) is modelled as the AI tier of Foundry on the same ontology — not a separate solution row. Foundry deploys on Palantir's cloud, hyperscalers, or fully on-prem/air-gapped.

records.description: Lakehouse-native unified platform: Delta Lake storage, Spark and Photon compute, Unity Catalog governance, Databricks SQL warehousing, MLflow + Mosaic AI for the ML/LLM lifecycle, and AI/BI Genie for natural-language analytics.
records.notes: Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP). Mosaic AI tier integrates foundation-model training, serving, and AI agents.

records.description: Multi-cluster cloud data platform with Snowpark for Python/Java/Scala compute, Horizon Catalog for unified governance, Cortex for managed LLMs and ML, Streamlit for data apps, and the Snowflake Marketplace for data sharing.
records.notes: Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP). Cortex was GA in 2024; native Iceberg tables and managed Polaris catalog added in 2024–2025.

records.description: Unified analytics SaaS combining OneLake (single Delta-Parquet lake), Data Factory (ingestion), Synapse Data Engineering and Data Warehousing, Real-Time Intelligence, Data Science, Power BI, and the AI Foundry tier for generative-AI workloads.
records.notes: GA November 2023. Bundles Power BI as the native BI experience, which gives Fabric primary BI coverage in addition to the platform domain.

records.description: Google Cloud's converged data-and-AI offering: BigQuery (serverless warehouse and lakehouse with BigLake/Iceberg), Dataplex (catalog and governance), Dataform (SQL transforms), Vertex AI (ML and Gemini-powered agent builder), Looker (BI).
records.notes: Treated as a single solution row because Google markets the BigQuery + Dataplex + Vertex AI bundle as one unified data-and-AI platform.

records.description: AWS's 2024 re-unification of its data-and-AI stack into a single workbench: SageMaker (ML), Redshift (warehousing), Athena (lake querying), Glue (ETL and catalog), Lake Formation (governance), and Bedrock (foundation models).
records.notes: Announced re:Invent 2024 as the umbrella experience over the underlying AWS analytics and AI services; supersedes the legacy SageMaker Studio framing.

records.description: IBM's enterprise data-and-AI platform: watsonx.data (open lakehouse with Presto, Spark, Iceberg), watsonx.ai (model training and serving with Granite foundation models), watsonx.governance (model and data governance), watsonx Code Assistant.
records.notes: Hybrid-deployable across IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure, and on-prem (Cloud Pak for Data). Targets regulated industries and hybrid-cloud estates.

records.description: SAP's 2025 successor to SAP Datasphere: a managed SaaS data foundation combining HANA Cloud, Datasphere modeling, BW data products, an embedded Databricks OEM for lakehouse and AI workloads, and Joule generative-AI integration into SAP business processes.
records.notes: Announced February 2025 with Databricks as the OEM lakehouse engine. Targets SAP-centric enterprises consolidating their data estate around SAP semantic models.

records.description: Hybrid data platform with deployable form factors across public cloud, private cloud, and on-prem: data engineering (Spark, Flink), data warehousing (Impala), operational database (HBase), machine learning (CML), and DataFlow streaming.
records.notes: Differentiator is air-gapped and fully on-prem support for regulated and sovereign workloads where SaaS platforms cannot deploy.

records.description: End-to-end data-science and generative-AI platform: visual data preparation flow, code notebooks, automated ML, LLM mesh for routing generative-AI traffic, governance and project-level controls, and a strong operational-application story.
records.notes: Connects to customer-owned storage (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, S3) — does not provide its own lakehouse. Strong in shops with mixed data backends.

records.description: Enterprise project portfolio management within Oracle Fusion Cloud — project financials, resource management, project planning. Distinct from Oracle NetSuite OpenAir which targets mid-market.
Total-compensation management for base pay, incentives, sales commissions, equity, and pay-equity analysis.
Compensation-survey-driven benchmarking, band-management, and pay-equity analytics platform; Radford / McLagan survey data are integrated.
AI-native workforce management with demand forecasting, automated scheduling, time and attendance, and frontline employee experience.
Forecasting, scheduling, and adherence management for contact-centre and back-office labour.
Benefits administration platform with carrier integrations, decision support, and ACA compliance services.
Total people platform combining PEO services, benefits, payroll, comp planning, and analytics.
VMS and MSP services for contingent workforce program management.
Mid-market CPM platform unifying budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and financial reporting.
Unified corporate performance management for close, consolidation, planning, and reporting on a single data model.
Global payroll, EOR (employer-of-record), and contractor management platform covering 150+ countries.
Global payroll, EOR, and contractor management platform.
Low-code platform for process automation, case management, and AI-driven workflow apps.

Low-code internal-tooling platform for developers building back-office and admin apps.
AI-native CLM platform with contract intelligence and legal-front-door agent overlay.
AI-driven CLM platform focused on post-execution obligation tracking and supplier-contract management.
AI CLM platform for in-house legal teams: contract review, repository, extraction, and reporting.
Customer onboarding and professional services delivery platform combining PSA and customer-portal capabilities.
Cloud LMS for corporate, channel, and customer learning. Divested from SAP to Francisco Partners in 2024.
Skills-development and learning-experience platform combining content aggregation, skill tracking, and pathway personalisation.
People-enablement platform spanning performance reviews, OKRs, engagement surveys, learning, and instant feedback.
Source-to-pay platform for direct and indirect procurement; strong in manufacturing and higher education.
Procure-to-pay and supplier-collaboration network with embedded fintech.
AI-driven AP automation: invoice capture, three-way match, exception workflow, and e-invoicing.
AP automation and P2P platform with e-invoicing network; strong in EU compliance and Peppol coverage.
Low-code application platform on the Salesforce data model, including Lightning, Flow, Apex, and Agentforce.
Unified IT-management platform: RMM (endpoint monitoring, patching, scripting), service desk/ticketing, MDM, endpoint backup, and remote access. Targeted at MSPs and internal IT.
Kaseya's flagship RMM: agent-based endpoint monitoring, patching, scripting, automation, and remote control across multi-tenant customer estates.

records.notes: Acquired by Kaseya in June 2022 as part of the $6.2B Datto deal; Datto brand preserved.

Per-technician pricing differentiates from per-endpoint competitors. Includes Action AI / Copilot for AI-assisted ticketing and scripting.

AI-native unified PSA + RMM platform for MSPs: ticketing, contracts, asset management, patching, scripting, and AI copilot for operations.

Sales engagement platform: cadences, dialler, conversation intelligence (Drift acquisition 2024), forecasting (post-InsightSquared).
Sales engagement + B2B prospecting database in one: cadences, dialler, embedded intent data, contact discovery.
Sales engagement layer on top of Gong's conversation-intelligence flagship; cadences powered by call insights.

Sales engagement layered on ZoomInfo's B2B contact/intent database: cadences, dialler, intent-triggered workflows.

Bundled Zoho CRM suite combining Sales (CRM), Marketing (Campaigns), Customer Service, Social, and Analytics under one UI/license.
Multi-currency corporate cards, expense management, and reimbursements within the Airwallex financial platform.
Corporate-card-led spend management with expense, reimbursement, and bill-pay for SMB and mid-market.
Travel and spend management with virtual cards, SaaS-spend tracking, and bill-pay.
Corporate cards, expense, and bill-pay alongside Navan's corporate-travel product (formerly Navan Liquid / TripActions Liquid).
European spend management with corporate cards, expense, bill-pay, approvals, and budget controls.
Corporate-card-led spend management (formerly Divvy), part of the BILL financial-operations platform.
Expense management and travel-expense capture with policy enforcement, OCR, and ERP integration. Primary EU market focus.
No-code database platform: linked tables, views (grid/gallery/kanban/calendar/timeline), forms, automations, and Interface Designer apps with write-back.

All-in-one workspace: collaborative docs and wiki, databases with multiple views, lightweight tasks, AI assistant. Primary buy reason is the team wiki + collaborative documents; database and task features are secondary.
Doc-database hybrid where structured tables and apps live inside collaborative documents. Owned by Grammarly after the 2024 acquisition; product brand and team retained.
Open-source Airtable alternative with self-hostable database, linked records, formulas, and a plugin ecosystem.
Open-source no-code platform that overlays a spreadsheet UI on any SQL database, with views, forms, and webhooks.

Spreadsheet with built-in live data connectors (Stripe, Salesforce, HubSpot, Postgres) and AI features. Differentiator vs Airtable: a spreadsheet metaphor with database power, not the other way around.
No-code database with pre-built integrations across 50+ services, designed for marketing, content, and ops workflows.
Configurable work-OS built on a board primitive; spans task/project management, CRM, dev tracker, and service modules with shared automation engine.
Consolidated work-management platform: tasks, docs, goals, dashboards, time tracking, and chat in one app. Aggressive product breadth strategy.
Collaborative work management with strong Gantt, resource workload management, request forms, and proofing for creative teams.
Kanban-first task management with Power-Ups for added capability (Gantt, automation, custom fields). Owned by Atlassian since 2017.
Opinionated, low-feature project communication tool: message boards, to-dos, schedule, docs, chat. Sells flat-rate pricing.
Project management built around services workflows: client billing, time tracking, resource utilisation, milestone management.
Project management with multi-view task tracking, native messaging, time tracking, and meeting notes.

BPMN 2.0 process modelling, repository, simulation, and collaborative publishing. Part of the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite (distinct from Signavio Process Intelligence, the mining product).
records.notes: Acquired by SAP in 2021. The Process Manager is the modelling product; Signavio Process Intelligence (id 187) is the mining product. Both are sold as part of the broader Signavio suite.

records.description: Veteran enterprise BPA platform: BPMN/EPC modelling, repository, governance workflows, simulation, ARIS Connect publishing, and ARIS Risk & Compliance Manager.
records.notes: One of the longest-standing BPA platforms (originating with IDS Scheer, acquired by Software AG in 2009). Strong in regulated industries.

records.description: Process and capability-modelling platform built on Microsoft Azure / Power BI. Ships APQC PCF as reference content; covers BPA, capability maps, risk, and EA views.
BPA platform with integrated process mining (via the Logpickr acquisition). Covers modelling, simulation, conformance, and publishing in one suite.
Bizagi Modeler (free BPMN authoring) plus Bizagi Studio (commercial low-code BPM execution engine). Modeler is one of the most widely-installed BPMN tools globally.
Standards-purist BPMN/DMN/CMMN modelling suite with strong decision-modelling and executable workflow features. Used by the OMG community as a reference implementation.
ArchiMate-native enterprise architecture and process architecture platform. Co-flagship: equally strong on BPA (process modelling, capability mapping) and APM (application portfolio, EA).

Commercial SaaS variant of Essential Project (open-source EA), with managed hosting, pre-built APQC PCF and Business Capability Model content, and reference architectures. Primary positioning is APM/EA; lighter BPA coverage.
records.notes: Open-core: Essential Project remains free OSS; Essential Cloud is the commercial managed product. Differentiator vs LeanIX/MEGA/Alfabet/Ardoq is pre-loaded APQC PCF + BCM content as a starting point.

records.description: Low-code platform combining App Studio (visual builder), Process Fabric (BPM/case management), Decision Hub (real-time AI decisioning), and Pega GenAI assistants. Gartner LCAP Leader.

Low-code platform within the Zoho One ecosystem: drag-drop UI, scripting via Deluge, 100+ pre-built connectors, native Android/iOS app generation. Strong mid-market footprint.
Low-code platform for citizen developers building process automation, project management, and case management apps.

Enterprise work management platform with strong Gantt, resource planning, and creative-review approval workflows. Adobe-owned since 2020 acquisition; deep integration with Adobe Creative Cloud for marketing/creative teams.
Universal semantic layer over Snowflake / Databricks / BigQuery / Redshift, exposing metrics via SQL / MDX / REST / DAX for BI tools, Excel, and AI agents.

Semantic-layer tier of dbt Cloud built on the Transform.co MetricFlow acquisition. Metric definitions live alongside dbt models; consumed via SQL / GraphQL / Python from BI tools and notebooks.

Headless BI / semantic-layer platform emphasising SQL-first metric authoring, lineage, and deterministic AI-agent consumption.
Cloud-native headless BI tier emphasising embedded analytics, multi-tenant data products, and semantic-layer governance. Distinct from the older GoodData Platform.

entity.description: A single JSON-RPC function the agent can call. Verb-shaped and vendor-independent; one row per function signature. Examples: send_email, query_invoices, transcribe_audio, create_calendar_event, post_chat_message.

validation_rules.message: A data_object_id may only be set when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: side_effect and compute tools have no business-data return value; the FK is meaningless for them and must stay null.

validation_rules.message: A data_object_id is required when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: Pairs with data_object_only_when_query_or_mutate. query and mutate tools must name the data_object they read or write so the 100% Semantius derivation can resolve solution coverage.

validation_rules.message: coverage_tier must be 'platform' when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: query and mutate tools operate against a Semantius-mastered data_object (enforced by data_object_required_when_query_or_mutate). Only the platform can serve queries/mutates against its own data_objects; external/integration coverage is incoherent for this operation_kind.

fields.title: Data Object
fields.description: Required when `operation_kind` is `query` or `mutate` (Semantius-mastered data). Must be NULL for `fetch` (external read), `side_effect` (external write), and `compute` (pure transform). Optional for `inbound` (populate when the landing target is known at the catalog level; NULL for generic inbound primitives like `receive_webhook`).

fields.title: Operation Kind
fields.description: What shape of work the tool performs. `query` and `mutate` read or write Semantius-mastered structured business data; `fetch` reads external data via a vendor API (no Semantius-side data model); `side_effect` triggers an external action with no business-data return; `compute` is pure computation, AI, or web automation; `inbound` receives an external event or message. The Semantius score derivation reads from `coverage_tier`, not from this column.

fields.title: Coverage Tier
fields.description: Where the tool's implementation lives today: `platform` = Semantius covers it natively; `external` = the customer must bring an external integration; `integration` = the platform maintains a curated OOTB integration (e.g. an MCP server in the Semantius catalog). Score derivations read this column, not `operation_kind`. Flip from `external` to `platform` only when the capability is shipped on BOTH the `crud` MCP server AND the `semantius` CLI; shipping one without the other does not count.

An external system POSTs a payload that lands as a record in a Semantius table. Native via the `webhook_receivers` built-in; each receiver is configured against one target table. Used when an upstream system (payment processor, e-signature provider, source-code host, observability platform, monitoring tool) needs to drive state into our system.

Inbound email parsed into a structured record (ticket, lead, case, supplier invoice). Backed by an external mail provider via IMAP, SMTP relay, or inbound-parse webhook. The #1 inbound channel for ITSM / CRM / HRSD / S2P workflows in real SaaS deployments.
Inbound SMS message converted to a record (two-way conversation, opt-in confirmation, automated reply). Backed by an external messaging provider via inbound-SMS webhook.
Inbound voice call (IVR menu, live agent, or voicemail) converted to a record and/or transcript. Backed by an external voice / CCaaS provider via SIP trunk or inbound-call webhook.
Continuous consumption from an external event broker (telemetry, observability signals, change data capture). Backed by an event-streaming platform consumed via a streaming-protocol connector.
Inbound EDI message (X12 850 PO, 810 invoice, 856 ASN, 214 shipment status; EDIFACT equivalents) via VAN or AS2. Backed by an EDI gateway / B2B integration platform.
SFTP-deposited file pickup (CSV, fixed-width, vendor-specific). Backed by a managed-file-transfer (MFT) gateway speaking SFTP / FTPS / AS2.
Submit a regulatory filing to a securities / financial regulator (SEC EDGAR, ESMA, FCA Connect, BaFin MVP-Portal, SEDAR+). Per-regulator delivery detail in `tool_solutions`.
Submit a tax filing to a tax authority (IRS e-File, HMRC MTD, DGFiP, ATO, BMF Elster). Pairs with payroll, AP, and ERP-finance workflows; per-jurisdiction delivery in `tool_solutions`.

Submit a privacy or security breach notification to a regulator within a statutory window (GDPR 72-hr to the supervisory DPA, HIPAA breach to HHS OCR, state AGs in the US, ICO in the UK). Failure to deliver inside the window is a separate compliance event.

Submit an anti-money-laundering report (FinCEN SAR / CTR, FATF FIU equivalents, AUSTRAC SMR). Banking, payments, fintech, and crypto exchanges all have hard reporting obligations on threshold-triggered transaction patterns.
Submit a pharmaceutical or medical-device adverse-event report (FDA MedWatch, EMA EudraVigilance, PMDA, MHRA Yellow Card). Pharma / device R&D and post-market surveillance workflows depend on this.

Submit an ESG framework disclosure (CSRD/ESRS via filings, CDP climate/water/forests questionnaire, TCFD aligned report, EU Taxonomy alignment). Annual or semi-annual cadence; multiple frameworks per company.

Submit a trade report to a trade repository or competent authority (EMIR, MiFID II RTS-22 transaction reporting, Dodd-Frank SDR, SFTR, ASIC OTC). Real-time or end-of-day; capital-markets ERP and trading systems depend on this.

Submit industry-specific statistics to a regulator or industry body (FFIEC Call Report for US banks, HEDIS for US health plans, CMS quality measures, FERPA reporting for US education). Sector-specific cadence and payload shape.

Emit an event to external subscribers via outbound webhook (the standard 'send webhook on event' surface that most SaaS platforms expose). Distinct from `invoke_webhook` which calls a known endpoint with arbitrary payload. NOTE: flip coverage_tier to 'platform' if Semantius natively emits webhooks from `trigger_events`.
Outbound EDI message (X12 850 PO, 810 invoice, 856 ASN, EDIFACT equivalents) via VAN or AS2 gateway to a trading partner. Backed by an EDI gateway / B2B integration platform.

Single-recipient outbound message; channel is routed by recipient profile or deployment config. Backed by `send_email`, `send_sms`, `make_phone_call`, and future per-channel primitives. Default link for skills that need to notify a specific person and don't require a specific channel. Becomes `platform` only when Semantius ships an outbound dispatcher (recipient lookup + channel routing) on BOTH the `crud` MCP server AND the `semantius` CLI.

Broadcast to a team or shared inbox; typical real-world pattern is chat-channel-alert plus email-audit-trail on the same event. Backed by `post_chat_message`, `send_email`, `post_social_message`. Default link for skills that need to alert a team (incident broadcast, deploy notification, escalation). Becomes `platform` under the same MCP + CLI criterion as `notify_person`.

entity.description: Controlled vocabulary of state-change events on data_objects. Referenced by cross_domain_handoffs.trigger_event_id. One row per event; multiple handoff subscribers reference the same row (the 'one event, many subscribers' pattern — see SKILL.md Phase D section). Event semantics (publisher, data_object, state transition, description) live here; integration metadata (friction_level, integration_pattern, notes) lives on the per-edge handoff row.

fields.title: Data Object
fields.description: The data_object whose state changes when this event fires.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: What this event means: payload contents, downstream consequences, known failure modes.

fields.title: Event Category
fields.description: Coarse-grained classification for filtering. lifecycle = creation/termination; state_change = mid-lifecycle transition; threshold = numeric crossing; signal = external observation. New values appended as clusters surface them.

fields.title: To State
fields.description: Resulting state after the event. Free-text v1. e.g. accepted, closed, resolved.

fields.title: From State
fields.description: Originating state of the data_object before the event. Free-text v1; future: FK to a state table. Empty string for creation events (no prior state).

fields.title: Module
fields.description: Events are published by the module that masters the data_object, not the whole domain. NULL until the publishing domain is modularized.
