Fired when a Incident is completed. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Engagement Driver is cycle closed. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Onboarding Task is access provisioning required. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Onboarding Task is compliance training required. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Onboarding Task is escalation required. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Onboarding Task is it provisioning required. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Onboarding Task is workplace setup required. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Hardware Asset is created. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a RMM Agent is resolved. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Time Entry is approved. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Event Correlation is published. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Supplier is added. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Work Order is invoiced. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.
Fired when a Contingent Worker is tenure threshold. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.

A work_item transitions to done/complete state in a WORK-MGMT platform. Used by SPM for portfolio rollup, by PSA for billable hours close-out, and by ITSM when the work_item was linked to an IT ticket.

Generic status transition on a work_item. Subscribers care about specific states (blocked, in_review, done) but the platform emits one event with the new status as payload. The atomic synchronization event for cross-tool work-item mirroring across work-management and ITSM platforms.

An OKR is created in one OKR-mastering domain (typically SPM with strategic intent or HCM with performance-cycle intent) and needs to cascade to team-level OKRs in WORK-MGMT. The cascade is rarely automated, and the resulting gap drives a dedicated OKR-platform market.
A work_project transitions to completed/closed. Triggers utilization rollup in PSA when services delivery runs in WORK-MGMT, and may trigger retrospective/lessons-learned workflows.
A general-ledger journal entry has been posted to the books, becoming part of the period's authoritative record. Downstream effects: audit log capture, anomaly detection, intercompany matching.
Three-way match or controller review flagged a candidate invoice as a probable duplicate. Requires manual disposition before payment release.

A payment run encountered an exception (bank rejection, account closure, routing error, ACH return). Requires AP-controller intervention and may need to notify subscription-billing customer-success when the failure affects an external party.
A dunning sequence has escalated to the next severity tier (e.g. payment retry N exhausted, account suspension imminent). CSM and collections need a heads-up for retention or contact.
A subscription is within the renewal window (typically 90 days from term end). CSM should engage with the customer for renewal motion.
A customer subscription has been downgraded (lower tier, fewer seats, removed modules). Churn-risk signal; CRM needs expansion-replan, CSM needs retention motion.
Cloud-provider spend exceeded a configured threshold (monthly, daily, per-account, per-service). Cost-center owners and procurement need a heads-up before the spike compounds.
A budget-vs-actuals variance crossed a configured threshold (usually unfavorable). Triggers reforecast or management review.
A lead's predictive score has crossed the qualified-handoff threshold. Sales engagement should pick it up for an outreach cadence.
An opportunity has been marked closed-lost. Triggers win-loss analysis in revenue intelligence and re-engagement nurture in marketing.
A new opportunity has been created. Feeds pipeline quota tracking in sales performance and forecast inputs in revenue intelligence.
An account's tier classification (strategic / enterprise / mid-market / SMB) has changed. Triggers territory or quota realignment in sales performance and CSM re-segmentation.
A CPQ-generated quote has reached its validity expiry without acceptance. Sales rep needs to re-engage or re-quote.
A sales engagement cadence has run to completion (all steps executed). The associated opportunity record needs a stage check; if no engagement was achieved, the lead may downgrade or move to nurture.
A scheduled sales meeting was missed by the prospect. The opportunity may need a stage-back or extra cadence iteration.
Revenue intelligence has flagged an opportunity as high-risk (slipping close date, lack of activity, sentiment shift). CRM should surface for sales-rep intervention.
Aggregate pipeline health metric has crossed below a configured threshold (coverage ratio, weighted forecast). Sales leadership needs visibility for pipeline-build motion.
An account's composite health score has declined materially. CSM needs to engage for retention; sales for expansion-replan.
Strategic account planning has identified whitespace (cross-sell or upsell opportunity not yet pursued). Sales engagement picks up for prospecting.
A joint opportunity has been created with a channel partner. Both internal sales and partner-rep need visibility; commissions may need split logic.
A partner-sourced referral has been qualified and is ready for the sales engagement motion. CRM lead-routing needs to assign to a partner-aware sales rep.
A supplier has completed onboarding (KYC, banking, tax forms, sanctions screening). Triggers vendor-master creation in ERP-FIN, AP setup, and procurement-spend enablement.
A supplier's risk score (financial, operational, ESG, security) has crossed a threshold. GRC and procurement need to engage for re-qualification, mitigation, or replacement.
A contract has reached its end date without renewal. Procurement and business owners need to decide renewal, replacement, or wind-down.
A contract amendment has been executed (price change, scope change, term extension). Finance needs to update payment terms, GL coding, and accruals.

An e-signature envelope has been fully signed by all required parties. Downstream: CLM persists the signed contract via signature_records; HR persists offer letters; sales-ops triggers commission and quota effects.

A metric definition completes its review/approval workflow and becomes the canonical version consumed downstream. Triggers BI cache invalidation, AI-agent definition refresh, and notification of metric consumers.

A previously certified metric is deprecated (with optional replacement metric reference). Triggers consumer warnings on BI dashboards and AI-agent tool-use prompts, with a grace period before retirement.

A new ontology version is published. Triggers ontology-reload in dependent KGP instances, federated SPARQL endpoint refresh, AI-agent schema-cache invalidation, and downstream consumers (DCG glossaries, MDM mappings) revalidation.

A KG entity gains a new relationship link (sameAs, partOf, derived from an inference run, or manually asserted). Triggers downstream re-reasoning, embedding-recomputation for similarity search, and notification of AI agents that hold the entity in context.
A customer's composite health score has declined materially. CSM needs retention motion; SUB-MGMT needs to flag for renewal risk.
A contact-center call has been escalated to a supervisor or specialist queue. The originating agent's customer-case may need re-assignment.
Real-time or post-call sentiment analysis flagged the customer interaction as negative. CSM should triage for outreach; supervisor intervention may be needed mid-call.
Conversational AI has identified a customer intent (billing question, technical issue, churn signal, upgrade interest). Downstream routing to CRM / case-management / sales-engagement.
A bot conversation has been handed off to a human agent. CCAAS picks up with full transcript context.
A field-service work order has been completed on site. CSM gets the customer-satisfaction signal; asset-lifecycle records the maintenance event; billing kicks off.
A field-service dispatch failed (technician unavailable, route conflict, customer no-show, equipment unavailable). CSM needs to contact the customer for rescheduling.
A loyalty member has been upgraded to a higher tier (qualifying threshold met). CRM should know for VIP treatment; marketing for celebration messaging.
A loyalty member's status has lapsed (inactivity threshold, missed renewal, opt-out). Marketing should engage in win-back motion.
Customer churn has been confirmed (subscription cancel, account close, contract non-renewal). SUB-MGMT processes the cancellation; CRM marks the account; LOYALTY revokes tier benefits if applicable.
CSM has identified an expansion opportunity (more seats, additional modules, tier upgrade). SUB-MGMT prepares the proposal; CRM creates the expansion opportunity.
Application added to portfolio, assigned to owner, baseline established.
Lifecycle transition (plan/develop/operate/sunset).
Integration-point failure detected.
Architecture fit assessment finished.
Periodic cost refresh published.
Quarterly value-score refresh; outliers trigger portfolio review.
New demand arrives; governance workflow begins.
Approved demand becomes authorized initiative or roadmap item.
Initiative moves to execution; announces to SWP (capacity) and WORK-MGMT (scope).
Execution complete; benefits tracking begins.
Feature/capability ships.
Portfolio composition or prioritization changes; cascades to children.
Tentative allocation becomes binding.
Executive scenario modeled end-to-end (financial + workforce).
New risk detected via assessment, policy review, or third-party notice.
Control test result is fail; triggers remediation plan.
Policy version incremented and approved; triggers re-attestation.
GRC issue opened (from audit, assessment, or policy exception).
Obligation completion date passes without evidence.
Risk assessment finalized; updates enterprise risk register.
Fieldwork initiative scoped and kicked off.
All fieldwork procedures executed; findings drafted.
Control deviation or non-compliance identified and documented.
Remediation evidence uploaded; finding closed.
Final audit report signed off and distributed.
Management acknowledged corrective action; remediation owner assigned.
Remediation evidence approved; triggers GRC issue closure.
New table/dataset/API detected via automated crawler; DCG creates draft asset.
Sensitivity label applied; DLP/DSPM react to enforce/audit.
Steward approves asset for production; signals DQ to activate monitoring.
Business term published; semantically links to assets and ontologies.
Classification rule revised; downstream re-scans triggered.
Steward assignment unacknowledged past SLA.
Access request to an asset approved by steward; IGA/DLP receive grant signal.
Rule definition published; triggers initial profile run.
Rule evaluation detected violation.
Incident created by profiler/monitor.
Profile scan complete; triggers scorecard aggregation.
Weighted score dropped below SLA threshold.
Match rule enabled; triggers re-evaluation of pending duplicate sets.
New deduplicated customer golden record resolved; published to CRM/CSM/SUB-MGMT/CDP.
Customer golden record updated; published to all consumers.
Supplier golden record updated; published to S2P, SUP-LIFE.
Deduplicated employee identity resolved; published to HCM, Payroll, IGA.
Raw emissions fact ingested; passed QC.
Actual emissions exceed target threshold.
Disclosure handed to external auditor; audit clock starts.
External assurance complete; sign-off recorded.
ESG score recalculated on refresh.
Calculated KPI crosses alert threshold.
Facility-level emissions locked for reporting period.
User/system triggers a DLP policy rule match.
Policy action executed (email rejected, USB blocked).
Attachment placed in temporary hold pending review.
Admin approved release/redaction; incident closed.
High-severity violation escalated to SIEM/SOAR/IGA.
Raw exfiltration attempt observed; triggers DLP scanning pipeline.
User or admin requests exception to a DLP policy.
Admin approves exception; rule applied to policy engine.
S3-equivalent bucket with public read/write or overly-broad principal access.
IAM policy grants broader permission than necessary.
DSPM detected over-privilege, shadow data, or toxic combination.
Sensitive-data incident mitigated.
Per-asset DSPM risk score recalculated.
Unmanaged data store/file/SaaS instance discovered.
Sensitivity label upgraded after new PII/PHI detection.
New lease signed; properties + cost center linked.
Lease renewal negotiated; new end date / cost / terms.
90/60/30-day expiry warning.
Lease ended.
Desk or room assigned to occupant.
Occupant released; space returns to pool.
Real-time badge/mobile check-in captured.
Work order generated (preventive or reactive).
FSM receives dispatch for technician assignment.
Work completed; asset history + cost captured.
Reading validated and published to ESG for emissions calc.
Project finished; property updated with new assets/configuration.
Real estate transaction has closed (deed recorded, funds disbursed). New owner becomes the landlord-of-record; brokerage commission is earned and disbursable.
Rental application has cleared screening and been approved by the landlord; triggers lease drafting and security-deposit collection.
Tenant rent payment has been received and reconciled; posts to per-property GL and triggers owner-distribution calculation.
Rent payment has crossed the late-fee threshold; triggers late-fee assessment, notice, and potentially eviction-process initiation.
Tenant has submitted a maintenance request; triggers vendor dispatch via FSM or in-house team work order.
Tenant eviction proceedings have completed; triggers asset-recovery, deposit-disposition, and legal-matter closure.
Commercial lease has been signed by both parties; triggers rent-roll update, NOI recalculation, and CAM-allocation update.
Annual CAM reconciliation has been completed; triggers tenant true-up billing or refund and audit-trail finalization.
Property or portfolio valuation has been refreshed; triggers NAV update, investor-reporting refresh, and potentially debt-covenant compliance check.
Capital call has been issued to LPs; triggers funding receipt tracking and reminder cadence.
Fund distribution has been declared per the waterfall calculation; triggers payment processing to LPs and tax-form preparation.
Real-estate buyer or seller lead has been qualified by the agent; transitions probabilistic intent into a deterministic next-action queue.
Investment property has closed acquisition; triggers asset onboarding into the operating PM platform and fund-accounting basis setup.
Vehicle trip has ended (engine off, idle threshold, or geofence exit). Triggers utilization update, fuel-trip reconciliation, and IFTA jurisdiction allocation.
Telematics-detected risky-behavior event (harsh brake, speeding, fatigue). Feeds driver-safety scoring and coaching workflow; severe events escalate to fleet-manager review.
HOS rule violation detected (e.g. driving over 11-hour limit, missed 30-min break). Triggers driver alert, dispatcher reroute, and DOT-compliance log entry.
Dashcam AI detected a likely collision or significant impact. Triggers safety-manager notification, video preservation, and potential insurance first-notice-of-loss.
DVIR found one or more defects requiring repair. Routes to FLEET-MAINT for work-order creation; severe defects ground the vehicle.
PM trigger has fired (mileage, engine hours, calendar, or DTC code). Triggers work-order auto-generation and shop scheduling.
Vehicle work order has been completed. Triggers invoice creation, parts-consumption update, vehicle return-to-service, and warranty-claim eligibility check.
Fuel-card transaction has been ingested and matched to vehicle/driver. Triggers expense-account posting and exception detection (out-of-route, capacity overflow).
Vehicle has been dispatched on an assignment (FSM job, route, delivery). Triggers telematics-tracking activation against this assignment context.
Shopping-cart session initiated.
Product added to cart; inventory reserved.
Cart inactivity timeout or explicit session close without conversion; triggers MA nurture.
Customer entered checkout flow; cart locked, shipping quoted.
Payment method validated and pre-authorized.
Order created from checkout; cart → order_lines conversion complete.
Payment captured; order moves to fulfillment queue; ERP-FIN AR posts.
All order_lines picked, packed, shipped.
Final delivery confirmed; post-purchase window closed.
Refund issued on entire order; ERP-FIN AR reversal; CSM notified.
Payment method authorized but not yet captured.
Payment amount debited from customer account.
Payment method rejected.
Carrier assigned, label generated, tracking number issued.
Delivery confirmed by carrier; triggers order.completed workflow.
New storefront launched; product catalog mapped, checkout enabled, payment processor connected.
Legal matter has been formally opened after conflict-check clearance and engagement-letter execution; triggers calendar setup, trust-deposit collection, and matter-team assignment.
Matter has been closed; triggers final invoicing, trust-balance disbursement, retention-rule activation, and file-archiving workflow.
Conflict-check search returned matches requiring partner review; triggers ethics-wall consideration or matter decline workflow.
Trust account three-way reconciliation detected a discrepancy or low-balance event; triggers bookkeeper review and potentially state-bar reporting.
Client has e-signed the engagement letter; triggers retainer-payment collection, matter creation, and work commencement.
Controlled substance has been dispensed; triggers ledger decrement, perpetual-inventory check, and DEA-compliant audit trail.
Preventive-care reminder threshold reached (vaccine due, dental scheduled, geriatric exam interval); triggers multi-channel outreach to pet owner.
Tax return has been filed (e-filed or paper). Triggers client notification, invoice issuance, working-paper archival, and IRS-acceptance polling.
Accounting engagement has commenced after engagement-letter signing and retainer collection; triggers workflow-template instantiation and task assignment.
An agency new-business opportunity reaches Closed Won in CRM, triggering downstream job spin-up in AGENCY-MGMT.
Client signs off on an agency estimate; agency converts it into a binding SOW in CLM and a kicked-off job.
All client and internal reviewers have approved the final version of a creative deliverable; ready to register in DAM as the canonical brand asset.
An agency-issued client invoice (combining time, materials, media, markup) is finalized; AR booking in ERP-FIN.
Media costs are reconciled and posted to the GL — covering net media spend, agency commission, and currency conversion. Period-cycle-close coupling against ERP-FIN.
Media-outlet or freelancer invoice arrives via S2P; matched against the originating insertion_order with quantity and rate reconciliation.

A field harvest event has been recorded with yield, harvest date, and field reference; downstream creates the upstream traceability lot AND realizes available-share inventory for direct-sales planning.

A chemical / fertilizer application pass has been recorded with product, rate, applicator, and weather conditions; downstream creates a KDE entry for traceability and feeds organic / certification-program evidence.
A bulk milk shipment has left the farm with volume, hauler, and quality-grade attestation; downstream creates a traceability lot at the processor.
A milk-quality test (SCC, bacterial count, or antibiotic residue) has crossed the failure threshold; downstream triggers food-safety incident, shipment halt, and corrective-action workflow.
A veterinary treatment with drug-withdrawal-period implications has been administered; downstream gates milk shipment until withdrawal-period clearance.
A food-safety incident has been escalated to recall status; downstream creates the recall execution record and notifies regulators.
A CCP monitoring reading has crossed its critical limit; downstream triggers product hold and compliance-event logging.
A product recall has been formally initiated; downstream fans out to FSMA Reportable Food Registry filing (GRC) AND inventory write-off / cost-recovery / customer-credit processing (ERP-FIN).
A supplier certification has passed its expiry date with no renewal received; downstream fans out to FSQM supplier-risk elevation AND SUP-LIFE supplier-onboarding-gate (blocks new POs until renewed).
A CSA membership has been activated for the current season; downstream creates / enriches the CRM-mastered customer record for ongoing engagement.
A CSA membership payment has been charged (full-season pre-pay or installment); downstream posts revenue to ERP-FIN with deferred-revenue treatment on pre-pays.
A weekly CSA share has been delivered or picked up; downstream is a customer-engagement touch-point and a churn-risk feedback signal.
BPA publishes a new or updated business process model — consumers re-evaluate conformance and downstream capability impact.
BPA publishes an updated business capability map — consumers re-align coverage assessments.
PROC-MIN detects a runtime deviation from the designed process — surfaces back to BPA for model review.
BPA's simulation or analysis identifies a bottleneck in a value stream — consumers (PROD-MGMT, etc.) re-prioritize.
A new requisition has been opened externally on careers site and job boards. Recruitment-source attribution begins; campaign tracking and referral programs receive a fresh anchor.
Posting closed (filled, canceled, or aged out). Sourcing channels should stop driving traffic; analytics finalize cost-per-hire.
Candidate submits an application against a posting. Triggers screening, source attribution, and (for internal candidates) HCM career-aspiration linkage.
Application moved to a later pipeline stage (phone-screen, interview, offer). Hiring-manager visibility updated; SLA timers reset.
Application is rejected or withdrawn. Talent-pool re-eligibility window opens; rejection-comms motion fires.
A hire is attributed to a sourcing channel (job board, referral, agency, event). Drives cost-per-hire analytics and channel ROI.
Employee submits a referral. Engagement and rewards-eligibility tracking kick off; ATS creates linked application.
Referred candidate crossed the tenure / hire milestone. Triggers payroll bonus payment and employee-experience recognition.
Candidate added to a passive talent pool (silver-medalist, leadership pipeline, returnee). Marketing nurture and recruiter outreach pickup.
Pool candidate re-engaged for an open requisition. Application is created; sourcing attribution flows.
Interview placed on candidate and panel calendars. Triggers prep packets, interviewer-scorecard provisioning.
Interview finished; scorecard collection window opens. Drives stage-advance decisions.
Interviewer submitted scoring. Hiring-manager dashboards refresh; pipeline analytics receive structured signal.
Background-check request sent to vendor. Offer is contingent until clearance returns.
Background-check returned clear (or with passable adjudication). Offer can convert from contingent to firm; HCM hire-event can proceed.
Background-check returned with adjudication-required findings. Offer may be rescinded; legal/HR review required.
Agency activated against a requisition. Fee-tracking and contract terms attach; sourcing channel tagged.
Recruiting event (career fair, hackathon, campus visit) executed. Attendee leads pour into talent-pool; cost ledger updates.
Onboarding plan template instantiated for a new hire. Tasks generated; cross-domain provisioning subscriptions can fire.
Hire completed a journey stage (pre-boarding, day-one, week-one, 30-day). Manager nudges and survey-launches keyed off this signal.
Buddy/mentor assignment activated (moves from 'assigned' to 'active'). WSC channel provisioning and intro-meeting scheduling trigger.
Cohort orientation activated (moves from 'planned' to 'active'). LMS provisions cohort-level training; comms channels created.
Pre-boarding welcome email/packet dispatched. Day-one no-show risk reduced; engagement signal captured.
All required new-hire documents (I-9, tax forms, direct-deposit, NDA) collected and validated. Payroll and IGA can finalize setup.
Workforce-plan refreshed demand by job family / location / quarter. ATS hiring plan and HCM headcount budget should align.
Skills-gap study finalized. LMS curricula refresh; ATS sourcing prioritization shifts; TALENT-MGMT succession-planning recalibrates.
Executive workforce scenario chosen (growth, restructure, shore-shift). HCM org changes, ATS hiring plan, and EPM financial plan adopt scenario.
New organizational design approved. HCM org-unit moves cascade; reporting lines, span-of-control, and IGA group memberships need realignment.
External labor-market data refreshed (salary medians, supply-demand index, attrition baselines). COMP-MGMT bands and SWP plans should reassess.
Canonical job profile (job code, family, level, competencies) published. ATS templates, COMP-MGMT band mapping, LMS skill-profiles all consume.
Existing job profile updated (responsibilities, competencies, level). Downstream postings, comp bands, and learning paths revalidate.
New org unit (team, department, cost-center-aligned group) created. IGA groups, ERP cost-center mapping, and reporting structures should reflect it.
Two org units consolidated. Employee re-assignments cascade; manager/dotted-line relationships, IGA groups, and reporting realign.
Org unit closed. Employee re-placement required; IGA group dissolved; ERP cost-center retired.
Employment contract signed (initial, amendment, renewal). HCM employee-record updates; PAYROLL ingests new pay terms; COMP-MGMT records compensation basis.
Active contract amended (FTE change, title, location, terms). PAYROLL, BEN-ADMIN eligibility, and IGA entitlements need reassessment.
Fixed-term contract reached end date without renewal. Triggers HCM termination workflow, IGA deprovisioning, PAYROLL final pay.
People-Analytics published refreshed attrition forecast. HCM and SWP align hiring plans; TALENT-MGMT prioritizes retention motion for at-risk segments.
Engagement / pulse survey campaign opened. EMP-EXP collects responses; HCM and TALENT-MGMT prepare to consume aggregate signals.
Engagement survey window closed and results computed. EMP-EXP action plans triggered; HCM and TALENT-MGMT receive driver scores.
People-Analytics predictive model (flight-risk, performance, hire-success) deployed to production. HCM, ATS, and TALENT-MGMT receive scored populations.
Predictive-model scoring batch completed. Score distributions published to consuming HR domains for action triage.
New pay run created for period. WFM time-export window opens; absence balances finalize; expense reimbursables cut off.
Gross-to-net calculation complete; pay slips drafted. Awaiting approval and disbursement steps.
Pay run approved for disbursement. ERP-FIN journal post-prep; banking file generation imminent.
Net pay disbursed via bank/ACH. ERP-FIN posts payroll journals; ESG labor-cost data refreshes.
New earning code defined (bonus type, allowance, retro). COMP-MGMT, PAYROLL, and ERP-FIN mappings need configuration.
Deduction code updated (rates, GL mapping, statutory basis). BEN-ADMIN, PAYROLL, and ERP-FIN should validate effective dates.
Statutory tax rate/threshold change published by authority. PAYROLL refreshes calculation tables; impacts net-pay forecasts.
Periodic statutory tax filing submitted to authority. ERP-FIN cash-out plan aligns; compliance evidence stored.
Tax authority confirmed filing receipt and acceptance. Compliance status updated; GRC obligation closes.
Court/agency garnishment order received against an employee. PAYROLL must apply withholding; HRSD opens confidential case.
Garnishment order satisfied or terminated. PAYROLL stops withholding; HRSD closes case.
New benefit plan (medical, dental, 401k, equity) configured and made available. BEN-ADMIN catalog refreshed; carrier feeds set up.
Benefit plan retired. Enrollees migrated to replacement; carrier feeds wind down; PAYROLL deduction codes deactivated.
Dependent added to enrollee record (spouse, child, partner). Documentation and eligibility verification kicks off; carrier feed updates.
Dependent crossed plan age limit (e.g., 26 for medical). Coverage termination scheduled; COBRA / equivalent notice sent.
Qualifying life event reported (marriage, birth, divorce, relocation). Opens special-enrollment window; documentation required.
Life event approved; enrollment changes accepted. BEN-ADMIN updates carrier feed; PAYROLL recalculates deductions.
Open enrollment window opened. Employees can elect/change plans; communications and decision-support tools activate.
Open enrollment closed. Elections lock; carrier feeds generated; PAYROLL deductions effective next period.
Eligibility/enrollment file sent to carrier. Confirmation expected; reconciliation window opens.
Carrier acknowledgment processed; discrepancies flagged. BEN-ADMIN owns remediation; HRSD case may open for affected employees.
New compensation plan structure approved for a population. COMP-MGMT cycles can apply it; HCM consumes effective compensation.
Salary bands repriced (market refresh, midyear adjustment). COMP-MGMT recalibrates; ATS uses new ranges in offers.
Personalized total-rewards statement generated and delivered. EMP-EXP captures engagement; HRSD answers questions.
Equity grant (RSU/option/PSU) issued. PAYROLL tax-event tracking begins; ERP-FIN records expense; ESG governance disclosure may apply.
Equity tranche vested. PAYROLL processes taxable event; HCM updates record; brokerage handoff fires.
External market-comp benchmark dataset refreshed. COMP-MGMT and SWP planning use updated medians; band updates may follow.
Work schedule published for an upcoming period. WFM notifies employees; PAYROLL planning consumes; PSA and field-services align resource calendars.
Shift swap or pickup approved. Schedule updates propagate; payroll attribution adjusts; manager notification sent.
Scheduled shift not worked without coverage. Triggers attendance-policy review; HRSD case may be created.
Absence/PTO balances recomputed (accrual run, true-up, carry-over). HCM and PAYROLL refresh available-balances; employee self-service updates.
Time-off policy updated (accrual rate, cap, eligibility). WFM recomputes balances; HCM communicates; PAYROLL adjusts effective dates.
Statutory meal/rest-break compliance violation detected (esp. CA wage-and-hour). PAYROLL premium-pay calc triggered; HRSD opens compliance case.
New course made available in LMS catalog. TALENT-MGMT and HRSD curricula linkages update; required-training assignment rules apply.
Course retired (replaced, outdated). Active enrollments redirected; transcripts preserve completion history.
Learning path assigned to employee (role-based, onboarding, compliance). LMS schedules enrollment; HCM tracks dev-plan progress.
Employee completed an enrolled course. LMS records completion; TALENT-MGMT updates skill-profile; HCM dev-plan progresses.
Authoritative learning record (course, certification, external) written to transcript. HCM, TALENT-MGMT, and GRC compliance evidence consume.
Employee's skill profile updated (assessment, completion, manager-rating). TALENT-MGMT, SWP, and ATS internal-mobility receive refresh.
Mandatory compliance training nearing/at due date. HRSD and HCM nudge employee + manager; GRC tracks obligation status.
Compliance training due date passed without completion. GRC obligation breach; IGA may suspend access for severe non-compliance.
Performance goal set for an employee/team (annual, quarterly). HCM, TALENT-MGMT, and COMP-MGMT pay-for-performance link to outcomes.
Performance goal marked complete with rating. Feeds review cycles, succession-planning, and merit-cycle inputs.
Succession plan finalized for a critical role/role family. HCM, SWP, and ATS internal-mobility align talent-pool prioritization.
Calibration session completed; ratings stabilized across managers. COMP-MGMT cycle inputs locked; performance review cycle continues.
Employee re-placed on 9-box grid (performance x potential). Succession-planning, dev-plan, and COMP-MGMT rewards strategy reflect.
Continuous-feedback note captured (peer, manager, upward, 360). HCM and TALENT-MGMT consume into review and dev-plan flows.
Engagement / pulse / lifecycle survey campaign launched. Responses collection window open; EMP-EXP action-plan workflows arm.
Individual survey response captured. Aggregation pipeline updates campaign-level scores; sentiment models may flag risk responses.
Engagement action plan created from survey insights. HCM and TALENT-MGMT align development and retention motions; WORK-MGMT may track tasks.
Engagement action plan marked complete. Follow-up pulse survey scheduling possible; impact-measurement recorded.
New pulse question added to question bank. Survey-campaign templates can use; lifecycle and ad-hoc surveys consume.
HR-case taxonomy category updated. HRSD routing, knowledge-base mapping, and reporting roll-ups need realignment.
Access request raised (joiner provisioning, mover entitlement change, ad-hoc). Approval workflow starts; SoD pre-check evaluates.
Access request approved through workflow. IGA orchestrates provisioning to target systems; ITSM may receive change/fulfillment task.
Access certification campaign completed by reviewer. Revocations queued for non-recertified entitlements; GRC evidence captured.
New entitlement (role, group, permission set) registered in IGA catalog. Access-request catalog refreshed; SoD ruleset re-evaluated.
Segregation-of-Duties violation detected (toxic combo of entitlements). GRC issue raised; IGA blocks or mitigates; auditor review.
Provisioning action executed against a downstream system (create, modify, disable, delete). ITSM and ITAM may receive subsequent fulfillment tasks.
Provisioning attempt failed at target connector. IGA opens remediation; ITSM ticket may be created for manual completion.
A pipeline stage definition has been created or modified (rename, reorder, probability change). CRM forecasting and revenue intelligence need to recompute weighted pipeline.
A sales call has been recorded and stored. Conversation intelligence picks up for transcription, scoring, and coaching insights.
Recording transcription completed. Downstream conversation intelligence and revenue intelligence consume the transcript for insights and risk signals.
A cadence-driven sales email has been sent to a prospect. CRM logs the touch; revenue intelligence tracks engagement signals.
Recipient opened a tracked sales email. Engagement signal flows to CRM, MA lead scoring, and CDP behavior profile.
Recipient replied to a sales email. Strong intent signal; cadence pauses, sales rep notified, CRM activity logged.
Sales email bounced (hard or soft). Contact data quality flag; MA suppresses further sends; CRM marks contact invalid.
Conversation intelligence has published an insight (competitor mention, pricing objection, churn risk, next-step commitment). Revenue intelligence and CRM consume for deal-risk and coaching.
CDP identity graph has resolved new edges (cookie merge, device match, email-to-known-customer). MA and LOYALTY refresh audience membership; CSM updates contact lookup.
Computed customer attributes (LTV, churn-propensity, segment membership) have been recomputed. MA refreshes nurture eligibility; CSM updates health-score inputs; LOYALTY revisits tier eligibility.
Customer entered a new journey stage (awareness → consideration → purchase → retention → advocacy). MA triggers stage-appropriate campaign; CSM may step up engagement for at-risk stages.
Customer dropped out of an active journey (opt-out, churn, journey complete). MA stops nurture; CSM logs the exit reason.
A new quote has been created in CPQ against an opportunity. CRM links the quote to the opportunity; CLM may stand by for downstream contract draft.
A quote with discounts or non-standard terms has been routed for approval. Approvers (deal-desk, finance, legal) need to act before the quote can be sent.
Quote approval workflow completed; the quote is now sendable. Sales rep proceeds to send; CRM updates opportunity stage.
A finalized quote has been sent to the prospect. CLM stands by for envelope creation; revenue intelligence logs forecast input.

Buyer has accepted the quote (typically via e-sign or portal acceptance). CLM creates the contract draft; CRM advances opportunity to closed-won pending signature; SUB-MGMT prepares subscription provisioning.
Buyer rejected or let the quote expire. CRM logs the loss reason; revenue intelligence updates win-rate forecast.
A new line item has been added to a quote (product, bundle, service). Pricing rules and discount approvals re-evaluate against the updated quote total.
A guided product configuration has been completed and validated against configuration rules. Quote-line generation proceeds with the resolved BOM.
A CPQ pricing rule has been updated (price-list change, discount-curve revision, regional pricing). Active quotes may need re-pricing; sales ops needs visibility.
A non-standard discount has been requested on a quote. Deal-desk approver needs to review; quote is blocked from send until decision.
Discount approval granted. Quote resumes its submit-for-approval / send workflow.
A new product bundle has been published in CPQ. Sales reps can now configure it on quotes; pricing rules apply.
CPQ has generated a contract draft from an accepted quote. CLM picks up for clause assembly, redlines, and signature routing.
A customer entitlement (support tier, included service hours, feature access) has been provisioned. CSM and CCAAS update their entitlement caches for SLA enforcement.
Customer has consumed all units of an entitlement (e.g. support hours, included incidents). CSM should engage for overage discussion; SUB-MGMT may trigger overage billing.
An entitlement has reached its end-of-term. CSM evaluates renewal; SUB-MGMT updates the subscription record.
A customer satisfaction survey response has been captured. CSM updates account health; supervisor or CSM follows up on detractors.
CSAT/NPS response classified as detractor. CSM immediate follow-up required; account health declines.
A customer invoice has been issued. ERP-FIN records receivable; B2C-COMM/CSM customer portal surfaces the invoice; dunning timer starts.
Customer invoice has been fully paid. ERP-FIN applies cash; CSM gets a healthy-account signal; LOYALTY accrues points where applicable.
Customer invoice is past due. Dunning workflow starts; CSM is notified for retention; ERP-FIN updates aging buckets.
A metered usage record has been posted for a subscription. SUB-MGMT aggregates for the next billing cycle; CSM monitors against entitlement caps.
Posted usage exceeds the subscription's included tier. SUB-MGMT triggers overage billing; CSM may engage for tier upgrade conversation.
A loyalty point accrual or burn has been posted. Member balance updates; tier-progression evaluation runs.
A new redeemable reward has been published in the catalog. Marketing can promote; loyalty members see new redemption options.
A member has redeemed points for a reward. CRM logs the engagement; B2C-COMM may fulfill physical reward; ERP-FIN books the redemption liability movement.
A CCaaS contact (call, chat, email, social) has been recorded. CSM links to the customer case; WFM uses for agent occupancy.
Queue wait time, abandon rate, or service-level threshold breached. WFM triggers staffing adjustment; supervisor receives alert.
A contact-center call recording has been stored. Quality management, sentiment scoring, and CSM coaching can consume.
An agent's state (available / busy / wrap / away / lunch) has changed. WFM adherence and queue routing both react.
Agent has exceeded the allowed time in an auxiliary (non-productive) state. WFM flags adherence breach; supervisor is notified.
Agent applied a disposition code (sale, callback, do-not-call, technical-issue) to a contact. CRM updates lead/opportunity outcome; reporting aggregates by code.
A line item has been added to a customer order. OMS allocates inventory; CDP records purchase intent signal.
A new product has been published in the commerce catalog. CDP can include in segments; MA can launch awareness campaign; B2C storefront surfaces it.
Product has been marked discontinued. OMS stops accepting new orders; CSM may need to engage existing customers about replacement.
Product list price has changed. Open carts may re-price; CPQ pricing-rule revaluation may run; CDP may trigger price-drop notifications.
A fulfillment shipment has been created for an order. ERP-FIN may recognize revenue (depending on Incoterms); customer receives shipment notification.
Fulfillment has been handed to the carrier. CSM tracks; CDP logs as engagement; loyalty points may be earned.
Fulfillment confirmed delivered. Revenue recognition triggers in ERP-FIN; LOYALTY accrues points; review-request campaign may launch.
A coupon has been issued to a customer or campaign. MA tracks distribution; B2C-COMM validates at checkout; CDP logs as a touch.
Coupon redeemed at checkout. ERP-FIN books the discount; LOYALTY may award bonus points; MA tracks campaign ROI.
Bulk marketing email delivered to recipient. CDP records the touch; engagement-tracking timer starts.
Recipient opened a marketing email. Lead score may increment; CDP updates engagement profile.
Recipient clicked a link in a marketing email. Stronger intent signal than open; lead-scoring threshold may now be exceeded.
Recipient unsubscribed via a marketing email. CDP and CRM suppress further marketing contact; opt-out persists across all channels per consent rules.
Lead score has been recalculated based on new engagement or fit data. CRM may re-route the lead; SALES-ENG may pick it up for cadence.
A lead has completed all steps of a nurture journey without converting. CRM may downgrade or recycle; MA may enroll in a longer-cadence sequence.
Web form (gated content, demo request, contact-us) has been submitted. MA captures lead; CDP merges to identity graph; CRM lead-routing kicks in.
A social account on a supported social network has been connected to the SMM platform. Publishing, listening, and analytics become available.
Social listening detected a spike or sentiment shift on a tracked topic (brand mention, competitor, crisis). CRM/CSM/comms team needs to triage.
Influencer has posted brand-related content or engaged with a campaign. SMM tracks ROI; CRM may seed influencer-attributed leads.
Agency staffer submitted billable time. PSA processes for client billing; retainer balance is debited; project utilization refreshes.
A client retainer balance has reached the configured warning threshold (e.g. 75% consumed). Account manager engages for replenishment or scope conversation.
Client retainer fully consumed. PSA halts unbilled work; CRM expansion opportunity may be created; ERP-FIN reflects final draw-down.
Client-approved media plan finalized. PSA can begin execution; ERP-FIN reserves vendor commitments; agency invoices align to the schedule.
Media buy executed against the plan (insertion orders placed). PSA logs media costs; ERP-FIN accrues vendor payable.
Creative brief approved by client and account team. PSA can dispatch to creative team; project work items materialize.
A contractual obligation (deliverable, SLA milestone, payment) is due. CLM notifies the owner; missed obligations escalate to risk.
Contractual obligation breached. CLM creates an issue; finance reviews penalty clauses; CSM/account engagement increases.
A contract clause has been flagged during review (non-standard, high-risk, requires legal review). CLM routes to the appropriate reviewer.
A new contract template has been published. CPQ and CLM authoring tools can use; legal reviews any open quotes that should re-template.
All signers on a contract envelope have signed. CLM persists the executed contract; SUB-MGMT provisions the subscription; CRM marks the opportunity won.
An MSP master service agreement has been activated. PSA can begin billing; ERP-FIN sets up recurring invoice schedule; CSM kicks off onboarding.
MSP contract is within renewal window. CSM engages for renewal; CRM tracks the expansion opportunity.
MSP invoice has been issued to a client. ERP-FIN records receivable; CSM monitors for payment health.
New MSP client onboarded. RMM agents deployed; CSM kicks off services; ERP-FIN sets up billing entity.
MSP client has been offboarded (contract end, churn). RMM agents removed; PSA closes projects; ERP-FIN finalizes billing.
Customer subscription upgraded (more seats, higher tier, additional modules). SUB-MGMT updates billing; CSM logs expansion; CRM closes expansion opportunity.
Customer subscription canceled (immediate or end-of-term). CSM logs reason; CRM marks churn; ERP-FIN updates revenue forecast; LOYALTY may revoke tier benefits.
A new accounting period is opened for posting. Subscribers (AP-AUTO, EXPENSE, S2P) may need to reroute postings; EPM aligns plan horizons.
A previously closed period was reopened for late adjustments. AUDIT must re-snapshot; GRC reviews the override; EPM refreshes actuals.
A new GL account has been added to the chart of accounts. MDM, EPM, and AP-AUTO refresh mapping tables; AUDIT logs the change.
GL account hierarchy or reporting mapping was changed. EPM models must re-aggregate; BI cubes need refresh; AUDIT logs.
A new cost center has been opened. HCM aligns org units; S2P and EXPENSE add it to spend-allocation pickers; EPM creates plan slot.
A cost center is closed/deactivated. AP-AUTO, EXPENSE, and S2P must block further postings; EPM rebalances rollups.
A new legal entity is registered. ERP-FIN sets up books; AUDIT scopes coverage; GRC enrolls in compliance frameworks; intercompany pairs refresh.
A new corporate bank account has been registered. AP-AUTO routes payment runs; AUDIT and GRC log the new payment surface.
A bank statement file/feed has arrived. ERP-FIN starts reconciliation; cash_transactions are imported and matched.
A cash transaction was recorded against a bank account. EPM updates liquidity actuals; AUDIT captures.
A cash transaction failed automated bank reconciliation. AP-AUTO and treasury must investigate; AUDIT flags.
A fixed asset has been capitalized in the books. Triggers depreciation schedule creation, ITAM/HAM asset record linkage, and AUDIT logging.
A fixed asset has been disposed/written off. ITAM marks the asset retired; AUDIT and GRC verify disposal evidence.
A depreciation run posted entries against fixed assets. EPM updates actuals; AUDIT samples for testing.
An intercompany transaction has been booked. Triggers matching with the counterparty legal entity; AUDIT logs; eliminations queue updates.
Intercompany matching has detected an imbalance between counterparty entities. AUDIT and GRC flag; controllership investigates.
Three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice) succeeded. AP-AUTO releases for payment; ERP-FIN posts the liability; S2P closes the PO line.
Three-way match failed (price, quantity, or receipt variance). AP-controller intervenes; S2P or SUP-LIFE may need to renegotiate or correct receipt.
An AP user manually overrode a match exception. AUDIT and GRC must capture the rationale for SOX/internal-control evidence.
A supplier qualification workflow has been initiated (RFI, security questionnaire, financial review). GRC, AUDIT, and S2P observe progress.
A supplier has been fully qualified for procurement. S2P unblocks sourcing; AP-AUTO enables payment; ERP-FIN finalizes vendor master.
Supplier qualification was rejected. S2P removes from sourcing pool; GRC logs the disqualification reason.
A qualification certification (insurance, ISO, security) has expired. S2P blocks new POs; SUP-LIFE triggers re-qualification.
A supplier risk assessment has been completed (financial, operational, ESG, cyber). GRC ingests; AUDIT samples; S2P adjusts tier.
A supplier risk score has crossed an elevated/high threshold. GRC opens an issue; S2P may suspend; AUDIT and ESG receive signal.
An employee has submitted an expense line for approval. Manager workflow kicks off; policy engine evaluates.
An expense line triggered a policy violation (over-cap, missing receipt, out-of-policy merchant). SPEND-MGMT and AUDIT capture; manager review required.
An expense line is approved. AP-AUTO queues reimbursement; ERP-FIN accrues; PAYROLL adds to next reimbursement pay cycle if applicable.
Approved expense has been posted to the general ledger. EPM updates actuals; AUDIT samples.
A corporate travel booking has been confirmed. SPEND-MGMT records committed spend; EXPENSE pre-creates expense lines for reconciliation.
A travel booking was canceled. SPEND-MGMT reverses commitment; EXPENSE may need to record cancellation fees.
A travel booking violated travel policy. SPEND-MGMT and AUDIT capture; manager approval may be required pre-trip.
A corporate card has been issued to an employee. SPEND-MGMT activates; EXPENSE links for auto-feed; AUDIT records.
A corporate card has been suspended (lost, fraud, employee termination). SPEND-MGMT blocks new auths; EXPENSE closes open lines.
A corporate card authorization was declined (policy, limit, fraud). SPEND-MGMT logs; cardholder notification; AP-controller review for high-value.
A card authorization crossed a high-value threshold and requires post-spend review. SPEND-MGMT routes for approver attestation; AUDIT samples.
A vendor payment has been authorized within SPEND-MGMT. AP-AUTO releases for payment-run inclusion; ERP-FIN reserves cash.
A vendor payment authorization was rejected (policy, budget, signature missing). AP-AUTO holds the invoice; controller re-routes.
A spend policy (per-diem caps, category restrictions, approver thresholds) was updated. EXPENSE, AP-AUTO, S2P, and SPEND-MGMT must refresh rule engines.
A corporate card account balance crossed a configured threshold (utilization, statement due). SPEND-MGMT and ERP-FIN cash forecasting react.
A financial plan (annual budget, quarterly reforecast) has been published. ERP-FIN locks budget data; downstream consumers (HCM headcount, SPM portfolio) align.
A financial plan version has been approved by leadership. Triggers actuals-vs-plan variance tracking and downstream cost-center budget locks.
A what-if financial scenario has been computed. SPM consumes for portfolio rebalancing; SWP aligns workforce scenario impact.
A variance analysis (actuals vs plan/forecast) has been completed for a period. Cost-center owners and FP&A review; reforecast may be triggered.
Variance analysis surfaced a material unfavorable variance. EPM, ERP-FIN, and AUDIT flag for management explanation.
A sourcing event (RFP/RFQ/auction) has been launched. SUP-LIFE notifies qualified suppliers; AUDIT captures.
A sourcing event has been awarded to one or more suppliers. CLM drafts contract; S2P prepares PO; SUP-LIFE updates supplier tier.
A PO has been formally issued to a supplier. AP-AUTO awaits invoice; SUP-LIFE tracks supplier activity; ERP-FIN encumbers budget.
A PO has been amended (quantity, price, schedule). AP-AUTO must reprice pending matches; ERP-FIN adjusts encumbrance.
A PO has been fully received and invoiced or otherwise closed. ERP-FIN releases encumbrance; AP-AUTO removes from open queue.
Goods or services receipt has been posted against a PO. AP-AUTO can now three-way match; ERP-FIN accrues received-not-invoiced.
Goods receipt quantity differs materially from PO. SUP-LIFE flags supplier; AP-AUTO holds match; S2P investigates.
A contingent-labor staffing supplier has been activated in VMS. SUP-LIFE finalizes onboarding; AP-AUTO opens payment channel.
A new contingent-labor rate card has been published. PSA aligns project bill rates; ERP-FIN refreshes cost accruals.
A contingent worker timesheet has been approved. VMS triggers invoice creation; PSA captures actuals; ERP-FIN accrues.
A contingent timesheet was rejected by the manager. VMS notifies the staffing supplier; PSA holds actuals.
A contingent-labor invoice has been received from a staffing supplier. AP-AUTO matches against approved timesheets; ERP-FIN posts liability.
Contingent invoice matched approved timesheets and rate card. AP-AUTO releases for payment; ERP-FIN posts.
An audit plan (annual or risk-based) has been approved by the audit committee. AUDIT engagements scheduled; GRC scoping aligns.
An audit plan has been amended (added scope, rescheduled engagements). GRC, ERP-FIN, and process owners refresh expectations.
A control test has been executed by audit. GRC ingests result; control owner notified; remediation plan may follow.
A control test result indicates a deficiency. GRC opens issue; ERP-FIN or process owner drafts remediation; AUDIT escalates.
An audit work paper has been completed and reviewed. AUDIT engagement progresses; findings drafted as needed.
An audit work paper has been signed off by reviewer. AUDIT engagement closes step; evidence locked for retention.
An ITSM knowledge article has been approved and published. Self-service portal and AI agents pick it up; KMS may sync.
An ITSM knowledge article is retired or superseded. Self-service portal hides it; AIOPS suggestion engine refreshes.
A new ITSM service catalog item is published for end-user request. IGA gets entitlement mapping; ITAM/HAM/SAM/SMP wire fulfillment.
An ITSM service catalog item is withdrawn from the portal. Pending requests resolve or transfer; integrations decommission.
A service-level objective on a ticket has been breached. Escalation hierarchies, customer notifications and credit calculations engage.
A service-level objective is at risk of breach (e.g. 75% of allotted time consumed). AIOPS may attempt auto-remediation; ITSM escalates.
An ITAM asset support/maintenance contract has been renewed. Finance accruals refresh; GRC re-records evidence.
An ITAM asset support/maintenance contract has expired without renewal. Risk to ongoing service; ITSM/HAM/SAM owners need action.
Lifecycle event captured against an asset (procured, deployed, transferred, retired, disposed). ERP-FIN updates fixed-asset register; CMDB updates state.
An asset has been retired and queued for disposal. HAM triggers disposal workflow; GRC records data-destruction evidence.
A software title has been added to the SAM catalog. SMP may cross-link discovered SaaS apps; SAM begins license tracking.
A software title has reached end-of-life. GRC flags vulnerability risk; ITSM may schedule replacement project.
SAM detected license consumption exceeding entitled count. Triggers true-up purchase via S2P or reclamation workflow.
SAM detected significant idle licenses below an allocation threshold. Triggers harvesting or downgrade in S2P.
SMP discovered a SaaS application via SSO logs, expense data, or browser plugins. Triggers shadow-IT review and IGA visibility.
A SaaS application has been sanctioned by IT. IGA establishes provisioning; FINOPS picks up spend; ITAM records subscription.
A SaaS application has been deprovisioned tenant-wide. ITSM closes related tickets; IGA revokes; FINOPS terminates spend.
SMP recorded SaaS application usage telemetry (active users, feature adoption, session count). Drives FINOPS optimization and reclamation.
SaaS usage telemetry shows a license has been idle past the configured reclaim threshold. Triggers reclamation workflow.
A new or updated CMDB CI class definition is published. Downstream CMDB consumers refresh schemas; discovery probes recalibrate.
A CMDB service map (business service topology) has been updated. ITSM impact analysis refreshes; AIOPS correlations recompute.
A CMDB CI baseline snapshot has been captured (pre-change reference). Change-control compares post-change deltas against this.
Live CMDB CI configuration deviates from its captured baseline. Triggers ITSM unauthorized-change investigation.
A DISCOVERY scan run finished. New/changed CIs flow to CMDB reconciliation; ITAM/HAM ingest hardware findings.
A DISCOVERY scan run failed (credentials, connectivity, throttling). ITSM ticket auto-created for owner attention.
A new DISCOVERY data source (hypervisor, public-cloud account, network probe) was successfully connected. Initial CI ingestion begins.
A DISCOVERY data source lost connectivity. CMDB freshness degrades; ITSM ticket raised.
An ITOM capacity record (CPU, memory, storage, IOPS) crossed a warning or critical threshold. AIOPS correlates; ITSM may auto-ticket.
ITOM capacity forecasting predicts resource exhaustion within the planning horizon. Triggers procurement or scale-out planning.
An OBS metric series crossed a configured threshold. AIOPS correlation engine receives the signal; ITSM may auto-ticket.
OBS anomaly detection flagged an unusual pattern on a metric series. AIOPS aggregates with other signals for RCA.
OBS log analysis matched a defined error pattern (regex, ML classifier, signature). Triggers AIOPS correlation and possible ITSM ticket.
OBS APM traces identified a slow critical path beyond the latency budget. AIOPS correlates; DEM cross-references endpoint experience.
OBS APM observed an error-rate spike on a traced service. AIOPS triggers RCA workflow; ITSM may auto-ticket.
OBS SLO error-budget burn rate is high. SRE/ITSM escalation engages; release freezes may be triggered.
OBS SLO error budget exhausted for the current window. ITSM major incident may open; release controls activate.
OBS error tracking detected a new error signature (not seen before). ITSM/VSDP creates investigation ticket linked to recent release.
OBS error tracking detected a previously resolved error has regressed after a new deployment. VSDP may roll back; ITSM ticket.
AIOPS RCA workflow concluded with a published probable root cause. ITSM updates the incident/problem record.
AIOPS predictive engine has elevated a signal above the action threshold (predicted outage, capacity exhaustion, error storm). ITSM proactive ticket opened.
AIOPS activated a new alert suppression rule (e.g. during planned change). ITOM and OBS apply the suppression.
AIOPS retraining run completed for an anomaly/prediction model. Model registry updates; deployment may roll out.
AIOPS detected drift in input distribution or prediction quality. Triggers retraining schedule.
AIOPS predicted an incident with high confidence ahead of impact. ITSM opens a proactive incident; ITOM may execute remediation.
An RMM automation script ran on one or more endpoints. ITSM updates linked tickets; logs ingested by OBS.
An RMM automation script execution failed on a target endpoint. ITSM auto-ticket opens for technician attention.
A REMOTE-ACCESS session has begun between a technician and an endpoint. ITSM ticket links; GRC records access.
A REMOTE-ACCESS support session has ended. ITSM ticket time captured; MSP-PSA billing engages; recording archived.
A REMOTE-ACCESS attempt failed authentication or violated policy. SECOPS notified; GRC records security incident.
NPMD detected an anomalous flow pattern (unusual destination, volume, port). AIOPS correlates; SECOPS may engage if security risk.
NPMD detected a degraded network path between segments. AIOPS correlation; ITSM ticket; OBS cross-reference for impact.
NPMD observed a performance metric (latency, jitter, loss, utilization) crossing a configured threshold. AIOPS correlates.
NPMD raised a network performance alert. AIOPS aggregates with other signals; ITSM may auto-ticket.
NPMD detected a network interface transitioning to down state. AIOPS correlates; ITSM auto-ticket; OBS impact analysis.
NPMD detected a network interface flapping (rapid up/down transitions). Stability ticket auto-created.
NPMD detected degraded SaaS application performance from the user perspective. DEM cross-references endpoint signals; ITSM may auto-ticket.
NPMD published a new network topology snapshot. CMDB reconciles network CIs; AIOPS topology refresh.
NPMD recalculated dynamic baselines for a metric. Future threshold breaches use new bounds; AIOPS resyncs.
A UEM-managed device completed enrollment. ITSM links to user; IGA establishes device-identity binding; ITAM/HAM record asset.
A UEM-managed device has been retired/wiped. ITSM closes related tickets; HAM updates disposal status; IGA revokes device-context grants.
A UEM-managed device has been marked lost or stolen. UEM issues remote wipe; SECOPS engages; ITSM tracks; IGA revokes.
A UEM configuration profile was assigned to a device or group. Provisioning workflow records change; CMDB updates desired state.
UEM detected drift between desired and actual configuration on a device. ITSM ticket opens or remediation auto-triggers.
A UEM device compliance policy was published or updated. Devices re-evaluate; IGA receives policy-aware access decisions.
UEM detected a device fell out of compliance. IGA blocks sensitive access; ITSM auto-ticket; GRC records evidence.
UEM recorded a device transitioning back to compliant state. IGA restores access; ITSM auto-closes related tickets.
A UEM-managed mobile app package was published to the catalog. Enrolled devices and assignments pick it up.
A UEM app assignment was deployed to a device group. SAM tracks license consumption; ITSM logs change.
A UEM enrollment token was issued to a user for self-service device enrollment. ITSM ticket links the request.
A UEM deployment failed on a device. ITSM auto-ticket; technician engaged for remediation.
DEM endpoint experience score for a user/device crossed a degradation threshold. ITSM proactive ticket; AIOPS correlates.
DEM synthetic check failed (transaction, login, page load). OBS aggregates; AIOPS correlates; ITSM may auto-ticket.
DEM RUM telemetry flagged a real user session as poor experience. OBS cross-references; AIOPS aggregates for trend.
DEM detected a digital friction event (slow app launch, hung process, repeated retries) on an endpoint. ITSM proactive ticket.
DEM endpoint anomaly engine published a finding (unusual app behavior, resource pattern). AIOPS aggregates; SECOPS may engage.
A HAM hardware model definition has been added. Procurement and ITAM reference the model on new acquisitions.
HAM recorded a vendor end-of-life announcement for a hardware model. Affected assets flagged; refresh planning kicks off.
A HAM warranty is approaching expiry (e.g. 90 days). Procurement evaluates extension; ITAM updates support coverage.
A HAM warranty has expired. Assets revert to time-and-materials repair; risk register updates.
HAM recorded the completion of an asset disposal (recycle, resale, destruction). ERP-FIN writes off the fixed asset; GRC archives evidence.
HAM spare parts on hand for a model fell below the configured threshold. Procurement triggers replenishment via S2P.
A DCIM rack reached space, power, or weight capacity threshold. ITOM/ITSM coordinate placement of new equipment.
DCIM detected an environmental issue (temperature, humidity, water leak) at a cabinet. ITSM ticket opens; AIOPS correlates with ITOM.
DCIM PDU reported a failure or imbalance. ITSM major incident may open; AIOPS correlates downstream impact.
DCIM detected a power circuit exceeding its breaker threshold. ITSM emergency ticket; load rebalance triggered.
A DCIM UPS failed over to battery or generator power. ITOM/AIOPS correlate; ITSM major-incident workflow.
DCIM cooling unit reported a failure. ITSM emergency ticket; AIOPS predicts downstream thermal impact.
DCIM environmental sensor reading (temp, humidity, smoke) crossed alarm threshold. ITSM ticket; ITOM remediation.
DCIM capacity plan refreshed with latest utilization and growth forecasts. ITOM/SPM use for build-out decisions.
DCIM detected a port connection added or removed. CMDB updates physical topology; NPMD cross-validates logical paths.
DCIM cable connection added between devices. CMDB topology refresh; documentation updated.
An ML model is promoted from staging to production; triggers monitoring, lineage registration, and AI-agent tool-cache refresh.
Production ML model exhibits feature or prediction drift exceeding configured threshold; triggers retraining and ITSM incident.
Drift, performance decay, or scheduled cadence requires model retraining; orchestrator picks up training job.
Post-training evaluation failed pre-deployment gates (accuracy, fairness, bias). Blocks promotion; alerts MLOps team.
Model is retired from production; lineage references close, consumers receive deprecation notice.
A feature set is published to the feature store and available for online/offline serving; downstream models can subscribe.
Feature set schema modified (column added/removed/renamed); dependent models need revalidation.
Feature freshness SLA breached; serving features are older than tolerance window.
A BI report has been published and made available to subscribers; cache warm-up and notification dispatch follows.
Scheduled BI report execution failed (query error, timeout, source unavailable). Subscribers may receive degraded notification.
A new BI dashboard published to a workspace; access policies applied; subscribers notified.
BI dashboard shared with external users or via public link; DLP and governance need to validate.
BI query execution exceeds configured runtime threshold; cost and capacity alerts triggered.
BI query consumed compute or scanned-bytes above cost threshold; FinOps and platform owners notified.
Scheduled subscription delivery (email, chat channel, file) failed for a recipient; needs retry or address fix.
A user activates a recurring BI subscription; delivery cadence scheduled.
A new dimensional model (cube/semantic model) is published; BI tools and AI agents can pick up the schema.
A dimensional model is deprecated with optional replacement; downstream consumers receive deprecation warning.
A pre-aggregated metric materialization is refreshed; BI caches invalidate; AI agents reload.
Materialization refresh job failed; consumers fall back to live query with cost/latency hit.
A query lineage record is captured; downstream catalog and governance tooling ingests for impact analysis.
Access policy for a metric was modified; affected BI dashboards and AI agents revalidate authorization.
An external ontology has been imported and reconciled into the KG; mappings published to DCG and AI agents.
Ontology validation rules failed; new version blocked from publication.
Two KG entities merged after duplicate resolution; downstream relationships re-pointed.
A new entity asserted in the KG; semantic index updates for retrieval and AI grounding.
A citizen developer provisions a new no-code base; access policies inherit from workspace defaults.
A no-code base is exported (CSV/API); DLP and governance may need to inspect.
Record schema in a no-code base changed; dependent forms, views, automations, and external sync need to revalidate.
A no-code form receives a submission; automations fire and downstream systems receive payload.
A no-code view is shared via public link or external user; DLP needs to validate.
A no-code automation run failed; citizen owner notified, may need IT escalation.
A no-code automation fired; downstream WORK-MGMT or LCAP may pick up the action.
A low-code app is published to production; APP-PAAS hosts runtime, IPAAS may need to refresh integrations.
Low-code app deployment failed; rollback initiated; ITSM ticket may be filed.
A low-code business object schema changed; dependent pages, workflows, integrations need re-validation.
A low-code workflow execution failed; admin alerted, may need IT escalation.
A low-code workflow is published; downstream IPAAS integrations may register new triggers.
A low-code page version published; users see updated UI.
Low-code data source connection failed; dependent pages and workflows degrade.
A new data domain registered with steward and policy scope; DQ and DLP receive scope updates.
Domain steward reassignment; access approvers and notification routing update.
New lineage edge captured (upstream/downstream/derived); impact-analysis graph updates.
Previously-observed lineage edge no longer present; may indicate pipeline change or deletion.
Asset receives a certification level (gold/silver/bronze); consumers see trust signal.
