An in-line or end-of-line quality inspection failed; downstream GRC logs the non-conformance, FSQM may escalate to incident, and the produced lot is quarantined.
A shop floor exception case has been opened by an operator; downstream ITSM may take it if equipment/IT related, EAM if mechanical, and supervisors are notified.
A dairy cow has transitioned lifecycle stage (heifer/lactating/dry/cull); downstream herd-management adjusts groupings, ERP-FIN updates fixed-asset valuation, and feed_rations rebalance.
A new lactation cycle has been opened for a cow after calving; downstream feed and breeding cycles initialise, ERP-FIN updates herd KPIs.
A milking event has been completed for a cow/parlor-session with volume and composition; downstream FOOD-TRACE rolls into bulk-tank lots and ERP-FIN aggregates daily yield.
A breeding event (insemination/natural service/pregnancy check) has been recorded; downstream GRC logs traceability requirement and herd projections refresh.
A feed ration formulation has been changed for a group; downstream ERP-FIN updates feed-cost-per-liter and FOOD-TRACE links ingredient lots for traceability.
A farmers' market sale has been recorded at a stall; downstream ERP-FIN posts revenue and CRM updates customer activity for direct-to-consumer relationships.
A wholesale order has been confirmed by a buyer; downstream ERP-FIN reserves AR/inventory and FOOD-TRACE prepares lot allocations.
A delivery route has been dispatched with manifest and driver; downstream CRM notifies customers of ETA and FOOD-TRACE attaches lot/temperature attestations.
A CSA pickup location has been activated for the upcoming cycle; downstream CRM notifies subscribers and ERP-FIN provisions cost-center tracking.
A butcher order is cut, packed and ready for pickup/delivery; downstream CRM notifies the customer and FOOD-TRACE finalizes the lot/cut traceability record.
A harvest forecast has been updated with revised yield/timing; downstream ERP-FIN updates revenue projection and CRM informs pre-sale subscribers/CSA members.
A farm storefront (e-commerce, on-farm shop) has been opened for a season; downstream CRM begins promotion and ERP-FIN provisions revenue tracking.
A field boundary/geometry has been updated; downstream FOOD-TRACE updates lot-to-field linkage, TELEMATICS recomputes geofences, and ERP-FIN updates land-cost allocation.
A crop plan for a field/season has been committed; downstream ERP-FIN updates input-cost projections and FOOD-TRACE prepares lot pre-assignments.
A planting pass has been completed on a field; downstream FOOD-TRACE creates the upstream traceability lot and TELEMATICS reconciles machinery-hour costs.
Agricultural input (seed/fertilizer/chemical) stock has crossed reorder threshold; downstream ERP-FIN/S2P triggers replenishment requisition.
A variable-rate prescription map has been published for application; downstream TELEMATICS pushes the map to machinery and FOOD-TRACE links it to the resulting application KDE.
A machinery telemetry record (GPS/coverage/yield/engine-hours) has been captured; downstream TELEMATICS aggregates utilization, ERP-FIN allocates machine-cost, FOOD-TRACE links to operation KDE.
A traceability lot has been created at an origin (harvest, receipt, production); downstream FSQM begins quality surveillance and GRC starts the retention-period clock.
A FSMA-204 Critical Tracking Event (receive/transform/ship) has been recorded; downstream GRC validates KDE completeness and AUDIT may sample for compliance evidence.
A Key Data Element has been captured (lot/location/date/quantity); downstream FSQM may correlate with quality incidents and AUDIT retains for traceability evidence.
A HACCP plan has been approved and is in effect; downstream MFG-OPS aligns work-instructions, GRC tracks training attestations, AUDIT schedules surveillance.
A CCP measurement has deviated from the critical limit (temp/pH/time/aw); downstream MFG-OPS quarantines the production lot, FOOD-TRACE flags affected lots, and GRC logs the deviation for reporting.
An allergen control failure has been detected (cross-contact, label mismatch); downstream FOOD-TRACE quarantines the lot, GRC triggers FSMA reporting evaluation, AUDIT records the non-conformance.
An environmental monitoring swab has returned positive for an indicator/pathogen; downstream MFG-OPS triggers intensified sanitation and FOOD-TRACE evaluates affected lots for hold.
A scheduled sanitation cycle has been completed and verified; downstream MFG-OPS releases the line for production and GRC retains evidence for audit.

A new inventory location (store, DC, 3PL node, dark store) has been activated in OMS. Sourcing engines must include it in allocation candidates; ERP-FIN provisions cost-center and stock-ledger accounts.

On-hand units at a location crossed the configured capacity or safety-stock threshold. Sourcing and replenishment workflows should rebalance; B2C-COMM may suppress availability promises from that node.
An order line has been allocated to a specific inventory location. Triggers WMS pick-pack, ERP-FIN inventory reservation accounting, and B2C-COMM order-status update.
Allocation could not be satisfied (no sourcing node has stock, all candidates exceeded SLA, or sourcing rules excluded all options). CSM must engage the customer; CRM logs the service event.
An existing allocation has been moved to a different inventory location (capacity issue, faster ship, store-cancellation). Downstream pick instructions and ETA updates flow to B2C-COMM and CSM.
An RMA has been generated for a customer return. CSM tracks the case; B2C-COMM exposes the return label and instructions; ERP-FIN holds the credit-memo accrual.
Returned merchandise has been received and inspected at the return location. Triggers refund release in ERP-FIN, restock or disposition decision, and CSM case close.
RMA was issued but the return window has elapsed without receipt. CRM may engage for re-purchase or write-off; the accrual is reversed.
The OMS sourcing engine has produced a sourcing decision for an order (chosen node, split lines, carrier). Feeds B2C-COMM promised-delivery dates and ERP-FIN cost-of-fulfillment planning.
A human operator or downstream WMS overrode the computed sourcing plan. CSM and B2C-COMM may need to refresh promised dates; analytics records the override reason.
A buy-online-pickup-in-store (BOPIS) order has been created. The destination store is notified for staging; B2C-COMM shows pickup instructions; CRM links the visit to the customer record.
BOPIS order is staged and ready for customer pickup. Notification is sent via B2C-COMM; CSM monitors for SLA breach.
Customer did not collect the staged BOPIS order within the configured hold window. Triggers restock in OMS, refund in ERP-FIN, and CRM lifecycle update.
A beta program has been opened to enrolled participants. CRM tags participating accounts; CSM activates white-glove monitoring; CDP segments the cohort for tailored comms.
Structured beta feedback (surveys, telemetry signals, NPS) has been aggregated. Routes into product-research backlogs and CSM account-notes for follow-up.
A beta program has been closed; participants transition to GA, extended trial, or exit. CRM updates entitlements; CSM resumes standard motion.
A new piece of customer feedback (support ticket theme, NPS verbatim, in-product feedback, social mention) has been captured. Routed to CSM for sentiment context and to PROD-MGMT triage queue.
A feedback item has been linked to a feature_request or product_feature, closing the listening loop. CSM/CRM should surface this on the customer record for renewal and expansion conversations.
A new feature request has been logged (from customer, sales, CSM, or internal). Joins the prioritization backlog; CRM tags requesting accounts.
Upvote / weighted-demand score for a feature request crossed the configured prioritization threshold. Triggers PM review and downstream WORK-MGMT initiative consideration.
A feature request has been delivered in a release. Notifies CRM-tracked requesters, fires close-the-loop comms via DXP and CSM, and updates the customer record.
A product feature has shipped to general availability. DXP needs marketing-page updates; CRM updates entitlements; CDP refreshes segment definitions that key on feature usage.
A product feature has been marked deprecated with a sunset date. CSM proactively notifies affected accounts; DXP updates docs; CRM tags impacted opportunities.
A feature's active-user adoption crossed the configured target (or fell below floor). CSM uses for expansion or churn-risk conversation; CDP refreshes feature-affinity segments.
A new product line is now live. Catalog updates flow to B2C-COMM and CPQ; CRM enables the line on opportunity records; ERP-FIN sets up the revenue stream.
A product line is being end-of-lifed. CSM begins migration motion; CRM blocks new opportunities; ERP-FIN closes the revenue stream after the wind-down.

A tracked product metric (DAU, activation rate, time-to-value, churn-leading indicator) crossed a configured threshold. CSM may need outreach; CDP refines segments; CRM is alerted for at-risk accounts.
A product metric snapshot has been published for the current period. Feeds product analytics dashboards and BI rollups.
A product release has been scheduled with a target date and scope. WORK-MGMT creates the delivery workstream; DXP plans the launch content.
A product release has been deployed to GA. DXP publishes release notes; CSM packages the customer communication; CRM updates entitled-features; CDP refreshes segments based on new capabilities.
A product release has been rolled back due to defects or customer impact. CSM mobilizes for incident comms; DXP retracts the launch content.
A new product-roadmap version has been published. DXP updates customer-facing roadmap; CRM/CSM refresh narrative for renewal and expansion conversations.
A roadmap item has moved from later to now/next (or committed). Creates WORK-MGMT delivery scope; CSM may notify advocating customers.
A discount has been applied to a quote line or quote header. CRM updates opportunity amounts; ERP-FIN models margin impact; SALES-PERF tracks discounting behavior.
A discount above the rep's threshold has been approved by sales-ops or finance. Triggers contract drafting in CLM with discount terms; CRM and SALES-PERF reflect approved amount.
A proposed discount exceeded the policy threshold (margin floor, percent cap, deal-desk trigger). Escalation flow opens to deal desk and ERP-FIN for margin review.

A consultant or named resource is firmly assigned to a project role with a start date and percentage allocation. Triggers HCM capacity decrement, WORK-MGMT seat creation, and finance commitment recognition.
A resource rolls off a project (planned end reached, early release, or scope change). Returns capacity to the HCM bench, closes the WORK-MGMT seat, and may trigger SWP demand-replan.

An active assignment's actual utilization falls below the configured floor (e.g., billed hours under 60% of plan for two consecutive weeks). PSA practice leads need a heads-up to rebalance or accelerate billing.

A contractual project milestone has been delivered and signed off, making the milestone billable. ERP-FIN must raise the invoice; CLM updates contract performance; revenue recognition records the trigger.
The billing milestone has been converted to a customer invoice in ERP-FIN. SUB-MGMT updates the customer-facing schedule; CRM logs the financial event against the account.
A scheduled billing milestone has not been delivered by its target date. Cash-forecast in EPM/ERP-FIN must reflect the slip and CLM may need to assess contract penalty exposure.
A tentative resource-allocation plan transitions to committed status. HCM treats the named hours as booked capacity; CLM links the allocation to the underlying engagement contract.
Allocation engine detected an over-booking conflict (same resource committed beyond 100% in a period). PSA resource managers must rebalance; SWP captures the demand signal.
Required skill-and-role demand for an upcoming project window cannot be staffed from internal supply. Triggers ATS requisition draft and contingent-worker sourcing in HCM.
A delivery task on the project plan has been marked complete. WORK-MGMT mirrors the status; PSA aggregates for milestone progress and EPM consumes for delivery KPI rollup.
A project task has crossed its due date without completion. Triggers escalation to project manager; WORK-MGMT updates the team board; PSA recalculates burn-rate forecast.
A successor task is blocked because an upstream dependency (deliverable, approval, or external input) has not arrived. WORK-MGMT shows the block; PSA may need to re-baseline.

A resource's certified skills, proficiencies, or certifications have been refreshed (project debrief, certification earned, manager review). HCM seeds the talent profile; ATS uses the updated inventory for internal mobility matches.

Aggregate skill inventory across the practice shows a gap against forecast demand (specific certification, technology, or role family). SWP triggers a hire-vs-train decision; LMS may seed an upskilling plan.
A new in-house legal matter has been opened (litigation hold, regulatory enquiry, M&A workstream, employment dispute). ECM creates the matter file workspace; GRC logs the regulatory or risk linkage.
An in-house legal matter has been resolved or formally closed. ECM archives the matter file; AUDIT may need the closure record as part of an evidence package.
A matter has crossed a threshold requiring regulatory disclosure (materiality, breach, sanctions exposure). GRC opens the obligation and AUDIT may scope a related engagement.

Formal legal advice has been issued by in-house counsel (privileged memo, policy interpretation, contract guidance). ECM files the privileged document; the requesting business function logs the guidance against their workflow.

Legal advice has been issued in connection with a specific employee or workforce matter (investigation, accommodation, termination review). HCM and HR cases attach the privileged-reference pointer without exposing content.
Candidate assessment result meets the configured pass threshold for the requisition. ATS advances the candidate stage; TALENT-MGMT may pre-seed the skill profile for the eventual hire.
Candidate assessment result falls below the configured threshold. ATS rejects or holds the application; talent-pool nurture may pick up the candidate for a future role.

Pre-employee record reaches the activation milestone (paperwork complete, background check cleared, start date reached). Published by ATS-PRE-EMPLOYEE-RECORD; HCM consumes to create the canonical `employees` row.
Deal has been signed and funded; portfolio company is now held.
Fund has reached final close; commitment book locked.
All call line items funded by LPs.
Distribution payments executed.
Quarter-end valuation locked; impacts PCAP and LP reports.
New 409A approved; future grants must price against it.
Exit closed; waterfall proceeds distributed to shareholders.
Secondary transfer completed; cap table updated.
EM fund vehicle operational; signals potential migration path to FUND-ADMIN.
Subscription has entered the renewal window (default 90 days pre-expiry). Triggers procurement and legal coordination.
Renewal executed. New term begins; CLM legal_contracts updated; FINOPS continues spend.
Subscription terminated. Triggers deprovisioning across IGA, FINOPS, ITAM.
User granted access to the SaaS app. IGA records the entitlement.
Idle license reclaimed and returned to the pool. User notified; IGA revokes access.
Assignment removed (typically driven by HCM leaver event). IGA revokes access.

Stock-on-hand for an item-location pair has fallen below its configured reorder point. Triggers replenishment suggestion against the preferred supplier (or transfer suggestion against a sister warehouse).
Any net change to on_hand quantity for an item-location pair: receipt, issue, transfer, or adjustment. High-frequency event consumed by OMS for ATP refresh.
On-hand quantity has been reserved against a sales order or pending fulfillment. Drives the available_for_allocation column down.
Cycle count variance has been reviewed, approved, and posted as inventory adjustment movements. Drives a GL journal in ERP-FIN for inventory revaluation.
Inter-location transfer has been received at destination. May trigger an inter-company cost move in ERP-FIN when the locations belong to different legal entities.
Lot is approaching its configured expiry threshold. Triggers proactive customer communication for perishable goods or controlled-substance compliance signaling.
Lot has been flagged for recall (supplier defect, contamination, regulatory notice). Fans out to customer service for shipped-lot tracing and to compliance for regulatory evidence.
Serialized unit has been issued (sold or installed) and its warranty start date has been registered. Triggers warranty registration in CSM.
New SKU has been authored in the inventory catalog. Syncs to storefront-facing PIM-like catalogs (B2C-COMM) for product publication.

Fired when an offer is rescinded after extension. Subscribers cancel the background check, halt the pre-employee onboarding paperwork, recall the onboarding journey, withdraw benefit enrollment, and unwind compensation seeding.
An ITAM asset contract has been signed/executed and transitions from draft to active. ITAM-LIFECYCLE generates initial procurement/deployment lifecycle events for covered assets.
An ECO has been CAB-approved and released; affected parts now carry new released revisions and the change effective date has passed.
A new engineering part has been released to production (first released revision exists).
An mBOM revision has been released; production planning should plan against the new structure.
A routing revision has been released; MES should regenerate work instructions.
Compliance declaration approved; affected parts gate sellable-in-market flags.
A 2D drawing has been released; downstream consumers (service, manufacturing, customer) can pull the current revision.
A requirement has been verified (test passed, inspection complete, analysis closed); traceability matrix updated.
A part has been marked obsolete; downstream systems should stop ordering and start sunsetting.
HR case is resolved and closed by the HR agent. Downstream consumers (knowledge authoring, learning analytics, audit) react to the closure signal.
People-KPI snapshot computed and published for the reporting period. HCM and EPM consumers refresh scorecards and workforce-cost forecasts.
Workforce-segment composition crossed a meaningful threshold (representation, span-of-control, attrition). Downstream DEI and HCM dashboards re-render; SWP recalibrates plan assumptions.
Aggregate attrition-risk score for a segment elevated past threshold. Signals TALENT-MGMT, HCM, and HRSD to act on retention motion.
Engagement driver score declined materially vs the prior cycle. EMP-EXP and TALENT-MGMT triage; HRSD may open a manager-outreach case.
Pay-equity analysis surfaced a statistically meaningful gap for a workforce segment. COMP-MGMT reviews and may launch a structured remediation cycle.
DEI / workforce analysis identified a skill gap in a segment. LMS curates targeted learning paths.
HR case requires Payroll Operations follow-up (off-cycle pay, W-2 reissue, garnishment question). Routes the case to PAYROLL.
HR case requires Benefits Administration follow-up (enrollment, qualifying-event update, carrier dispute). Routes the case to BEN-ADMIN.
Employee submits an HR request via the self-service portal. Case-mgmt picks it up, applies AI triage, and starts the case lifecycle.
Merit cycle opened to managers for recommendation entry.
Fired when an engagement is delivery-complete. CRM and account-team systems react; PSA financials closes out residual billing.
Calibration complete across leadership cohorts; cycle moves into approval routing.
Effective-dated pay changes posted to HCM and payroll.
Manager submits merit, bonus, and equity-refresh recommendation for review.
Approved recommendation locked and posted as effective pay-rate change.
Compensation plan moves from draft to active and becomes assignable.
Compensation plan retired from new assignments and kept for historical reference.
Total-rewards statement released to the worker through portal or email.
Worker has viewed or acknowledged the total-rewards statement.
Board, compensation committee, or delegate signs off on the equity award.
Equity grant canceled due to termination or unmet performance condition.
Pay run canceled before disbursement. Downstream stages reset; tax filing prep is rolled back.
Pay slip published to employee self-service. HCM YTD balances refresh; statement available for download.
Pay slip amended after publication. Original retained; supersession recorded; downstream YTD adjustments cascade.
Payroll journal entry reversed (mid-period correction or error). ERP-FIN posts counter-entry; benefits accruals reverse.
Tax authority rejected the filing. Compliance status flips; remediation case opened.
Tax filing amended after submission. Supersedes original; GRC evidence refreshed.
Garnishment order satisfied in full. Withholding stops; HRSD closes case; audit trail retained.
Earning code deactivated. PAYROLL-RUN excludes from future calculations; historic records preserved.
Deduction code deactivated. PAYROLL-RUN and BEN-ADMIN integrations refresh mappings.
Fired when a desk booking is checked in. Subscribers update occupancy signals (IWMS-SPACE-ANALYTICS) and badge / access systems (IGA) where physical-access provisioning is wired up.
Fired when a workplace service request is resolved. Subscribers update chargeback / cost-allocation systems (ERP-FIN) and feed completion-time SLAs back into space-analytics.
Fired when a room reservation is auto-released after the grace window. Subscribers (IWMS-SPACE-ANALYTICS) recapture the time slot for utilization reporting.
Position record approved and ready for posting and recruiting.
Position transitioned to open status; recruiting can begin.
Position filled by a hired employee; no further hiring on this position until vacancy.
Position frozen; no new requisitions or hires permitted until thawed.
Position eliminated from the org structure; existing requisitions must be closed.
Job profile approved and available for use by positions and requisitions.
Job profile activated for production use.
Job profile retired; existing references should migrate to a successor profile.
Org unit activated and available for use across downstream domains.
Org unit structure changed (parent re-pointed, scope adjusted); downstream tags need refresh.
Org unit closed; active references must be re-targeted or terminated.

A CRM lead has been converted into a customer (account), contact, and optionally an opportunity. Suppresses ongoing nurture in MA, primes onboarding-readiness signals, and feeds funnel-conversion analytics in revenue intelligence.
Strategy-office cascades a corporate or divisional objective down to subordinate units; subscribers create child OKRs.
Strategic initiative approved for execution; downstream portfolio (SPM) registers the investment.
Strategic initiative completed; benefits realization captured.
Strategic initiative canceled; downstream portfolio releases capacity.
Operating review concluded; commentary, action items, and decisions are now in the record.
Strategy decision logged by the decision-maker; affected initiatives, OKRs, or resources are updated.

CMDB-CORE: a discovered Configuration Item has been reviewed by a data steward and registered into the authoritative CI repository. Downstream CMDB modules (Service Mapping, Baselines/Drift) consume the CI from this point.
A new PIM product has been authored in draft state.
Author has submitted the product for merchandising review; attribute submit-lock now active.
Merchandiser has approved the record; ready to be published to any configured channel.
Product is now live on one or more syndication channels; storefronts, inventory, and CPQ become eligible to read.
Product has been pulled from all channels but remains in approved state for later re-publishing.
Product is no longer offered; downstream systems must stop fulfillment for net-new orders.
Asset has cleared rights / brand-compliance review and is available to PIM products.
Asset is live on a channel feed; CDN URL is in active use.
Translation cleared for publishing; the locale variant is consumable by syndication jobs.
A syndication job has been created and is awaiting a worker.
All records on the run were accepted by the destination channel.
Job aborted before any records succeeded; usually destination outage or credentials.
Customer or RMM agent has opened a new MSP ticket.
Technician has applied a fix; awaiting customer confirmation.
Ticket finalized after customer confirmation or auto-close.
Technician has submitted a time entry for approval.
Time entry approved; eligible for billing or block-hour decrement.
MSP customer invoice has been paid in full.
Invoice past due date; dunning workflow may trigger.
MSP contract has been terminated (early termination, churn, non-renewal).
MSP contract paused (non-payment, dispute). SLAs paused; billing held.
An installed_equipment unit has been physically installed and activated. Triggers PM schedule creation and contract coverage start.
A PM cycle is due on the unit. Drives proactive work-order generation.
Equipment marked non-operational. PM schedules pause; reactive work orders allowed.
Unit permanently retired. Triggers contract termination and PM cancellation.
PM cycle hit due date. Work order should be generated.
PM cycle past grace window. Escalation alert sent to account manager.
PM cycle satisfied by a closed work order. Triggers next-cycle scheduling.
Site moves from prospect to active service. May trigger CRM account update and contract creation.
Site removed from service. Triggers contract termination and PM cancellation on all equipment at the site.
Work order canceled (customer change, duplicate, no longer needed).
Library acquisition order fully received from vendor.
Library item received from vendor and ready for cataloging.
Bibliographic record published to discovery layer.
Library item activated; circulable.
Patron placed a hold on a bibliographic record or item.
Hold is on the pickup shelf awaiting patron retrieval.
Fine assessed against patron account.
Patron borrowing privileges suspended.
Borrowed item received and ready to loan to patron.
A CSA share pack has been composed and packed for delivery; downstream DELIVERY-OPS picks it up for route sequencing.
A wholesale order has been physically fulfilled (delivered or picked up); downstream WHOLESALE module finalizes invoice posting.
New course version published; replaces prior version for new enrollments and notifies content-delivery + paths.
Course version retired; active enrollments referencing it are flagged for migration.
Terminal completion record posted for a learner per course version; feeds transcripts, paths, talent-mgmt skill profiles.
Completion voided by admin (e.g. integrity violation discovered post-grading); cascades to learning_records, certifications.
Course assessment available for attempts; assignment rules activate.
Learner submitted an attempt for grading.
Attempt graded as passing; downstream certification eligibility evaluated.
Attempt graded as failing; remediation paths and retake policies engage.
SCORM package validated and ready for course-version binding.
Offering opened for enrollment; audiences and waitlist promotion engage.
Offering completed; rolls up session attendances and triggers evidence packaging.
Offering canceled; waitlisted and enrolled learners are notified and refunded where applicable.
Individual session completed; attendance roster finalized.
Session canceled; attendees re-scheduled or refunded.
Instructor available for session assignment.
Instructor unavailable; future assignments blocked.
Attendance validated; OSHA evidence ready for evidence package.
Waitlisted learner promoted to enrolled when a seat opens.
New certification definition available; assignment and award workflows engage.
Certification definition retired; new awards blocked, existing certifications grandfathered.
New badge definition published; award rules and learner display engage.
Learner earned a badge; downstream talent-mgmt and learner-profile surfaces update.
Badge revoked from learner; downstream profiles update.
CE record filed with accrediting body; closes the credit-reporting cycle for the learner.
FINRA Rule 1240 CE record filed; regulator evidence retained.
Campaign launched; auto-enrollment rules fire and assignment cohort populates.
Campaign window closed; final completion rollup and evidence package generated.
Audit record submitted into evidence package or regulator filing.
Evidence package finalized; ready for regulator submission.
Evidence package submitted to regulator.
Statutory acknowledgment signed; signature record captured.
Regulator filing submitted; receipt captured.
Learner granted GDPR consent for training data processing.
Consent withdrawn; downstream LMS modules must stop processing and queue deletion.
SAR received from learner; regulator deadline begins.
SAR fulfilled; data package delivered to subject.
Erasure request received; affected modules notified to plan deletion.
Erasure completed across LMS modules; record archived as evidence.
Curriculum published; available for assignment to roles or audiences.
Path assignment completed by learner; rollups fire to talent-mgmt and skill-profile.
Path assignment expired without completion; remediation engages.
Learning plan activated; component path assignments materialize.
Learning plan completed; talent-mgmt profile picks up the development milestone.
Enrollment rule activated; processes the current audience and fires enrollments.
Notification sent to learner via configured channel.
Notification send failed; escalation rule may re-route.
Manager nudge sent for direct report's overdue training.
Manager acknowledged the nudge.
Escalation rule activated; eligible overdue assignments will trigger escalations.
Learner failed the enrolled course; remediation paths and retake policies engage.
Enrollment expired without completion; HRSD and HCM are nudged for action.
Learner withdrew from enrollment; downstream assignment trackers update.
Learning record voided after audit (e.g. integrity violation); transcript and talent-mgmt profile update.
Certification renewed by learner; new validity window starts and IGA accesses retained.
Certification revoked; IGA must reassess gated accesses, GRC obligation status updates.
Certification expired without renewal; IGA accesses requiring it are revoked or suspended.
Learner completed mandatory compliance training; GRC obligation closes; evidence package row generated.
Compliance assignment waived through documented exception; GRC obligation closes with annotation.
Compliance assignment expired without completion; IGA access may be suspended; GRC obligation remains open.
Learning path published; available for assignment to learners and curriculum bundling.
Learning path retired; new assignments blocked; existing assignments allowed to complete.

A team-execution OKR is committed: KRs are finalized, owners set, and downstream task-creation / KR-to-task linking may now happen. Subscribers in TASK-EXEC create placeholder work_items or link existing ones to the freshly-committed KRs.

A team-execution OKR is scored at end-of-cycle. Scoring is the cadence ritual on the WORK-MGMT side (Asana / Monday / ClickUp Goals models); distinct from TALENT-MGMT-side grading which is tied to performance review compensation. Cascades to dependent work_items closure and dashboard rollup.
An automation rule is enabled and begins firing on matching events. Audit observers and downstream surfaces (WSC, PSA, PROD-MGMT) may subscribe to know which rules are active in a tenant.
A user entitlement has been requested via the IGA access-request workflow. Routes to approver.
Approver granted the entitlement request. Routes to auto-provisioning.
The entitlement has been provisioned (SCIM/API write to the target application succeeded). User now has access. SMP sees the corresponding seat appear on next sync.
Periodic access certification confirmed the entitlement is still appropriate. Resets the next-certification timer.
Entitlement removed (leaver, manual revoke, or certification rejection). SMP-side seat is freed for reclamation on next sync.

A work_item is canceled. Distinct terminal from done (canceled signals rescinded scope; done signals completed scope). Gated by cancel_work_item permission so the cancellation is intentional and traceable.
A work_milestone has been reached. Downstream subscribers (dashboards, reports, PSA billable-milestone recognition when WORK-MGMT runs services delivery) react to milestone closure.
A work_milestone passed its date without being reached. Signals schedule slip; portfolio rollup and program review should re-baseline.
A single approver has approved this step. Approval chain advances to the next step or completes.
A single approver has rejected this step. Chain typically short-circuits to chain-level rejected.
All steps in the chain are approved; the gated work_item or work_project transition is now authorized.
At least one step rejected; the gated transition is denied and downstream subscribers should halt.
The initiator or admin canceled the approval chain before completion. Distinct from rejected (rescinded vs denied).
A work_project_template is now usable for seeding new projects across the workspace.
A work_task_template is now usable for seeding new work_items.
A work_form is now accepting submissions. Routing rules are active.
A work_form_submission has been converted to a work_item in the target project. The submission record stays for audit trail; downstream work happens on the spawned work_item.
A work_form_submission was rejected by the triage step (out of scope, duplicate, insufficient info). Submitter is typically notified.
A key_result is committed: target value, owner, and measurement cadence are finalized. Downstream KR-to-task linking can now happen.
A key_result reached its target value. End-of-cycle scoring on the parent okr_objective uses this signal.
A key_result ended the cycle below target. Scoring on the parent okr_objective reflects miss.
A user assigned as a typed owner of a SaaS application.
Ownership revoked (typically driven by HCM leaver or manual reassignment).
Integration connection configured against a SaaS app's API.
Integration authenticated successfully; sync active.
Integration sync degraded (auth expiry, rate-limit, API change). Triggers alert.
Integration disconnected; sync halted.
A catalog listing is published and visible to employees for requests.
A catalog listing is deprecated; new requests blocked but visible.
A catalog listing is removed from the catalog.
A new alert raised on the SaaS portfolio.
An alert acknowledged by an operator.
An alert resolved; underlying condition cleared.
An alert suppressed; will not re-raise for the suppression window.
A SaaS application advances to a new portfolio lifecycle stage.
A new optimization recommendation generated by SMP.
A recommendation accepted; triggers downstream action (reclamation, renewal change).
Recommended savings realized.
Recommendation dismissed without action.
An idle seat identified for reclamation.
User notified that a seat is up for reclamation; grace period begins.
Seat reclaimed; revocation executed via the IGA-side entitlement revocation.

Affected lots and the consignee response set have been consolidated for the recall, establishing the working scope for reconciliation.
Recovered, held, and outstanding quantities have been reconciled against the consolidated recall scope.
Recall effectiveness checks have confirmed the affected product was removed from commerce; closure evidence is recorded for audit.
The recall has been formally terminated after effectiveness verification and regulatory sign-off.

A traceability lot has been transformed into a new product lot; genealogy links the output lot to its input lots.
A traceability lot has been fully consumed and is no longer available; the lot record is retained for traceability.

Three or more positive environmental-monitoring results in 60 days at the same zone form an adverse trend; the program escalates for investigation.

An application enters sunsetting, signaling dependents to plan replacement, migration, or decommissioning.
A technology platform is classified as declining, signaling teams to avoid new investment and plan a path off it.
A technology platform is retired and no longer supported, requiring remaining workloads to move off it.
A technology fit assessment is approved, locking the verdict that drives invest, migrate, or eliminate decisions.
An application interface is deprecated, warning consumers to migrate to a supported integration before it is removed.
An application interface is retired and no longer available, breaking any integration still bound to it.
Employee self-assessment phase opens on the review cycle. Read-write access shifts to the worker for the self-rating window.
Manager assessment phase opens after self-assessment. The reviewing manager records ratings and narrative.
Manager submits the completed review for calibration. The record locks against further rating edits pending calibration.
Calibration adjusts the rating to fit the normalized distribution. The calibrated outcome supersedes the manager's draft rating.
Final review is released to the employee. Drives merit recommendations, 9-box derivation, and successor-readiness reassessment.
Goal is approved and committed for the period. The goal becomes active and measurable against its metric and weight.
Goal is canceled before completion (reorg, role change, deprioritization). The goal exits the active set without a completion outcome.
Calibration committee locks the normalized ratings at the end of the session. Reviews can no longer be re-rated for this population.
Calibration outcomes are published to the affected reviews and downstream consumers. The session reaches its terminal state.
Bench plan passes business-unit review of successors and readiness ratings ahead of publishing.
Superseded or expired succession plan is archived. The plan exits the active bench and is retained for audit.
Performance-by-potential placement is confirmed for the cycle. Drives succession-plan revision and differentiated investment.
Continuous-feedback record is shared with the recipient. Feeds the next formal review cycle as supporting context.
A kit has been assembled from its component items. Triggers component-consumption stock movements so component on-hand depletes and finished-kit on-hand increases.
A feature_request has been accepted into the roadmap. PROD-MGMT drafts a product_feature in PM-ROADMAP-DELIVERY and the request moves out of triage.
Engagement / pulse / lifecycle survey campaign closed. Response collection window shut; driver scores finalized and available for action planning and downstream analytics.
An engagement driver score crossed an at-risk threshold for a team or segment. Signals that the driver warrants a manager or HRBP action plan.
Issuer enters an exit process; cap-table moves toward wind-down.
Board commits to a modeled exit scenario as the operating plan.
Secondary share transfer approved and cleared to execute.

Investment committee approved the memo, recording the formal investment decision.
Limited partner has firmly committed capital, ready to convert into a fund commitment.
Limited partner has declined to commit for this fund.

A proposed sensitivity classification is approved by a steward and locks against further edits; downstream DLP/DSPM enforcement reads the approved rule.
A data access policy is signed off by its single accountable approver and locks; the platform access-control layer must enforce it.
A steward assignment is revoked, leaving the asset or term without an active steward until reassigned; escalation should fire if the gap persists.
A held reservation is ticketed and confirmed. The segment becomes a firm part of the itinerary and a charge is generated for downstream expense and spend reconciliation.
A ticketed reservation is canceled, removing the segment from the itinerary and potentially creating unused-ticket credit.
A planned trip has all segments booked. The trip record and its charges become available to expense and spend, and the traveler's location footprint becomes monitorable for duty of care.
The traveler has returned and the trip is complete. The final trip record is ready for expense reconciliation and program reporting.
A confirmed itinerary is disrupted (cancellation, delay, schedule change). Triggers rebooking and may raise a duty-of-care concern for the affected traveler.
A pre-trip authorization is approved, releasing the trip for booking or confirming an out-of-policy exception.
A pre-trip authorization is rejected; the trip may not proceed as proposed.

A plan line has been placed on the marketing calendar and handed to execution and delivery teams.
A spend record has been reconciled against its budget allocation, updating remaining budget and plan-to-actual variance.
Committed plus actual spend has exceeded the approved allocation for a plan line, signaling a budget overrun for review.

A safety incident investigation is complete and all corrective actions are closed.
A corrective or preventive action has been completed and its effectiveness verified.
An environmental permit is approaching its renewal or expiry date and requires action.
An environmental permit has expired without renewal, creating a compliance exposure.
A management-system audit is complete with all nonconformities dispositioned into corrective actions.
An industrial-hygiene sample result exceeds an occupational exposure limit, triggering review and control.
An emission or release record has been captured at an establishment and is available for corporate sustainability disclosure.
A lease has commenced: the right-of-use asset and lease liability are recognized and the initial journal entry is generated for posting to the general ledger.

A lease liability has been remeasured (discount-rate, index, or scope change), triggering a disclosure update for the period.
A lease journal entry has been approved and posted to the general ledger.
A lease-accounting disclosure has been finalized and filed for the reporting period.
A lease critical date is approaching its deadline: an alert fires to the lease administrator to act on the option, renewal, or notice.

A treatment or medicine has been administered, opening a withholding period that gates sale and slaughter eligibility until it clears.
A mob movement between paddocks or properties has completed; updates animal locations and feeds traceability-scheme movement reporting.
A mob has begun grazing an allocated paddock; the grazing plan advances and the paddock's rest clock resets on exit.
A paid social campaign moved live across its target ad platforms. Downstream: organic-side context in SMM, performance tracking begins.
A server-side conversion event was matched to paid social delivery. Downstream: attribution and incrementality, revenue analytics.
The optimization loop redistributed spend across ad sets on a pacing and ROAS signal. Downstream: budget owners notified, pacing dashboards update.
A monitored metric (CPA ceiling, ROAS floor, frequency cap, pacing) crossed a configured threshold. Downstream: alert to the performance marketer, possible auto-pause.
A creative cleared review and is eligible to publish into live ads. Downstream: campaign orchestration consumes the approved creative.
A triaged alert crossed the escalation threshold and an insider-risk case is opened. Carries the user, contributing indicators, and risk score.
A user's risk score crossed a configured threshold, signaling elevated insider risk and prompting alert generation.
A substantiating case is handed to HR and Legal with its evidence package for employment-action or legal-hold decisions.
Investigation concluded the insider risk is substantiated; the case carries findings and recommended actions.
A departing employee exhibited high exit-related data-theft risk during the monitoring window; raises an alert or opens a case.
Heightened exit-risk monitoring started for an employee entering a resignation, transfer, or termination window.
A process instance finished its end event. Carries the instance id, definition key, and final variables; downstream domains react to the business outcome.
A process instance was terminated before completing, by operator action or an error end event.
A person completed a human task; the engine advances the waiting process instance.
A job exhausted its retries or hit an unhandled error; the instance is blocked pending resolution. Operations subscribes to triage.
A new version of a decision table went live; running processes now evaluate against it.
A case was closed after its milestones were met or it was resolved; downstream record-keeping is notified.
A frontline broadcast was published to its audience; downstream channels deliver it and acknowledgment tracking starts.
A worker acknowledged a mandatory broadcast; the read-receipt is recorded as policy-compliance proof.
A frontline task was completed with its required evidence; store, plant, or field operations consumes the completion.
A manager approved a shift swap; the approved swap is handed to Workforce Management to update the schedule of record.
A worker received recognition in the frontline feed; the recognition is visible to the team.
A frontline worker completed a microlearning module; completion is tracked against the worker and role.
An approved advocacy content item is published to advocates and becomes shareable. Triggers newsletter inclusion and availability in advocate feeds.
An employee share is successfully posted to a linked personal social account. Drives share-metric collection, points award, and downstream reach and attribution.
An advocacy campaign goes live, opening its content set and participation targets to advocates for the campaign window.
Cumulative reach or earned media value from advocacy shares crosses a reporting threshold, signaling material program impact for revenue attribution.
A listing is activated and becomes bookable. The reservations module can accept inquiries and bookings against it; channel connections push it live to OTAs.
A reservation is confirmed. Fires turnover scheduling in operations and a revenue accrual on the owner statement in trust accounting.
A guest checks out. Fires the turnover-clean task and finalizes the occupancy/lodging-tax record for the stay.
A slip contract is activated. The inventory module reserves the seasonal slip and the billing module begins generating recurring charges.
A reservation is confirmed. The inventory module assigns a slip and the billing module accrues the dockage charge for the stay.
A vessel checks out. The billing module finalizes utility and dockage charges and issues the invoice for the stay.
A boatyard work order is completed. The billing module invoices the labor, parts, and haul-out charges to the boater.
A target account list is approved in GTM-PLAN and handed to engagement.
An ICP definition is updated in GTM-PLAN.
A feature has been committed to delivery and pulled into implementation.
A portfolio epic has completed delivery.
A program increment plan has been committed at the end of PI planning.
A delivery value stream has been modeled and activated for flow measurement.
A delivery bottleneck has been detected in a value stream from measured flow.
The investment mix of work in a value stream has shifted beyond a configured threshold (e.g. defect or debt load rising).
A booking is confirmed (payment captured or hold accepted). Drives guide assignment, waiver dispatch, manifest update, and channel availability sync.
A booking is cancelled by guest or operator. Releases capacity, may trigger a refund, and frees assigned guides and equipment.
A booking is completed after the activity takes place. Feeds the customer record and history downstream and prompts a review request.
A refund is processed back to the customer. Exports the financial adjustment to accounting.
A waiver is dispatched to a participant for electronic signature via the e-signature provider.
A participant signs their liability waiver. Marks the participant ready and attaches the signed release to the booking.
A guide confirms assignment to a departure. Updates the departure manifest and notifies the customer.
A departure is completed. Closes out its bookings, releases resources, and triggers review requests.
